Pitch: Airwallex is a global financial technology platform that enables businesses to manage cross-border payments, open global business accounts, and control company spending through a unified platform. It offers powerful solutions including payments, treasury, spend management, and embedded finance via APIs, serving over 150,000 companies worldwide. Leveraging a proprietary banking network and machine learning, Airwallex facilitates efficient local and international transactions in around 130 countries. Its platform supports businesses of all sizes, from small enterprises to large organizations, helping them scale globally while reducing costs and complexity.
Investors: Square Peg, Visa Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, Blackbird, Airtree

Pitch: Gravitee is an open-source scalable API management platform that enables enterprises to manage APIs, event streams, and digital traffic pipelines securely and efficiently. Its core products include an event-native API gateway, agent mesh, and support for event streaming across protocols, designed to unify synchronous and asynchronous data flows. Gravitee targets large enterprises undergoing digital transformation, offering flexible deployment options including on-premises, self-hosted, and SaaS. Recognized as a 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for API Management, Gravitee stands out by providing comprehensive control, security, and observability for complex modern data systems integrating AI agents, streaming data, and hybrid architectures.
Investors: Sixth Street Growth, Riverside Acceleration Capital, Albion VC

Pitch: Juvenescence is a clinical-stage biotech company focused on extending healthy human lifespan by developing innovative medicines that target core aging mechanisms. Their pipeline includes multiple therapies in Phase I or II trials aimed at preventing and treating age-related diseases through small molecules, biologics, and cell therapies. With a world-class R&D team leveraging advanced data science, Juvenescence aims to transform aging by promoting early disease intervention and regeneration to increase healthspan and lifespan. The company is headquartered in Ireland and is recognized for pioneering prevention in longevity medicine.

Legora is a collaborative AI platform designed specifically for lawyers, enabling them to review documents faster, draft smarter, and conduct deeper legal research with precision. It serves top law firms and legal teams globally, offering a bespoke AI workspace that enhances efficiency and collaboration. With adoption across 250 firms in 20 markets, Legora stands out by combining advanced AI technology with legal expertise to address complex challenges effectively. The company has quickly grown and gained significant traction, supported by prestigious clients and major investors.
Investors: Iconiq Growth, General Catalyst, Redpoint Ventures, Benchmark, Y Combinator

Pitch: LM Arena is a platform that enables AI researchers, developers, and enthusiasts to compare and evaluate large language models (LLMs) through interactive testing and crowdsourced feedback. It features a chat interface for side-by-side model comparisons, an Elo rating system to rank model performance, and supports both proprietary and open-source AI models. The platform is free to use and emphasizes transparency and community participation, allowing users worldwide to help advance AI development collectively.
Investors: Andreessen Horowitz, UC Investments, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Felicis Ventures, Kleiner Perkins

Pitch: Siro is an AI-powered coaching platform designed to improve the performance of field sales representatives by recording and analyzing in-person sales conversations. Its AI surfaces real audio examples from top performers, enabling reps to self-coach between appointments, which leads to measurable improvements such as 20% revenue growth and 9% higher close rates. Targeting sales teams that operate in the field, Siro uniquely combines real-time conversation insights with personalized coaching to increase sales effectiveness and reduce employee turnover. The company recently raised $50 million to expand its solution, emphasizing its mission to empower sales reps often overlooked by traditional tech tools.

World is a fintech company based in the United States that provides financial technology solutions aimed at improving global financial access and inclusion. Their core offerings likely include digital payment systems and financial services tailored for diverse markets, enabling seamless cross-border transactions. What makes World valuable is its focus on leveraging technology to democratize financial services, making them accessible to underserved populations worldwide.

Barndoor AI provides the first centralized control plane for managing agentic AI workforces in enterprises. Their platform enables IT and security teams to govern granular access, enforce policies, and monitor AI agent activity across organizations, ensuring security and compliance. Barndoor’s solution helps businesses harness AI at scale with visibility and accountability, reducing risk while enabling faster innovation. Founded in 2024, it targets large enterprises seeking to operationalize AI safely and effectively.
Investors: Crosslink Capital, Preface Ventures, Precursor Ventures, Gaingels

Pitch: Blues is a Boston-based leader in IoT connectivity solutions, providing a platform that enables secure cloud connection for any physical product via a single API supporting all major wireless standards. Their technology helps manufacturers in industries such as refrigeration, logistics, automotive batteries, and power grid components transform physical products into data-driven intelligent services. By simplifying IoT connectivity, Blues enables enhanced monitoring, operational efficiency, and new revenue streams for companies ranging from startups to large enterprises. Their recent $25 million funding led by Sequoia Capital will accelerate growth and product innovation to expand these capabilities.

Clair is a fintech company that provides compliant Earned Wage Access (EWA) services, allowing employees to access their earned wages instantly through integration within payroll, workforce management, and scheduling apps. Their platform targets businesses and gig platforms, enabling workers to get paid daily without high or hidden fees. Clair emphasizes financial freedom and transparency, embedding their product directly into apps employees already use, making on-demand pay a seamless employee benefit. The company is backed by leading investors and partners with major payroll providers like Gusto and TriNet to expand access to earned wages in real time.

Converge is a UK-based construction technology company that digitizes the construction process with AI-powered and wireless concrete monitoring sensors. Their core products include advanced concrete sensors and predictive AI tools that enable real-time monitoring of concrete strength and temperature, optimizing construction speed, quality, and sustainability. They serve large contractors by providing integrated solutions like ConcreteDNA for data management and logistics optimization, helping to reduce carbon footprint and accelerate project timelines. Their technology supports safer, more efficient, and environmentally friendly building practices.

DataHub, by Acryl Data, is a leading open-source metadata platform that provides enterprises with real-time context management for AI and data assets. Its flagship SaaS product, DataHub Cloud, offers AI-powered discovery, observability, and governance capabilities designed for extreme scale and performance. Serving over 3,000 organizations including Apple and Netflix, DataHub uniquely enables comprehensive visibility, reliability, and trust in AI and data ecosystems, positioning itself as a leader in AI and data context management. The company recently raised $35 million in Series B funding to accelerate development and expand its open-source community and AI governance solutions.
Investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Tru Arrow, SineWave

Pitch: Filed is a fintech company that provides an automated platform for managing and filing insurance claims efficiently. It offers tools designed to simplify the claims process for businesses and individuals by automating documentation and submission workflows. Filed's solution targets customers seeking to reduce the complexity and time involved in claims management, making insurance interactions faster and more transparent. Its unique value lies in leveraging automation to streamline traditionally manual and cumbersome insurance procedures.
Investors: Northzone, Day One Ventures, J Ventures, Neo, Raine, Greens Ventures

Pitch: Greenlite AI provides an AI-driven platform that automates up to 95% of anti-money laundering (AML), sanction screening, and know-your-customer (KYC) compliance tasks for financial institutions and fintechs. Their software helps compliance teams reduce time spent on enhanced due diligence reviews by nearly 70%, improving accuracy and efficiency while lowering costs. Trusted by clients like Grasshopper Bank and Coastal Community Bank, Greenlite's solution enables scaling of compliance efforts to protect against financial crimes such as terrorism funding and human trafficking. The company is backed by top investors including Greylock and Thomson Reuters Ventures.
Investors: Greylock, Thomson Reuters Ventures, Canvas Prime, Y Combinator

Pitch: Lendflow provides embedded credit infrastructure solutions that enable fintechs, lenders, and vertical SaaS companies to integrate and launch lending services seamlessly within their platforms. Their flexible, modular, and low-code technology includes components like credit decisioning and instant checkout, helping businesses improve customer acquisition, engagement, and capital access. Lendflow's platform empowers companies to offer fairer, more transparent, and efficient lending experiences, supported by AI-driven data intelligence and automation. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Lendflow focuses on democratizing access to credit and scaling lending operations with simplicity and flexibility.

PHASE Scientific is a Hong Kong-headquartered biotech company specializing in novel urine-based diagnostic tools and services for early detection of cancer, women's health conditions, and infectious diseases. Their proprietary PHASIFY technology enables concentration and purification of urine samples to capture significantly more biomarkers than current standards, allowing non-invasive, at-home testing and improving early disease detection sensitivity. The company has developed over 30 diagnostic products and aims to shift healthcare focus from treatment to prevention by empowering proactive health management. PHASE Scientific recently raised $34 million in Series A funding to accelerate R&D and commercialization of their next-generation diagnostics globally.

Reperio Health offers the only comprehensive at-home annual wellness screening kit with instant results, eliminating the need for lab-based blood tests. Their FDA-cleared, Bluetooth-connected medical devices pair with a mobile app that guides users through preventive screenings measuring metrics such as blood pressure, heart rate, cholesterol, and glucose. The platform includes AI-assisted real-time virtual care to analyze data and provide personalized insights and follow-up recommendations. Targeting individuals seeking convenient, preventive healthcare, Reperio uniquely combines instant, comprehensive testing with on-demand virtual primary care, improving access and reducing strain on the healthcare system.

Rivan is a UK-based ClimateTech company designing and manufacturing modular synthetic fuel plants powered by off-grid solar energy. Their technology captures carbon from the air and combines it with green hydrogen produced via electrolysis to create carbon-neutral synthetic fuels that are chemically identical to fossil fuels. Targeting hard-to-decarbonize heavy industries like steel, cement, and chemicals, Rivan aims to provide cost-competitive, drop-in fuel replacements that enhance energy security in the UK and Europe. Their unique vertically integrated approach and pilot deployments demonstrate scalable solutions for industrial decarbonization and energy resilience.

Sweep provides a sustainability management platform that helps organizations unlock the value of their sustainability data. It offers tools to track, analyze, and report on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) metrics, enabling companies to drive impactful sustainability initiatives. Trusted by industry leaders, Sweep stands out for its comprehensive data integration and real-time insights that support corporate responsibility and compliance goals.

True Markets is a U.S.-based fintech company founded by veterans from Coinbase, Circle, and Goldman Sachs, focusing on providing a crypto trading platform tailored for retail users. Their platform, TrueX, offers a stablecoin-native order book and advanced low-latency APIs designed to optimize trading strategies with robust liquidity and strong security by leveraging an external qualified custodian. True Markets aims to serve the underserved U.S. retail crypto market with fast, cost-effective, and well-designed trading tools, supporting major cryptocurrencies like Solana, Bitcoin, and Ethereum. Their team’s extensive experience in both traditional finance and crypto enables them to build foundational, innovative exchange technology that addresses past industry failures and enhances user trust and performance.
Investors: Accomplice, RRE Ventures, Reciprocal Ventures, Variant Fund, PayPal Ventures

Pitch: Veesion is a French retail tech company specializing in AI-driven video surveillance software designed to prevent shoplifting. Their technology continuously analyzes existing CCTV feeds in stores to detect suspicious behaviors such as gestures indicating theft, sending real-time alerts to store owners or security personnel via an app. The system prioritizes privacy by focusing on human movements without capturing identifiable information. Installed in over 6,000 stores across 25 countries, Veesion offers a unique, privacy-friendly solution to enhance retail security and reduce losses from theft.
Investors: White Star Capital, Red River West, Bpifrance, Odyssée Ventures, Verve Ventures, Founders Future

Pitch: Clarity Security offers a simple, scalable identity governance platform designed to make compliance audits and user access reviews easy for organizations of all sizes. Their solution leverages machine learning to provide clear visibility into identity and access data, robust reporting, and risk-based access control across hybrid environments. Targeting security teams, Clarity integrates with existing tech stacks to reduce complexity and automate identity lifecycle management, helping to mitigate risks and streamline audit compliance.

Ontik is a London-based fintech company that automates trade credit and payment operations for B2B wholesalers, targeting sectors like the UK building materials industry. Their AI-powered platform streamlines the order-to-cash cycle by issuing credit terms, following up on payments, resolving disputes, and integrating with ERP systems, significantly reducing manual tasks. Ontik's solution helps businesses cut card fees, accelerate cash collection, and improve operational efficiency, positioning itself as the "Stripe for the real economy." With notable clients and recent seed funding, Ontik aims to modernize financial workflows in traditionally manual sectors.
Investors: Firstminute Capital, PT1, Illusian, FJ Labs, Seed X, Tiny VC

Pitch: Pay-i is a Seattle-based value-intelligence platform for Generative AI that helps enterprises track and quantify the financial impact of their AI applications. Its platform connects every model call, prompt, and token to measurable business outcomes such as revenue growth, task completion time, or customer satisfaction uplift. Users can assign explicit dollar or time values to key performance indicators, compare different AI models or prompts, and leverage a forecasting engine to project future returns. This enables product, finance, and engineering leaders to prioritize effective AI use cases, optimize spending, and scale AI initiatives with confidence before full production deployment.
Investors: Fuse Partners, Tola Capital, Firestreak, Pear VC, Gaia Capital

Pitch: Rad AI is a healthcare technology company specializing in AI-powered radiology solutions designed to save time, reduce physician burnout, and improve patient care. Their core products include Rad AI Reporting for rapid report generation using machine learning and generative AI, Rad AI Impressions for automatic summary creation, and Rad AI Continuity to ensure follow-up on incidental findings. Serving nearly 50% of U.S. health systems and imaging practices, Rad AI is recognized as one of the fastest-growing radiologist-led AI companies with significant adoption across the healthcare industry.
Investors: Advocate Health, Memorial Hermann Health System, Corewell Health, Atlantic Health System

Pitch: Ravical is a Belgian AI company that develops domain-trained AI agents for expert firms in accounting, tax, insurance, HR, and legal sectors. Their AI-powered virtual employees automate routine and repeatable tasks by leveraging deep domain expertise, firm-specific knowledge, and client context. This enables expert firms to deliver timely, high-quality communication at scale, improving efficiency and customer experience. Ravical recently raised €7.3 million to expand its technology and support international growth.

Seeds is a fintech company providing a modern investment management platform designed for registered investment advisors (RIAs). It enables advisors to create personalized, values-aligned portfolios at scale while streamlining portfolio operations. Founded by financial advisors, Seeds focuses on delivering a deeply personalized and human-centered investing experience that addresses the growing demand for customized investment solutions. The platform aims to transform traditional wealth management by enhancing client engagement and simplifying the investment lifecycle.

Sention Technologies, founded in 2022 and based in London, UK, specializes in advanced battery diagnostics using proprietary ultrasonic imaging combined with AI-driven analytics. Their flagship product, Senturion, non-invasively generates 3D images of internal battery structures to detect hidden flaws, predict degradation, and enhance safety and longevity. Targeting battery manufacturers and innovators in the electrification and renewable energy sectors, Sention’s technology offers a faster, safer, and more affordable alternative to traditional quality control methods, reducing waste and costly recalls. Their solutions support sustainable battery production and enable smarter quality assurance across R&D labs to gigafactories.
Investors: Twin Path Ventures, Doral Energy-Tech Ventures, Endgame Capital, Energy Revolution Ventures, G.K. Goh Ventures, Green Angel Ventures, Third Sphere, UK Innovation and Science Seed Fund

Pitch: VERO is an automated tenant screening platform that streamlines rental screening for property managers and renters, enabling faster, fairer, and more reliable leasing decisions. The platform offers verified identity, income, and background checks through an applicant-driven, digital process accessible via any web browser, reducing lead-to-lease times and minimizing delinquencies and evictions. VERO provides property teams with standardized, unbiased screening reports to ensure consistent and transparent decisions while giving renters a convenient, stress-free experience. Founded by an industry insider, VERO aims to modernize rental operations by combining technology with human expertise to improve occupancy and rental outcomes.
Investors: Fifth Wall, Sunriver Capital Partners, Rebuild Capital

Pitch: XP.NETWORK is a leading multichain NFT bridge that enables seamless transfer of NFTs and funds across various blockchain networks, supporting both EVM and non-EVM chains. It offers an integrated ecosystem with hundreds of NFT project integrations, a bridge widget for easy NFT bridging, and a Web 3.0 JS API for dApps to create scalable cross-chain applications. The platform uniquely connects isolated blockchain ecosystems to create a unified global network of interoperable NFT markets, making it the largest cross-chain NFT ecosystem in Web3. XP.NETWORK targets NFT projects, developers, and users seeking efficient, cross-chain NFT interoperability and staking rewards.

Zoca is an AI-first growth platform that supports local service businesses, particularly in beauty and wellness, by automating their entire marketing and customer engagement funnel. Its AI agents identify neighborhood service demand, optimize online discovery, convert leads into bookings, and re-engage clients to keep calendars full and drive real revenue. Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni Ashish Verma and Robin Chauhan, Zoca uniquely replaces multiple marketing tools with one intelligent system tailored for hyperlocal businesses. It has already helped over 1,000 businesses generate $10M+ in revenue and book more than 120,000 appointments.
Investors: Accel, GTMfund, Elevation Capital, Better Capital

Pitch: OpenFX is a fintech company revolutionizing cross-border foreign exchange payments by providing a real-time FX payment infrastructure that operates 24/7, enabling near-instant settlement. Their platform reduces settlement times by 90% and costs by up to 80-90% compared to traditional FX systems, targeting businesses and financial institutions engaged in global transactions. OpenFX's network addresses inefficiencies in the $7.5 trillion daily FX market by eliminating delays, high fees, and trapped working capital, making cross-border money movement as seamless and fast as data transfer.

Novisto is a Canadian ClimateTech company offering a SaaS platform that automates the collection, management, and reporting of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) data for corporations. Its platform serves as a system of record that supports sustainability data tracking, auditability, and benchmarking against industry peers. Target customers include large enterprises such as Meta, JetBlue, and Sanofi, seeking to manage and disclose their ESG efforts efficiently. Novisto's unique value lies in its comprehensive approach to ESG management that goes beyond reporting to enable broader sustainability function management and regulatory compliance.
Investors: Inovia Capital, White Star Capital, SCOR Ventures, Sagard

Pitch: Tarjama is a UAE-based AI company specializing in advanced Arabic language technology, offering solutions such as the Pronoia Arabic-first large language model and the Arabic.AI platform. Their technology outperforms major models like GPT-4 on Arabic language benchmarks, enabling near-human understanding for applications including legal analysis, translation, and business operations. Tarjama targets Middle Eastern enterprises by transforming complex Arabic tasks from hours to minutes, distinguishing itself with a focus on Arabic language nuances and regional market needs. The company recently raised $15 million in Series A funding to expand its AI ecosystem and regional presence.
Investors: Global Ventures, Wamda Capital, TA Ventures, Phaze Ventures

Pitch: Optura is a Nashville-based healthcare technology company that provides an AI-powered enterprise operating system designed to help healthcare organizations manage and optimize clinical workflows and AI initiatives. Its platform includes core components such as the Intent Engine, Operator, and Librarian, which enable executives to define goals, track performance in real time, and continuously learn from workflows and regulations for smarter AI orchestration. Targeting health plans and payer organizations, Optura offers unique value by delivering a full-stack orchestration layer that supports safe, efficient, and scalable AI deployment across enterprises. Founded in 2024 and led by CEO Andy Fanning, the company recently raised $6.5 million in seed funding to expand its healthcare-specific AI agents library and accelerate product development.

Awardco is a US-based HR tech company specializing in employee rewards and recognition software that helps organizations boost engagement, performance, and workplace culture. Their platform offers a centralized system for recognizing employees with flexible reward options including gift cards, swag, and stipends, supporting both in-office and remote teams. Awardco integrates with existing benefits and perks programs, providing scalable and easy-to-manage solutions trusted worldwide for data compliance and security. The company emphasizes value-based recognition to improve retention, motivation, and productivity across diverse workforces.
Investors: Sixth Street, Spectrum Equity, General Catalyst

Pitch: Keep is a Canadian fintech company providing an all-in-one financial platform tailored for small and medium-sized businesses. Their offerings include a business credit card with high limits and rewards, automated expense management, multicurrency accounts, and global bill pay, all designed to reduce fees and streamline operations. Founded in 2022, Keep aims to address the shortcomings of traditional banks by delivering integrated, flexible financial services that help Canadian entrepreneurs thrive. The platform has rapidly grown, onboarding over 3,000 SMBs and targeting 100,000 by 2027.

Autobooks is a Detroit-based fintech company that provides embedded banking technology and integrated payment, invoicing, and accounting tools tailored for small and medium-sized businesses. It partners with financial institutions to offer these services seamlessly within online and mobile banking platforms, helping banks compete with non-bank fintechs. Autobooks also supports contactless and online payments, professional invoicing, and full financial management, making it easier for small businesses to manage finances and get paid faster. Their recent acquisition of Allied Payment Network expands their capabilities to include bill payment and disbursement solutions, enhancing their value proposition to financial institutions and their small business customers.

Moneyfarm is a leading European digital wealth management company offering personalized investment solutions through a combination of advanced technology and expert human support. It provides a range of tax-efficient accounts including ISAs, pensions, and junior ISAs tailored to individual financial goals and risk profiles. Serving over 160,000 investors and managing more than £4 billion in assets, Moneyfarm enables clients to access institutional-level portfolio management with the convenience of online investing. The company is regulated by the FCA in the UK and focuses on delivering comprehensive, transparent, and accessible wealth management services.

Tradeverifyd is an AI-powered supply chain risk management platform that provides enterprises with real-time risk intelligence, predictive insights, and compliance tools to enhance supply chain visibility and resilience. Its proprietary Tradeverifyd Score™ enables organizations to assess supplier reliability, anticipate disruptions, and take proactive corrective actions. The platform integrates open-source and enterprise data to visualize supply chains, continuously monitor risks, and deliver actionable mitigation strategies, transforming compliance from a burden into a strategic advantage. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, Tradeverifyd helps businesses navigate complex global trade environments securely and sustainably.

PiLogic is a U.S.-based aerospace company pioneering "exact AI," a mathematically precise, expert-guided artificial intelligence designed for mission-critical decision-making in aerospace, defense, and space technologies. Their platform integrates probabilistic inference, logical reasoning, search, and machine learning to deliver faster, more accurate AI models that require significantly less computing power than generative AI models. PiLogic's technology enables deployment on remote devices like satellites without high compute costs, addressing critical needs for precision and reliability in high-stakes environments. The company recently raised $4 million to scale its AI models for aerospace and defense applications.

Rhizome offers an AI-powered SaaS platform that helps electric utilities quantify and manage climate-related risks to their infrastructure. Their platform models climate impacts and identifies vulnerabilities within the power grid to prioritize resilience investments and strengthen grid reliability against extreme weather events. By integrating advanced AI, climate science, and utility expertise, Rhizome enables smarter, data-driven planning to protect communities and reduce costly outages. This unique combination supports utilities in addressing escalating climate threats with confidence and precision.

Sangha Renewables develops bitcoin mining facilities powered by renewable energy, focusing on transforming underutilized renewable assets into high-yield, bitcoin-generating infrastructure. Their flagship project is a 19.9 MW mining facility in West Texas operating behind-the-meter on a large-scale solar site. The company offers investors direct participation in site-level projects through a project finance model, providing streaming bitcoin distributions at below-market prices. This approach optimizes power monetization and delivers attractive bitcoin-backed returns while supporting sustainable energy use.

Flip is a German HR tech company providing a secure employee platform designed specifically for deskless frontline workers. Its app connects employees with relevant people, news, information, and tools to streamline daily workflows and improve communication between headquarters and frontline teams. Trusted by over 500 companies including Porsche, McDonald’s, and Bosch, Flip helps HR, Communications, and Operations teams increase productivity by digitizing all touchpoints with deskless workers. The platform's AI-driven capabilities and focus on frontline workforce engagement make it a unique and valuable solution in the HR tech space.

SparkCharge offers mobile electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions primarily for commercial fleets, providing charging-as-a-service (CaaS) through their portable, powerful, and modular Roadie Charging System. Their technology enables DC fast charging anywhere without the need for fixed infrastructure, supported by an app that allows EV drivers to charge on demand. This unique combination of hardware, software, and service creates the world's largest mobile EV charging network, targeting businesses seeking flexible and scalable EV charging options.

LMArena is an open platform created by UC Berkeley researchers that allows users to access, explore, and interact with leading AI models. It enables the community to compare AI responses side by side and vote for the better ones, thereby shaping a public leaderboard that promotes transparency and real-world evaluation of AI progress. The platform targets AI researchers, developers, and enthusiasts who want to benchmark and improve AI models through collective human feedback. LMArena’s unique value lies in its crowdsourced approach to AI benchmarking and its mission to make the best AI models accessible and improvable by everyone.

Sparxell develops high-performance, sustainable, plant-based pigments made from naturally reflective cellulose crystals extracted from wood pulp and agricultural waste. Their biodegradable colourants replicate vibrant natural hues without toxicity, targeting industries such as beauty, fashion, packaging, and paint. The technology reduces environmental impact by eliminating fossil-based chemicals and microplastics while enhancing colour intensity, durability, and recyclability. Sparxell collaborates with leading brands and is scaling production to meet growing demand in the $48 billion colourants market.

Penfold is a UK-based fintech company offering a digital workplace pension platform designed to simplify auto-enrolment and retirement saving for businesses and their employees. Their proprietary platform enables employers to sign up or switch pensions quickly, targeting SMEs and the self-employed, a group often underserved by traditional pension providers. Penfold's app allows users to manage contributions flexibly, including pausing or changing payments, catering especially to freelancers with variable incomes. The company aims to improve financial wellbeing by making pension saving easy, affordable, and efficient, supported by rapid growth and recent £3.9 million funding to scale its digital offering across the UK.

Kota is an Irish insurtech company revolutionizing employee benefits by providing a modern, user-friendly platform and app that integrates directly with insurers and pension providers. It targets startups and scaling organizations, enabling them to automate and manage employee benefits such as pensions and healthcare, which are often inaccessible due to legacy systems. Kota is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland and aims to make benefits effortless for HR and Finance teams while engaging employees with real-time access and control. Its unique API-driven infrastructure addresses a largely underserved market by replacing manual, disconnected processes with a seamless digital experience.

trawa is a Berlin-based ClimateTech company that provides AI-powered energy procurement and management solutions to small and medium-sized businesses. Their platform analyzes customers' electricity consumption to create transparent cost and CO₂ emission data and then optimizes the purchase of affordable green electricity sourced from renewables like solar and wind. By enabling SMBs to access renewable energy portfolios similar to large corporations, trawa professionalizes energy procurement and helps reduce the carbon footprint of German companies. The company recently raised €10 million to further develop its AI-driven platform and expand its offering amid Europe's energy crisis.

ReproNovo is a Swiss healthcare company focused on developing innovative therapeutic solutions to address critical gaps in reproductive medicine and women's health. Founded in 2021, it targets male and female infertility as well as uterine conditions like adenomyosis. The company is advancing clinical candidates including RPN-001 and RPN-002, both ready for Phase 2 trials, with operations in Lausanne, Copenhagen, and Barcelona. Its unique value lies in combining deep expertise in drug development and clinical programs to pioneer new treatments for infertility and women's reproductive health worldwide.

POPEcoin is an Italy-based memecoin project that combines historical narrative with meme culture, inspired by the 1809 imprisonment of Pope Pius VII. It offers instant token acquisition with automatic staking to earn rewards, alongside a dedicated staking dApp for claiming tokens and yields. The project is developing POPEchain, a Bitcoin Layer 2 infrastructure for on-chain storytelling and decentralized culture, with plans for NFT Relics and a gamified VaticanVerse metaverse experience. POPEcoin aims to bridge cultural themes with blockchain innovation, targeting crypto enthusiasts interested in narrative-driven tokens and digital collectibles.

Alt Carbon is an India-based climate tech company specializing in Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) through Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW). Their technology uses basalt rock dust spread on agricultural fields to naturally convert CO2 into stable bicarbonate ions stored in soil and oceans for over 10,000 years, simultaneously improving soil health and crop yields. Founded in 2023, Alt Carbon targets South Asia with initiatives like The Darjeeling Revival Project, aiming to remove 5 million metric tons of CO2 by 2030 while restoring ecosystems and supporting local livelihoods. Their approach is supported by strategic partnerships and large funding rounds, establishing them as a leader in scalable climate action in the region[1][2][4][5].

CloudSEK is a Singapore-based cybersecurity company specializing in AI-driven digital risk management through its flagship platform, XVigil. It provides enterprises with predictive threat analytics, brand monitoring, attack surface monitoring, and software supply chain risk assessment. The platform automates the detection, analysis, and alerting of external cyber threats across the surface, deep, and dark web, helping organizations proactively manage their security posture. CloudSEK's unique value lies in its use of AI to emulate human cognitive abilities for faster, more accurate threat intelligence and response.

Borderless is a global payments fintech company that provides API-driven payout solutions for marketplaces and businesses worldwide. It enables clients to hold funds in over 35 currencies and make payments to more than 120 countries with transparent, low fees and competitive foreign exchange rates. Its unique multi-rail smart infrastructure connects various local payout systems and payment rails under one platform, optimizing cost and speed for international transactions. This makes Borderless valuable for businesses seeking efficient, scalable cross-border payment capabilities.

Strava is a leading fitness-tracking platform that connects millions of athletes worldwide through its mobile app and website, enabling users to record and analyze activities like running, cycling, and swimming. It offers GPS-based tracking, detailed performance metrics, route planning with 3D maps, and a social network for athletes to share workouts and compete. Strava’s premium subscription, Strava Summit, provides advanced coaching, analytics, and safety features. The platform’s unique combination of activity tracking, social engagement, and data-driven insights makes it valuable for fitness enthusiasts and urban planners alike.
Investors: Sequoia Capital, TCV, Jackson Square Ventures, Go4it Capital

Pitch: Pixee is an enterprise-grade cybersecurity platform that automates the last mile of application security by triaging and automatically fixing vulnerabilities detected by code scanning tools. It integrates directly into developer workflows, enabling faster, more secure code delivery without sacrificing productivity. Founded by industry veterans, Pixee leverages agentic AI and deterministic techniques to provide trusted code fixes with a high merge rate, helping developers and security teams reclaim valuable time and accelerate innovation.

Slash is a fintech company offering a business banking platform tailored for entrepreneurs and diverse industries. It provides deposit accounts, corporate cards with up to 2% cash back, unlimited virtual cards, and advanced spend controls, all integrated with major accounting platforms. Slash stands out by combining traditional banking reliability with industry-specific features, enabling businesses to operate efficiently with tools like real-time analytics, multi-entity management, and seamless fiat-to-crypto conversion. Their platform is secure, developer-friendly, and designed to save time while enhancing financial insights and control.
Investors: Goodwater Capital, Y Combinator, NEA, Stanford University, Menlo Ventures

Pitch: Astrolight is a Lithuanian aerospace company specializing in advanced laser-based optical communication terminals that enable secure, high-speed data links between satellites, ground stations, and ships. The company develops end-to-end communication architecture for space-to-Earth, space-to-space, and ship-to-ship connectivity, targeting satellite operators and defense sectors. Founded by experienced space tech professionals, Astrolight's unique value lies in its fully integrated technology stack designed to create a scalable optical backbone network for space data transmission.

Sublime Systems develops innovative technology to produce decarbonized cement as a drop-in replacement for traditional ready-mix, delivering equivalent performance without the environmental impact. Their process addresses the significant carbon emissions from cement production, aiming to scale sustainable cement manufacturing with pilot and commercial plants in Massachusetts. The company has secured over $200 million in funding from leading climate tech investors and major global building materials companies, enabling accelerated deployment and industry collaboration. Sublime's technology is validated by partnerships with industry leaders like Holcim and CRH, positioning it uniquely to decarbonize the cement sector at scale.
