Novëm emphasizes eco-conscious production with eco-designed, refillable packaging and local manufacturing in the Grenoble region. The brand offers skincare routines and discovery sets that combine efficacy, sensory experience, and sustainability, targeting consumers seeking clean, effective, and environmentally friendly beauty products.

Ecomer Data is a French ClimateTech company specializing in providing data-driven solutions to support environmental sustainability. They focus on leveraging data analytics to help businesses and organizations monitor and reduce their environmental impact. Their unique approach combines advanced data technologies with climate expertise to deliver actionable insights, enabling clients to make informed decisions towards decarbonization and climate resilience.

Every is a media company based in the United States that creates high-quality, long-form newsletters and content aimed at professionals and knowledge workers. Its platform offers deeply researched, well-written essays and insights that help subscribers stay informed and think critically about important topics. Every stands out for its focus on thoughtful, in-depth analysis rather than quick news bites, providing valuable perspectives that empower its audience to engage meaningfully with complex issues.

WorkDone is a healthcare AI startup that provides a real-time AI compliance copilot designed to prevent costly medical documentation errors in Electronic Health Records (EHRs). By integrating directly with hospital EHR systems, WorkDone continuously monitors clinical workflows to detect and fix issues such as missed discharge notes or incorrect medication times before they lead to denied insurance claims or audits. Its platform enhances compliance, reduces denied claims, and improves revenue recovery while supporting clinicians without disrupting existing workflows. WorkDone's unique real-time AI approach helps healthcare providers protect patients, avoid penalties, and improve operational efficiency.

Hedra is a next-generation multimodal AI content creation platform that enables users to create expressive, talking, and singing human character videos from simple text and images. Their flagship product, Hedra Studio, allows anyone—from individual creators to marketing teams—to produce professional-quality character-driven videos quickly and easily without technical expertise. With advanced AI models like Character-3, Hedra offers precise control and seamless integration into creative workflows, making digital storytelling accessible and engaging. The platform has attracted around 3 million users and has powered over 10 million videos, serving a diverse range of creators including TikTok comedians and Fortune 500 marketers.

Tomorrow Bio is a Germany-based company specializing in advanced cryopreservation services using cutting-edge biostasis technology to preserve individuals until future medical advancements can extend life. It is the fastest-growing cryonics provider globally, serving over 600 active members, with standby, stabilization, and transportation teams available 24/7 across Europe. The company offers all-inclusive cryopreservation plans with high-quality, on-location service and operates a dedicated research facility to advance biostasis science. Tomorrow Bio is expanding its services to the US, aiming for nationwide availability by 2025.

Tarjima offers omni-channel ecommerce solutions enabling businesses to launch localized web and mobile apps quickly in English and vernacular languages. Their platform supports B2C, B2B, and in-store assisted ecommerce with features like online payments, EMI options, and electronic catalogs. Tarjima provides training and digital strategy support to accelerate both online and offline sales, targeting SMBs and retailers. It is used by notable clients such as DC Books and QRS Electronics, making it a comprehensive solution for multi-channel retail growth in India.

viAct is an industrial technology company specializing in AI-powered construction management software that uses advanced computer vision to provide 24/7 remote visual monitoring for workplace safety and task completion. Their platform offers modules such as fleet management, work-at-height safety, confined space monitoring, and automated alerts to reduce accidents and improve operational efficiency. viAct’s smart dashboard enables real-time data visualization and performance measurement, helping stakeholders stay informed and enhancing project safety and productivity. Their solutions have demonstrated significant reductions in jobsite accidents and monitoring labor hours, making them valuable for construction companies focused on safety and efficiency.

EnduroSat is a Bulgarian aerospace company that designs, builds, and operates CubeSats and nanosatellites for commercial and scientific space missions. They provide end-to-end satellite services including mission design, launch, and operational support, targeting customers in aerospace, research, and organizations needing satellite data. The company aims to make space universally accessible by streamlining satellite technology into a data service platform. EnduroSat is recognized as a leading small satellite startup and is developing inter-satellite linking and data applications.
Investors: Founders Fund, CEECAT Capital, Morphosis Capital

Pitch: Hedera Dx is a Swiss biotech company specializing in precision oncology, offering a liquid biopsy platform that enables hospital labs to perform cost-efficient, on-site molecular diagnostics for cancer patients. Their integrated solution combines advanced molecular profiling with AI-driven patient-centric insights to support personalized treatment decisions and accelerate oncology drug development. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Lausanne, Hedera Dx addresses global barriers to accessing targeted cancer therapies outside the US centralized testing model, aiming to make precision cancer care accessible worldwide. The company recently raised €15 million in Series A funding to expand its hospital-based cancer diagnostics and real-world data infrastructure.
Investors: Vsquared Ventures, Tesi, Helsana HealthInvest, Eyrir Venture Management, Inventure, Top Harvest

Pitch: Gail is an AI-powered platform designed specifically for the financial services industry, including insurance, banking, and finance. It offers 24/7 conversational AI across voice, chat, text, email, and WhatsApp to help businesses sell more, engage customers, and provide instant support while ensuring compliance. Gail features GailGPT, which provides teams with AI-driven expert insights on policies, claims, and contracts, enabling faster, more accurate responses and real-time revenue opportunities. Its ability to operate in multiple languages and tailor workflows to specific business needs makes it unique and valuable to financial service providers.
Investors: HTwenty, Act One Ventures, Mangusta Capital, NextView Ventures, A15

Pitch: Surgify Medical, based in Finland, develops advanced surgical technology to enhance safety and precision in bone surgeries such as spinal, cranial, ENT, and orthopedic procedures. Its flagship product, Surgify Halo™, uses patented HaloSense technology to differentiate between hard bone and soft tissue, automatically protecting soft tissues during high-speed drilling. This innovation reduces surgical risks and streamlines procedures, with potential applications in robotic surgery as well. Surgify's technology has received international recognition, including the Red Dot Award for Innovative Product in 2024, and the company has raised significant funding to expand globally.
Investors: ZEISS Ventures, EIC Fund, Lednil, Cascara Ventures

Pitch: Mura is a New York-based AI platform that automates the order-to-cash process for commercial field service companies, particularly in the HVAC industry. Founded in 2024, its AI-powered 'dark software' integrates invisibly with existing field service management systems to streamline billing, dispatch, and back-office workflows without disrupting current operations. This enables commercial HVAC and field service providers to reduce overhead, accelerate payment times, and eliminate manual tasks. Mura's solution is designed to help mid-market to enterprise service providers improve operational efficiency and cash flow.
Investors: Lerer Hippeau, Level One Fund, Levante Capital

Pitch: SCI Semiconductor is a UK-based company developing the ICENI family of memory-safe chips that enforce security by compartmentalizing memory access to reduce cybersecurity risks. Their products, launching soon, leverage CHERI technology from the University of Cambridge and target critical infrastructure, defence, automotive, and medical markets. SCI aims to lower cybersecurity costs and eliminate constant patching by providing hardware-level security compatible with open source software and development tools. Founded in 2022 by industry veterans, SCI Semiconductor seeks to establish a new standard in secure computing while enhancing UK semiconductor leadership.

Horizon3.ai is a cybersecurity company specializing in autonomous penetration testing through its NodeZero® platform, which continuously simulates real-world attacks to identify and prioritize security vulnerabilities. Founded by veterans of U.S. Special Operations and cybersecurity experts, it leverages AI to provide scalable, cost-effective, and proactive defense against sophisticated cyber threats. Trusted by over 3,000 organizations and having performed more than 150,000 pentests, Horizon3.ai helps enterprises move from reactive security to continuous verification and remediation before attackers can exploit weaknesses.

UNESCO is a specialized United Nations agency headquartered in France that promotes international cooperation in education, science, culture, and communication to foster peace and sustainable development worldwide. It supports global efforts to protect cultural heritage, advance literacy, promote scientific collaboration, and uphold freedom of expression. UNESCO is unique in its role of establishing and safeguarding World Heritage Sites of cultural and natural significance, while also providing crisis response and educational access. Its work fosters mutual understanding, intercultural dialogue, and resilience through multilateral cooperation.

Senti Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a new generation of smarter medicines using synthetic biology to create proprietary Gene Circuits that program cells with biological logic. Their therapies are designed to precisely kill cancer cells while sparing healthy cells, increasing specificity and controlling drug expression after administration. The company focuses on cell therapy for oncology, with a lead product candidate, SENTI-202, in clinical trials for acute myeloid leukemia. Senti Bio’s unique approach leverages advanced gene circuit technology to address incurable diseases with enhanced precision and control.

BreachRx provides an intelligent incident management and response platform designed to help organizations achieve operational resilience during cybersecurity incidents. Their SaaS platform automatically generates tailored incident response plans and offers targeted guidance to relevant stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring compliance with evolving regulations. BreachRx integrates privileged communication channels and audit trails to protect CISOs from personal liability, making it uniquely valuable for enterprises seeking proactive, streamlined breach response. Trusted by leading cybersecurity and privacy teams, it reduces risk, saves time, and recovers budget by automating and strengthening incident readiness and response.
Investors: Ballistic Ventures, SYN Ventures, Overline, Silver Buckshot Ventures

Pitch: Button Finance is a fintech company specializing in home equity loans and lines of credit designed to provide homeowners, especially non-prime borrowers, with greater access to capital at lower monthly payments. Their AI-driven underwriting platform enables quick and efficient unlocking of home equity, typically providing funds within about five days of application. The company combines innovative financial products with education to empower borrowers to make informed decisions and achieve long-term financial independence. Button Finance primarily serves the wholesale and correspondent lending sectors and aims to improve financial stability by tapping into the substantial untapped home equity in the U.S.

FINRA (Financial Industry Regulatory Authority) is a private American self-regulatory organization that oversees brokerage firms and exchange markets in the United States. It regulates trading in equities, corporate bonds, securities futures, and options, ensuring compliance with federal securities laws and industry rules. FINRA provides education, qualification exams for industry professionals, and investor protection tools such as BrokerCheck. It also offers market data resources and conducts regulatory examinations to maintain market integrity and protect investors.

Finwave Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in innovative Gallium Nitride on Silicon (GaN-on-Si) transistor designs and process technologies. Their products enable improved performance, energy efficiency, and simplified design for RF communications, targeting markets such as aerospace, defense, mobile infrastructure, smartphones, medical devices, and cloud computing. Originating from MIT research, Finwave has scaled its technology for large-scale manufacturing and is commercializing high-power RF switches with broad bandwidth and fast switching capabilities. Their unique GaN-on-Si technology offers high power and efficiency, supported by strategic partnerships to expand global distribution.

Fore Biotherapeutics is a precision oncology company focused on developing innovative treatments for patients with the hardest-to-treat cancers. Their lead program, plixorafenib, is a next-generation BRAF inhibitor designed to target a broad range of BRAF gene alterations in cancer cells beyond those addressed by earlier inhibitors. They are currently conducting a phase 2 clinical trial for plixorafenib in patients with advanced, unresectable solid tumors harboring BRAF alterations. Fore Bio leverages strategic partnerships and a virtual biotech model to accelerate the delivery of high-impact therapies to patients with unaddressed tumor mutations.

Greenlite is a woman- and diversity-owned manufacturer specializing in energy-efficient lighting and energy-saving products for utilities, retailers, distributors, and contractors across North America. They provide customized energy efficiency kits, including lighting, smart thermostats, EV chargers, and water conservation products, aimed at reducing energy usage and costs while promoting sustainability. Trusted by over 150 utilities, Greenlite also supports income-eligible programs by distributing ENERGY STAR certified products to families in need, making them a key partner in energy efficiency and green initiatives.

Hinge Health is a digital healthcare company specializing in musculoskeletal (MSK) care by combining expert clinical teams with advanced technology such as wearable devices and computer vision. Their digital clinic offers personalized virtual physical therapy and comprehensive support to help patients reduce pain, avoid unnecessary surgeries, and decrease opioid use. Targeting individuals with joint and muscle pain, Hinge Health aims to make high-quality MSK care accessible and patient-centered, enhancing mobility and quality of life through innovative, technology-driven solutions.

Mark Cuban Companies is an innovative e-commerce and investment firm led by entrepreneur Mark Cuban, featuring diverse businesses such as the Dallas Mavericks NBA team, Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company offering low-cost generic medications, and various media and entertainment ventures. The company focuses on disruptive models that bring transparency and affordability, such as its online pharmacy with transparent drug pricing. Its portfolio also includes ventures in health technology, entertainment distribution, and community empowerment, targeting consumers and industries seeking value and innovation. The company is distinguished by its founder’s high-profile entrepreneurial background and commitment to transforming traditional markets.

Passage Health provides an all-in-one clinical and practice management platform designed primarily for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and related healthcare services for autistic individuals. The platform is tailored to meet the needs of a variety of organizations including large national agencies, local agencies, start-ups, multi-disciplinary practices, and schools. Passage emphasizes simplicity, productivity, and quality with features that are reliable, secure, and easy to learn, complemented by insights and analytics to improve outcomes and operations. Their dedicated support and partnership approach ensure seamless onboarding and ongoing collaboration with over 100 practices.

Persist AI develops next-generation drug formulation development processes by combining robotics and artificial intelligence. Their core service involves high throughput screening and rapid scale-up of drug formulations, targeting pharmaceutical companies seeking to accelerate drug development. The company's unique integration of AI and robotics enables faster, more efficient discovery and optimization of drug formulations, providing a competitive edge in pharmaceutical innovation.

Pharmazz, Inc. is an innovative biopharmaceutical company based in the United States focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapeutics for critical care medicine. It has an approved product, Lyfaquin® (centhaquine), for hypovolemic shock marketed in India, and a promising pipeline including drugs like sovateltide for acute cerebral ischemic stroke and Alzheimer's disease. The company leverages exclusive worldwide rights from Midwestern University and maintains a strong patent position with clinical development ongoing in multiple indications. Pharmazz's unique value lies in its first-in-class therapies targeting large critical care markets with novel mechanisms of action and global regulatory collaborations.

Reflect Scientific, Inc. develops and markets innovative cryogenic cooling technologies and scientific equipment primarily for the healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and life sciences industries. Their core products include Cryometrix ultra-low temperature and blast freezers used for storing sensitive biological materials like blood and cancer vaccines, as well as laboratory consumables and chromatography components. The company serves a diverse customer base including hospitals, diagnostic labs, pharmaceutical companies, universities, and government research facilities. Reflect Scientific's unique value lies in its proprietary patented technologies and over 40 years of expertise, enabling cost-effective, high-quality solutions for cryogenic storage and laboratory applications.

Schilling Cider is a craft cider company founded in 2013 in Seattle, specializing in bold, innovative, and flavor-forward ciders made from fresh-pressed apples and locally sourced ingredients. Their offerings include unique products like nitro ciders and ciders made from rare apple varieties, targeting adventurous beverage consumers who appreciate high-quality, sustainable, and creatively crafted drinks. The company combines traditional cider-making knowledge with engineering innovation to produce consistent, exciting flavors that stand out in the U.S. craft cider market. Schilling also operates tasting rooms in key cider markets like Seattle and Portland, enhancing customer engagement and brand experience.

Simplify Compliance offers a comprehensive portfolio of publications, subscriptions, workflow tools, and training programs designed to help professionals and business leaders navigate complex regulatory and operational requirements. Serving industries such as human capital management, healthcare, and telecommunications, the company provides expert-driven content and practical solutions to improve accuracy, consistency, and confidence in compliance tasks. Their resources reduce risk, streamline implementation of regulatory changes, and optimize business performance. Simplify Compliance operates well-known brands including BLR®, Bluepoint, CCMI, and HCPro, delivering trusted knowledge and regulatory information to support decisive and productive business decisions.

Timeline is a company developing innovative solutions to promote longevity in the food, beauty, and health sectors. They have created a proprietary molecule, Mitopure®, which rejuvenates aging mitochondria, backed by over a decade of research and clinical studies. Their technology is unique in targeting cellular aging processes, offering potential benefits for skin health and beauty. Timeline's work is supported by strategic investments, including from L’Oréal’s venture capital fund, enabling further development and collaboration in longevity science.

TOCA Football is a technology-enabled soccer training company offering indoor practice and training programs for players of all ages and skill levels. Founded in 2016 and based in Costa Mesa, California, it provides services including lessons, classes, leagues, and venue rentals, utilizing a proprietary ball machine, digital targets, and a data-driven app. The company emphasizes ball touches and practical game skills with personalized coaching to enhance player development. TOCA aims to create an authentic, inclusive soccer experience that builds a global community and helps players improve effectively.

World.Org is a fintech company building a global human network that integrates digital identity, finance, and community to empower every individual in the Age of AI. Its core products include World ID, a privacy-preserving digital proof of unique humanness verified by biometric Orbs, and World App, a wallet for managing World ID, digital assets, and Mini Apps. The company also offers Worldcoin (WLD), a native digital token claimable by verified users, and World Chain, a human-first blockchain designed for scalability. World.Org aims to increase economic opportunity, enable secure online human verification, and foster a global inclusive financial ecosystem.

Yellow Ribbon Fund is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting severely wounded, ill, and injured post-9/11 American service members, their caregivers, and families during extended medical recovery and reintegration. It provides supplemental assistance such as free lodging, transportation, and community events to alleviate financial and logistical burdens while service members receive treatment at Walter Reed National Military Medical Center and Bethesda Naval Hospital. The organization emphasizes keeping families together during the recuperation phase, enhancing the quality of life for veterans and their loved ones. Its unique Crossroads Program offers critical support services at no cost to military families, helping them focus on recovery.

Yext is a leading digital presence platform for multi-location brands, providing a centralized platform to deliver consistent, accurate, and engaging customer experiences across digital channels. Its AI and machine learning technology powers the knowledge behind every customer engagement, automates workflows at scale, and offers actionable cross-channel insights. Yext’s solutions span SEO, websites, social media, reputation management, and modern search experiences on websites and voice assistants like Alexa and Siri. Serving industries such as financial services, retail, healthcare, and more, Yext enables brands to differentiate their digital presence effectively.

Anglian Water is the largest water and water recycling company by geographic area in England and Wales, serving nearly seven million people across the East of England and Hartlepool. The company operates and maintains an extensive network of water mains and sewerage infrastructure to provide essential water and wastewater services. Under its 'Love Every Drop' initiative, Anglian Water is committed to environmental and social prosperity, focusing on sustainability and customer support. Their business plan includes significant investment to ensure affordable, reliable water services while protecting natural resources.

Envoke is a UK-based healthtech company specializing in simulation software that enables medical staff to train on laboratory equipment and troubleshoot issues remotely. Their platform creates virtual models of medical devices, allowing manufacturers to provide e-learning and remote support, reducing the need for physical site visits. Clients include major device manufacturers and institutions such as Bio-Rad, Waters Corporation, and the NHS. Recent funding is being used to enhance the system, expand marketing, and grow their customer base ahead of a Series A investment.

Penfold Pension is a UK-based fintech company offering a digital workplace auto-enrolment pension platform designed to make pension saving easy and flexible for businesses and their employees. Their proprietary platform enables employers to sign up or switch pensions in minutes, targeting SMEs and self-employed individuals who often find traditional pensions complicated and inaccessible. Penfold stands out with excellent customer service, strong investment performance, and features like instant online changes and pauses to pension contributions, catering especially to freelancers with variable incomes. The company has rapidly grown its customer base and assets under administration, supported by recent funding to expand its digital offerings and reach across the UK market.

CureBay is an Indian healthcare startup building the country's first full-stack, tech-enabled rural healthcare ecosystem with over 150 eClinics operational across Odisha and Chhattisgarh. It offers teleconsultations with qualified doctors, diagnostic services, pharmacy delivery, and AI tools for personalized health monitoring. CureBay employs around 1,000 community health workers called Swasthya Mitras who facilitate last-mile healthcare delivery and patient education. Their hybrid model combines technology with concierge-style support to make quality healthcare accessible, affordable, and trustworthy for rural populations.

Data Sutram is a Mumbai-based fintech company that leverages AI to clean, structure, and blend data from over 250 sources to provide actionable intelligence on people and businesses. Their platform primarily serves banks and lenders to help curb fraud, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer onboarding processes. The company is expanding its AI-driven fraud detection capabilities into transaction monitoring and new sectors such as cryptocurrency, insurance, gaming, and ecommerce. Data Sutram operates on a pay-per-inquiry model and aims to address the rising fraud risks associated with digital financial transactions in India and beyond.

Euler Motors is an Indian electric vehicle startup specializing in commercial electric vehicles designed and built for India’s market. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New Delhi, the company focuses on last-mile logistics solutions for e-commerce and 3PL companies, offering high-spec, cost-effective electric cargo vehicles. Euler Motors differentiates itself with an ecosystem-led technology approach that includes product innovation, charging infrastructure, servicing, and financing, enabling significant cost savings and sustainability. It has rapidly gained market share and serves clients like BigBasket, operating in multiple cities across India.

Ola Electric is an Indian electric vehicle manufacturer specializing in electric two-wheelers, headquartered in Bengaluru. It designs and produces a range of electric scooters, including the popular Ola S1 series with multiple variants like S1 Air, S1X, and S1 Pro, targeting the Indian urban mobility market. The company operates its own manufacturing facility in Tamil Nadu, where it also produces battery cells, enabling integrated energy storage solutions. Ola Electric leads the Indian electric scooter market with a significant share and plans to expand its product line to electric motorcycles by 2025.

Shiprocket is an Indian logistics aggregator platform that provides cost-effective, technology-driven shipping solutions primarily for eCommerce sellers and D2C retailers. It integrates with multiple courier partners to offer a wide range of shipping options, covering over 27,000 pin codes in India and 220 countries globally. Beyond shipping, Shiprocket supports eCommerce growth with services in marketing, warehousing, finance, and global expansion, making it a comprehensive growth partner for online businesses. Its AI-driven platform simplifies order fulfillment and logistics, helping sellers optimize delivery and scale their operations efficiently.

Tan90 Thermal Solutions is an Indian deep-tech startup specializing in sustainable thermal energy management with a focus on climate-resilient and energy-efficient products. Their core offerings include proprietary Phase Change Materials (PCMs) that enable passive cooling for cold chains, logistics, and data centers, along with portable cold storage solutions and customized thermal systems. They also provide a Cooling-as-a-Service model active in multiple cities, targeting sectors like quick commerce, food logistics, and healthcare. Tan90’s innovative PCM technology offers longer cycle life and improved efficiency, positioning them as leaders in thermal innovation and climate resilience.

TCS BaNCS offers a comprehensive suite of digital banking, capital markets, and insurance solutions designed to transform financial institutions by enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency. Its cloud-native platform supports rapid deployment, exemplified by enabling a digital-only bank launch with 90-second onboarding. Serving over 500 financial institutions globally, TCS BaNCS leverages open technologies and rich ecosystems to provide a secure, agile, and intelligent digital core that drives innovation and frictionless financial journeys.

Flip is a German-based SaaS company providing an employee experience platform specifically designed for enterprises with large deskless workforces. Its secure app serves as a single digital interface to streamline internal communication, onboarding, shift planning, and task management for frontline and deskless workers. The platform integrates AI to enhance workflow automation and employee engagement, targeting HR, Communications, and Operations teams to improve productivity and connection between headquarters and frontline employees. With over 500 companies using its solution, including Porsche, McDonald’s, and Bosch, Flip stands out by focusing on the unique needs of the deskless workforce and expanding AI-driven capabilities.

JUPUS is a German LegalTech company that offers an AI-powered legal secretary designed to fully automate the client intake process for law firms, from initial contact to case completion. Their platform includes an AI chatbot, an online appointment booking tool, and automated communication capabilities that streamline handling inquiries, information, and documents. Targeting law firms, JUPUS enhances efficiency by integrating seamlessly with existing legal software and processing hundreds of inquiries daily across Germany. Founded in 2022 and based in Cologne, JUPUS stands out as one of Europe's first legal AI secretaries, driving transformation in legal client communication and case management.

Gravitee.io is a leading open-source API management platform that provides full-lifecycle management for both synchronous and asynchronous APIs and event streams. Their platform includes tools for API design, access management, gateway services, and observability, enabling enterprises across industries like financial services, healthcare, and government to securely govern and optimize their API ecosystems. Recognized as a 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Gravitee.io stands out for its no-code approach and commitment to simplicity and innovation, powering digital transformation for global brands. Headquartered in London, the company recently raised $60 million in Series C funding to fuel its hyper-growth.

Clear Current offers an AI-powered virtual energy management platform designed for large enterprise energy consumers. Their platform centralizes energy operations data, enabling users to optimize efficiency, reduce costs, and make informed decisions by leveraging historical data, real-time IoT feeds, and market insights. The system automatically identifies errors in utility invoices and uncovers hidden cost-saving opportunities, providing unprecedented transparency and control over energy procurement, forecasting, consumption, and reporting. Clear Current's unique value lies in its comprehensive, continuously learning AI-driven approach, which acts as a virtual extension of an energy management team to accelerate decision-making and operational improvements.

Cerebro Capital is a fintech company revolutionizing commercial lending by providing a data-driven marketplace that matches mid-sized businesses with the right loan options from over 2,200 lenders. Their platform simplifies and accelerates access to debt capital for middle market borrowers, offering loans ranging from $2 million to $100 million. By using advanced technology and AI tools, Cerebro Capital increases transparency, reduces friction, and delivers actionable insights to both borrowers and lenders, enabling faster and more equitable financing solutions. The company has facilitated over $1 billion in loan closings and continues to expand its capital markets team to enhance lender-borrower connections.

ITM Isotope Technologies Munich SE is a biotechnology company specializing in the development and production of next-generation radiopharmaceuticals for precision oncology. Their core products include a broad pipeline of radioisotopes combined with targeting molecules aimed at diagnosing and treating hard-to-treat tumors. The company serves cancer patients, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners globally, leveraging over two decades of expertise and multiple Phase III clinical studies. ITM's unique value lies in its vertically integrated approach and focus on improving clinical outcomes and quality of life through advanced targeted radiotherapies.

Volare is a Finnish biotech company specializing in sustainable protein production using black soldier flies to convert food industry byproducts into high-quality protein, oil, and fertilizer. Their proprietary, zero-waste, fossil-free process significantly reduces emissions compared to conventional protein sources and supports circular economy principles. Volare targets markets such as aquaculture, pet food, agriculture, and chemical industries, with products already used in aquaculture feed and a long-term supply agreement with Skretting. The company is building the world's most energy-efficient insect protein production plant in Finland, set to produce protein equivalent to 200 million Baltic herrings annually, enhancing Europe's food system resilience and sustainability.

Auditstage is a Belgian SaaS startup founded in 2024 that develops an AI-powered collaboration platform designed to streamline and accelerate financial audits for audit firms and their clients. Its platform automates repetitive tasks, enhances transparency, and reduces back-and-forth communication, enabling auditors to focus on delivering high-quality, accurate reports. Targeting audit firms of all sizes, Auditstage aims to modernize and simplify the audit process through AI-native technology, with a public launch planned for late 2025 and broader rollout in 2026. The company recently raised €750,000 in pre-seed funding to further develop its platform and expand its team.

Wayl is a fintech company that operates as a payment aggregator and facilitator primarily serving small merchants and freelance contractual workers. Founded in 2021, it offers a streamlined platform that enables users to manage orders, inventories, and payment processing without complex registration or payment gateway agreements. Targeting the Iraqi market, Wayl aims to democratize access to digital payment services, addressing the gap in a region where most transactions are still cash-based. Its strategic partnership with Visa and focus on the growing e-commerce sector position it as a key player in revolutionizing digital payments in Iraq.

Slikk is an Indian quick-commerce fashion startup offering a 60-minute delivery service for apparel, accessories, and footwear, primarily targeting impulse-driven Gen Z and millennial consumers in urban India. The platform features a unique Try & Buy model with instant refunds and aims to provide a curated, convenient shopping experience. Founded in Bengaluru, Slikk plans to expand its category offerings to include beauty and personal care while scaling its presence across key metro cities. Its rapid delivery and instant returns differentiate it in the fast-growing lifestyle commerce market.

Birdeye is a leading AI-powered platform specializing in hyperlocal marketing and customer experience management for multi-location businesses. Their core products include AI agents that autonomously run marketing workflows, reputation management, and social media engagement tailored to each brand's unique voice and industry context. Birdeye’s innovations like Brand AI and Industry AI enable businesses to deploy AI agents that act with brand authenticity and domain-specific intelligence, driving measurable business outcomes. Trusted by over 150,000 businesses worldwide, Birdeye combines AI with expert support to increase leads, foot traffic, and revenue while reducing costs.

Jane Software is a cloud-based practice management platform designed for health and wellness practitioners. It provides tools for online booking, scheduling, billing, charting, secure payment processing, and patient communication, accessible from any device. Serving over 200,000 practitioners at 50,000 clinics across Canada, the U.S., and the U.K., Jane supports a wide range of disciplines and focuses on ease of use and strong customer support. Founded in 2012 in Vancouver, Canada, it is valued at $1.8 billion following a recent $500 million secondary financing round.

GlycoEra is a Swiss biotechnology company developing best-in-class extracellular protein degraders to treat autoimmune diseases by selectively targeting and degrading disease-causing circulating proteins such as autoantibodies. Their proprietary platform enables precision immunology therapies that alter the treatment paradigm by removing harmful extracellular proteins through glycan receptor-mediated uptake in the liver. The company is advancing multiple programs, including a lead IgG4-targeted degrader in clinical development, aiming to improve patient outcomes and address high unmet medical needs in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. GlycoEra's unique approach leverages natural glycan pathways to enable precision degradation of extracellular proteins, distinguishing it in the immunology therapeutics space.
Investors: Novo Holdings, Catalio Capital Management, LifeArc Ventures, QIA, Sixty Degree Capital, Agent Capital, MP Healthcare Venture Management, Sofinnova Partners, 5AM Ventures, Roche Ventures, Bristol Myers Squibb

Pitch: Salvia BioElectronics is a clinical-stage medical device company based in the Netherlands, pioneering neuromodulation therapy for chronic migraine patients. Their core product, MySalvia Therapy, is an ultra-thin implant designed to target key nerves involved in migraine, aiming to reduce attack frequency and intensity. The company offers personalized migraine treatment leveraging bioelectronic technology, addressing a significant unmet need in neurological disorder management. Founded in 2017, Salvia is advancing clinical development globally with strong investor backing to bring innovative relief to people suffering from debilitating migraines.
Investors: Innovation Industries, Invest-NL, EIC Fund, Inkef, Panakès Partners, SHS Capital, Dolby Family Ventures, Brabant Development Agency, Thuja Capital

Pitch: Superblocks is a New York City-based enterprise software company that offers a secure, AI-powered platform for building internal business applications. Its AI agent, Clark, enables both technical and non-technical users to create production-grade internal apps and automation using natural language, enhancing productivity and governance. The platform addresses the growing security risks of AI-generated applications by enforcing data and access policies on a governed platform. FOXO's integrated approach combining clinical services with advanced biotechnology and data analytics distinguishes it in the healthcare industry.

Paytient offers a Health Payment Account and Visa card that enable employees and health plan members to pay out-of-pocket healthcare expenses such as medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, behavioral health, and veterinary care without interest, fees, or credit checks. Their platform partners with employers, insurers, and health systems to provide flexible, easy-to-manage payment plans deducted automatically from paychecks or linked accounts, improving access to care and affordability. Paytient serves over 23 million members across nearly 7,000 partners and is expanding nationwide, uniquely addressing the need for accessible healthcare financing solutions in the U.S.

Rally is a fintech platform that enables investors to buy and sell equity shares in collectible assets such as rare sports cards, classic cars, dinosaur fossils, digital assets, and more. By turning valuable collectibles into regulated companies and dividing ownership into shares, Rally allows investors of all sizes to build diversified portfolios beyond traditional stocks. The platform offers a user-friendly app with no commissions or hidden fees, providing liquidity through in-app trading after an initial holding period. Rally's unique model democratizes access to alternative asset investment, blending community, emotion, and financial opportunity.

SpyGlass Pharma, Inc. develops an innovative intraocular lens (IOL)-mounted drug delivery platform designed to provide multiple years of continuous treatment for glaucoma patients undergoing cataract surgery. Their platform delivers bimatoprost over a targeted period of three years to lower intraocular pressure, addressing the critical issue of patient non-adherence to glaucoma medication. The technology offers a versatile, controlled-release system implanted during standard cataract procedures, aiming to improve long-term management of glaucoma and other chronic ophthalmic diseases. SpyGlass Pharma’s approach represents a significant advancement in ophthalmic drug delivery with ongoing Phase III clinical trials supported by recent $75 million Series D funding.

AccelerComm Ltd is a UK-based semiconductor company specializing in high-performance physical layer IP solutions for 4G and 5G radio access networks, including terrestrial and satellite communications. Their core products include customizable hardware cores and software libraries for channel coding and signal processing, designed to maximize network efficiency, reduce latency, and lower power consumption. They serve diverse markets from private networks to large-scale cloud RAN and defense applications, offering scalable, field-proven technology with O-RAN standard interfaces for easy integration. Their innovation lies in patented algorithms and ultra-low power IP solutions tailored for next-generation wireless communications and satellite link challenges.

Melius Cyber, based in Newcastle, UK, provides affordable, automated cybersecurity solutions specifically designed for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Its flagship platform, CyberSafe, offers 24/7 monitoring of IT networks, websites, and mobile applications to detect, analyze, and respond to cyber threats in real-time. The platform automates vulnerability scanning and penetration testing, helping businesses achieve government-standard cyber security certifications such as Cyber Essentials and ISO 27001. Melius Cyber's unique value lies in its comprehensive threat detection capabilities combined with continuous monitoring and automated alerts, supporting SMEs in maintaining robust cybersecurity defenses.

ThreatSpike Labs is a UK-based cybersecurity company offering an end-to-end fully managed security service through its software-defined security platform. The platform installs quickly and continuously monitors network activity using expert analysts and penetration testers to detect and alert clients to real-time threats and vulnerabilities. It enables organizations to respond immediately by implementing protective controls like web filtering, data loss prevention, and network zoning, all via a flexible per-seat licensing model. ThreatSpike serves over 200 customers globally, focusing on simplifying cybersecurity with a unified, transparent, and scalable solution for mid-sized enterprises and beyond.

Goofy Tails is an Indian petcare company dedicated to providing honest, holistic nutrition and high-quality durable toys and supplies for dogs and cats. Their products, including balanced meals, treats, toys, and bone broth, are developed with veterinarians and nutritionists to ensure optimal health and taste. The company emphasizes empathy and supports all pets, including strays, by donating a portion of proceeds towards street dog vaccination and fostering adoption. Goofy Tails aims to improve pet wellness and promote a compassionate ecosystem for animals in India.

LoanTap Financial Technologies is an Indian fintech company providing fast, flexible, and customized personal loans primarily targeting millennials and salaried professionals. Their platform offers quick online loan approval and disbursal, with loan amounts up to ₹10 lakhs and flexible repayment options up to 60 months. LoanTap differentiates itself by using advanced technology to deliver user-friendly, transparent, and customer-centric loan products with no hidden charges, supported by a secure and encrypted data system. They operate as an RBI-registered NBFC focused on simplifying the lending process and enhancing customer experience.

Udaan is India's largest B2B trade platform designed to empower small and medium businesses by connecting traders, wholesalers, retailers, and manufacturers across diverse categories such as FMCG, staples, fruits & vegetables, and pharma. It offers a powerful mobile app for easy ordering and facilitates efficient supply chain and logistics operations through technology. Udaan also provides financial products and services via udaanCapital to address working capital needs, making it a comprehensive solution for small businesses in India.

SWTCH Energy provides smart EV charging solutions specifically designed for multi-tenant residential and commercial buildings, utilizing existing electrical infrastructure to enable cost-effective deployment. Their SWTCH Control™ platform integrates with building energy management and grid services to optimize energy use, reduce capacity constraints, and support demand response programs. Targeting building owners, operators, utilities, and real estate developers, SWTCH facilitates the transition to electric vehicles by improving access to charging in multi-unit residential buildings. With over 7,500 chargers deployed and a focus on sustainable energy integration, SWTCH is a leader in EV charging innovation in North America.

Syfe is a Singapore-based digital investment platform licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore that offers personalized managed investment portfolios, brokerage services, and cash management solutions to individual investors across Asia. It enables users to invest with no minimum amount and low fees, providing access to diversified portfolios and the ability to trade US and Singapore-listed securities with features like free trades and real-time market data. Syfe's platform is designed to make high-quality financial services affordable and accessible, targeting everyday investors seeking simple, smart, and affordable ways to grow their wealth. The company operates in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Australia, managing assets for over 250,000 investors.

Parlay Finance offers an AI-powered Loan Intelligence System designed to streamline and automate the qualification and verification process for small business and SBA loans. Targeting community banks and credit unions, Parlay's platform integrates seamlessly with existing loan origination systems to enhance loan volume, operational efficiency, and underwriting accuracy. Its technology enables rapid digital onboarding, real-time data validation, and AI-driven decision management, helping lenders serve small businesses more effectively and competitively. The system uniquely addresses the complexity and cost of SBA loan processing, democratizing access to advanced lending tools for community lenders nationwide.

XRobotics is a US-based company that develops the xPizza Cube, the world's smallest and most powerful pizza-making robot designed to automate pizza production with key ingredients like sauce, cheese, and pepperoni. Founded in 2019 in San Francisco, it aims to revolutionize the food industry by providing affordable and reliable automation solutions. The robot can produce 25,000 pizzas per month, significantly enhancing restaurant efficiency by delivering adjustable volumes of 100-300 pizzas per hour. This compact and efficient technology makes XRobotics unique in improving pizza production scalability and consistency.

Apis Point Energy provides energy wholesalers and commercial end-users with price stability by offering ceiling, floor, and fixed-price forwards on physically deliverable refined petroleum products and natural gas liquids (NGLs). Their proprietary platform uses commodity market analytics to hedge deliverable supply and eliminate fuel price volatility, customized for local prices, delivery points, and timing. This solution targets fuel distributors and customers seeking to manage price uncertainty effectively. The company recently raised $4.2 million in Series A funding to scale this innovative platform.

Dilon Technologies is a medical device company specializing in women's healthcare and biosurgery, developing innovative medical devices for healthcare providers. Their core products include MarginProbe for accurate margin assessment in breast cancer surgery, HEMOBLAST Bellows, a unique powdered surgical hemostat, and the Navigator System for radio-guided surgical procedures. They also offer advanced technologies like TrueView 200 Pro for tumor lesion identification and CoPilot VL+, a portable video laryngoscope. Dilon is distinguished by its focus on improving breast cancer treatment outcomes and surgical precision through cutting-edge medical technology.

Nooks provides secure, modern, and scalable classified infrastructure solutions primarily for government agencies, defense contractors, and industry innovators. Their platform leverages advanced technologies and programs like STRATFI and DARPA Prospero to optimize classified workspaces, improving efficiency and collaboration. With significant backing from major defense contractors such as SAIC and Lockheed Martin, Nooks aims to transform the defense industrial base by reducing costs and accelerating secure infrastructure access.

Swimlane is a cybersecurity company specializing in security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) solutions. Their cloud-scale, low-code platform enables organizations to automate and streamline security operations, accelerating incident response and improving threat management. Swimlane integrates with multiple security tools to consolidate alerts, automate workflows, and provide centralized case management and playbooks. It leverages AI-driven automation to enhance security operations centers (SOC) and help enterprises and service providers reduce response times and strengthen their security posture.

Beewise develops advanced technology solutions to protect bees from extreme weather, disease, and chemicals, thereby supporting stronger bee populations. Their core product, the BeeHome™, is designed to improve hive health and productivity, enhancing pollination services for growers. By safeguarding bees, Beewise helps secure the global food supply, making their approach valuable for both beekeepers and agricultural producers.

Onyx Renewables is a vertically integrated clean energy asset developer, owner, and operator in the United States, specializing in customized solar and energy storage solutions for commercial, industrial, municipal, educational, and government clients. The company offers end-to-end services including development, financing, construction, operation, and maintenance with no upfront costs, enabling clients to accelerate decarbonization and reduce carbon emissions. Onyx leverages its expertise and stable capital backing from major institutional investors to deliver tailored clean energy projects across various sectors such as commercial and industrial, utility-scale, and community solar. Headquartered in New York City, Onyx is uniquely positioned to simplify complex energy and regulatory challenges while fostering long-term client partnerships throughout the life of the assets.

Modii is a US-based SaaS company specializing in smart parking and mobility solutions aimed at creating smarter, more sustainable, and safer cities and university campuses. Their digital infrastructure products include Parking Finder, which helps users make informed parking and mobility choices, and Parking Admin, a platform for administrators to manage and optimize parking operations. Modii integrates data-driven technology to reduce congestion, emissions, and driver distractions, enhancing safety and streamlining transportation management. Formerly known as Spot Parking, Modii focuses on unifying technologies to support digital transformation in urban mobility and parking management.

Impact Recycling is a UK-based ClimateTech company specializing in advanced plastic recycling using its patented water-based BOSS (Baffled Oscillation Separation System) technology. This process separates mixed post-consumer plastic waste into two high-purity streams of polyethylene and polypropylene, each exceeding 95% purity. The company operates plants in Glasgow and Peterlee, serving clients across healthcare, packaging, and waste management sectors, with unique capabilities to recycle both rigid and flexible plastics, including challenging flexible film packaging. Their innovative approach supports a circular economy by turning waste plastics into valuable raw materials, attracting significant investment for scaling operations globally.

Noah is a UK-based fintech startup developing a stablecoin-powered infrastructure to simplify and accelerate cross-border payments. Their platform enables businesses and individuals to send, receive, and convert over 60 currencies quickly, transparently, and at low cost, bypassing traditional banking delays and fees. By providing a compliant, API-driven global payment network that connects local payment rails through stablecoins, Noah aims to become the foundational layer for next-generation international money transfers. Their solution targets the inefficiencies of legacy systems like SWIFT, offering a seamless, cost-effective alternative for B2B and remittance payments.

Omnisient is a privacy-preserving data collaboration platform based in Germany that enables businesses in industries such as retail, telecommunications, and healthcare to securely collaborate and monetize high-value consumer data while ensuring consumer privacy and data protection. The platform offers expert matchmaking of non-traditional data monetization and advertising partners, unlocking value from first-party data without compromising privacy. Omnisient is internationally recognized for its excellence in security, consumer privacy protection, and societal impact, and has developed AI tools that allow non-technical users to query complex anonymized data through conversational interfaces similar to ChatGPT.

FinanceKey is a Finnish fintech company that offers a real-time cash management and payment automation platform designed for enterprise treasury and finance teams. Its API-based platform, branded as One Finance API, unifies and standardizes financial data from multiple banks, ERPs, and internal tools to provide real-time visibility and automate complex payment workflows. This cloud-native solution simplifies treasury infrastructure with dynamic dashboards, freeing finance professionals from manual tasks and enabling strategic decision-making. FinanceKey's platform has processed over €1.5 billion in payments and serves clients such as Nors Group and Obton, delivering measurable operational improvements and cost savings.

Hirundo is an AI company specializing in machine unlearning, which enables AI models to forget flawed or biased data without requiring full retraining. This approach helps address issues like hallucinations and biases in AI models, making them more reliable and trustworthy for enterprise use. Hirundo's technology is designed to optimize AI models across various industries, including finance, healthcare, and defense. By remedying AI models at their core, Hirundo aims to accelerate safe and large-scale AI adoption.

ai.work is an Israel-based SaaS company specializing in AI-driven workforce management solutions. Their platform leverages artificial intelligence to optimize employee productivity, automate task assignments, and enhance operational efficiency. Targeting businesses seeking to improve workforce utilization, ai.work offers a unique combination of AI technology and SaaS delivery that simplifies complex workforce management challenges.

SANTECHTURE is a UAE-based healthtech company specializing in AI-powered Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) solutions that automate and optimize financial processes for healthcare providers across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the GCC region. Their platform streamlines medical coding, billing, and insurance claims management, improving accuracy, reducing claim denials, and accelerating revenue collection. The company is uniquely positioned through its strategic partnership with global healthcare technology leader CorroHealth, integrating advanced AI capabilities to enhance operational efficiency and protect healthcare providers' revenue streams. SANTECHTURE is backed by prominent investors like Gulf Capital and Shorooq Partners, reinforcing its leadership in healthcare digital transformation in the Middle East.

Archeda, Inc. is a Tokyo-based ClimateTech startup that develops AI-powered analytical models using satellite data to support nature-based carbon credit projects. Their solutions aid in site selection, project registration, monitoring, and verification for projects in forests, paddy fields, and mangroves, aligning with international carbon standards like VCS and Gold Standard. They also offer services to municipalities and forestry businesses for forest resource estimation and illegal logging detection. Archeda's unique integration of AI and satellite data enhances the accuracy and efficiency of carbon credit project development and environmental monitoring.
Investors: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, ME Innovation Fund

Pitch: IOST is a Singapore-based blockchain company that provides a modular platform designed for tokenizing real-world assets (RWAs) such as bonds, real estate, and on-chain funds. Its infrastructure includes a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain and EVM-compatible subnets that enable scalable and compliant decentralized finance (DeFi) applications. The company targets institutional and accredited investors by partnering with regulated platforms to offer secure and compliant RWA yield products. IOST distinguishes itself with its robust, high-throughput network that has processed over 954 million transactions with zero downtime since 2018, aiming to support over $10 billion in tokenized assets by 2028.

Linear is a San Francisco-based enterprise software company that offers a purpose-built platform for modern product development and issue tracking. Its core product helps software development teams manage bugs, feature requests, and product roadmaps with streamlined workflows and AI-assisted coding capabilities. Linear targets high-growth technology companies, including over 15,000 customers such as OpenAI and Cash App, by focusing on speed, usability, and tailored features for software development cycles. The company differentiates itself by prioritizing customer-first product design and integrating AI to enhance developer productivity without overwhelming users.
Investors: Accel, Seven Seven Six, Designer Fund, Sequoia Capital, 01A

Pitch: Tastewise is an Israeli SaaS company offering a generative AI platform that provides real-time consumer intelligence for food and beverage brands. It analyzes trillions of data points from recipes, restaurant menus, and social media to generate actionable marketing campaigns, product positioning, and sales strategies. The platform helps CPG companies accelerate decision-making and innovation by turning complex consumption trends into insights within minutes. Tastewise serves global food giants, enabling them to respond rapidly to evolving consumer behaviors and market pressures.

Hypernative is an Israeli cybersecurity company specializing in real-time threat detection and prevention for the Web3 ecosystem. Their platform uses AI-driven monitoring to detect and stop a wide range of attacks such as hacks, fraud, phishing, and compliance risks before any damage occurs, protecting over $100 billion in assets for more than 200 customers. Unique features include automated onchain actions and wallet-level security, making Web3 transactions safer and fostering trust in decentralized finance. Hypernative recently raised $40 million in Series B funding to enhance their AI capabilities and expand fraud prevention and transaction protection services.
Investors: Ten Eleven Ventures, Ballistic Ventures, StepStone Group, Boldstart Ventures, IBI Tech Fund

Pitch: Aiera is a fintech company providing an AI-powered platform that delivers live audio access, transcription, summarization, and analytics for investor events such as earnings calls and conferences. Its services enable financial institutions, asset managers, and investment professionals to efficiently manage event workflows and extract actionable insights from real-time and historical event data. Aiera's platform integrates seamlessly into clients' internal systems, supporting quant strategies, equity research, and corporate intelligence with features like event calendars, topic extraction, sentiment analysis, and financial KPI data. Founded in 2016 and based in New York, Aiera distinguishes itself by automating and enriching investor event analysis to save time and enhance decision-making.

Sintra is a Lithuanian AI startup offering AI-powered helpers designed to empower small businesses by automating core tasks such as social media management, customer support, and administrative work. Their platform integrates with popular tools like Facebook, Gmail, and Google Calendar to streamline business operations. Serving over 40,000 paying customers globally, Sintra provides a simple-to-use solution that boosts productivity and business growth. The company recently raised $17 million in Seed funding to expand its product and engineering teams while continuing to build globally relevant AI products from Lithuania.

Eli Health is a Canadian healthcare company specializing in at-home hormone monitoring technology. It offers saliva-based testing for continuous and personalized hormone profiles, helping individuals manage conditions like menopause, fertility, and endocrine disorders. Eli Health's mission is to make hormone health more accessible and inclusive, particularly in the underserved women's health market. The company's technology provides real-time insights, empowering users with evidence-based information to optimize their health.
Investors: BDC Capital, Muse Capital, Telus Ventures, Foreground Capital, Accelia Capital

Pitch: Somnee is a healthcare technology company that offers a smart sleep headband designed to improve sleep quality by helping users fall asleep faster, reduce tossing and turning, and wake up more refreshed. Using proprietary EEG+ and AI technology, the headband monitors brain activity and delivers personalized neurostimulation to promote natural sleep patterns. Developed with leading neuroscientists, Somnee's device is clinically validated to significantly enhance sleep efficiency and duration, targeting individuals struggling with poor sleep or insomnia. The company’s unique approach combines non-invasive, personalized stimulation with real-time sleep insights to revolutionize sleep health.
Investors: Khosla Ventures, Time Ventures, Lead VC, the DeVos Family Office, Seaside Ventures, Nelstone Ventures, Metalab

Pitch: Co-Power is a Munich-based ClimateTech startup that installs and operates large-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) and battery storage systems directly at industrial sites across Europe. Their solutions enable industrial companies to reduce energy costs by up to 50%, optimize local energy consumption, and generate additional revenue through energy trading and grid services. By decentralizing energy generation and storage on-site, Co-Power addresses the flexibility challenges of renewable energy and enhances energy resilience and autonomy for European industry. The company offers these benefits with no upfront investment or running costs, making clean energy affordable and a competitive advantage for its customers.
Investors: Cherry Ventures, Abacon Capital, Aurum Impact

Pitch: Clara Home Care is a San Francisco-based AI-powered platform that enables families to directly and affordably hire professional in-home senior caregivers. The platform streamlines the caregiving process by handling discovery, background checks, scheduling, payroll, and tax filings, ensuring compliance and transparency. Clara uses AI to match families with caregivers based on skills, availability, and personality fit, promoting better relationships and caregiver satisfaction. By offering flexible private hiring without agency costs, Clara addresses the growing demand for in-home senior care in the United States.

PFx Biotech is a Portuguese biotech company specializing in the development of sustainable and nutritional alternative protein solutions, particularly human milk proteins, through precision fermentation and engineering biology. Their proprietary platform produces proteins structurally and functionally identical to those in breast milk, targeting applications in early-life nutrition, nutraceuticals, elderly care, and sports performance. PFx Biotech’s unique approach addresses cow milk protein allergy while delivering optimal nutrition and immune support across different life stages, aiming to improve health and sustainability in the food industry.
Investors: Buenavista Equity Partners, EIT Food, Beta Capital

Pitch: Agibank is Brazil's first omnichannel digital neobank offering accessible financial services to all Brazilians through a hybrid business model that combines a fully digital platform with over 1,000 physical Smart Hubs. Its services include digital checking accounts, cashback, investments, payroll loans, and credit cards linked to payroll, supported by advanced AI and big data for credit risk management. Agibank's unique approach balances rapid growth with profitability, maintaining resilience across economic cycles and delivering a high Net Promoter Score by focusing on customer-centric, tech-enabled solutions. This model has attracted significant investment and positions Agibank as a leading fintech ecosystem player in Brazil.

ReSpo.Vision is a Polish sportstech startup that uses AI-powered computer vision to transform single-camera sports broadcasts into precise 3D player tracking and tactical insights, creating immersive "Digital Twin" replays. Their technology tracks 50 different body parts to generate centimetre-accurate 3D positional data without the need for specialist on-site equipment, making it scalable and easy to implement. Targeting broadcasters, football federations, clubs, and sports analytics platforms, ReSpo.Vision offers advanced analytics and storytelling tools that enhance fan engagement and provide elite tactical insights. Certified by FIFA for data quality, the company aims to revolutionize how football is watched and analyzed globally.

Remarcable is a cloud-based construction technology platform designed specifically for trade contractors, particularly in the electrical construction industry. It streamlines material procurement, tool management, prefab, warehouse operations, and field requests into a single integrated system, providing real-time visibility and reducing waste. The platform connects contractors directly with suppliers, simplifying and accelerating purchasing while integrating smoothly with accounting and ERP systems. By automating workflows and offering AI-driven insights, Remarcable helps contractors save time, reduce costs, and keep projects on schedule and on budget.

Aethero designs and manufactures high-performance, space-rated computers for a wide range of space platforms from small CubeSats to large space stations. Their products include single board computers and distributed high-performance computing clusters that enable autonomous spacecraft operations, advanced machine vision, and real-time data processing for applications such as optical navigation, multispectral imaging, AI/ML, and software-defined radio. Leveraging radiation-hardened commercial components and modern software, Aethero offers versatile, low-power edge computing modules optimized for space environments. Their unique value lies in enabling satellites and spacecraft to perform computationally intensive tasks in orbit, reducing the need to transmit large volumes of raw data to Earth.

Glean is a Work AI platform that integrates with enterprise data to help organizations find, create, and automate workflows efficiently. It offers AI-powered tools including workplace search, AI assistants for content generation, and AI agents for automating tasks at scale, all within a secure and extensible platform. Targeted at enterprises, Glean addresses knowledge fragmentation by enabling seamless access to information across multiple software applications. Its unique value lies in combining advanced AI capabilities with enterprise-grade security and customizability to enhance productivity.

32 Biosciences is a healthcare company specializing in gut microbiome medicine, developing advanced diagnostic management tools and microbiome-based interventions to prevent and treat chronic diseases linked to dysbiosis. Their diagnostic platform uses mass spectrometry and AI to quantitatively assess the functional health of the gut microbiome, providing clinicians with actionable insights. The company is also pioneering a novel non-antibiotic antimicrobial therapeutic aimed at preventing gut-derived bacterial infections by targeting virulence gene expression and promoting beneficial bacteria growth. Founded on extensive scientific research and supported by NIH funding, 32 Biosciences aims to improve health span and longevity through innovative microbiome solutions.

Wealthbox is a leading CRM software platform designed specifically for financial advisors, offering a modern and intuitive solution that enhances advisor productivity and firm-wide efficiency. Its core product integrates AI features and extensive integrations to streamline operations for independent advisors and larger RIA firms as well as enterprise broker-dealers. The company recently secured a $200 million strategic majority investment from Sixth Street Growth to accelerate product development, expand its market presence, and innovate within the wealth management industry. Wealthbox distinguishes itself by providing an elegant, user-friendly CRM that financial advisors truly enjoy using, supporting their growth and operational needs.

FlexiLoans is an Indian fintech company providing an online lending platform that offers collateral-free loans to MSMEs and startups. It addresses the challenge many SMEs face in accessing quick, flexible, and adequate funding due to lack of credit history or collateral. Using proprietary technology and alternative social scoring models, FlexiLoans approves loans typically within 48 hours, partnering with over 120 companies including major e-commerce and fintech firms. The platform aims to drive financial inclusion by catering to the large untapped SME market across India.

Bedrock Ocean Exploration is a vertically-integrated ClimateTech company specializing in high-resolution seafloor data collection through autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) optimized for nearshore geophysical surveys. Their technology enables lower-cost, faster, and environmentally friendly marine surveys with minimal permitting and reduced emissions. They serve diverse industries including offshore wind, cultural resource management, maritime security, and port infrastructure, providing critical data for ocean mapping and decision-making. As a public benefit corporation, Bedrock is committed to creating a free, detailed map of the world's oceans to enhance understanding and sustainability of marine environments[1][3][5].
Investors: Primary, Northzone, Autopilot, Costanoa Ventures, Harmony Partners, Katapult, Mana Ventures

Pitch: MesoMat develops advanced tire-mounted sensors and a cloud-based tire management platform that provides real-time data to improve fleet efficiency, safety, and performance. Their technology transforms tires into intelligent components by monitoring pressure, temperature, fuel consumption, mileage, and leak detection, helping fleet operators optimize tire use and reduce costs. The company targets large vehicle fleets and tire manufacturers, leveraging over 50 years of engineering expertise and scientific innovation. MesoMat is unique in extracting high-resolution tire performance data from the only vehicle part in direct contact with the road, supporting the automotive industry's shift toward connected and smart vehicle components.
Investors: Ridgeline, RISC Capital, RPV Global, Extra Innings Ventures

Pitch: Snapmint is an Indian fintech company specializing in Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) services that enable shoppers to purchase mobiles, electronics, appliances, and other products through easy, no-cost EMI plans without requiring credit cards. Its fully digital, paperless process takes about 5 minutes, making it accessible and convenient, especially for consumers in tier II and smaller towns. Snapmint's platform also supports merchant partners by increasing sales and customer reach through seamless integration and fraud detection. Founded in 2017, Snapmint has grown rapidly, with over 4 million users and partnerships with major lenders and more than 300 D2C brands across India.

GIVA is an Indian retail brand specializing in BIS Hallmarked gold, 925 silver, and 100% certified lab-grown diamond jewellery, offering over 3500 modern and elegant designs for men and women. The company targets fashion-conscious customers seeking affordable, high-quality jewellery, combining traditional precious metals with contemporary styles. GIVA stands out by providing lifetime exchange, free lifetime plating for silver jewellery, easy returns, and no shipping fees across India, along with a rapidly expanding direct-to-consumer presence through online and 75 physical stores. Their use of advanced ecommerce solutions supports their international growth and customer service excellence.

PostHog is an all-in-one product analytics platform designed specifically for developers, offering tools such as feature flags, session replays, A/B testing, and surveys. It enables teams to analyze user behavior, test and deploy new features, and gather user feedback within a single integrated system. PostHog emphasizes data privacy and compliance, catering primarily to software development companies seeking to build and refine successful products. Founded in 2020 and based in San Francisco, PostHog stands out by providing the lowest pricing at scale and shipping a wide range of products rapidly to meet developers' needs[1][2].

Quantum Space is an aerospace company focused on transforming critical national defense missions through a highly maneuverable, space-based defense system. Founded by Kam Ghaffarian, the company leverages decades of experience in developing, launching, and operating complex space systems to deliver innovative solutions that enhance space operational capabilities. Quantum Space collaborates with government and defense sectors to support sensitive and advanced projects that improve national security and expand the commercial space economy.
Investors: Prime Movers Lab, Sporos Capital, 1802 Ventures, AnD Ventures

Pitch: Tebi is a Netherlands-based fintech startup that provides an all-in-one financial operating system tailored for hospitality businesses such as restaurants and bars. Its platform integrates POS, reservations, QR ordering, inventory, and payments to streamline operations and enhance business management. Co-founded by an Adyen veteran, Tebi stands out by offering a comprehensive, software-embedded payment solution designed to reduce reliance on traditional banks, enabling merchants to process significant payment volumes efficiently. With recent funding led by CapitalG and Index Ventures, Tebi is expanding its reach across the Netherlands and planning entry into the UK market.

Daybreak is an AI-native supply chain planning platform that uses autonomous AI agents to improve prediction accuracy, decision quality, and planning efficiency for global industrial and consumer packaged goods companies. Its platform automates data processing, delivers probabilistic forecasts, and orchestrates better decisions at scale, helping reduce inventory waste and improve service levels. Unlike traditional, rules-based systems, Daybreak's explainable AI continuously learns and adapts to market volatility, enabling planners to focus on strategic decisions that create value. The company recently raised $15 million in Series A funding to accelerate development and deployment of its AI-driven supply chain solutions.

Q5D is a UK-based industrial technology company specializing in robotic wire harness manufacturing that automates the embedding of electrical wiring directly into product structures. Their 5-axis manufacturing robots produce wiring parts on demand, significantly reducing labor, cost, weight, and supply chain complexity in sectors like automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics. Q5D's automation enhances product reliability and allows localized production, eliminating the need for wiring harness inventory and enabling more resilient, efficient supply chains.
