Their innovative CAD/CAM integrated systems and hardware-as-a-service model uniquely position them to transform traditional manual wiring assembly processes.
Investors: Lockheed Martin Ventures, Chrysalix, Maven SWIF, SOSV, UKI2S, UntroD, CPI Enterprises

Pitch: Guidehealth is an AI-powered healthcare services platform that helps health systems and clinically integrated networks proactively manage high-risk patients and improve outcomes under value-based care models. The company uses advanced AI technology to facilitate care coordination tasks such as prior authorizations and referrals, while providing virtual clinical team members called Healthguides to support providers and patients. Guidehealth focuses on personalized, prescriptive analytics to deliver tailored interventions that reduce fragmentation and close care gaps, including for uninsured and underinsured populations. Its platform integrates seamlessly into provider workflows to lower administrative burden and improve care access and quality across multiple states in the US.

ZeroRISC is a Boston-based company providing silicon supply chain integrity solutions through open-source silicon security technology. Founded by Dominic Rizzo, the creator of the OpenTitan project, ZeroRISC commercializes OpenTitan-based open-source silicon root of trust designs to deliver secure, transparent device ownership and control. Their Integrity Management Platform allows customers in sectors like silicon production, IoT, and critical infrastructure to enforce security policies independently of manufacturers, enhancing device trust and supply chain security. The company recently raised $10 million in seed funding to accelerate adoption of its production-grade open-source silicon security solutions.
Investors: Fontinalis Partners, Fundomo, Ray Stata, Dylan Patel

Pitch: Dreamhub is an AI-native CRM platform specifically designed for B2B SaaS companies, offering predictive insights and workflow automation to sales teams. It leverages SaaS-tuned deep AI models and a modern AI-vertical ontology to create a fully autonomous CRM that learns from real sales interactions, executes workflows, and updates pipelines in real time. Dreamhub integrates data across the entire customer journey, delivering deeper insights and smarter automation than traditional CRM stacks. Its unique architecture enables scalable, reliable predictive intelligence, aiming to unify the go-to-market stack under a single AI-powered system.
Investors: founders of MuleSoft, founders of Pardot, founders of Datorama

Pitch: OpenTrade is a London-based fintech providing an institutional-grade platform for real-world asset-backed USDC and EURC yield products, designed for fintechs and institutions globally. The company offers safe, compliant, and scalable stablecoin infrastructure and yield products that can be embedded directly into digital wallets and financial apps. OpenTrade stands out with its bankruptcy-remote SPVs, bank-grade operations, and tested legal framework, enabling secure and transparent access to digital dollar and euro yields.
Investors: Notion Capital, Mercury Fund, AlbionVC, a16z crypto, CMCC Global

Pitch: Arlequin AI is a French startup specializing in sovereign AI-driven data intelligence and decision support, founded in 2024. Their flagship platform, HuDex, processes large volumes of complex, multilingual, unstructured data in real time without relying on pre-trained models or black-box methods, ensuring transparency and European data sovereignty. Targeting public institutions, media, and major corporations, Arlequin AI helps combat disinformation and provides unbiased, actionable insights for security, communication, and strategic planning. The company stands out by combining cutting-edge unsupervised AI algorithms with expertise in geopolitics and systemic risk to address information chaos efficiently and cost-effectively.
Investors: Vsquared Ventures, 10x Founders, Kima Ventures, Better Angle

Pitch: Nova Healthcare Administrators specializes in self-funded health benefits, offering employers the flexibility to design personalized plans that manage medical costs. Their services focus on enhancing employee benefits while simplifying healthcare management. Nova's approach allows for customized benefit plans tailored to meet the specific needs of employees and their families. This flexibility and personalized service make Nova a valuable partner for businesses seeking to optimize their healthcare offerings.

Shovels is a construction technology company that offers a building permit intelligence platform to help construction companies and related businesses leverage rich, real-time permit data. Their core product provides comprehensive access to building permits, contractor expertise, inspector schedules, and real estate transaction data, enabling users to identify qualified contractors and understand market opportunities. Targeting decision-makers in construction and climate tech sectors, Shovels simplifies complex data to drive smarter project decisions and growth. Their unique value lies in aggregating over 100 million building permits into an accessible, actionable resource, akin to a Pitchbook for the construction industry.

Atraverse Medical is a San Diego-based medical device company developing next-generation transseptal access technologies for minimally invasive cardiac procedures. Their proprietary HOTWIRE™ system is a radiofrequency guidewire designed to simplify left-heart access with universal sheath compatibility and optimized RF biophysics, improving patient outcomes and streamlining physician workflows. Founded in 2022 by the same team behind FARAPULSE, Atraverse targets cardiovascular disease treatment, aiming to enhance safety and efficiency in left-heart catheter-based procedures performed worldwide. The company recently closed $29 million in financing to accelerate commercialization and expand its product pipeline.

Standard Nuclear is an advanced nuclear fuel company based in the United States that manufactures and supplies TRISO fuel forms for next-generation nuclear reactors, including small modular and micro-reactors. The company operates commercial-scale, fully permitted radiological facilities on a 36.8-acre campus at the former K-25 Nuclear site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee. Serving commercial and government customers such as the U.S. Department of Energy and Department of Defense, Standard Nuclear aims to secure the domestic advanced nuclear fuel supply chain and support America's nuclear energy renaissance with safe, reliable, and scalable fuel solutions. Their strategic focus on TRISO fuel production and substantial funding positions them to meet growing energy demands and advance energy independence.

AIM is a ClimateTech company that has developed the world's first embodied AI platform for earthmoving machinery, targeting the construction and mining industries. Their AI-powered technology automates heavy equipment such as excavators to improve safety and productivity in these traditionally dangerous sectors. AIM's platform helps transform how critical materials and resources are mined and grown by enabling autonomous operations. The company recently raised $50 million to advance its mission of maximizing safety and efficiency in earthmoving tasks globally.

Nexus IT is a U.S.-based IT support and managed services company. It offers a worry-free, hyper-responsive approach to IT solutions, allowing leaders to focus on their business. Nexus IT provides world-class support to elevate business operations. The company's services are designed to ensure seamless IT operations, enabling businesses to focus on growth and strategy.

Abacum is a financial planning and analysis (FP&A) software platform designed to empower finance teams by streamlining processes, enabling real-time data collection and analysis, and supporting faster, more strategic decision-making. Their core product is a scalable, AI-powered solution tailored for mid-market companies, focusing on eliminating manual tasks and enhancing collaboration within finance departments. Abacum stands out for its agentic AI, robust modeling engine, and collaborative workflows, making it valuable for organizations seeking to accelerate business growth and execution[1][3][5].

Antares Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on developing first-in-class precision medicines targeting validated yet previously undruggable targets in cancer and other serious diseases with significant unmet needs. The company, a spin-out from Scorpion Therapeutics, advances a pipeline of small molecule assets in precision oncology and other therapeutic areas. Its lead program is expected to enter clinical trials in 2026, supported by a robust preclinical pipeline. Antares is led by experienced executives from Scorpion and aims to transform treatment options for patients with critical illnesses.

HighGround is a SaaS platform that helps investors and operators seamlessly access and succeed in the U.S. government market. It provides investment intelligence, forecasting tools, and real-time data pipelines to streamline compliance, procurement, and market entry. The platform targets startups, investors, and technology companies looking to unlock growth opportunities in sectors such as defense, infrastructure, health, and science. By simplifying the complex government market, HighGround enables users to identify and capitalize on high-growth opportunities unique to this space.

VODA.ai is a ClimateTech company that uses proprietary AI and machine learning to help water utilities predict pipe failures and lead presence, enabling better infrastructure management. Their platform offers tools like risk modeling, leak monitoring, and capital planning to optimize water asset management and reduce water loss. Serving utilities and municipalities, VODA.ai’s technology improves operational decisions, prevents catastrophic failures, and supports efficient capital investment in water infrastructure. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Boston, the company stands out for its industry expertise and customer-focused AI solutions.

Arcos, Inc. provides a comprehensive workforce management platform designed to enhance efficiency and productivity in field operations, particularly for utilities and large-scale industries. Their solution connects crews, back-office teams, and executives in a single platform, enabling faster response times and better operational visibility. Trusted by major electric and gas utilities and Fortune 150 energy companies, Arcos offers tailored resource management tools that optimize daily activities and emergency response with real-time insights. Their platform helps organizations achieve up to 30% increased efficiency and improved workforce agility.

T.D. Williamson is a global leader in pipeline services, providing equipment and solutions for the gathering, transmission, and distribution sectors of the pipeline industry. Their core offerings include pigging, integrity, intervention, and isolation products for both onshore and offshore pipelines. The company serves pipeline operators worldwide, focusing on maximizing uptime, safety, and sustainability through innovative technologies like the ProStopp™ DS isolation tool. With over 100 years of experience, TDW is valued for its commitment to safety, reliability, and helping the industry meet net-zero and sustainability goals.

Finofo is a Calgary-based fintech platform that automates accounts payable, treasury, and global receivables for businesses, enabling efficient cross-border payments and multi-currency management. Its core product integrates global banking, FX, and AP/AR workflows into a single, user-friendly interface, helping companies reduce fees, streamline operations, and manage currency risk. Finofo primarily targets mid-market and SMB businesses that require reliable, compliant, and cost-effective solutions for international financial operations, distinguishing itself with native support for both U.S. and Canadian entities and embedded compliance.

Proxima Fusion is a German ClimateTech startup pioneering the development of the world's first stellarator-based fusion power plant, aiming to deliver clean, carbon-neutral energy. Founded in 2023 as a spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, it leverages advanced quasi-isodynamic stellarator technology to create powerful magnets that enable fusion reactions. The company targets energy markets seeking sustainable and resilient power solutions, with plans to build a demonstration plant by 2031 and commercial plants in the following decade. Its unique value lies in being Europe's fastest-growing fusion startup with strong public-private partnerships and record private funding backing.

Elkedonia is a French healthcare startup pioneering a novel neuroplastogen approach to develop fast-acting, non-addictive, and non-hallucinogenic antidepressant treatments targeting treatment-resistant depression and other neuropsychiatric disorders. Their innovative therapy induces neuroplasticity through a highly selective intracellular signaling pathway, differentiating it from existing drugs like ketamine. Founded by experts from Sorbonne University and Argobio, Elkedonia focuses on precision medicine to provide safe, effective psychiatric treatments accessible to all.

SpliceBio is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company based in Spain that develops next-generation gene therapies using its proprietary Protein Splicing platform. The company focuses on treating severe genetic diseases caused by mutations in large genes that are difficult to address with traditional gene therapies. Its lead program, SB-007, targets Stargardt disease, a hereditary retinal disorder, and is currently in phase 1/2 clinical trials. SpliceBio's unique dual AAV gene therapy approach enables delivery of large genes, offering new therapeutic options for patients with currently untreatable genetic conditions.

Lembas is an Israeli healthcare startup leveraging AI to discover and design natural bioactive peptides that stimulate the body's GLP-1 hormone, which regulates appetite and metabolism. Their flagship product, GLP-1 Edge, is a food-grade ingredient aimed at weight management and metabolic health, offering a natural alternative to prescription drugs like Ozempic. By embedding science-backed nutrition into foods and supplements, Lembas empowers consumers to manage weight effectively without costly prescriptions or side effects. The company’s AI-driven platform accelerates the discovery of functional ingredients with broad health benefits, backed by licensed technology from Tel Aviv University.

Machaxi is a Bengaluru-based sports tech startup that provides AI-powered grassroots coaching and training facilities, primarily focusing on badminton. Their platform uses AI to analyze players' posture and technique via the Machaxi app, enabling consistent and scalable coaching even in areas with limited access to expert trainers. The company operates multi-sport centers under the Machaxi Sports Centre brand, offering professional coaching, playing memberships, and integrated sports equipment shopping. Machaxi is expanding beyond Bengaluru into Hyderabad, Pune, and Chennai, and partnering with the Padukone School of Badminton to establish over 1,000 coaching centers nationwide in the next four years.

Cyera is a cybersecurity company specializing in data security for enterprises, offering an AI-native platform that provides deep visibility, continuous control, and rapid risk remediation of sensitive data across cloud environments. Founded by veterans of Israel’s Unit 8200, Cyera addresses the critical gap in data visibility and protection that many organizations face, helping security leaders discover their data attack surface and monitor data usage effectively. Its unique approach combines agentless deployment with AI/ML technology to secure data as a vital enterprise asset, trusted by major clients like Paramount Pictures and Mercury Financial. The company recently raised $300 million in Series C funding, valuing it at $1.4 billion, underscoring its rapid growth and industry impact.
Investors: Georgian, Greenoaks, Lightspeed, Accel, Coatue, Cyberstarts, Redpoint, Sapphire Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Spark Capital

Pitch: Fermàt is an AI-native commerce platform that enables enterprise brands and agencies to create hyper-personalized shopping experiences without heavy engineering resources. Its core products, including Pierre Strategize AI and Commerce Brain, use behavioral data and large language models to optimize customer journeys for both human and AI-driven interactions. Targeting brands facing rising customer acquisition costs and personalization demands, Fermàt helps drive stronger engagement and conversion through scalable, AI-powered commerce solutions. The platform’s unique value lies in delivering tailored, measurable commerce experiences that adapt in real-time across all digital touchpoints.
Investors: VMG Partners, QED Investors, Greylock, Bain Capital Ventures, Courtside Ventures

Pitch: Tracksuit is a New Zealand-based SaaS company providing an always-on brand tracking platform that delivers real-time, AI-powered insights into brand health metrics such as awareness, consideration, usage, and perception. Their platform surveys thousands weekly, offering detailed insights across markets, demographics, and competitors, making brand tracking more affordable and accessible for small to medium businesses as well as large firms. Tracksuit serves over 1,000 brands globally, including notable clients like Steve Madden and Disney, and operates in multiple regions including the US, Europe, and Asia. The company aims to become the common language for brand tracking by enabling smarter decisions through visible and actionable brand data[2][3][5].
Investors: VMG Partners, Altos Ventures, Footwork, Blackbird, Icehouse Ventures

Pitch: CloudQuery offers a comprehensive cloud asset management platform that enables organizations to perform smarter cloud audits, maintain detailed cloud asset inventories, and conduct targeted security monitoring. Its platform integrates with major cloud providers like AWS, GCP, and Azure, syncing data into a unified system accessible via UI, SQL console, and REST API. Unique features include easy cloud connection setup, attribute-based asset search, and the ability to export data to various data warehouses, making it valuable for teams seeking centralized visibility and control over cloud environments.

Farsight is a fintech company providing an AI-driven financial insights and workflow automation platform tailored for investment banks, private equity, hedge funds, and wealth management firms. Their technology automates the creation of client-ready documents such as pitch decks, financial models, and memos, replicating a firm's historical work style and voice to maintain brand consistency. By integrating institutional knowledge and CRM data, Farsight proactively generates strategic materials and sharpens competitive intelligence, enabling financial teams to work faster and uncover deeper insights. Founded by MIT graduates, Farsight has rapidly grown its revenue and customer base by transforming complex, manual finance workflows into efficient, high-accuracy AI-powered processes.
Investors: SignalFire, RRE Ventures, Link Ventures, K5 Ventures

Pitch: Lemony offers an innovative "AI in a Box" hardware device that enables organizations to run generative AI workflows securely on-premise, ensuring data privacy by keeping all documents, files, and AI models local. Their solution targets heavily regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, and legal sectors that demand strict data control. Lemony's product integrates with enterprise-grade AI models and development tools from partners like IBM and JetBrains, providing a federated architecture that supports multiple teams within an organization while maintaining tight control over shared AI insights. This unique combination of secure hardware, preloaded AI models, and collaborative software makes Lemony valuable for businesses needing powerful yet private AI capabilities[1][2][3].

Sefit health is a Swiss healthtech startup developing a virtual reality-based training tool designed to help individuals with impaired stimulus filtering, such as those with ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, or migraines, manage sensory overload and reduce reliance on medication. Their VR solution provides a safe, controlled, and gamified environment where users can gradually build coping skills by facing stressful real-life situations at their own pace. Targeting over 120 million people across the DACH region, the US, and Canada, Sefit aims to enhance daily functioning in social, educational, and work settings. The company plans to obtain medical certification following clinical studies expected in late 2025.

Perci Health is a UK-based virtual care clinic specializing in multidisciplinary cancer survivorship care, connecting patients and caregivers with over 85 NHS-trained cancer experts across 17 disciplines. Utilizing an AI-powered platform, it offers personalised care plans, early detection, risk assessment, symptom management, and vocational rehabilitation, facilitating appointments within 48 hours. The company focuses on holistic support from prevention to rehabilitation, improving quality of life and return-to-work outcomes. Its unique blend of digital innovation and expert human care makes high-quality cancer support accessible and effective.

OneBalance is a UK-based fintech and crypto software company that simplifies cross-chain blockchain interactions by eliminating the need for chains, bridges, and gas fees for users. Their core product, the OneBalance Toolkit, leverages innovative Resource Locks technology to enable developers and fintech apps to offer seamless one-click transactions across any blockchain, token, or action with unmatched speed, reliability, and cost efficiency. Targeting wallets, exchanges, launchpads, stablecoin-powered apps, and AI agents, OneBalance enhances user acquisition and retention by delivering a frictionless onchain experience that addresses crypto's fragmented user experience. Founded by blockchain infrastructure veterans, the company also provides configurable transaction fees and MEV protection, making it a unique and valuable platform in the fintech and crypto space.

Bolo AI provides a comprehensive AI-powered operating system designed specifically for the energy industry to enhance operational speed, safety, and efficiency. Their platform unifies diverse data sources, enabling energy workers to ask natural language questions and receive accurate, domain-specific answers quickly, improving decision-making and productivity. Bolo AI’s solutions automate complex tasks like compliance reporting and lease management, integrating seamlessly with existing enterprise tools such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Azure SQL. This specialization in energy industry nuances and data types makes Bolo AI uniquely effective at delivering fast, reliable insights to capital projects and operational teams.

Leumas is a digital manufacturing solution provider based in Bangalore, India, specializing in on-demand production for brands in the nutrition, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical sectors. Their modular, AI-driven factories enable flexible batch sizes and rapid product iterations, allowing brands to go from concept to market efficiently while minimizing inventory and capital investment. Leumas offers scalable, FDA-compliant manufacturing that supports product development, pre-commercial testing, and commercial production with improved capital efficiency. Founded in 2022, Leumas uniquely combines advanced robotics and cloud-based formulation improvements to accelerate product development and scale-up for brands seeking innovative manufacturing solutions.

Gillidanda Tech Pvt. Ltd, operating under the brand MetaShot, is an Indian gaming startup based in Bengaluru that develops innovative gaming hardware and software. Their flagship product, the MetaShot Smart Bat, is a cricket bat equipped with motion sensors that track real-world shots and translate them into virtual gameplay within the MetaShot app. Targeting both B2C and B2B markets, MetaShot aims to deliver a console-like gaming experience to a broader audience using homegrown technology with pending patents. The company focuses on merging physical and virtual play across sports-based games, differentiating itself with localized manufacturing and quality India-made products.

AIM Intelligent Machines transforms existing heavy machinery used in mining and construction into autonomous, AI-powered equipment, enhancing safety and productivity in high-risk environments. Their rugged, plug-and-play platform retrofits a wide range of earthmoving machines, regardless of make or model, enabling autonomous operation with features like site planning and remote management. Founded by engineers from top tech companies, AIM's technology addresses labor shortages and operational inefficiencies in critical infrastructure and mining sectors. Their solution unlocks value through improved fleet availability, fuel savings, and safer job sites.
Investors: Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, Human Capital, Ironspring Ventures, Mantis, DCVC, Elad Gil

Pitch: Coco Robotics is a U.S.-based company specializing in autonomous last-mile delivery robots designed for urban logistics. Their zero-emission robots can carry up to 90 liters of goods and have completed over 500,000 deliveries since 2020, serving national retailers like Subway and Jack in the Box. The company leverages AI, including a partnership with OpenAI, to optimize delivery efficiency and scale its fleet, aiming to operate the world's largest autonomous delivery vehicle fleet. Their capital-efficient model and strategic funding enable expansion across multiple U.S. cities and internationally, targeting rapid growth in autonomous delivery solutions.
Investors: DeepWater, Outlander, SNR, Sam Altman, Max Altman, Pelion Venture Partners, Offline Ventures

Pitch: Outset is an AI-powered research platform that automates and scales user research by conducting AI-moderated video, audio, and text interviews at speed and scale. It enables companies to capture rich, nuanced insights from hundreds of participants simultaneously, synthesizing raw conversations into themes, quotes, and actionable insights within hours. The platform supports diverse use cases including usability testing and user behavior analysis, allowing one person to perform the work of an entire research team efficiently. Outset uniquely combines AI interview moderation, multi-language support, and instant insight generation to streamline research workflows and reduce costs.
Investors: 8VC, Bain & Company, Y Combinator, Adverb Ventures, Rebel Fund, Genius Ventures, Ritual Capital, Alt Capital

Pitch: Spinny is a leading online platform in India for buying and selling certified used cars, offering a wide selection of over 5000 fully inspected vehicles from trusted brands like Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai, and Honda. The company provides transparent pricing, hassle-free RC transfer, and dependable after-sales support, ensuring a safe and convenient car buying experience. Spinny caters to a broad range of customers with options across different budgets, from affordable first cars to premium vehicles. Its acquisition of Haymarket's automotive titles further strengthens its position and connection with automotive enthusiasts in India.

Kisah is an Indian e-commerce brand specializing in men's celebration and ethnic wear, offering premium, stylish kurtas and traditional clothing. The brand emphasizes unique designs inspired by nostalgia and premium fabric quality, catering primarily to customers seeking fashionable attire for Indian weddings and cocktail parties. Kisah combines cultural heritage with modern style, providing a direct-to-consumer shopping experience both online and offline. Recently, it raised Rs 13 crore in angel funding to expand its offline and D2C business presence.

Repello is an AI-powered cybersecurity startup based in India and the US, specializing in securing generative AI (GenAI) applications. Their flagship products, ARTEMIS and Repello Guard, provide continuous automated red teaming and runtime threat monitoring to identify, simulate, and mitigate AI-specific vulnerabilities across text, image, and audio modalities. Tailored for enterprises, Repello integrates into CI/CD pipelines to proactively safeguard AI systems against evolving threats with context-aware, model-agnostic technology. Founded in 2024 by IIT Roorkee alumni, the company leverages advanced offensive security simulations to protect GenAI applications in real time.
Investors: Venture Highway, Pi Ventures, Entrepreneur First

Pitch: Multiverse Computing is a leading AI and quantum software company based in Spain that develops hyper-efficient quantum-inspired AI solutions to address complex industry challenges. Their flagship products, Singularity and CompactifAI, serve blue-chip clients in sectors such as finance, energy, manufacturing, and cybersecurity. CompactifAI specializes in compressing large AI models like large language models to enhance efficiency and portability. The company is recognized as the largest quantum software firm in the EU and one of the top 100 AI companies globally.

Payrails is a German fintech company offering an all-in-one payment platform designed for global enterprises to manage and optimize payments across multiple providers and geographies. Their modular platform covers the entire payment lifecycle, including payment orchestration, payouts, tokenization, unified analytics, automated reconciliation, and in-person payments. Targeting high-growth companies facing fragmented payment systems and regulatory complexities, Payrails provides greater control, visibility, and flexibility in payment operations. The company has rapidly expanded across 30 markets, serving clients like Puma, Vinted, and Flix, and recently raised €27.7 million in Series A funding to accelerate product innovation and commercial growth in EMEA.

LILT is an AI platform specializing in enterprise-grade content creation, translation, and summarization for over 100 languages, integrating with 100+ business systems. The company serves global organizations, enterprises, and government teams seeking to centralize, automate, and secure multilingual workflows. LILT differentiates itself by combining context-aware AI with human expertise to deliver high-quality, compliant, and scalable solutions for marketing, life sciences, technical materials, and e-learning.

hellocare.ai is an AI-assisted virtual healthcare delivery platform that integrates software, hardware, and artificial intelligence to transform hospital care models and operations. Its unified platform is deployed across over 70 health systems, enabling hospitals to offer AI-powered services such as ambient documentation, digital whiteboards, patient engagement, and hospital-at-home care. The company collaborates with leading institutions like Mayo Clinic to develop ambient clinical intelligence technology that aims to improve patient outcomes by enabling early detection, reducing clinician workload, and supporting proactive inpatient care. hellocare.ai's enterprise-grade solution enhances the safety, responsiveness, and efficiency of virtual care delivery in healthcare settings.

New Iridium is a Colorado-based ClimateTech company pioneering sustainable, carbon-negative chemical solutions using proprietary photocatalysis technology. Their platform converts CO2 and plant-based feedstocks into bio-based chemicals like acetic acid and ethyl acetate at lower cost and ambient temperatures, reducing emissions compared to fossil-based methods. Targeting the chemical industry, they offer cost-effective, environmentally friendly alternatives that leverage clean photons to drive reactions, enabling decarbonization and electrification of chemical manufacturing.

Second Foundation Partners is a technology-driven investment firm that analyzes and anticipates the narratives influencing behavior in financial, business, political, and sports markets. Co-founded by experts with backgrounds in investment management, political science, and technology, the company leverages interdisciplinary insights and advanced analytics to inform investment decisions. Their unique combination of market expertise and storytelling analysis aims to create value through understanding complex market dynamics.

Olyzon is an AdTech company specializing in Connected TV (CTV) advertising, offering an AI-powered agentic media activation platform designed to maximize campaign reach for Tier 1 advertisers and agencies. Their proprietary platform, Olyzon+, provides hyper-contextual targeting, interactive in-stream ad formats, and ad sequencing to enhance ad effectiveness and viewer experience in premium broadcast environments. Olyzon's solutions focus on boosting return on ad spend (ROAS) for advertisers while increasing monetization opportunities for publishers, supported by an in-house creative studio. The company recently secured significant funding to expand its innovative CTV advertising technology, particularly in the U.S. market.

Iterate.ai is an enterprise AI application platform that accelerates AI development through its low-code, drag-and-drop environment called Interplay. It supports building intelligent AI agents and agent swarms with over 400 AI nodes and 4,000 additional integrations, seamlessly connecting to legacy systems like SAP, Salesforce, and Oracle. Targeting developers and business users, Iterate.ai enables ultra-fast, scalable AI application deployment anywhere from cloud to edge with a strong focus on privacy and security. The platform is recognized for innovation and trusted by leading enterprises and technology partners worldwide.

GrailPay is a fintech company founded in 2021 that provides a risk platform and ACH payment processing infrastructure designed to make bank payments safer, faster, and more efficient. Its platform offers predictive analytics and real-time signals for account enrollment, transaction monitoring, and merchant underwriting, helping fintechs, lenders, and payment platforms reduce failed payments and automate risk management. GrailPay's modular tools can be adopted with or without its payment processing services, serving over 10,000 businesses. The company's unique value lies in its AI-native, machine learning-enhanced risk layer tailored specifically for bank payments, addressing the need for innovation in ACH payment security and intelligence.

Sauz is a food and beverage company specializing in a new generation of tomato and pasta sauces featuring bold, curated, and innovative flavors like Hot Honey Marinara and Summer Lemon Marinara. Founded in 2023 by childhood friends, Sauz uses premium, non-GMO, gluten-free ingredients to create restaurant-quality sauces that bring creativity and excitement to pasta night. The company targets both traditional and dietary-conscious consumers and has rapidly expanded to over 7,000 retailers nationwide including Target, Whole Foods, Kroger, and Sprouts. Sauz stands out with its vibrant packaging and unique flavor combinations that elevate the jarred sauce category.

Zorro is a healthcare benefits company that enables employers to set a fixed benefits budget per employee and helps employees personalize and choose the optimal health benefit bundles for their individual needs. The platform shifts from traditional defined benefit plans to a defined contribution model using ICHRA regulations, providing cost stability and flexibility. Zorro offers end-to-end administration and compliance management, empowering employers to control costs while giving employees choice and flexibility in their healthcare coverage. Their solution targets employers, brokers, and employees, aiming to make healthcare benefits more affordable, personalized, and easier to manage.

Parallel Bio pioneers human-first drug discovery by combining organoids and AI to create true-to-life models of human biology, focusing on the immune system to cure disease. The company uses a human immune system in a dish and AI to identify drugs more likely to succeed in patients, targeting pharmaceutical partners and major healthcare organizations. Parallel Bio differentiates itself by moving beyond animal models to organoid-based platforms, aiming to dramatically reduce drug development failure rates and accelerate the discovery of effective therapies[1][2][5].

SushiDog is a London-based FoodTech company operating a quick service restaurant chain specializing in freshly made Japanese food to go, including sushi burritos, sushi rolls, poke bowls, and salads. Founded in 2018, the company currently runs 10 locations and aims to expand to 40 sites across the UK over the next five years. SushiDog is known for its made-to-order offerings and a proven scalable business model, targeting customers seeking convenient, high-quality Japanese fast food. With £1.3 million in recent seed funding led by Middleton Enterprises, SushiDog plans to accelerate growth and expand beyond London into regional cities and travel hubs.

Mezzion Pharma is a South Korean biopharmaceutical company specializing in developing treatments for rare diseases, particularly single ventricle heart disease and Fontan circulation. Their lead product candidate, JURVIGO® (udenafil), aims to be the first treatment option to improve physiology and exercise capacity in Fontan patients aged 12 and older. The company has made significant progress with a pivotal Phase 3 clinical study recognized by the American Heart Association as a major advancement in congenital heart disease. Mezzion is committed to delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of over 70,000 Fontan patients worldwide.

Meter is a San Francisco-based company providing enterprise internet infrastructure solutions, including hardware, firmware, software, deployment, and support for reliable, secure, and scalable internet, Wi-Fi, and cellular connectivity. Their integrated networking solution scales from branch offices and warehouses to large campuses and data centers, automating complex network setup and management. Meter's products include internally developed switches, access points, power distribution units, and cybersecurity appliances that filter malicious traffic and enable secure remote access. Trusted by major companies like Bridgewater, Lyft, and Reddit, Meter aims to be the foundational networking infrastructure provider for enterprises of all sizes.
Investors: General Catalyst, Baillie Gifford, JPMorgan Chase, Microsoft, Sequoia Capital, WndrCo, Lachy Groom

Pitch: Gecko Robotics develops AI-powered wall-climbing robots and enterprise software to inspect, protect, and maintain critical industrial infrastructure faster and more safely than traditional methods. Their Cantilever platform uses advanced robotics and AI to collect and analyze high-quality data, enabling operational excellence and asset life extension for customers in energy, manufacturing, and defense sectors. By combining hardware and software as a service, Gecko transforms infrastructure management with actionable insights and reduces human risk during inspections.
Investors: Cox Enterprises, USIT, XN, Founders Fund, YC, Friends & Family Capital

Pitch: Sojo Industries is an industrial automation company specializing in robotics, mobility, and modular packaging solutions primarily for the food and beverage industry. They operate a sophisticated SQF-compliant facility in Pennsylvania with multiple automated lines supporting various packaging materials. Additionally, Sojo offers a proprietary mobile manufacturing system, Sojo Flight, which delivers on-site packaging services to reduce freight, labor, packaging costs, and emissions. Their blockchain-secured technology, Sojo Shield™, ensures compliance with FDA traceability guidelines and enhances quality control and recall management.

Landbase is a SaaS company offering the first agentic AI platform designed to automate go-to-market (GTM) workflows for sales and marketing teams. Its AI agents autonomously identify ideal prospects, generate compelling outreach, and manage the entire sales pipeline, significantly increasing conversion rates by 4-7x. Targeting small businesses, sales agencies, and GTM teams, Landbase replaces fragmented tools with a unified intelligent platform that handles outbound sales, lead generation, and inbound marketing. The platform’s uniqueness lies in its agentic AI model trained on billions of GTM data points, enabling autonomous planning, execution, and learning with minimal human intervention.
Investors: Sound Venures, Picus Capital, 8VC, A*, Firstminute Capital, the GP

Pitch: Autonomize AI provides a Trusted AI platform designed specifically for healthcare and life sciences organizations to reduce administrative burdens and improve patient outcomes through AI copilots that organize, contextualize, and summarize unstructured data. Their solutions emphasize enterprise-wide orchestration, explainability, and human-in-the-loop workflows, ensuring transparency and accuracy in regulated healthcare environments. Serving top pharmaceuticals, Fortune 100 healthcare enterprises, and life sciences companies, Autonomize AI uniquely augments healthcare knowledge workers rather than replacing them, facilitating scalable and responsible innovation in healthcare operations.
Investors: Valtruis, Cigna Ventures, Tau Ventures, Asset Management Ventures, ATX Venture Partners, Capital Factory

Pitch: Try Your Best is a community rewards platform focused on brand loyalty and consumer engagement within the ecommerce sector. It allows brands to create challenges that fans can participate in to earn rewards redeemable for discounts, fostering deeper customer connections and measurable loyalty. Founded in 2020 and based in Tucson, Arizona, Try Your Best leverages blockchain and crypto technologies to enhance loyalty programs, distinguishing itself as a challenger in the loyalty and rewards tech space.
Investors: Offline Ventures, Strobe Ventures (fka Blocktower VC), Coinbase Ventures, Castle Island Ventures, Unusual Ventures

Pitch: Brandback is a German RetailTech company providing an AI-powered resale platform that integrates directly into retailer checkouts to boost conversion rates and customer lifetime value through resale insights. Their turnkey solution manages all operational processes including customer service, shipping, disputes, and payouts, enabling retailers to focus on their core business without upfront costs. Brandback serves global fashion brands like Replay Jeans and Sandqvist, offering a scalable, vertical-agnostic platform that supports sustainable consumption and new revenue models by embedding resale seamlessly into online shopping. With recent funding, Brandback aims to expand its AI capabilities and grow its presence in Europe and the US resale markets.

RIIICO is a German deeptech startup that offers an AI-powered software platform to create accurate 3D digital twins of existing industrial factories. Biobot's unique approach leverages molecular technologies and AI to track disease outbreaks and inform public health strategies on a national scale.

Xatoms is a cleantech startup developing the world’s most efficient visible light-activated photocatalysts to clean polluted water from biological pathogens, heavy metals, and chemical pollutants. Their technology targets remote communities, Indigenous regions, industrial sites, and emerging markets where traditional water treatment is unavailable or costly. Xatoms offers a patented photocatalyst powder that can be integrated into filters or water systems, providing a scalable, cost-effective, and sustainable water purification solution.

Polestar is a Swedish automotive manufacturer specializing in electric performance cars. Polestar targets environmentally conscious consumers seeking luxury electric cars, leveraging an asset-light manufacturing model with production handled by Volvo and Geely facilities globally. Its unique value lies in combining motorsport heritage with cutting-edge electric vehicle technology to drive progress toward a sustainable future.

Hailia is a Finnish FoodTech company developing innovative seafood processing technologies that transform underutilized fish sidestreams, such as heads and fins, into high-value, ready-to-eat products with a unique fish-like texture. Founded in 2021 and based in Karkkila, Finland, Hailia targets seafood processors and professional kitchens, enabling them to increase resource efficiency, profitability, and sustainability. Their technology supports circular economy practices by maximizing the use of fish byproducts and contributing to a more sustainable food system.

Pitch: Ostrom is a German digital green energy provider founded in 2021 that offers households transparent and affordable access to renewable electricity through a seamless energy management platform. Ostrom operates Germany's largest Virtual Power Plant, leveraging technology to simplify the energy transition and provide a flexible, customer-centric alternative to traditional utilities. Their mission is to make green electricity accessible and economical for all customers in Germany.

Seven is an Indian fintech startup that develops wearable contactless payment devices, notably the 7 Ring, a durable zirconia ceramic ring enabling tap-and-pay transactions without charging or smartphone dependency. Certified by RuPay and MasterCard, it targets daily metro commuters and digital payment users, aiming to expand financial inclusion through innovative, user-friendly hardware. The platform integrates advanced generative AI technologies to help healthcare providers meet CMS requirements and improve outcomes while reducing clinician burnout. Its unique clinician-validated large language model and patient care management system leverage text and voice to optimize care delivery for health systems, ambulatory surgery centers, and private practices.

Pitch: Sifflet is an AI-native data observability platform that provides unified data discovery, quality monitoring, lineage tracking, and anomaly detection to ensure data reliability and confidence. It serves data leaders, engineers, and business users by enabling proactive monitoring and troubleshooting across the entire data lifecycle. Headquartered in Paris, France, Sifflet aims to transform data strategy and governance for modern data-driven organizations.

Pitch: Ecohelix is a Swedish biotechnology company specializing in sustainable wood-based biopolymers called WOODMER®, developed through a patented process that converts pulp industry side streams into high-performance, climate-friendly alternatives to fossil-based plastics. Their products serve industrial applications such as packaging, adhesives, and paper chemicals, offering up to 96% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions and significantly higher performance than existing solutions. Headquartered in Stockholm, Ecohelix collaborates with biorefineries and has scaled demo production toward commercial industrial manufacturing, driving the transition to circular and sustainable materials in the chemical industry.

BlinkTroll is a defense technology startup founded by former Norwegian soldiers that develops autonomous, wire-based moving target systems to simulate realistic combat scenarios. Their modular and mobile target systems enhance soldier and police training by providing dynamic, realistic moving targets that improve decision-making and shooting accuracy. The technology is used by military and police forces across Northern Europe and aims to increase operational readiness and safety for NATO allies. BlinkTroll recently secured €1.5 million in pre-seed funding to scale production and expand within European defense markets.

Opensee provides AI-powered real-time data analytics and management solutions tailored for financial institutions such as banks, asset managers, and hedge funds. Their platform enables users to aggregate, explore, simulate, analyze, and visualize granular financial data to improve risk management, trade analytics, collateral management, and ESG risk analysis. Founded by former finance professionals, Opensee combines financial expertise with advanced big data technology to help clients leverage their complete data sets efficiently and gain competitive advantages. The company is recognized as a category leader in risk data aggregation and market risk solutions.

muffintech is a Berlin-based InsurTech company founded in 2021 that develops a specialized large language model and conversational AI platform tailored for the insurance industry. Their AI automates time-consuming tasks such as answering customer queries, searching policy details, handling objections, and providing benefit arguments to improve productivity for insurance companies and brokers. The platform integrates with internal systems to streamline workflows, reduce team workloads, and enhance customer service and conversion rates. muffintech's AI is trained on over 30,000 insurance-specific conversations and is recognized for its superior industry expertise and efficiency.

Electra is a French company providing a network of fast charging stations for electric vehicles across Europe. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Paris, it targets EV users by offering reliable, rapid charging solutions and a mobile app to book charging spots. Electra aims to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles through a vast, high-performance charging infrastructure, supporting the EU's transition to zero-emission transportation.

Giskard provides a collaborative and open-source SaaS platform designed for AI professionals to continuously test, evaluate, and monitor machine learning models, particularly large language models (LLMs). Their platform detects vulnerabilities such as hallucinations and security flaws, ensuring AI quality, fairness, and compliance before deployment. Targeting data scientists and enterprise AI teams, Giskard emphasizes proactive, automated vulnerability detection and business stakeholder accessibility to secure AI systems effectively.

Amartha is an Indonesian fintech microfinance marketplace that empowers women-led micro and small businesses in rural areas by providing accessible loans and impact investment opportunities. Established in 2010, it leverages technology to connect individual and institutional lenders directly with grassroots entrepreneurs, promoting inclusive economic growth. Licensed and supervised by Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK), Amartha offers various loan products including group loans and working capital loans, supported by data-driven risk profiling. Its unique focus on social impact and sustainability helps transform communities and improve livelihoods across Indonesia.

Pryme is a UK-based fintech company offering a multi-currency money app with personal and business accounts supporting over 60 currencies. It enables seamless cross-border transactions and flexible multi-currency management tailored to individuals and businesses. Pryme stands out by providing dedicated account managers and innovative financial solutions that simplify global banking for a new generation.

XFOLIO is a fintech platform offering modern treasury and portfolio management software designed for financial professionals such as financial institutions, family offices, and wealth managers. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in the United Kingdom, XFOLIO enables users to consolidate, automate, and visualize both bankable and non-bankable assets across multiple classes including stocks, bonds, real estate, art, and collectibles on a single platform using financial messaging standards like SWIFT. The platform targets mid-sized wealth managers who are underserved by existing systems and aims to democratize access to treasury and wealth management solutions with transparent, cost-effective pricing starting at $40 per month. It recently raised $2 million in seed funding to accelerate product development and expand across the MENA region and Europe.

Winich Farms operates a digital platform connecting over 180,000 smallholder farmers directly with processors and retailers, streamlining the agricultural supply chain in Nigeria. The platform reduces middlemen involvement, lowers costs, and improves market access and financial inclusion for farmers. Their services include a mobile app and a web-based agent platform to onboard farmers and aggregate produce efficiently. The company aims to expand its agri-fintech solutions beyond Nigeria into MENA markets.

Infinity Bio specializes in antibody reactome profiling using its proprietary Molecular Indexing of Proteins/Peptides by Self-Assembly (MIPSA) technology. The company provides comprehensive antibody analyses to support research in infectious diseases, autoimmune diseases, and cancer immunotherapy. Its services are utilized by vaccine developers, precision medicine initiatives, and biomarker discovery programs. Founded in 2023 and based in Baltimore, Infinity Bio advances disease understanding and therapeutic development through detailed antibody mapping.

Paradigm Therapeutics is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapies for rare diseases, primarily Epidermolysis Bullosa (EB). Its leading product, SD-101 (Zorblisa™), is a topical cream that has completed Phase II and III trials, showing potential to improve severe skin effects in all EB subtypes. The company aims to provide this therapy globally and works with partners for regulatory approval and commercialization. Paradigm's unique value lies in addressing a critical unmet medical need with a breakthrough, easy-to-use treatment.

isima is a clinically backed haircare brand inspired by the Latin community and ignited by Shakira. It offers a range of clean, cruelty-free products including shampoos, conditioners, and hair oils designed for total hair and scalp care. The brand emphasizes sustainable packaging and is committed to conscious beauty, with products available online and at Ulta Beauty stores in the U.S. and Mexico.

Materna Medical is an innovative MedTech company focused on women's pelvic health, developing FDA-cleared and investigational medical devices to address common pelvic conditions. Its flagship product, Milli, is an adjustable silicone vaginal dilator designed to treat vaginismus and chronic pelvic pain, marketed as a consumer wellness product and now FDA-cleared for treatment use. Materna also develops Prep, an investigational device aimed at improving acute labor and delivery outcomes. The company targets a $6 billion OBGYN market by revolutionizing care standards and empowering women to safeguard their pelvic health.

Profound offers a comprehensive AI platform that enables businesses to integrate generative AI and large language models with no-code tools for creating AI assistants and automating operations. The platform supports seamless connection to business data and deployment across applications, targeting organizations seeking practical, impactful AI solutions. Profound differentiates itself by focusing on real business value, ease of use, and rapid implementation to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

Budderfly provides energy management and efficiency services using an energy-as-a-service model that includes installation, monitoring, and management of high-efficiency equipment and proprietary energy software. The company serves businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurants, retail, healthcare, and educational institutions, helping them reduce energy costs and carbon footprint with no upfront costs. Headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut, Budderfly combines patented technologies, IoT sensors, HVAC and lighting upgrades, and renewable energy sourcing to deliver sustainable and cost-effective energy solutions.

Carefull is an AI-powered financial safety platform designed to protect older adults, especially those aged 55 and older, from financial fraud and mistakes. The platform provides monitoring tools for caregivers and family members to oversee and alert unusual financial activities such as suspicious transactions and duplicate payments. Carefull partners with banks, credit unions, and wealth advisors to help them safeguard senior customers and maintain their financial independence while facilitating caregiver involvement. Its unique focus on senior-specific financial threats and integration with financial institutions makes it a valuable solution in the fintech space.

NovaSpark Energy designs and manufactures mobile atmospheric hydrogen generators that produce clean hydrogen fuel and power from water in the air, enabling zero-emission energy solutions. Their technology supports extended flight times and enhanced payload capacity for hydrogen-powered long-range drones and vehicles, targeting defense, emergency response, and critical infrastructure sectors. The company’s systems operate off-grid, providing reliable power in remote or contested environments, and are deployed by the U.S. Department of Defense and commercial partners. NovaSpark’s innovation decouples critical energy systems from fragile infrastructure, advancing energy resilience and sustainability.

Icon Solutions is a UK-based fintech company that delivers state-of-the-art payment systems and technology solutions to leading financial institutions globally, including Citi, NatWest, and BNP Paribas. Their flagship product, the Icon Payments Framework (IPF), accelerates payments transformation, enabling banks to reduce costs, mitigate risks, and implement real-time payments. The company combines deep payments expertise with innovative technology to support banks' modernization and digitalization efforts. Icon Solutions recently secured new equity investment from UBS alongside existing investors, reinforcing its leadership in payments infrastructure.

Senra Systems revolutionizes aerospace and defense wire harness manufacturing by integrating advanced automation with proprietary software. Founded by former SpaceX engineers in 2023, the company accelerates production timelines from months to weeks while ensuring aerospace-grade precision and quality. Their platform combines sophisticated machinery, process controls, and expert engineering to deliver complex harnesses rapidly and reliably. Senra serves leading aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial, and healthcare clients with a unique assembly-as-a-service model that reduces overhead and hassle.

Enterome is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Paris, France, developing immunomodulatory drugs and therapeutic vaccines targeting cancer and immune diseases. Jubilé operates as a real estate company based in the United States, specializing in residential property brokerage and management. La Bourse aux Livres is a French e-commerce platform specializing in the resale and purchase of second-hand books. Founded by CEO Tim Estes, Angel AI recently secured $4.75 million in seed funding to accelerate product development and marketing. Its unique value lies in combining advanced AI with a parent-designed approach to child internet safety.

Daven Technologies operates in the HRTech sector, focusing on innovative solutions for talent acquisition and recruitment processes. The platform integrates real-life jockey performances into gameplay, offering competitions with rewards including digital cards and immersive experiences. Headquartered in France, Jockiz combines Web3 technology with horse racing fandom to create a unique digital collectible gaming experience.

PolyActiva is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Melbourne, Australia, specializing in innovative biodegradable ocular implants with sustained drug delivery for ophthalmic diseases such as glaucoma. The company has two main products in clinical development targeting glaucoma and post-surgical ocular infections. PolyActiva's technology ensures consistent dosing with implants that fully biodegrade without residue, offering a unique approach in ophthalmic medicine.

Elemental Advanced Materials transforms waste plastics, gases, and other carbon-containing materials into high-performance graphene at commercial scale using a patented CO2e neutral process. Targeting industries needing advanced materials, Elemental offers a sustainable alternative to toxic, resource-intensive graphene production. Gradient Network is developing the world's first fully decentralized AI runtime, creating a sovereign, peer-powered infrastructure where AI intelligence is hosted and owned by users rather than centralized entities. Targeting developers, researchers, and blockchain-native investors, Gradient Network aims to democratize AI access and foster innovation by decentralizing control over AI resources. TAC is a purpose-built blockchain designed to enable Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) decentralized applications to seamlessly access the TON and Telegram ecosystem's billion-plus user base. TAC focuses on onboarding leading Ethereum Mainnet protocols and boosting liquidity within the TON DeFi ecosystem, aiming to integrate DeFi services directly into Telegram Mini Apps and TON wallets.

Nook is a cryptocurrency savings platform founded by former Coinbase engineers that simplifies decentralized finance for non-crypto native users. Thinking Machines Lab is an artificial intelligence research and product company founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, United States. It emphasizes openness and collective scientific progress by frequently publishing technical work and sharing code.

RenewBuy is an Indian online insurance platform that simplifies comparing, buying, and renewing health, motor, and life insurance policies. The platform emphasizes transparency, expert advice, and hassle-free claims, targeting individual consumers seeking convenient and trustworthy insurance solutions. Headquartered in Gurugram, RenewBuy aims to empower customers with easy access to tailored insurance and financial products.

Quantix Edge Security is a public-private joint venture based in the Region of Murcia, Spain, focused on developing advanced cybersecurity solutions and semiconductor customization. The company collaborates with partners like WISeKey, SEALSQ, OdinS, and TProtege to foster technological sovereignty and reduce reliance on non-European suppliers. Its strategic center aims to become a leading hub for cybersecurity and microelectronics innovation aligned with EU digital transformation goals.

Captoplastic is a Spanish technology company founded in 2020 that develops patented solutions to identify, quantify, and capture microplastics from water bodies. Their innovative magnetic-based technology enables continuous removal of microplastics even as small as one micron, offering a sustainable and energy-efficient alternative to existing methods. Targeting wastewater treatment plants, drinking water facilities, and industrial applications, Captoplastic aims to protect human health and the environment by reducing microplastic pollution with a focus on zero waste and resource reuse.

Phenyx Health develops digital tools to support complex decision-making in healthcare, focusing on putting people at the center of healthcare transformation. The company aims to empower healthcare providers with advanced e-health solutions to improve patient outcomes. Based in Spain, Phenyx Health leverages technology to enhance healthcare processes and decision support systems.

Throxy is a UK-based startup founded in 2023 that offers an AI-powered, fully managed outbound sales platform. It automates the process of booking high-quality meetings with hard-to-reach decision-makers by combining proprietary outreach technology with expert human oversight. Targeting B2B sales teams, Throxy eliminates the need for large SDR teams by delivering personalized, relevant outreach that drives qualified meetings rather than just leads. Their innovative use of intelligent automation and continuous feedback loops enhances sales effectiveness while reducing repetitive prospecting tasks.

Robopedics is a company in the robotics industry specializing in robotic and automated material handling solutions. Their technology focuses on automating repetitive and high-risk warehouse tasks such as induction, depalletizing, and palletizing with AI-powered vision systems. The company emphasizes human-robot collaboration to enhance productivity and safety in fulfillment operations. Robopedics targets logistics and warehouse clients seeking scalable automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.

Silbo Money is a Spanish fintech that enables users to send, pay, and receive money instantly and securely through WhatsApp without needing to download an additional app. Founded in 2021 and authorized by the Bank of Spain as an electronic money institution, it targets consumers seeking seamless, chat-based payment solutions. Backed by former banking executives, Silbo Money focuses on convenience, security with multi-factor authentication, and plans to expand across the eurozone integrating with popular platforms.

Descartes Underwriting specializes in parametric insurance solutions addressing climate and emerging risks for corporate and public sector clients globally. Leveraging AI, machine learning, and real-time data from satellite imagery and IoT, it offers transparent, customized, and swift claims payment insurance products. The company partners with brokers to provide innovative risk coverage that traditional insurers struggle to offer due to increasing natural catastrophes. Its technology-driven approach enables rapid adaptation to evolving risk landscapes and supports global expansion.

ONiO is a Norwegian fabless semiconductor company specializing in ONiO.zero, a groundbreaking batteryless microcontroller that operates entirely on ambient energy sources like solar, RF, thermal, and kinetic energy. This technology eliminates the need for batteries in IoT devices, enabling sustainable electronics with minimal maintenance and environmental impact. ONiO.zero targets applications such as electronic shelf labels and remote controls, offering ultra-low power operation and programmable RISC-V architecture. The company recently raised €5 million to scale production of this innovative, energy-harvesting chip.

umob is a Dutch mobility platform based in Rotterdam that integrates multiple transportation options including public transit, bike-sharing, car rentals, and ride-hailing into one app. Founded in 2021, it enables users to compare, book, and pay for various shared and public transport modes seamlessly, promoting sustainable and efficient travel. The platform collaborates with municipalities and providers to optimize shared mobility infrastructure and reduce traffic congestion and emissions. umob currently operates in multiple European countries, offering a unified account for diverse mobility services and aiming to make shared mobility a convenient alternative to private vehicle ownership.

It supports contracts on both EVM and Solana without relying on bridges or wrapped tokens, enabling direct asset transfers from multiple blockchains. The platform offers cross-margin and multi-collateral accounts, deep liquidity through vaults and market makers, and supports a wide range of assets including crypto, FX, commodities, and TradFi indices. Defx focuses on risk management and self-custody to provide secure, transparent on-chain trading without counterparty risk.

BitVault offers an open source Bitcoin wallet focused on advanced security features including multisig technology and customizable time-delayed transactions to protect assets from physical attacks and hacks. It integrates with Bitcoin layers like Liquid and Lightning Network to provide a seamless and secure user experience. The wallet is designed for Bitcoin holders seeking robust protection of their digital assets through innovative security measures.

DEALCIRCLE is a German SaaS company providing a technology-based M&A deal matchmaking platform that helps M&A advisors identify suitable buyers using intelligent search algorithms and a proprietary investor database. Founded in 2018, the company supports the small- and mid-cap market by automating buyer identification and market approach processes, facilitating over 1,500 M&A projects annually. DEALCIRCLE leverages big data and AI to deliver superior buyer matching, making M&A processes more efficient and effective for advisors and investors.

InSoil is a climate fintech company that operates a marketplace connecting farmers with investors to support sustainable agriculture practices. It facilitates investments in regenerative farming, aiming to reduce carbon emissions and promote environmental resilience. The company's platform is designed to provide financial resources to agricultural businesses while generating both financial returns and climate impact.

CloudWalk is a Brazilian fintech company providing a cutting-edge global payment network and financial platform focused on small and medium enterprise merchants. Their flagship product, InfinitePay, democratizes access to world-class payment solutions, serving millions of clients in Brazil. CloudWalk leverages AI and machine learning for fraud prevention, earning certification from Brazil's National Confederation of Financial Institutions, and supports entrepreneurs with innovative payment technologies like Buy Now, Pay Later and Tap to Pay.

The startup serves around 300 clients and processed R$5 billion in credit in 2024, aiming to triple this volume by 2025. Its platform decentralizes credit access, increasing competition and reducing borrowing costs for end customers.

Trii is a Colombian fintech platform that democratizes stock market access by enabling retail investors to buy and sell local and international stocks and ETFs through a user-friendly mobile app. It offers low commissions, a fully digital experience, and professional advisory services in Spanish. Mágio is a Brazilian consumer goods company specializing in hygiene and cleaning products, including automotive care lines. Future Cow is Brazil's first food tech startup using precision fermentation to produce real milk without cows. Their technology creates molecularly identical dairy proteins that are lactose-free, cholesterol-free, and antibiotic-free, targeting the dairy ingredient industry. By replicating cow milk proteins sustainably, they reduce environmental impact significantly compared to traditional dairy. The company aims to supply alternative dairy proteins for use in products like cheese and ice cream, appealing to environmentally conscious consumers and multinational dairy clients.

Targeting businesses in Brazil, GRTS Digital stands out by focusing on legal tech applications tailored to labor and union management challenges.

Accordia provides an AI-powered contract intelligence platform that analyzes contracts in seconds to identify risks and opportunities often missed by manual review. Their technology targets legal and business professionals seeking faster, more accurate contract analysis to improve decision-making and risk management. The platform's unique value lies in its speed and precision, enabling users to efficiently extract actionable insights from complex contract data.

Norte Media is a Brazilian startup pioneering in the creator economy segment, focusing on influencer-driven content marketing. It owns the Guday brand, which offers creatine in gummy form developed with influencer Manuela Cit. The company targets the health, wellness, and media markets, leveraging influencer partnerships to drive product growth. Supported by strategic investments, Norte Media aims to expand its portfolio with multiple brands by 2026.

Just Travel is a Brazilian Travel Tech company founded in 2017 that provides a full e-commerce solution for travel agencies. Their platform offers white-label websites with API integrations to hotels, tickets, attractions, vacation homes, car rentals, and cruises, enabling agencies to scale online sales with competitive net rates and anti-fraud guarantees. It specializes in viral vector design, cell line development, and scalable manufacturing technologies, including proprietary platforms like TESSA for AAV production. Pimloc is a UK-based AI company specializing in visual privacy and security with its flagship product, Secure Redact. This platform automatically anonymizes personal and sensitive data in video and audio, enabling organizations to comply with privacy regulations while utilizing video for security and analytics. Pimloc serves diverse sectors including public safety, transport, healthcare, and retail, offering SaaS and API integrations that uniquely protect individuals' privacy in mass-scale video usage.

CarOnSale is a Berlin-based digital B2B marketplace that facilitates the trade of used cars across Europe, serving licensed dealers and OEMs. The platform offers an end-to-end solution including vehicle inspections, transparent auctions, and financing flexibility, streamlining procurement and remarketing processes. Perry is a Dutch AI startup founded in 2025 that develops AI-powered work instructions to empower technicians across Europe. Perry addresses the critical shortage of skilled technical personnel in sectors like renewable energy, telecom, and construction by making complex tasks easier and more efficient. Qoruz is an influencer marketing and intelligence platform based in India that provides brands and agencies with tools for influencer discovery, campaign management, market research, and detailed reporting. Cariqa is a Berlin-based fintech company providing an end-to-end payment, billing, and pricing platform designed specifically for electric vehicle (EV) charging. QualiBooth is a Barcelona-based SaaS company providing an AI-powered digital accessibility platform that helps businesses comply with accessibility regulations such as the ADA and European Accessibility Act. Movetru develops wearable sensor technology combined with AI to provide real-time biomechanical insights focused on lower body movement for athletes in basketball, ice hockey, and soccer. Their product offers automatic movement screenings and personalized recommendations to improve performance and reduce injury risk, especially targeting ACL rehab and other lower-limb injuries. LumenStream develops clean energy solutions focused on solar technology to provide sustainable power generation. The company offers innovative solar panels and energy management systems that optimize renewable energy use and enhance environmental impact. Hololight is a leading Austrian deep-tech company founded in 2015 that develops advanced augmented and virtual reality (XR) software and streaming technology for enterprise industrial applications. Tulum Energy is an Italian startup developing scalable methane pyrolysis technology to produce low-carbon turquoise hydrogen and solid carbon without CO2 emissions. Targeting automotive, aerospace, marine, and robotics industries, Donut Lab enables faster, more efficient EV production with scalable, plug-and-play components. Founded in 2024, the company has rapidly gained traction with innovative hardware and software solutions that enhance performance and ease of use.
