Founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, Wrisk leverages real-time data analytics and machine learning to continuously improve its products. The company offers innovative solutions such as monthly subscription insurance and embedded insurance, targeting partners who want to rapidly launch tailored insurance products with exceptional customer experience.

ScienceMachine is a London-based AI startup that accelerates biotech data analysis with its fully autonomous AI agent, Sam. Sam functions as a 24/7 AI bioinformatician, automating the entire data analysis pipeline for biotech and pharma companies. This enables faster scientific discovery by integrating with existing databases and workflows, providing insights that would typically require a team of data scientists. The company aims to expand its reach from biotech startups to larger companies.

Oraion is an AI-powered enterprise intelligence and automation platform based in Dublin, Ireland. It uses agentic AI to provide enterprises with a single source of truth, delivering deep insights and automating critical workflows to enable rapid, data-driven decisions. The platform targets enterprise customers across sectors such as e-commerce, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, private equity, investment management, and financial services. Oraion recently raised €2.9 million in pre-Seed funding to accelerate product development and expand into the US and Latin American markets.

AmphiStar develops and produces sustainable microbial biosurfactants entirely from bio-based waste and side streams, offering eco-friendly alternatives to conventional surfactants. Their platform transforms agri-food waste into high-performance products for home and personal care markets, reducing environmental impact while maintaining performance. AmphiStar targets consumer product manufacturers seeking greener, biodegradable ingredients, and stands out by eliminating reliance on fossil feedstocks, palm oil, or direct land use.

CYNiO is a German chemical startup pioneering a patented CO₂-based technology for the sustainable, safe, and flexible production of specialty isocyanates without using toxic phosgene. Their innovative process enables production of rare and specialized isocyanates on demand, serving pharmaceutical, agricultural, construction, and plastics industries. Founded in 2025 as a spin-off from TU Bergakademie Freiberg, CYNiO aims to localize supply chains in Europe and foster innovation by providing novel chemical building blocks with reduced environmental impact.

INSHUR is a digital-first Insurtech company providing commercial auto insurance to TLC drivers and private hire fleets. It offers a mobile app for easy policy management, allowing drivers to quote, purchase, and service insurance policies on-demand. INSHUR focuses on serving the gig economy, including ride-share and delivery drivers, with personalized coverage options.

ODOS is an Irish climate-tech startup focused on driving sustainability in the agri-food sector by simplifying data collection and providing actionable strategies that enable companies to reduce environmental impact without sacrificing productivity. The company develops technology for cooperatives and farmers to measure, report, and verify their environmental footprint, helping them comply with climate regulations and achieve net zero goals. ODOS works with cooperatives and food companies across Europe and is expanding its technological capabilities and market reach following a €680,000 funding round. It is a joint spin-out from University College Dublin and Trinity College Dublin, supported by the Spanish accelerator Lanzadera.

Also Inc. is a newly spun-out micromobility company from Rivian, focusing on developing small, lightweight electric vehicles designed to address global transportation challenges. Leveraging Rivian's expertise in software, electronics, and electric propulsion, Also aims to offer cost-effective and advanced micromobility products. The company secured $105 million in funding from Eclipse Ventures to support growth and innovation in sustainable urban mobility solutions.

Insomnia Labs is a New York City-based enterprise company delivering blockchain-powered fintech solutions and loyalty programs for large brands. Their services target enterprises in fashion, sports, CPG, and entertainment sectors, helping them innovate with blockchain technology and creator-focused financial products like stablecoin credit. Founded in 2021, Insomnia Labs combines technical expertise with creative production to accelerate Web3 adoption for culture-minded industries.

OllyGarden is a software company specializing in observability solutions by transforming poor telemetry data into actionable insights. Built by OpenTelemetry experts, it provides tailored instrumentation guidance and vendor-neutral optimization for telemetry data. The company supports the open-source ecosystem with contributions to OpenTelemetry and offers a unique Instrumentation Score to improve data quality and efficiency for users.

Wefox is a leading digital insurance company that connects insurance providers, distributors, and customers through its platform. It operates a hybrid model, utilizing both in-house and external brokers to sell insurance products. Wefox has a strong presence in European markets, serving over 2 million customers and aiming to revolutionize the insurance industry with cutting-edge technology.

Mistral AI is a French AI startup founded in 2023 specializing in open-weight large language models and open-source AI solutions. Headquartered in Paris, it develops efficient, customizable AI models that prioritize user data privacy and accessibility. The company also offers AI infrastructure products like Mistral Compute to empower enterprises and research institutions globally. Its mission is to democratize frontier AI technology beyond a few dominant providers, making cutting-edge AI accessible to all.

SpaceX designs, manufactures, and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft for missions to Earth orbit and beyond. Its core products include the Falcon and Starship launch vehicles, Dragon spacecraft, and the Starlink satellite internet constellation. SpaceX targets commercial, government, and research clients, distinguishing itself with reusable rocket technology and ambitious goals for Mars exploration.

Novenda Technologies is a Dutch dental 3D printing innovator specializing in multi-material additive manufacturing for dental products such as nightguards and dentures. Founded in 2019, the company offers a full-stack solution combining proprietary hardware, software, and biocompatible materials to produce high-quality, natural-looking dental products with minimal post-processing. Novenda targets dental labs aiming to improve production efficiency and product accuracy while reducing labor and costs. Its technology enables simultaneous printing of hard and soft materials, enhancing comfort and fit, and supports seamless digital workflow integration.

LangChain enables developers to rapidly build and deploy large language model (LLM) applications with a framework for context-aware, reasoning agents. Its suite of tools supports debugging, testing, and monitoring throughout the AI engineering lifecycle. The company targets developers and enterprises seeking to integrate advanced AI agents into production environments, offering unique orchestration and observability features.

OneText is a fintech startup that enables customers to complete purchases and interact with brands via SMS through its text-to-buy network. Founded by former PayPal employees and headquartered in San Francisco, it targets midsized e-commerce brands with AI-powered two-way conversations, cart recovery, post-purchase upsells, and personalized recommendations. The platform offers a frictionless checkout experience without requiring merchants to replace their existing payment flows, driving higher conversion rates and customer satisfaction.

Centivax is a biotechnology company developing universal vaccines and broad-spectrum antibody therapies to combat infectious diseases like influenza, HIV, and coronavirus. ServiceUp is a technology platform based in Los Gatos that transforms how commercial fleets and insurers manage vehicle repairs. The company targets fleets and insurance companies, aiming to eliminate delays and inefficiencies in the vehicle repair process through tech and automation.

DeepRobotics develops intelligent quadruped robots designed for autonomous inspection and operations in complex, harsh, and dangerous industrial environments. Their self-developed robot series are deployed in sectors such as power station inspection, emergency rescue, and public safety, with clients including major Chinese state grid companies and industrial enterprises. Old Glory Bank is a digital-first financial institution headquartered in Oklahoma, offering modern, secure, FDIC-insured banking services with a focus on privacy, security, and liberty. The bank emphasizes serving customers who value faith, family, and freedom, and is recognized for its rapid growth and innovative technology stack. Its leadership includes prominent patriotic figures, positioning it uniquely as a pro-America bank standing against politicization in financial services.

Arevon Energy, Inc. is a leading U.S.-based renewable energy company specializing in the development, construction, ownership, and operation of utility-scale solar and energy storage projects. It provides asset management and integrated solar-plus-storage solutions primarily to utilities and corporations aiming to reduce environmental impact. Arevon leverages innovative technology and financial expertise to optimize clean energy assets across North America, delivering reliable and affordable clean energy. The company stands out for its extensive portfolio and commitment to safe, sustainable energy transition projects.

Enquire AI provides an AI-powered research platform that blends expert human judgment with large language model efficiency to deliver real-time, verifiable insights. Its platform enables enterprises to access and leverage global subject-matter expertise to make faster, smarter decisions with confidence. The company’s patented AI workflows and global expert networks create seamless, compliant, and actionable knowledge discovery for professionals across industries. Enquire AI’s unique combination of AI, data science, and human intelligence empowers organizations to be knowledge efficient and enhances decision-making.

Fantasy Life is a media company that specializes in fantasy sports and sports betting. It offers a range of content, including breaking news alerts, injury trackers, fantasy football advice, and live strategy chats. The company provides tools and insights to help fans make informed decisions in fantasy sports and sports betting. It is known for its high-quality content and expert analysis.

Gallant Pet is a clinical-stage animal health biotechnology company developing stem cell therapies to treat root causes of diseases in dogs and cats. Their off-the-shelf regenerative medicines aim to restore pets' health by reducing inflammation and supporting long-term recovery, targeting conditions with limited treatment options. Based in San Diego, Gallant focuses on making veterinary regenerative medicine accessible and impactful through FDA-structured approval pathways and clinical trials.

North is a fintech and payment processing company headquartered in Troy, Michigan, serving over 350,000 merchants across the U.S. It offers a range of payment technologies including credit, debit, EBT, check conversion, ATM, gift and loyalty programs, and online payments. With a network of more than 3,000 sales partners and processing over $100 billion annually, North provides customized payment solutions and partners with technology developers and ISVs. The company is recognized for its innovation and diversity initiatives and was rebranded from North American Bancard in 2024.

Poppy is a female-founded floral studio specializing in wedding arrangements and floral design kits, sourcing flowers directly from wholesalers to keep prices low. The company provides custom arrangements and dedicated support for couples, emphasizing freshness and sustainability. Its unique value lies in seamless local delivery and a curated selection of high-quality blooms.

Soteris offers a machine learning-powered SaaS platform that transforms auto insurance underwriting by providing precise rate-adequacy scoring at the individual policy level. Its technology enables insurers to accurately select and quote adequately-rated risks in real time, improving profitability and reducing loss ratios. Designed for insurers of all sizes, Soteris integrates swiftly with existing systems and allows all market segments to remain active while enhancing risk assessment efficiency.

Syntis Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing oral therapies that leverage the small intestine’s unique biology for effective, accessible treatments. Their lead product, SYNT-101, is a once-daily oral pill for obesity that mimics gastric bypass surgery effects. The company targets rare genetic disorders and prevalent conditions, focusing on gut-restricted enzyme therapies and transient polymer coatings for enhanced drug absorption.

Walker & Dunlop is a leading commercial real estate finance and advisory services firm in the United States. Founded in 1937, it provides a comprehensive range of financing products including first mortgage, construction, mezzanine, and preferred equity loans for multifamily, industrial, affordable, and senior housing properties. The company also offers property sales brokerage, loan servicing, and investment advisory services, leveraging innovative platforms and strong lender relationships to serve owners and developers. Its unique value lies in its nationwide expertise, technology integration, and full lifecycle loan support.

Impossible Cloud Network delivers decentralized, enterprise-grade cloud storage solutions with built-in ransomware protection and unlimited hot storage, offering up to 80% savings compared to AWS. Its platform is GDPR-compliant, S3 API compatible, and integrates with leading backup and data management tools. The service targets businesses seeking secure, scalable, and cost-efficient alternatives to traditional cloud providers.

Polimorphic provides AI-powered Constituent Relationship Management (CRM) software tailored specifically for local and state governments. Their platform digitizes workflows, automates constituent service processes, and offers AI search, chat, and voice solutions to improve accessibility and efficiency. Polimorphic serves government clients by acting as a single source of truth for constituent data and services, enhancing transparency and service delivery. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York, the company raised $9.54M in seed funding to advance its government technology solutions.

Flexi Software provides enterprise accounting software tailored for insurance companies, financial institutions, and businesses with complex multi-entity accounting and regulatory needs. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in the United States, it offers a flexible, automated platform that powers billions of transactions annually and supports tens of thousands of users globally. The company is distinguished by its industry-specific functionality, strong compliance features, and partnerships with technology vendors embedding Flexi as the accounting backbone in broader platforms. Its recent strategic investment aims to enhance product innovation and customer service while maintaining a customer-first culture.

Technical Toolboxes provides pipeline engineering software and analytics for the midstream energy sector, addressing challenges in integrity, crossings, corrosion, and welding. Its cloud platform centralizes calculations and data management, improving accuracy and compliance. The company also offers industry-standard technical training. Major pipeline operators rely on its solutions for productivity and risk reduction.

Clear Capital is a U.S.-based real estate valuation technology company founded in 2001, providing advanced property valuation, analytics, and data solutions primarily for mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, and government agencies. Their offerings include appraisal services, automated valuation models, collateral risk analysis, and property data collection, enabling faster and more accurate real estate decisions. Clear Capital's technology integrates AI-driven analytics and hybrid appraisal processes to streamline transactions and improve risk management. Their unique value lies in combining extensive property data with innovative technology to support real estate, finance, and insurance sectors nationwide.

Actithera develops next-generation radioligand therapies (RLTs) for oncology, linking radioactive isotopes to molecules tailored to target tumors while sparing healthy tissue. The company advances a pipeline focused on fibroblast activation protein (FAP) and uses covalent, isotope-agnostic chemistry for high specificity and efficacy. Actithera targets cancer patients and is preparing clinical trials for its lead assets.

Unblock converts stranded energy, such as flare gas or curtailed renewables, into computing power by deploying modular data centers at remote production sites. Their technology helps oil and gas companies reduce emissions, avoid regulatory fines, and generate extra revenue. Unblock targets energy producers in Latin America, offering a scalable and climate-friendly solution for high-performance computing demand.

Candid Hospitality is a UK-based SaaS platform revolutionizing hospitality recruitment by enabling anonymous candidate profiles and CV-free matching based on culture, competencies, and compensation. Founded in 2025, it serves hospitality operators and suppliers, helping them find better-fit hires while protecting candidate privacy and reducing unconscious bias. The platform uses AI-powered tools and psychometric testing to match candidates and employers, attracting over 3,000 candidates and 100 brands shortly after launch. It aims to improve hiring outcomes and employee retention in the hospitality industry.

Guardsquare is a global leader in mobile application security, providing advanced software solutions that protect Android and iOS apps from reverse engineering, tampering, and hacking. Their products integrate throughout the development cycle, offering app security testing, code hardening, and real-time threat visibility. Serving over 900 organizations worldwide across industries such as financial services, e-commerce, gaming, and public sector, Guardsquare is recognized for delivering robust mobile app protection without compromising user experience or performance.

Galaxy Education (GE) is a leading Vietnamese edtech platform offering AI-powered, personalized learning experiences for K-12, language, and adult upskilling. Its proprietary ICAN platform leverages AI for adaptive lessons and teacher support, targeting public schools and underserved communities. GE stands out for its profitable growth and vertically integrated approach, serving over 8 million learners in Vietnam and 34 other countries.

XerpaAI is an AI-driven growth platform that accelerates the expansion of disruptive businesses by automating user acquisition and content distribution through AI and social networks. It offers tools like AI Growth Agent for targeted marketing campaigns, Growth Portal for streamlined campaign management, and Discovery for hyper-personalized content delivery. With a user base across major social platforms and AI-powered data feedback, XerpaAI enables clients to optimize growth strategies rapidly and outperform competitors in fast-moving markets.

Brainfish is an Australian AI startup founded in 2022 that provides an ambient AI-powered customer experience platform. Its technology leverages computer vision and contextual intelligence to deliver seamless, automated in-product assistance and self-service solutions for software products. Brainfish targets global technology and e-commerce companies seeking to enhance user engagement and product adoption through innovative AI agents. The platform has supported millions of end-users and earned recognition for transforming customer self-service.

Vytalize Health is a leading value-based care platform specializing in Medicare services for independent primary care physicians. The company offers an all-in-one solution that combines risk-sharing, virtual and in-home clinics, and advanced technology to help doctors deliver better patient outcomes and lower costs. Vytalize supports over 350,000 patients across the US by empowering practices with data-driven, personalized care and financial incentives.

Million Victories is a Lyon-based gaming studio founded in 2017, known for its multiplayer strategy mobile game Million Lords, which has over 4 million downloads and 100K monthly players. The company focuses on creating engaging and meaningful game experiences for a global audience, with strong communities in the US, France, the UK, Germany, Brazil, Spain, and Turkey. Supported by experienced investors, Million Victories is expanding its player base and investing heavily in production, marketing, and user acquisition to scale internationally, particularly targeting markets in the US, Europe, and Asia.

Castellum, Inc. is a technology company specializing in strategic acquisitions within cybersecurity, information technology, information warfare, and electronic warfare sectors. Based in Bethesda, Maryland, it focuses on addressing national security challenges through advanced technology solutions. The company targets government and defense-related clients, leveraging its expertise to enhance security capabilities.

ZeroEntropy is a San Francisco-based AI startup founded in 2024 that provides a developer-first API for high-accuracy search over complex and unstructured documents. Its platform supports ingestion, indexing, re-ranking, and evaluation of documents to enable fast, precise retrieval in AI workflows, particularly for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The company targets developers building AI agents and search tools across industries like law, healthcare, and sales, offering a proprietary re-ranker model that outperforms competitors. ZeroEntropy emphasizes secure, adaptive, and self-improving search technology to reduce AI hallucinations and improve relevance in knowledge-intensive applications.

Interstellar Technologies is a Japanese aerospace company focused on making space accessible through low-cost and convenient space transportation services. It develops launch vehicles like ZERO and DECA, aiming to serve small satellite companies launching into low Earth orbit. The company offers flexible launch windows and tailor-made solutions, operating under ITAR-free regulations for international clients.

EX9 is a French startup providing autonomous electric yard tractors to automate heavy load movements such as trailers and containers within logistics and manufacturing terminals. Their turnkey Unmanned Transport as a Service solution enhances safety, reduces operational costs, and cuts carbon emissions by over 90%. EX9 targets logistics hubs, distribution centers, and industrial sites, offering a sustainable and efficient alternative to traditional diesel-powered yard operations.

Clean Fanatics is a Bengaluru-based home services platform founded in 2024 that offers high-quality services including deep cleaning, painting, marble polishing, and civil renovations. The company recently raised $2 million in seed funding to expand its team, enhance technology, and enter new service verticals such as home renovation and civil construction. It distinguishes itself by maintaining high customer retention and leveraging trained professionals to provide exceptional home service experiences.

The company has secured listings with major UK and French retailers and recently completed a £5 million Series A funding round to expand its market presence. Goodrays differentiates itself by focusing on effective, natural benefits for mental clarity and calm rather than simply what is excluded from products.

Solence develops a personalized digital app for women with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS), offering tailored lifestyle interventions that address nutrition, activity, stress, sleep, and emotional well-being. The platform is targeted at design and manufacturing engineers in leading industrial brands, aiming to accelerate product development and drive revenue growth. Backed by significant venture capital funding, Foundation EGI leverages domain-specific AI to revolutionize engineering workflows.

Skleo Health is a German healthtech company founded in March 2024 that offers rapid, AI-assisted preventive eye screenings in everyday locations such as opticians, pharmacies, and retail stores. Their six-minute non-invasive scans are validated by both certified AI software and specialist eye doctors to ensure clinical accuracy. Targeting the prevention of blindness and early detection of eye conditions, Skleo Health has expanded to Germany's 50 largest cities, screening over 11,000 people and identifying more than 3,000 cases requiring medical attention. The company's platform and partnerships aim to reduce specialist wait times and improve access to eye care nationwide.

QuiX Quantum is a Dutch startup pioneering photonic quantum computing technology. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Enschede, the company develops and commercializes scalable photonic quantum processors designed for universal quantum computing. Their technology enables room-temperature operation and high scalability, targeting industries such as healthcare, defense, infrastructure, and IT with applications requiring advanced quantum simulations and computations. NUCLIDIUM focuses on improving safety, efficacy, and accessibility of cancer therapies with scalable and economically advantageous production processes suitable for hospital workflows.

Headway Inc is a consumer tech platform revolutionizing lifelong learning with digital products like its leading book summary app. The app provides 15-minute summaries and actionable insights from bestsellers, targeting busy individuals and corporate clients. Its unique value lies in gamified learning, spaced repetition, and a seamless mobile experience for self-development.

The Blue Box Biomedical Solutions is a medtech company based in Barcelona, Spain, founded in 2020. It offers a unique, non-invasive, radiation-free urine-based device to detect breast cancer using proprietary AI that analyzes volatile organic compounds. The device targets women aged 20-49, providing a pain-free, low-cost, and sensitive screening alternative that outperforms mammography by 15%-30% sensitivity. The company aims to launch in gynecology clinics by 2026 after planned clinical trials.

Airalo is a telecommunications company founded in 2019 that operates the world's first eSIM store, offering digital SIM cards for travelers to access local and regional mobile data plans in over 200 countries. Headquartered in Delaware with an operational base in Singapore, Airalo provides instant connectivity through its app, eliminating the need for physical SIM cards and reducing roaming costs. With over 20 million users as of 2025, it combines innovative mobile technology and transparent pricing to enhance global travel connectivity.

Ryft is a cloud data management platform designed to help enterprises fully own and control their data without vendor lock-in. Optimized for Apache Iceberg, it provides agile, flexible infrastructure for data unification, governance, and scaling, targeting finance, e-commerce, adtech, gaming, and cybersecurity sectors. Founded by former Israeli intelligence officers, Ryft offers customers the ability to mix and match tools for AI and data applications, differentiating itself from cloud giants by prioritizing customer data ownership and flexibility.

MaintainX is a mobile-first workflow management and computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) platform designed for industrial and frontline teams. It helps companies streamline maintenance operations, improve asset management, and ensure compliance while empowering workers with IoT-enabled and AI-driven tools. Trusted by over 8,000 companies worldwide, MaintainX serves sectors requiring operational reliability and safety, offering features like preventive maintenance, safety audits, and multi-site reporting. Headquartered in San Francisco, it supports a global customer base with offices across North America, Latin America, and Asia.

CoRegen, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company developing novel cancer treatments by leveraging a patented master gene regulatory platform. It focuses on genetically modifying regulatory T cells to enable the immune system to recognize and eradicate solid tumors, targeting aggressive cancers such as glioblastoma and pancreatic cancer. CoRegen's unique approach involves steroid receptor coactivator modulation, with preclinical studies showing tumor eradication without toxicity. The company collaborates with Baylor College of Medicine and is advancing towards clinical trials following significant funding rounds.

AirMDR offers AI-powered Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services, providing fast and affordable cybersecurity solutions for small to medium-sized businesses. Its AI-driven virtual analysts automate over 80% of routine security tasks, enhancing speed and efficiency while maintaining human supervision. This approach allows SMBs to access enterprise-grade cybersecurity at a lower cost.

Chariot Claims is a legal-tech platform that democratizes access to corporate justice by connecting individuals to mass action legal cases and simplifying the claims process through automation. The company partners with top law firms to manage claim discovery, filing, and payouts, helping users recover compensation from corporate wrongdoing. With over 164,000 clients served and $3 million recovered, Chariot aims to unlock billions in unpaid consumer claims and make mass actions scalable and accessible.

Bastazo offers an AI-powered cybersecurity platform specifically designed for operational technology environments in critical infrastructure sectors such as energy, water, and manufacturing. The platform identifies, prioritizes, and recommends remediation steps for vulnerabilities, integrating directly with existing work management systems to enable proactive security without compromising operational reliability. Founded in 2020 by University of Arkansas faculty and based on U.S. Department of Energy licensed technology, Bastazo uniquely combines machine learning with national threat databases to deliver tailored, actionable security solutions for industrial control systems.

Blok is a U.S.-based AI company founded in 2020 specializing in integrating semantic and generative AI for enterprises. It provides a framework that enables businesses to build evidence-based AI applications by linking their knowledge to AI systems. Its solutions primarily target sectors requiring advanced document analysis, compliance, risk management, and productivity improvements. This focus on enterprise-grade AI applications distinguishes Blok in the AI software space.

Varda Space Industries develops infrastructure and technology for manufacturing high-value products, such as pharmaceuticals and advanced materials, in the microgravity environment of low Earth orbit. Targeting urban, style-conscious consumers, KNOT stands out for its rapid delivery, try-before-you-buy service, and curated brand partnerships.

Deep Algorithm Solutions is an Indian cybersecurity and AI startup founded in 2021 that provides advanced fraud prevention solutions for digital financial ecosystems. Its flagship platforms, adapIDAI and BotShield, use adaptive behavioral intelligence and real-time analysis to prevent identity fraud and zero-day cyberattacks, serving major banks and government organizations. The company focuses on continuous authentication and behavioral biometrics to secure banking, fintech, and BFSI sectors, with plans to expand regionally and launch SaaS offerings for mid-market clients.

H2Ok Innovations is an AI and IoT-enabled platform that optimizes industrial liquid and fluid systems within manufacturing and supply chains. Headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts, it serves major industrial clients such as Unilever, Coca-Cola, and PepsiCo by providing data-driven insights through proprietary sensors and machine learning models. The company's technology enables efficiency and sustainability improvements in processes like cleaning, quality assurance, and wastewater management, bridging operational and information technologies for enhanced facility performance.

evolvedMD integrates behavioral health specialists directly into primary care clinics, providing collaborative, in-person mental health services that improve access and outcomes. Their model embeds clinicians onsite at physician practices, serving both adults and children, and leverages the Psychiatric Collaborative Care model to deliver comprehensive care. The company is unique for its strong emphasis on in-person integration, rapid patient outcomes, and scalable support for healthcare providers across the United States.

Rwazi is a hyper-local market intelligence platform that uses AI and a global network of local mappers to deliver real-time, actionable consumer data from developing markets. Its AI copilot helps multinational companies predict consumer behavior, simulate outcomes, and make faster, data-driven decisions to enter and grow in emerging regions. Rwazi stands out by capturing ground-truth data directly from consumers, not relying on modeled or inferred data, and serves leading global brands across multiple industries.
Investors: Bonfire Ventures, Santa Barbara Venture Partners, Newfund, Alumni Ventures

Pitch: Function is a crypto company headquartered in New York City that transforms Bitcoin from a passive store of value into a productive, composable financial asset. Its flagship product, FBTC, is a fully reserved Bitcoin asset with over $1.5 billion in total value locked, targeting corporate treasuries and institutional investors. Backed by Galaxy Digital and others, Function enables secure and sovereign deployment of Bitcoin to generate yield and flow seamlessly across decentralized and traditional financial markets.

MiniMax develops advanced general artificial intelligence (AGI) systems, including large-scale, multi-modal foundation models for text, audio, image, and video generation. The company offers both consumer-facing AI apps (e.g., chatbots, voice, video tools) and enterprise APIs, targeting developers and businesses seeking cutting-edge AI capabilities. MiniMax stands out for its open-weight models, rapid innovation, and strong backing from major Chinese tech investors.

GRIDSERVE develops, owns and operates a UK-wide network of high-power electric vehicle charging stations, solar farms, and battery storage systems, all powered by 100% renewable energy. The company offers fast, reliable EV charging at motorway service areas, dedicated forecourts, and retail hubs, as well as electric vehicle leasing services. GRIDSERVE’s integrated 'Sun-to-Wheel' ecosystem combines clean energy generation with EV infrastructure, targeting both individual drivers and fleet operators seeking convenient, sustainable transport solutions.

Bedrock Robotics develops advanced autonomous systems for the construction industry, retrofitting existing heavy equipment with reversible, same-day hardware and software to enable fully autonomous operations. The company targets builders and contractors seeking to improve safety, reduce labor shortages, and accelerate project timelines. Its leadership team includes former Waymo autonomy experts, bringing proven technology to complex, labor-intensive environments.

Eton Solutions provides an AI-driven, cloud-native ERP software platform, AtlasFive®, designed specifically for ultra-high-net-worth family offices, multi-family offices, and wealth management firms. The platform integrates investment, accounting, tax data, and workflow processes into a single secure system, enabling efficient management of liquid and alternative assets with enhanced accuracy and risk reduction. Targeting family offices and private wealth managers globally, Eton Solutions leverages AI and automation to streamline operations and deliver real-time financial insights, supporting complex wealth structures and large asset volumes.

iCOUNTER provides precision cyber risk intelligence to help companies detect and counter highly targeted attacks, including those from nation-states and ransomware groups. Its AI-powered platform delivers actionable intelligence tailored to each client's specific vulnerabilities, enabling proactive defense. The company serves sensitive organizations across the U.S., focusing on reducing risk through intelligence-led security solutions developed by industry veterans.

GT Medical Technologies develops innovative medical devices focused on improving outcomes for brain tumor patients. Their flagship product, GammaTile®, is an FDA-cleared, bioabsorbable collagen implant embedded with radiation seeds for surgically targeted radiation therapy. The product treats newly diagnosed and recurrent malignant intracranial neoplasms, offering a novel approach that combines a collagen matrix with brachytherapy. This technology aims to revolutionize treatment for thousands of patients annually in the United States.

FlyGuys operates a nationwide online marketplace connecting businesses with professional drone pilots to capture and deliver high-quality aerial data for industries like construction, agriculture, energy, and emergency services. The company specializes in advanced imaging, LiDAR, thermal inspections, and confined space drones, turning aerial data into actionable insights. FlyGuys stands out with its scalable platform, sophisticated drone fleet, and integration of AI-powered analytics for real-world decision-making.

GigaIO specializes in AI and high-performance computing infrastructure, offering composable solutions that optimize resource utilization and efficiency. Their flagship product, FabreX, provides dynamic resource management for demanding data center workloads. GigaIO targets industries like education, life sciences, and financial services with its scalable and cost-effective technologies.

Blockskye is a blockchain-based travel infrastructure company that streamlines corporate travel management by eliminating intermediaries and ensuring direct connections between companies and suppliers. It offers a platform for booking flights, processing payments, and managing travel expenses, providing significant cost savings and real-time transaction tracking. Blockskye's innovative payment solutions, such as stablecoin-based transactions, enhance efficiency and transparency in the payment process.

Receive is a fintech company that provides Earned Revenue Access to small and medium-sized businesses through a business Mastercard. This card allows clients to access funds based on their sales revenue, offering dynamic spending power without fees or interest. Primarily serving the ecommerce sector, Receive helps businesses manage cash flow and fund growth initiatives effectively. The company is headquartered in Paramus, New Jersey.

Empirical Security develops custom AI and machine learning models tailored for cybersecurity teams to enable data-driven security decisions. Their platform offers both global models trained on extensive exploitation telemetry and localized models fine-tuned to each customer's environment and threat profile. This dual-model approach helps organizations prioritize vulnerabilities and reduce alert noise effectively. Headquartered in Chicago, they raised $12M in seed funding in 2025 to expand operations and product development.

HOPE Hydration designs and deploys HydroStations™, tech-enabled water refill stations that provide free filtered water in urban environments, airports, stadiums, and commercial venues. Their stations use advanced filtration and IoT technology to monitor usage and environmental impact, while featuring digital advertising screens that fund the free water service through brand sponsorships. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in the United States, HOPE Hydration aims to reduce single-use plastic waste and make clean water universally accessible through sustainable, innovative hydration infrastructure.

Boulevard is a client experience platform purpose-built for appointment-based, self-care businesses such as salons, spas, and medspas. Its all-in-one software streamlines online booking, business management, marketing, and payment processing, helping owners optimize schedules, increase revenue, and improve client retention. The platform is designed to deliver a modern, personalized booking experience and integrated point-of-sale, distinguishing itself with features tailored specifically for the beauty and wellness industry.

QpiAI is a leading Indian startup that integrates AI and quantum computing to develop sophisticated AI models and algorithms. It focuses on sectors like finance, logistics, healthcare, and materials science. QpiAI offers end-to-end quantum solutions, including a developer platform and a 25-qubit quantum computer, QpiAI Indus. The company aims to establish India as a major player in quantum computing.

Jälle Technologies is an Estonian deeptech startup developing advanced recycling processes to recover critical materials from end-of-life lithium-ion batteries. The company uniquely upcycles discarded graphite waste into high-value graphene-like materials with applications in composites, electronics, and energy storage. Their technology addresses Europe's growing battery waste challenge and supports a circular, sustainable battery materials economy. Jälle's solutions aim to improve recycling efficiency and reduce dependence on imported raw materials through scalable, science-driven innovation.

Callidus AI is a legal technology company that provides an advanced AI platform for automating legal workflows, including document drafting, contract review, and legal research. It offers enterprise-grade solutions tailored to the needs of law firms and in-house legal teams. The platform is designed to enhance attorney productivity and outcomes with its comprehensive case database and advanced AI capabilities.

Spiko is a fintech company that democratizes access to money markets by leveraging blockchain technology to tokenize money market funds. It provides daily interest on cash with zero lock-ins, offering institutional-grade financial instruments to businesses often overlooked by traditional banks. The platform primarily invests in low-risk assets such as Eurozone and U.S. Treasury bills. By reducing intermediaries, Spiko enables efficient and transparent cash management solutions for European businesses.

Parkobot is an Indian startup that operates an IoT-enabled smart parking platform allowing property owners to monetize unused private parking spaces. Its unique offering includes an IoT-powered smart barrier integrated with a mobile app, enabling real-time booking and access to private parking spots. Marketed as an "Airbnb for parking," it aims to reduce street congestion while creating value for parking space owners. The company recently raised ₹2.09 crore in seed funding to scale its smart parking solutions.

Zuppa is an Indian deep-tech company specializing in indigenous drone intelligence and autonomous aerial platforms. Founded in 2008 by aerospace engineers, it develops proprietary flight control systems and navigation stacks for defence, precision agriculture, and smart logistics. Its made-in-India technology addresses operational challenges in defence drones and supports AI-driven automation. The company is recognized for its DGCA-approved drones and autopilot systems targeting both defence and commercial sectors.
Investors: Rahul Dewan, Ajay Gupta, a group of seasoned entrepreneurs and industry backers

Pitch: DCG Tech is an India-based B2B platform specializing in packaging, warehouse solutions, and procurement. Founded in 2005, it serves over 60,000 customers including MSMEs and e-commerce brands, offering tech-enabled end-to-end procurement with over 10,000 SKUs across 78 categories. The company provides unique services like credit facilities for corporate customers, sustainable packaging solutions, and operates through multiple fulfillment centers and a subsidiary in Dubai. It recently raised Rs 15 crore in a pre-Series A round to accelerate growth and expand international operations.

Kilsar is a dual-use AI software company specializing in tribal knowledge capture and maintenance training. It offers the Orion platform, which transforms complex maintenance procedures into interactive digital workflows. Kilsar aims to preserve and scale knowledge from retiring technicians, enhancing training and efficiency in the aviation and broader industrial sectors.

One Biosciences is a precision oncology company leveraging AI and single-cell analysis to develop molecular profiling solutions for difficult-to-treat conditions. It offers clinical-grade single-cell tumor transcriptomic profiling to enhance clinical decision-making and therapy development. The company collaborates with leading research institutions and is supported by significant partnerships.
Investors: Redmile Group, Blast, several other investors

Pitch: StayTerra is a collection of premier vacation rental brands providing best-in-class property management and elevated guest experiences. It focuses on delivering exceptional customer service and is committed to excellence, integrity, and sustainability in the hospitality industry. By partnering with leading local brands, StayTerra offers a diverse portfolio of accommodations across the United States.
Investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, Garnett Station Partners

Pitch: TRIFFT Loyalty is a UK-based SaaS startup that helps mid-sized brands create and manage data-driven customer loyalty programs focused on emotional connections and behavioral engagement. The platform uses AI to automate personalized customer experiences and rewards, integrating with major commerce platforms. It aims to become a leading solution in loyalty management, similar to Shopify in e-commerce. TRIFFT targets businesses looking to enhance customer retention without requiring in-house technical resources.

Q.ANT is pioneering photonic computing technology, developing energy-efficient processors for AI and high-performance computing applications. Its photonic chips, built on thin-film lithium niobate, offer up to 30 times greater energy efficiency and 50 times performance improvement compared to traditional CMOS technologies. Q.ANT's solutions are designed to seamlessly integrate into existing data centers, reducing operational costs and environmental impact. The company aims to revolutionize AI infrastructure by providing sustainable and high-performance computing solutions.

Quadsat is a Danish company specializing in drone-based antenna testing and RF measurement solutions for the satellite communications and defense industries. It offers cost-effective, operationally flexible, and time-saving antenna testing and diagnostics. Quadsat's technology is crucial for ensuring efficient radio spectrum utilization and optimizing satellite network performance. Its solutions cater to major satellite operators, manufacturers, and service companies.

Yetipay is a UK-based fintech company providing an all-in-one payments platform with fast, low-cost card terminals and payment processing services. Founded in 2017, it serves hospitality, retail, and service sectors with notable clients like Brewdog and Pho. The company focuses on a lean, innovative approach to compete with larger incumbents by offering efficient, customer-centric payment solutions. Its recent £3.5m funding aims to expand product offerings and accelerate growth in the UK market.

Weebora is a sports travel platform specializing in padel-related experiences. It offers travel packages that integrate sport, culture, and leisure, targeting a global community of padel enthusiasts. Weebora is the first international marketplace dedicated to this niche, providing services in multiple languages and currencies. Its partnerships with prominent padel academies and players enhance its presence in the professional padel scene.

Commutator Studios is a German-based company focused on developing quantum software solutions to enhance quantum computing infrastructure. It offers a unique Quantum Error Management Platform that combines AI with proprietary algorithms to improve the performance and reliability of quantum applications. Targeting enterprise customers, the company aims to optimize quantum code and manage quantum errors, enabling industries to leverage the full potential of quantum computing.

Starflight Dynamics is a Munich-based startup developing foundational technologies for in-space operations, focusing on industrial-scale manufacturing and propulsion systems in orbit. Founded in 2023, the company specializes in reactive in-space platforms powered by proprietary water-based propulsion and high-throughput bulk crystal growth systems for advanced semiconductor and quantum materials production in microgravity. Their solutions target robotic, sovereign, and defense missions, aiming to enable sovereign and sustainable industrial infrastructure in space. Backed by nearly €2 million in pre-seed funding, Starflight Dynamics advances prototypes and partnerships to lead Europe's autonomous space industrial capabilities.

Paddle is a UK-based merchant of record platform serving over 6,000 digital product companies including SaaS, AI, and app businesses. It simplifies global payments by handling sales tax, refunds, fraud, and compliance, replacing complex payment stacks with a unified solution. Paddle enables companies to receive payments worldwide seamlessly while managing regulatory and operational complexities. Its platform supports global expansion and product growth for digital commerce businesses.

Teletactica is a Ukrainian DefenseTech company specializing in rugged, jamming-resistant communication systems designed for hostile, GPS-denied environments. Their modular products, including video and telemetry modems and antenna kits, enable secure, low-latency data and voice transmission for defense forces, particularly integrated into UAVs and unmanned ground vehicles. These battlefield-proven solutions offer superior price-to-performance and resilience under heavy electronic warfare, supporting frontline operations and NATO standards. The company is scaling production and expanding into European markets following a $1.5 million investment round.

Fiber Elements specializes in automated basalt fiber manufacturing for the construction industry, offering a sustainable alternative to steel reinforcement. Its technology combines finite element analysis with advanced manufacturing to produce mineral composites that are three times stronger than steel and two-thirds lighter. The company aims to reduce CO₂ emissions by up to 70% compared to traditional methods. Fiber Elements targets the global construction market with its innovative basalt-concrete solutions.

Virtual Compute Corporation (vCompute) specializes in high-performance computing and hosting infrastructure services, catering to industries such as energy, manufacturing, and life sciences. The company provides colocation and cloud services, focusing on advanced AI and HPC infrastructure. vCompute operates debt-free data centers in Houston, Texas, and is expanding its operations to meet growing demand. Its strategic partnerships enhance its capacity to deliver powerful IT solutions.

Headway is a healthcare technology company building a national network of therapists who accept insurance, making mental health care more accessible and affordable. Their software platform streamlines insurance billing and practice management for therapists while helping patients find in-network providers easily. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York City, Headway addresses the cost and access barriers in mental health treatment through a managed marketplace model.

Circle is a fintech company specializing in the issuance and management of regulated stablecoins, such as USDC, a cryptocurrency pegged to the U.S. dollar. It offers a platform for digital currency transactions, including secure wallet integration, smart contract management, and cross-chain transfer solutions. Headquartered in New York City, Circle serves sectors requiring digital currency payments, trading, and liquidity, positioning itself as a critical infrastructure provider for the future of finance.

Yuno is a Berlin-based edtech company that enhances general knowledge through AI-powered, expert-curated micro-learning. It offers short, engaging audio stories and quizzes designed to make learning a daily habit. Targeting lifelong learners, Yuno combines AI narration with expert content to provide trustworthy, entertaining education on the go. The company recently raised €7 million to expand product development and enter new markets.

ExpectedIT is a German deep-tech company redefining data architecture, focusing on AI-driven solutions for modern data management. The company targets enterprises seeking advanced, scalable cloud and SaaS infrastructure. Its unique value lies in pioneering approaches to data architecture, optimizing performance and integration for complex, large-scale environments.

Carelane is a German health tech startup founded in 2023 that revolutionizes clinical trials by integrating multiple essential functions into a single, AI-driven, end-to-end platform. Its software digitizes study protocols and processes, significantly reducing trial management workload and enabling real-time collaboration among stakeholders such as sponsors, CROs, and research sites. Targeting researchers and healthcare professionals, Carelane's platform improves efficiency and quality in clinical research, backed by successful pre-seed and seed funding rounds.

Elum Energy is a Paris-based company providing advanced energy management and automation solutions for renewable energy systems, including solar photovoltaic projects, energy storage, and electric vehicle integration. Their technology, such as ePowerControl and ePowerMonitor, optimizes the performance and control of hybrid solar power plants ranging from commercial buildings to utility-scale installations. Serving over 2,500 projects in 50 countries, Elum Energy targets EPCs, IPPs, and energy producers aiming to improve efficiency and grid stability in renewable energy deployments. Their recent $13 million Series B funding will support growth and innovation, including expansion into the U.S. market.

Seaturns is a French startup developing innovative wave energy technology using a cylindrical floater with an internal water pendulum to convert wave motion into electricity. Their solution targets grid electricity production, industrial sites, and off-grid areas, focusing on affordable, low-carbon, and sustainable energy. After successful prototype testing offshore in France, Seaturns is industrializing its technology to accelerate large-scale deployment and contribute to the energy transition.

MovaLife develops innovative microrobotics and microfluidic incubators designed to optimize in vitro fertilization (IVF) processes and improve success rates. Their all-in-one medical device integrates advanced technology to support reproductive biologists, gynecologists, and patients. The company combines expertise in reproductive biology, microrobotics, microfluidics, and AI to address complex IVF challenges, aiming to enhance clinical outcomes and accessibility.

OPTIPUS PV is a French spin-off from CNRS labs that develops lightweight, flexible, and colorful organic photovoltaic modules called Energyskin. These solar modules transform any surface into a sustainable energy source, enabling electronic devices like headphones, tablets, and IoT devices to be self-powered. The company targets consumer electronics brands seeking to integrate efficient, customizable solar power without compromising design, advancing sustainable energy usage.

Retirable provides affordable retirement plans and chat-based advice from U.S.-based Certified Financial Planners. Their platform helps users navigate retirement planning with clear, bite-sized guidance and real-time support. They target individuals seeking accessible, straightforward retirement advice regardless of wealth. Retirable differentiates itself by combining human financial expertise with technology to make retirement planning approachable and affordable.
Investors: IA Capital Group, Nationwide Ventures, Western & Southern Financial Group, Clocktower Ventures, Primary Venture Partners, Portage Ventures, Vestigo Ventures, SilverCircle

Pitch: Billee Technologies is a SaaS platform that transforms utility billing for multifamily properties through AI and automation. It streamlines billing processes, improves accuracy, and reduces costs for property owners and operators. By offering real-time resident support and intelligent bill audits, Billee enhances operational efficiency and compliance. The company aims to expand its platform to cater to a broader market, focusing on data-driven solutions.

Mango is a fintech platform specializing in embedded credit and real-time B2B payments for the construction industry in Latin America. It acts as a credit intermediary, helping construction companies streamline procurement without upfront capital, while reducing payment risks for suppliers. By facilitating smoother financial transactions, Mango aims to accelerate project completions and reduce financial strain on construction projects.
Investors: Ironspring Ventures, Brick & Mortar Ventures, Great North Ventures, Incisive Ventures

Pitch: Hootology is a modern market research company that uses gamification and generative AI to gather deep, real-time consumer insights at scale. Their platform transforms qualitative feedback into quantifiable, actionable metrics for marketers and strategists, serving Fortune 50 clients across industries. What sets Hootology apart is its integration of psychology, technology, and sociology to uncover the 'why' behind consumer behavior, enabling faster, more nuanced decision-making.

Terrestrial Energy develops advanced nuclear reactors, notably the Integral Molten Salt Reactor (IMSR), designed to deliver reliable, emission-free, and cost-competitive energy for industrial and grid-scale applications. The company targets utilities and industrial clients seeking scalable, carbon-free power solutions. Its technology aims to provide a safer, more efficient alternative to traditional nuclear and fossil fuel systems.

Loro Insurtech provides a no-code, multilingual platform for digitalizing insurance transactions. It enables insurance companies, managing general agencies, and brokers to conduct business online, offering full distribution capabilities and customizable insurance products. Loro is unique in offering a free solution with no minimum commitment, making it accessible for global insurance markets.

Backstroke is a generative AI email marketing platform for e-commerce brands, automating the creation of personalized email and SMS campaigns. Its tools—including AI Content Studio, Predictive Templates, and Hero Lab—enable marketers to quickly produce engaging, revenue-optimized content without extensive design or copywriting resources. The platform targets online retailers seeking to boost conversion rates and reduce campaign production time through advanced AI-driven personalization.

Billee Technologies offers a comprehensive utility management platform that leverages artificial intelligence and automation to streamline and modernize utility billing workflows for multifamily property owners and operators. The platform eliminates manual processes, improves billing accuracy, and provides real-time resident support and intelligent bill audits, unlocking significant cost savings and enhancing transparency. Targeting multifamily communities, Billee aims to increase operational efficiency and revenue through its next-generation SaaS solution backed by proptech expertise.

Firestorm Labs develops low-cost, modular, and highly attritable unmanned aerial systems (UAS) for defense applications, leveraging distributed and expeditionary manufacturing. The company’s products, such as the Tempest self-loitering munition and xCell portable additive manufacturing system, are designed for rapid deployment and adaptability in complex operational environments. Firestorm targets military and security clients, offering innovative solutions that address evolving defense needs through advanced autonomy and scalable production.

Nuqleous is a retail technology company that provides innovative software solutions for retail analytics and space planning to enhance operational agility and efficiency. It offers products like planogram automation software and retail analytics platforms, primarily serving the retail and consumer goods industries. Nuqleous helps retailers and suppliers streamline business practices and improve decision-making through actionable insights.

Warden AI offers an AI assurance platform specializing in continuous bias auditing for HR technology and enterprises deploying AI in recruitment and HR processes. Their platform provides real-time transparency and compliance tools to help organizations meet regulations like the EU AI Act and NYC Local Law 144. By continuously auditing AI systems for fairness and bias, Warden AI enables clients to build trust, ensure accountability, and respond effectively to discrimination claims.

Quandri is an AI-powered renewal intelligence platform that automates repetitive tasks and data analysis for insurance agencies, helping them manage policy renewals more efficiently and accurately. Its software integrates with agency management systems to provide actionable insights, reduce errors, and identify upsell opportunities, targeting personal lines insurance brokerages across North America. Quandri stands out by enabling agencies to save significant time, improve client retention, and make data-driven decisions at scale.

FundApps provides automated regulatory compliance monitoring and reporting software for financial institutions, including asset managers, hedge funds, and investment banks. Its platform automates complex tasks like shareholding disclosure and position limit monitoring, combining proprietary technology with expert-curated regulatory content. Serving over 160 clients globally, FundApps is recognized for its accuracy, scalability, and ability to handle cross-border regulatory complexity.

GenSight Biologics is a clinical-stage biopharma company developing innovative gene therapies for retinal neurodegenerative diseases and central nervous system disorders. Its lead product, LUMEVOQ®, targets Leber Hereditary Optic Neuropathy (LHON), a rare mitochondrial disease causing blindness, using a single intravitreal injection per eye to restore vision. The company leverages proprietary technologies including Mitochondrial Targeting Sequence and optogenetics to preserve or restore vision. Headquartered in Paris, it is advancing regulatory approval and early access programs in France.

vVARDIS is a Swiss healthcare company specializing in innovative dental products based on biomimetic peptide technology. Their flagship product line, including the Curodont brand, offers non-invasive, drill-free treatments for early tooth decay, enabling rapid dental care that saves chair time. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, vVARDIS targets dental professionals and consumers with patented, science-backed oral care solutions that promote remineralization and sensitivity relief, setting new standards in dental treatment and daily oral health.

GeologicAI develops AI-driven core scanning robots and software that generate high-resolution geological datasets to improve mineral exploration and mining workflows. Their platform combines advanced sensors with machine learning to analyze drill core samples in real time, providing geologists and mining companies with faster, more accurate insights. By enhancing exploration efficiency and reducing environmental impact, GeologicAI supports sustainable sourcing of critical minerals worldwide. The company is headquartered in Calgary, Canada, and collaborates with major mining firms like BHP and Rio Tinto.
Investors: Blue Earth Capital, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Rio Tinto, VC arm of BHP

Pitch: Folio is a hospitality-focused SaaS platform that modernizes hotel procurement and financial operations. It offers a centralized marketplace where hotel staff can shop, compare, and pay for supplies while enabling management to track orders, automate invoice processing with AI, and issue virtual cards to suppliers. By integrating hotels, suppliers, and finance systems, Folio helps hotels optimize spend and increase contract utilization, delivering measurable savings and operational efficiencies. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in the United States, Folio has quickly expanded to serve hundreds of hotels with major management company contracts.
Investors: Thrive Capital, Construct Capital, Redseed, SciFi VC

Pitch: Hadrian is an advanced manufacturing company focused on building AI-powered factories for the aerospace and defense industries. It aims to accelerate the production of precision components, enabling customers to make products faster and more efficiently. Hadrian's vertically integrated technology and semi-autonomous manufacturing processes help reduce production time and costs, supporting the reindustrialization of the United States.
Investors: Founders Fund, Lux Capital, Altimeter, 1789 Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Construct Capital, 137 Ventures

Pitch: Substack is a media platform that empowers independent writers and creators to publish subscription-based content, including newsletters, podcasts, and video. It provides tools for content creation, payment management, and analytics, allowing writers to connect directly with their audience. Substack supports over 500,000 paying subscribers and is valued for its ability to create a new economic model for independent creators.
Investors: BOND, The Chernin Group, Andreessen Horowitz, Rich Paul, Jens Grede

Pitch: Augmodo provides Spatial AI technology to enhance retail workforce productivity by enabling real-time tracking of every product in stores using passive Smartbadges. Their platform offers live 3D store maps and real-time data to optimize inventory management and reduce operational inefficiencies. The company's solution is privacy-focused, enhancing employee roles without tracking them, and aims to improve in-store customer experiences. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Seattle, Augmodo targets retail chains seeking advanced, scalable store monitoring technology.

Ephemera is a US-based Web3 company developing a decentralized messaging protocol called XMTP and an encrypted messenger app named Convos. It focuses on privacy, data ownership, and interoperability to provide a secure alternative to centralized messaging apps like Signal and WhatsApp. Ephemera targets developers and the blockchain community by offering open-source SDKs and infrastructure to build private, decentralized messaging experiences.
Investors: Union Square Ventures, a16z crypto, Lightspeed Faction, Coinbase Ventures, Sound Ventures, Offline Ventures, Distributed Global

Pitch: Confident Security is a U.S.-based company specializing in cybersecurity, AI, and privacy solutions. It focuses on protecting personal and organizational data through advanced security technologies. The company targets clients seeking robust privacy and security measures in the digital environment. Its unique value lies in combining AI-driven approaches with privacy-centric services to enhance data protection.
Investors: Decibel, South Park Commons, Ex Ante, Swyx

Pitch: BrightAI is a San Francisco-based company specializing in transforming physical infrastructure into intelligent digital systems through AI and IoT technologies. Their platform enables businesses to digitize, control, and automate physical operations, unlocking new growth opportunities and operational efficiencies. Founded in 2019, BrightAI targets infrastructure service providers and enterprises seeking to modernize and automate their physical assets. With $15M raised in seed funding, they focus on revitalizing western infrastructure with advanced AIoT solutions.

Occupi is a fintech platform that simplifies rental payments and tenant screening for property owners and renters by aggregating multiple payment options, including cash-based apps like Cash App and Venmo, into a single app. It enables tenants to pay rent using their preferred financial service, with payments posting directly to landlords' or property managers' general ledgers. The platform also offers a quick, mobile tenant application process with comprehensive background and credit checks, including support for international residents with visas. Occupi addresses key challenges in the rental housing sector by enhancing financial accessibility, payment efficiency, and tenant screening transparency.
Investors: Fenway Summer, Assurant Ventures, Halcyon Venture Partners, Sorenson Impact Foundation

Pitch: 38 Degrees North is a developer, operator, and capital partner specializing in distributed generation, community solar, battery storage, and sustainable infrastructure assets. Founded in 2015 and based in Sausalito, California, it collaborates with communities, developers, and investors to develop and operate renewable energy projects across multiple U.S. states. The company focuses on transparent, durable partnerships and flexible capital solutions to support project development through construction and operation, managing over 400 MW of projects and serving over 25,000 community solar subscribers.
Investors: Climate Adaptive Infrastructure (CAI), Kimmeridge Energy Management Company

Pitch: AWAKE Chocolate produces functional, caffeinated chocolate bites designed to deliver an energy boost comparable to coffee or energy drinks, but with real chocolate taste. Their products—available in multiple flavors and dietary options—are targeted at on-the-go professionals, nightshift workers, and healthcare staff. The company differentiates itself by offering a convenient, tasty alternative to traditional energy products, with a focus on clean ingredients and social responsibility.

Thermondo is Germany's market leader in retrofitting residential heating systems, offering innovative, environmentally friendly energy solutions. The company digitizes the entire process from planning and financing to installation and after-sales, enabling scalable and customer-oriented heat solutions. Thermondo focuses on heat pumps and provides rental products with no upfront costs, helping homeowners reduce CO2 emissions and modernize heating efficiently. Headquartered in Berlin, it has empowered over 28,000 customers and is a pioneer in the heating transition.

CityFibre is a leading independent British telecommunications network provider specializing in gigabit-capable full fibre broadband (FTTP) across the UK. It operates an open-access digital infrastructure platform serving over 3.5 million properties and partners with more than 35 ISPs, targeting residential, business, and public sector clients. The company focuses on expanding high-speed fibre connectivity in underserved cities and is committed to upgrading its network to multi-gigabit speeds, making it the UK's third-largest network provider behind Openreach and Virgin Media.

Perplexity AI is an AI-powered search engine headquartered in San Francisco that delivers fast, clear, and concise answers by synthesizing real-time web search results using large language models. Unlike traditional search engines, it provides natural language responses with citations and supports conversational follow-up questions. The company offers a free public version and a paid Pro subscription with advanced features, targeting users seeking reliable, up-to-date information efficiently.

Blaxel is a computing platform built specifically for AI builders to efficiently build, deploy, and scale autonomous AI agents. It offers a serverless cloud infrastructure with rich developer tools, including GitHub-native integration and sandboxed VMs, optimized for agentic AI workloads.
