Salient is a financial technology company specializing in AI-driven loan servicing solutions for auto lenders. Founded in 2023 and based in San Francisco, it partners with major lenders across the United States to offer AI agents that handle payments, due date changes, and compliance in real time. Its technology is purpose-built for financial services, ensuring regulatory compliance and data security. Salient differentiates itself with industry-leading SLAs, multi-language support, and seamless integration with lending tools.
Investors: A16z, Matrix Partners, Michael Ovitz, YC

Pitch: Positron AI develops custom hardware systems designed to accelerate generative AI, specifically Transformer model inference, offering high performance and energy efficiency. Their flagship product, Atlas, supports seamless integration with the HuggingFace Transformers Library and an OpenAI API-compliant endpoint, targeting cloud providers and AI service companies. Founded in 2023 and based in Reno, Nevada, Positron aims to provide an affordable, efficient alternative to GPUs for AI inference workloads.
Investors: Valor Equity Partners, Atreides Management, DFJ Growth, Flume Ventures, Resilience Reserve, 1517 Fund, Unless

Pitch: BlinkOps is a cybersecurity company providing the first security automation copilot platform that enables experts to automate workflows across security tools with simple prompts. Their no-code solutions allow security and IT teams to enforce policies, respond to alerts, optimize cloud security, and validate compliance efficiently. Targeting security and platform operations teams, BlinkOps stands out by offering customizable AI security agents and extensive integrations to reduce manual work and enhance security operations.
Investors: O.G. Venture Partners, Lightspeed, Hetz Ventures, Vertex Growth

Pitch: Julius AI is an AI-powered data analysis platform headquartered in San Francisco that enables non-technical users to explore, visualize, and transform data through natural language queries. It automatically generates code and visualizations while connecting directly to data warehouses, empowering teams across industries like finance, hospitality, education, and legal tech. The platform aims to democratize data analysis by reducing reliance on specialized data teams. Julius AI recently raised $10 million in seed funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners to expand its AI features and accelerate adoption among enterprises.

Promptfoo is a San Francisco-based company providing an open-source framework for AI red-teaming and security testing of large language models. Their platform is used by over 125,000 developers and enterprises including Shopify and Amazon to find and fix vulnerabilities in AI applications. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Promptfoo offers specialized pentesting tools that generate industry-specific attack scenarios to enhance AI safety and reliability.

Tilla is a Berlin-based maritime tech startup founded in 2021 that offers an AI-powered digital platform to automate and optimize crew change logistics for commercial shipping. Its platform integrates voyage schedules, crew data, port agents, and real-time travel updates to streamline the entire crew change lifecycle from planning to reporting. By replacing manual workflows, Tilla helps shipping companies reduce costs by up to 24% and save 40% of time, improving efficiency and transparency in crew management.

JotPsych is a Washington, DC-based AI-powered scribe software designed exclusively for behavioral and mental health professionals. It automates clinical note-taking by listening to patient-provider interactions and generating medically accurate, customizable notes that capture behavioral health nuances, including ICD-10 and CPT codes. The platform significantly reduces administrative time by up to 90%, streamlining workflows such as billing, e-prescribing, and appointment management. JotPsych targets psychiatrists, therapists, and clinics seeking to improve efficiency and patient care through specialized AI documentation tools.

Trustfull is an Italian AI-driven fraud prevention platform founded in 2020 that analyzes hundreds of digital signals such as phone numbers, emails, IP addresses, and web domains to deliver real-time digital risk assessments. It serves enterprise clients across industries including banking, payments, e-commerce, and iGaming, helping to strengthen KYC, KYB, and AML processes. The platform's unique use of open-source intelligence and AI enables robust detection and prevention of digital fraud, protecting businesses from financial and reputational losses. Recent funding of €6 million will support its expansion across Europe and the development of advanced fraud detection features.

Pronto is an Indian quick services startup offering on-demand domestic help including cleaning, laundry, and household chores with a 10-minute service guarantee. Founded in 2024 and based in Gurugram, it operates hubs serving local customers rapidly with verified, trained professionals paid on guaranteed shifts rather than commissions. Pronto aims to provide reliable, fast home services while improving worker income stability and plans rapid expansion into new cities and service categories.
Investors: General Catalyst, Glade Brook, Untitled VC

Pitch: Sharpsell.ai provides a sales playbook automation platform designed to help large sales teams scale deal-winning behavior through dynamic product illustrations, real-time learning, and personalized content. It primarily serves sectors such as banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, and automotive. The platform enables sales reps to create personalized presentations quickly, resolve customer queries in real time, and improve sales productivity, trusted by over 550,000 sales reps in leading BFSI and pharma companies. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, Sharpsell.ai combines AI-powered sales coaching with field-tested insights to enhance high-velocity sales teams.

Zepto is an Indian quick-commerce startup specializing in ultra-fast grocery delivery within 10 minutes through a network of optimized micro-warehouses called dark stores. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Bengaluru, it targets urban metro customers seeking daily essentials quickly. The company differentiates itself by its speed, extensive dark store network, and a subscription membership program with millions of subscribers, making it a leader in India's fast-growing quick commerce market.

Delian Alliance Industries is a Greek defense tech startup founded in 2021 that develops advanced autonomous surveillance and strike systems to protect high-risk areas such as borders and forests. Their flagship product, the Lambda Autonomous Surveillance Tower (LAST), uses AI for real-time threat detection with over 95% accuracy, while their Interceptigon series offers low-cost, autonomous coastal defense effectors. Targeting governments and defense agencies, Delian's dual-use technologies enhance security in harsh environments with scalable, cost-effective solutions, positioning Greece as a leader in autonomous defense systems.

Psylink is a Lithuanian biotechnology company developing innovative, science-driven treatments for mental health disorders, focusing on patients unresponsive to conventional therapies. It uses a proprietary sustainable biotechnology platform that employs engineered yeast cells to biosynthetically produce plant- and fungi-derived compounds, including psychedelic molecules like psilocybin. The company aims to discover and evaluate novel therapeutic compounds for conditions such as depression and PTSD, providing an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional drug synthesis. Psylink combines deep molecular research with scalable production to create next-generation mental health therapies.

Quartr is a Stockholm-based fintech company providing a leading platform for qualitative public market research. It offers AI-powered tools including a research platform, mobile and web apps, and an API to deliver structured access to first-party information from public companies. Targeting institutional and individual investors, Quartr focuses on making company narratives accessible, searchable, and actionable to support better investment decisions.

Fireworks AI provides a generative AI platform focused on rapid product iteration, cost-efficient inference, and model fine-tuning. Their platform enables developers and enterprises to build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications with minimal latency and high throughput. It supports flexible deployment on cloud and on-premises with advanced tuning techniques and global infrastructure. Fireworks AI serves AI startups, digital-native companies, and Fortune 500 enterprises, offering a unique serverless model for generative AI workloads.

ARX Robotics is a German defense tech company specializing in autonomous, modular unmanned ground systems for military and commercial applications. Their flagship product line, the GEREON UGV series, is designed to enhance mission productivity and safety with scalable hardware and advanced software. The company supports European armed forces and commercial operators by providing cost-effective robotic solutions that improve operational capabilities and protect personnel. ARX Robotics is notable for operating Europe's largest production facility for autonomous military robotic systems and focuses on strengthening European technological resilience.

Centauri Therapeutics is a UK-based immunotherapy company developing novel therapeutics using its proprietary Alphamer® platform, which redirects the body's natural antibodies to target diseases. The company focuses on infectious diseases, particularly multi-drug resistant Gram-negative bacterial infections, and has early proof-of-concept in oncology. Its lead candidate, ABX-01, is progressing towards first-in-human clinical trials to treat serious lung infections in vulnerable patients. Centauri's unique bifunctional molecules combine immunotherapeutic and antibacterial mechanisms, supported by significant funding from CARB-X and other investors.

Kuvi.ai is a Toronto-based fintech startup that offers an AI-driven crypto interface enabling users to execute digital asset transactions through simple text or voice commands. Its proprietary technology automates complex processes like bridging and multi-step swaps across blockchains, providing a seamless 'text-to-trade' experience without requiring manual intervention or advanced crypto knowledge. Kuvi targets both newcomers and experienced traders by simplifying DeFi interactions while maintaining user self-custody and security. The company's unique value lies in its agentic finance operating system that optimizes crypto trading efficiency and reduces friction.

Tonic Security is a cybersecurity company based in Tel Aviv, Israel, specializing in data protection solutions designed to safeguard digital information. It offers services focused on privacy and compliance to help organizations maintain a strong security posture. The company serves clients looking to protect sensitive data and comply with privacy regulations. Its unique value lies in providing a platform with high user privacy standards and transparent data handling.

Fluid Focus is a UK-based SaaS company offering a productivity app that rewards users for healthier screen time and focused work habits. The app incentivizes users by awarding 'Fluid Coins' for avoiding distractions and engaging in productive sessions, which can be redeemed for rewards and charitable donations. Targeting knowledge workers and students, Fluid Focus promotes better digital wellbeing and reduces burnout through gamified progress tracking and science-backed techniques. The company recently raised £640,000 to expand globally, including into the US market.

Fable Security is a SaaS company specializing in AI-driven human risk management to reduce security incidents by shaping employee behavior. Their platform provides data-driven insights, targeted training, and compliance tools aimed at enterprises seeking to enhance their security posture through improved human factors. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in the United States, Fable Security offers adaptive, personalized security awareness solutions that have demonstrated significant reductions in phishing clicks and human risk.

E2B provides open-source cloud infrastructure purpose-built for AI agents, enabling secure, scalable deployment and management of millions of agentic workflows. It serves hyper-growth AI startups and Fortune 100 enterprises, offering enterprise-grade security, self-hosting, and compliance with data residency regulations. E2B's platform allows AI agents to have dedicated computing environments, significantly boosting productivity and operational scale for advanced AI workflows.
Investors: Insight Partners, Decibel, Sunflower Capital, Kaya, angel investors

Pitch: Reach Security offers an AI-powered platform that integrates with existing enterprise security tools to assess and improve security posture by identifying misconfigurations, exposure, and underused controls. Their solution continuously monitors and automates remediation workflows, helping security teams optimize their current investments and reduce risk without adding operational friction. Founded in 2020 and based in San Francisco, Reach Security targets CISOs and security leaders aiming to enhance security effectiveness through automation and actionable insights.

Overwatch Imaging develops AI-driven wide-area search and intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) imaging systems for piloted and unmanned aircraft. Their products combine custom onboard AI software, computer vision, GPU processing, and sensor fusion to deliver real-time object detection and geospatial intelligence. Serving sectors such as fire services, maritime search and rescue, and tactical intelligence, they enable time-critical mission support with advanced automated multispectral sensors and software solutions. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Hood River, Oregon, they are venture-backed and focus on challenging operational environments.
Investors: Squadra Ventures, SEMCAP AI, the Elevate Oregon Venture Direct Fund, Edo Capital

Pitch: Keye provides an AI-powered due diligence platform tailored for private equity investors, transforming raw deal files into structured, audit-ready insights that accelerate investment decisions. Its platform automates data analysis, anomaly detection, and modeling to help firms evaluate deals faster and more accurately, reducing human error and uncovering critical insights others miss. Founded by former investors and AI experts, Keye targets private equity teams seeking to improve deal flow management and investment confidence with enterprise-grade security and transparency.
Investors: Sorenson Capital, General Catalyst, Y Combinator, ERA, Tiferes Ventures, Dunamu Ventures, Palm Drive Capital, angel investors

Pitch: Reveal Technology is a veteran-founded defense tech company delivering AI-powered offline intelligence platforms for tactical military and public safety use. Its flagship products, Farsight (3D drone mapping) and Identifi (mobile biometrics), enable real-time decision-making in network-denied environments. Serving U.S. Army, Special Operations, Marine Corps, and international forces, it uniquely provides mission-critical tools that operate under fire and without connectivity.

Dropzone AI develops an autonomous AI SOC analyst that uses large language models to investigate and resolve security alerts automatically, mimicking expert human analysts. Its product integrates with existing security tools to reduce investigation time by 90% and increase alert handling capacity tenfold, targeting enterprise security teams and managed service providers. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Seattle, it differentiates itself by offering a free product test drive and rapidly deployable, no-code AI solutions to alleviate cybersecurity workforce burnout and improve threat response efficiency.

Lumana provides an all-in-one AI video security system that transforms existing security cameras into intelligent agents capable of proactive monitoring, detecting, and responding to critical events in real-time. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Los Gatos, California, Lumana leverages advanced computer vision and machine learning to reduce false alerts and automate incident response. Its platform targets commercial businesses, enterprises, schools, and government organizations, enhancing safety, security, and operational efficiency with cloud-based management and NDAA-compliant cameras.

Farmers Business Network (FBN) is an agriculture technology company that empowers family farmers with a data-driven platform for buying farm inputs directly from manufacturers, accessing financing, and leveraging crop marketing tools. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Carlos, California, FBN serves over 100,000 farmers across the U.S. and Canada. Its unique integrated platform combines e-commerce, fintech, sustainability products, and community-driven insights to help farmers maximize profit potential and promote sustainable farming practices.

Main Street Auto operates a network of nearly 60 local auto repair shops across the United States, providing trusted vehicle maintenance and repair services including oil changes, tire service, brakes, and engine repair. Their certified technicians serve community customers with a focus on safety, reliability, and long-term care, backed by a 24-month warranty. The company emphasizes personalized service without call centers and offers easy financing options, making it a valued partner for vehicle owners and local shops alike.

ARTBIO is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company developing a novel class of targeted alpha radioligand therapies (ARTs) for cancer treatment. Their lead program, AB001, focuses on metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, using the alpha-emitting isotope lead-212 to maximize therapeutic potential while minimizing healthy tissue impact. The company leverages proprietary AlphaDirect™ technology for efficient production and delivery, aiming to improve outcomes across multiple cancer types. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, ARTBIO combines advanced isotope targeting with innovative manufacturing to redefine cancer care.

Pluristyx is a biotechnology company specializing in induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) products and gene editing technologies to accelerate the development and commercialization of cellular therapies. They provide research and clinical grade iPSC lines, proprietary genetic engineering including their FailSafe® and iACT Stealth™ technologies, and end-to-end support for cell therapy product development. Their offerings target medical and healthcare industries aiming to create safe, universal, and scalable regenerative medicine solutions. Pluristyx's platform enables faster translation of innovative stem cell therapies to clinical and commercial applications.

TakeUp provides an AI-powered revenue optimization platform designed for independent hospitality properties such as boutique hotels, inns, and B&Bs. Its platform uses causal inference AI and machine learning to dynamically adjust room rates in real time without relying on historical data, enabling small properties to maximize revenue competitively against larger brands. The solution is tailored to SMBs, offering enterprise-grade pricing intelligence and demand insights at an accessible price point, helping operators increase revenue by around 20% and save significant time on pricing management.

Harmonya provides AI-powered solutions that help consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers enrich product data, gain deep market and trend insights, and optimize attribution for improved decision-making and growth. Their platform is used by six of the top 10 global CPG brands, including Coca-Cola and Unilever, combining advanced AI with industry expertise. Harmonya operates from New York and Tel Aviv, focusing on transforming static product information into actionable intelligence for Fortune 500 companies.

Pahr Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies for pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Founded by researchers from the National Cerebral and Cardiovascular Center in Osaka, Japan, and incubated at Raven by RA Capital Management, the company leverages pioneering molecular pathophysiology research to create innovative treatments. Pahr aims to advance into clinical studies early and address significant unmet needs in PAH patient care.

Apera AI develops advanced 4D vision technology that provides robots with human-like vision intelligence to enhance industrial automation. Their software enables robots to perform tasks such as bin picking, assembly, sorting, and machine tending with improved speed and reliability. Targeting manufacturing and industrial sectors, Apera AI's solutions facilitate scalable, AI-driven robotic automation that increases factory productivity and operational efficiency.

TaskMaster Resources is a UK-based workforce solutions provider established in 1996, specializing in temporary and permanent staffing across multiple sectors including warehousing and industrial. The company offers flexible recruitment solutions tailored to client needs, supporting large-scale operations and critical sectors such as transport, public sector, and utilities. With nearly three decades of experience, TaskMaster combines specialist recruitment teams and operational expertise to deliver dependable, cost-efficient workforce solutions nationwide. Recently, it secured £15 million in funding to support national expansion and acquisition strategies.

ARO Network is a Singapore-based decentralized edge cloud platform that transforms idle internet bandwidth and compute into a scalable peer-to-peer content delivery network (CDN) optimized for AI workloads and real-time content delivery. It leverages a crypto-native incentive model to power a global community-driven network, aiming to reduce latency and costs compared to traditional data centers. The platform targets markets where last mile latency is critical and competes with legacy CDNs by enabling edge computing through user participation. Its technology builds on a proven architecture with over 1.5 million active nodes and significant prior revenue generation in emerging markets.

BosonQ Psi develops quantum computing-powered simulation and optimization solutions targeting aerospace, automotive, manufacturing, biotech, and defense industries. Their platform leverages hybrid quantum-classical algorithms to accelerate complex engineering simulations, enabling proof-of-concept projects through cloud-based access to quantum systems. Unique integrations with IBM Quantum Network and Strangeworks provide hardware-agnostic, scalable quantum capabilities accessible via pay-as-you-go models.

Armada Systems provides full-stack edge computing solutions combining connectivity, compute, storage, and AI to solve complex challenges where data is generated, especially in remote and harsh environments. Their offerings include the Commander SaaS platform, ruggedized mobile data centers called Galleons, and AI models tailored for industries such as oil & gas, mining, manufacturing, logistics, telecommunications, and the public sector. Armada's technology enables real-time decision-making and digital transformation at the edge, offering faster, more reliable, and secure infrastructure than traditional cloud computing. They serve clients including government defense sectors and commercial industries globally.

Charta Health provides an AI-powered automated chart review platform that performs fully autonomous pre-bill audits with high accuracy and cost efficiency. Their technology identifies hidden revenue opportunities, coding errors, and compliance issues in medical charts, validated by physicians and certified coders. Targeting healthcare providers, Charta Health helps reduce labor costs and improve operational efficiency while enhancing clinical and financial outcomes.

Dash Technologies Inc. is a US-based company specializing in custom software solutions for the healthcare and MedTech sectors. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, it delivers innovative digital health solutions including telemedicine platforms, AI-driven diagnostics, and device system integration. The company focuses on improving care coordination, clinical workflows, and regulatory compliance through advanced technology. Dash is recognized for its expertise in MedTech software development and has a strong track record of accelerating healthcare innovation.

Delve AI is a San Francisco-based AI-native compliance automation platform founded in 2023. It automates end-to-end compliance operations for frameworks like SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and GDPR using AI agents integrated into company workflows. Serving over 500 companies, Delve accelerates compliance processes from months to days, reducing manual busywork and enabling faster product launches and enterprise deals. Its recent $32 million Series A funding led by Insight Partners will deepen AI capabilities and expand framework support.

Dispatch Biotherapeutics is a biotherapeutic company focused on developing novel immunotherapy treatments targeting multiple solid tumor cancers. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Philadelphia, it engineers its first-in-class Flare platform to overcome targeting and resistance challenges in solid tumor therapy. The company aims to harness the immune system to create curative cancer therapies beyond blood cancers, addressing a critical unmet medical need.

Eton Solutions provides an AI-driven, fully integrated ERP software platform called AtlasFive® designed to simplify and secure wealth management operations for single and multi-family offices, RIAs, private equity, and real estate firms. Their platform aggregates investment, accounting, tax data, and workflow processes into one source of truth, maximizing efficiency and minimizing risk. With proprietary AI capabilities (EtonAI™), they offer intelligent document processing, portfolio analysis, and workflow automation, targeting ultra-high-net-worth families and wealth management institutions globally.

Imprint is a fintech company that designs, launches, and manages co-branded financial products including credit cards, deposit accounts, and installment loans for iconic global brands. Its proprietary technology platform delivers tailored rewards and a seamless digital cardholder experience to increase customer engagement and loyalty. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York City, Imprint emphasizes security, scalability, and data-driven underwriting to create bespoke financial programs. It has raised over $200 million from top investors and supports brands with advanced marketing and rewards capabilities.

Market Research & Consumer Insights is a U.S.-based company specializing in delivering actionable consumer insights through a variety of advanced market research methodologies. The firm offers customized qualitative and quantitative research services to help businesses identify opportunities, optimize products, and understand customer behavior. Their expertise includes study design, data collection, analysis, and reporting to support smart and profitable business decisions. They serve diverse industries with flexible, scalable solutions leveraging proven methods and expert researchers.

Scrunch is a global membership platform serving marketers, agencies, and creators within the Creator Economy. It offers done-for-you influencer marketing, user-generated content facilitation, and social media management services focused on affordable micro-marketing. The company also provides free educational resources such as podcasts and blogs to help clients improve marketing strategies. Headquartered in West End, Queensland, Scrunch leverages years of influencer campaign experience to deliver expert insights and campaign execution.

Solidec develops electrochemical technologies that extract molecular building blocks from air and water to produce chemicals and fuels without fossil emissions. Their platform uses renewable electricity to capture carbon and manufacture sustainable chemicals, targeting the environmental service sector. Founded by experts from Rice University, Solidec aims to lower the capital and energy required to meet net-zero goals, offering innovative solutions for clean chemical production and carbon management.

Trunk Tools is an AI-powered platform transforming construction project data into actionable insights and workflow automation. It enables construction teams to interact with vast unstructured data like drawings and schedules via natural-language queries, providing instant, accurate answers and autonomous task handling. Founded by a construction industry expert, it targets general contractors and large construction firms, enhancing productivity by reducing manual administrative work and preventing project delays.

UgenticAI is a Maryland-based AI holding company that acquires and launches agentic AI companies focused on autonomously managing complex business functions such as sales, content creation, and customer support for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Its unique approach centers on building or acquiring AI firms that deliver full business function solutions rather than isolated features, enabling SMBs to scale and operate efficiently with minimal human oversight. With $4 million in funding raised in 2025, UgenticAI is expanding its portfolio, infrastructure, and team, aiming for a $350 million IPO and a $3 billion valuation. The company emphasizes educating SMBs on the transformative potential of agentic AI to replace full-time roles with autonomous software agents.

Unlock Technologies offers home equity agreements that enable American homeowners to access cash by sharing a portion of their home's future value without monthly payments or interest charges. Their product is not a loan but a financial contract providing an alternative to traditional debt, aimed at helping families with debt reduction, home improvements, or funding small businesses. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, Unlock focuses on financial inclusion for homeowners underserved by conventional finance systems.

Volcon ePowersports designs, manufactures, and engineers all-electric off-road vehicles including two-wheel motorcycles and utility terrain vehicles (UTVs). Founded in 2020 and based in Round Rock, Texas, it targets outdoor enthusiasts and work environments seeking high-quality electric powersports vehicles. Its product line includes the Volcon Brat E-Bike, Grunt EVO motorcycle, and Stag LE UTV, distinguished by stealthy quiet drivetrains and smartphone-enabled features for a connected outdoor experience.

ALL.SPACE develops advanced satellite communication terminals capable of simultaneous multi-orbit connectivity (LEO, MEO, GEO) from a single device. Their technology targets defense, government, maritime, aerospace, and land mobile sectors, providing resilient, secure, and high-performance communications-on-the-move. With field-proven platforms used by UK and US defense agencies, ALL.SPACE enables uninterrupted access to multiple satellite networks, enhancing operational capability and strategic decision-making.

CapitalRise is a UK-based fintech company providing a crowdfunding platform for property investments, enabling individual and institutional investors to fund loans for prime property development. Founded in 2015, it targets self-certified sophisticated and high-net-worth investors, offering access to high-quality real estate-backed loans with no investor fees. The founders invest their own money in every project, underscoring confidence in their underwriting. CapitalRise focuses on transparency, competitive pricing for developers, and regulatory compliance under the Financial Conduct Authority.

Fuse Energy is a UK-based clean energy supplier focused on providing low-carbon electricity with cheaper tariffs and better service. The company emphasizes transparency by reinvesting proceeds from renewable certificates into building new clean energy infrastructure and pioneering technologies such as green hydrogen. Fuse Energy offers home and business energy plans, EV charging tariffs, and aims to power the grid with real renewable impact over greenwashing. Their approach targets environmentally conscious consumers and businesses seeking affordable, genuinely sustainable energy solutions.

Lightyear is a UK-based fintech company providing an investment platform that offers access to 5000 stocks, ETFs, and money market funds with low fees and transparent pricing. It is regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and safeguards customer funds with major banks and BlackRock money market funds. The platform targets retail investors seeking a simple, low-cost way to invest globally without barriers. Lightyear emphasizes customer asset protection, ease of withdrawals, and competitive interest on uninvested cash.

TRIFFT Loyalty Platform is a London-based SaaS company founded in 2024 that offers an AI-powered loyalty platform designed to help mid-sized brands create and manage personalized, data-driven loyalty programs focused on emotional connections and behavioral engagement. It integrates with tools like Shopify, Klaviyo, and Bloomreach and provides a white-label mobile app for branded customer experiences. The platform enables brands to move beyond transactional loyalty programs by using behavioral data such as referrals and reviews to deliver tailored rewards and communications, enhancing genuine customer loyalty. TRIFFT aims to simplify adoption of advanced loyalty strategies without requiring in-house technical resources and plans expansion into the US market.

Avanse Financial Services Ltd. is India's second-largest education-focused non-banking financial company providing education loans to students and financial support to educational institutions. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Mumbai, it specializes in lending for higher studies in India and abroad, professional courses for working professionals, and institutional working capital. Avanse is distinguished by its strategic partnerships, such as with Flywire, to digitize and streamline student loan disbursements internationally, enhancing transparency and compliance in payments.

EnliteAI is a Mumbai-based climate tech company specializing in smart building management through a plug-and-play automation system that replaces traditional building management systems with compact wireless hardware and AI-driven edge intelligence. Founded in 2017, it targets enterprises and government clients to optimize energy use, enable remote management, and reduce environmental footprint in buildings and infrastructure. Their solutions are deployed in airports, data centers, public infrastructure, and hospitality sectors, with a unique focus on real-time responsiveness and sustainability.

Navana Tech develops a full-stack voice AI platform tailored for Indian enterprises, enabling scalable deployment of voicebots, speech recognition, and real-time analytics in over 12 Indian languages. Their proprietary AI models are trained on diverse Indian voice data, ensuring high accuracy across accents and dialects, with on-premise deployment options for data security and compliance. Serving mainly the banking, financial services, and insurance sectors, Navana enhances customer engagement and automates contact center solutions with multilingual voice AI technology.

Calo is a Saudi Arabian foodtech startup offering personalized, chef-crafted meal plans through a mobile app that uses a nutritionist-approved algorithm. It targets busy and health-conscious individuals by delivering ready-to-eat meals tailored to users' fitness goals and dietary preferences. The company operates a subscription model and provides flexible meal options with fast, fresh delivery. Calo recently raised $39 million in a Series B extension to expand into new markets like the UK and enhance partnerships in physical spaces.
Investors: Nuwa Capital, Saudi Technology Ventures, AlJazira Capital

Pitch: VelaVigo is a biotech company specializing in the discovery and development of multispecific antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). Founded in 2021 and based in Shanghai with operations in Boston, it uses a unique BD+VC business model combining drug innovation with strategic partnerships. Its lead asset, a first-in-class bispecific ADC, is advancing toward U.S. clinical trials in 2025. The company targets global biopharmaceutical partners and investors to maximize drug development efficiency and value.
Investors: Shunwei Capital, Northern Light Venture Capital, Han Kang Capital, Everest VC, Songqing Capital, Lingang Lanwan Capital

Pitch: Wingspan provides a payroll platform specifically designed for independent contractors and businesses relying on flexible workforces. It automates the full lifecycle of flexible work including onboarding, invoicing, payments, compliance, and benefits in one platform. Trusted by hundreds of businesses, Wingspan simplifies contractor management at scale and processes over a billion dollars in payments annually. Backed by top-tier investors like Andreessen Horowitz, it addresses the growing needs of the freelance economy with seamless, automated solutions.
Investors: Touring Capital, a16z, Long Journey Ventures, Distributed Ventures, Company Ventures

Pitch: Seal Security provides an AI-driven solution for automated, scalable remediation of open source software vulnerabilities. Its platform delivers standalone security patches across multiple programming languages, enabling organizations to centrally control vulnerability patching without involving R&D teams. Targeting security teams, Seal Security significantly reduces manual effort, technical debt, and mean time to remediation by securing open source components, containers, and legacy code rapidly and compliantly.
Investors: Vertex Israel, More Investments, SBI Group, CCL

Pitch: Planted Solar offers an integrated platform for smarter solar deployment combining terrain-following solar arrays, field automation, and powerful design software. Their technology enables high-density, terrain-adaptive solar power plants that unlock more land, reduce costs, and accelerate project timelines. Targeting renewable energy developers and solar innovators, Planted Solar uses robotics and software to streamline construction and maximize energy output per acre, making solar deployment faster and more efficient.
Investors: Piva Capital, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures

Pitch: Chillblast is a UK-based premier gaming PC manufacturer founded in 2001 and headquartered in Poole, Dorset. The company specializes in hand-built, rigorously tested custom desktop computers for gamers, creators, businesses, and esports professionals. It offers industry-leading five-year warranties and lifetime customer support, serving clients from gaming enthusiasts to pharmaceutical and engineering sectors. Chillblast is recognized for its high-quality, award-winning PCs designed to deliver top performance and reliability.

CareRev is a technology platform founded in 2015 that connects healthcare facilities with clinicians to provide flexible, on-demand staffing solutions. It offers an app-based marketplace enabling healthcare professionals to self-schedule shifts, helping hospitals, health systems, and outpatient centers manage workforce needs efficiently. Headquartered in Los Angeles, United States, CareRev's platform reduces fixed staffing costs while increasing nurse engagement and operational agility.

Arintra is an AI-powered healthcare technology company specializing in autonomous medical coding automation. Its platform integrates bi-directionally with leading electronic health records (EHRs) such as Epic and Cerner to convert patient charts into insurance claims with high accuracy and zero human intervention. Serving US hospitals and clinics, Arintra reduces coding errors and claim denials, improving revenue cycle efficiency. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, it leverages advanced AI and clinical NLP to streamline medical billing processes for health systems and large physician groups.

Energy Dome is an Italian climate technology company founded in 2020 that develops the CO2 Battery, a proprietary long-duration energy storage system enabling 24/7 dispatchability of solar and wind power. Its technology uses carbon dioxide in a patented thermo-mechanical process to store energy efficiently and cost-effectively without lithium or rare-earth elements, offering a scalable, modular, and site-independent solution. Energy Dome targets utility grids and renewable energy markets globally, supporting decarbonization and the energy transition with validated, commercial deployments and strategic partnerships such as with Google.

C8 Health is a healthcare knowledge management platform founded by clinicians to make clinical best practices accessible and actionable across healthcare systems. Its AI-powered platform consolidates clinical protocols and resources into a centralized, searchable system integrated with clinical workflows, enhancing care coordination and reducing staff overload. The company targets the steel industry aiming to decarbonise heavy industry emissions while preserving production capacity. WiseBee is an AI-driven autonomous cybersecurity platform headquartered in New York with an R&D center in Sofia, Bulgaria. It provides mid-market organizations with an on-demand, autonomous security team that continuously monitors, detects, and neutralizes cyber threats in real time using AI-powered remediation workflows. The platform integrates with existing security systems to deliver scalable, cost-effective, enterprise-grade protection while reducing manual intervention. WiseBee's unique approach focuses on proactive, full-lifecycle risk management and collaborative supply chain security, making advanced cybersecurity accessible to mid-sized businesses.

Orbital Paradigm designs and develops highly autonomous reusable re-entry vehicles to provide frequent, efficient, and precise cargo return services from orbit to Earth. Their technology leverages novel autopilot software and reusable heatshields to enable low-load returns and pinpoint landings, targeting space industrialization and in-space manufacturing logistics. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Madrid, Spain, the company focuses on solving the bottleneck of space-to-Earth transportation with scalable and rapid spacecraft reusability.

BOB is a British crypto infrastructure startup founded in 2024 that builds a hybrid Layer 2 blockchain combining Bitcoin's security with Ethereum's DeFi capabilities. It enables users to earn yield on native Bitcoin through BTC-secured bridges and a hybrid chain model, targeting institutional and retail DeFi users. BOB's platform supports multi-chain Bitcoin yield products and leverages zero-knowledge rollups to enhance efficiency and security, positioning itself as a gateway to Bitcoin DeFi.

Rebelvolt is a Finnish company specializing in emission-free battery-based e-Generators designed to replace diesel generators. Their products offer quiet, pollution-free, and sustainable power solutions tailored for military, construction, events, and logistics sectors. Rebelvolt's e-Generators provide tangible financial benefits by reducing fuel consumption and maintenance while enabling reliable off-grid power. Founded in 2023, they have gained significant traction, including investment from Gorilla Capital, and aim to lead in sustainable off-grid power solutions.

With over $90 million raised, SNIPR Biome advances novel therapeutics through clinical trials, leveraging engineered bacteria as delivery vehicles for gut-directed gene therapy.

WATR provides an integrated, sensor-agnostic environmental monitoring system focused on real-time water and soil quality measurement. Their products deliver accurate, reliable data via cloud-based telemetry and API integration, enabling immediate response to environmental incidents. Targeting businesses, environmental agencies, and agricultural users, WATR offers patented, easy-to-use devices that support diverse parameters such as pH, dissolved oxygen, and chlorophyll. Their solutions help clients globally improve water conditions and optimize agricultural practices with real-time insights.

Bit2Me is a Spain-based fintech company founded in 2014 that provides a secure platform for buying, selling, and managing cryptocurrencies and digital assets. Serving individuals, companies, and institutions, Bit2Me combines regulatory compliance with strong security measures such as €150M asset insurance and ISO certification. It is a leading crypto exchange in Spain and Latin America with over one million users and a growing global presence.

Coinbase operates a leading cryptocurrency exchange platform offering services including trading, staking, safekeeping, and transferring crypto assets. It serves individual consumers, institutional clients, and developers building decentralized applications. Key products include Coinbase Prime for institutions and Coinbase Wallet for self-custody. The company is notable for its large user base, regulatory compliance focus, and global operations from its headquarters in Wilmington, Delaware.

Grasshopper Bank is a digital-first bank headquartered in New York, focused on providing banking solutions tailored for startups, fintechs, SaaS, and tech companies. It offers FDIC-insured accounts with competitive APYs, cash back rewards, and seamless digital tools including mobile check deposit and API-driven Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platforms. The bank supports flexible financing, treasury management, and compliance solutions, aiming to fuel growth in innovation-driven businesses with transparent pricing and enhanced FDIC insurance protection.

The platform integrates securely with enterprise workflows, supporting tasks like investment research, risk management, compliance automation, and portfolio management. Menos AI aims to help investment teams build firm-specific AI capabilities and enhance their strategic decision processes.

DISA Technologies develops High-Pressure Slurry Ablation (HPSA) technology for sustainable extraction of critical minerals like copper, nickel, and uranium from ore and mine waste. It serves mining companies and environmental agencies by improving mineral recovery efficiency and enabling remediation of abandoned uranium mines. The company’s technology is validated by regulatory and environmental bodies and is advancing toward commercial scale with recent sales and federal support.

Stavtar Solutions provides a SaaS platform called StavPay designed for the Office of the CFO in complex businesses, especially alternative asset managers. It automates vendor management, expense allocation, contract workflows, payments, tax filing, and budgeting. The platform serves over 100 leading alternative asset managers managing $2.3 trillion in assets, processing more than $10 billion in expenses and 450,000 invoices. Stavtar combines software with dedicated business process operations support to streamline financial workflows in hedge funds, private equity, and related sectors.

Apreo Health, founded in 2019, designs and manufactures advanced medical instruments for medical, surgical, ophthalmic, and veterinary applications. Their products include ultra-sharp surgical blades, portable veterinary ultrasound systems, and high-resolution diagnostic displays, all made with medical-grade materials and micron-level precision. They serve healthcare providers in over 15 countries, focusing on innovation, quality, and better patient outcomes. Their rigorous testing and automated production ensure reliability and safety in clinical environments.

Strand Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing the first platform for programmable, long-acting mRNA therapeutics that enable precise control of protein expression in targeted cells. Their proprietary technology uses synthetic biology to create mRNA smart therapies with sophisticated logic circuits, aiming to improve treatments for cancer and other life-threatening diseases. Founded by researchers from MIT, Strand focuses on creating autonomous medicines that act with cell-specific precision and durability, offering potentially curative programmable mRNA therapies.

Ten Thousand is a premium men's activewear brand founded in 2016, specializing in purpose-built training gear designed for performance, comfort, and durability. Their product line includes best-in-class gym shorts and workout clothes developed in collaboration with elite athletes. The company targets athletes committed to continuous self-improvement and rigorous training. Ten Thousand emphasizes quality, functionality, and long-lasting gear to support everyday workouts and physical resilience.

Pale Blue develops innovative water-based propulsion systems for small satellites ranging from 3U CubeSats to 700 kg spacecraft. The company targets satellite manufacturers and space operators seeking sustainable, safe, and cost-effective in-space mobility solutions. Gladful is a Jaipur-based startup focused on producing protein-rich and wholesome foods for kids and families. Their flagship product, NutraMilk Mix, offers clean, nutritious breakfasts free from refined sugars, palm oil, and additives. The company targets health-conscious parents seeking pure and effective nutrition solutions for growing children. Gladful emphasizes traditional sprouting methods and real ingredients to ensure superior nutrient absorption and overall wellness.

Cautio builds affordable AI-powered dash-cams and an operating system designed for fleet operators and owners in India. Their solution enhances driver and rider safety, improves fleet productivity, reduces ancillary costs, and lowers on-road accidents. The product features dual-lens cameras with real-time streaming and alerts, targeting mobility and transport companies seeking advanced telematics and safety technology.

Capitalmind is an Indian fintech-enabled wealth management firm founded in 2013, offering data-driven investment research and portfolio management services. It provides tailored, low-cost portfolio management strategies designed for individuals, families, and businesses to build long-term wealth. Capitalmind combines quantitative techniques with qualitative research to manage risk and optimize returns, serving over 1500 clients with assets under management exceeding ₹2000 Cr. Its unique value lies in transparent, rigorous investment strategies and a focus on first-principles thinking.

TPlusA India, founded in 2024 by Anil Goel, specializes in premium furniture hardware including wooden components, fittings, fixtures, and door systems. Fibe, formerly known as EarlySalary, is one of India's largest consumer lending platforms focused on providing instant credit solutions to young, tech-savvy working professionals. Its platform offers flexibility for substitutes to choose assignments via mobile app or text, improving the substitute teaching experience and helping maintain student learning continuity during teacher absences.

Cellbox Labs develops automated organs-on-a-chip technology that creates miniature human organ replicas outside the body to enable more efficient and personalized drug testing. Snappt provides a data-driven fraud detection and income verification platform designed for multifamily property owners and operators. Trusted by leading property management firms, Snappt offers fast, secure, and scalable solutions that reduce risk and maximize investment returns.

Retension Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative treatments for hypertension and cardiovascular disease. The company focuses on patients with resistant and uncontrolled hypertension, having demonstrated significant blood pressure lowering effects in clinical trials. Retension leverages deep scientific expertise to address a major unmet need in cardiovascular health.

Capacity is an AI-powered support automation platform that connects an organization's entire tech stack to answer questions and automate repetitive support tasks. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, it serves over 19,000 customers by unifying knowledge into one smart system and integrating with more than 250 CRMs, helpdesks, and collaboration tools. Capacity uniquely offers intelligent virtual agents, real-time agent assistance, and no-code workflow automation to improve customer and internal support efficiency across multiple communication channels.

Orbital Operations is developing a high-thrust, reusable space vehicle with a unique cryogenic fuel management system that enables long-duration orbital stays by preventing propellant boil-off. Founded by former Relativity Space engineers, they target government and commercial satellite operators, offering advanced propulsion and modular payload hosting for space situational awareness and defense applications.

Zype aims to expand its lending and payment solutions while leveraging AI to scale operations and maintain robust risk management.

Fusepay is a Seychelles-based fintech startup founded in 2024 that provides an end-to-end B2B payments and operations platform tailored for underserved island economies. It aims to replace outdated payment methods such as cheques and cash with secure, real-time digital payment solutions that reduce costs, save time, and prevent fraud for small and medium-sized businesses. The company targets markets in the Indian Ocean region, including Seychelles, Mauritius, and Réunion, focusing on improving financial operations and cash flow for local businesses. Fusepay is backed by a global investor pre-seed round and is working toward becoming a licensed Payment Service Provider in Seychelles.

August Health builds AI-enabled software platforms designed specifically for senior living communities to improve care quality and operational efficiency. Their products include a user-friendly electronic health record (EHR), digital move-in experiences, medication administration records (eMAR), billing and payments, and real-time insights with predictive intelligence. By simplifying complex healthcare finance data and automating reporting, it helps healthcare organizations manage operations and make strategic decisions in real time. Perle is an AI training data platform powered by Web3 technology that integrates human expertise to improve AI model training and evaluation. It offers Perle Labs, a crypto-native ecosystem providing transparent payments, on-chain attribution, and verifiable work histories to incentivize global participation and enhance data quality. Founded by AI veterans, Perle serves AI teams working on generative AI, LLMs, and reinforcement learning from human feedback, enabling faster, reliable, and context-rich data annotation and model evaluation.

Maxwell Biosciences is a preclinical biotechnology company developing synthetic small molecule therapeutics called Claromers™ that mimic the innate immune system to combat life-threatening viral, bacterial, fungal infections, and biofilms. Their patented platform offers broad-spectrum anti-infective compounds that have shown efficacy in preclinical animal models and lab-grown human tissues, targeting currently untreatable diseases. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, the company aims to provide safe, scalable, and affordable therapies with planned human trials starting in 2026.

OneSkin is a biotech skin health company founded in 2016 by four female scientists. The company develops topical supplements that target molecular damage to extend skin longevity, validated by clinical testing and lab replication of skin aging. Headquartered in San Francisco, OneSkin combines advanced research with product development to optimize skin cell functionality.

The company is distinguished by its comprehensive capabilities and long-standing family ownership, supporting clients through every stage of bringing new designs to market.

Celera Semiconductor leverages AI-powered automation and patented digital twins technology to revolutionize analog integrated circuit design, delivering custom analog ICs up to 10 times faster than traditional methods. Headquartered in San Jose, California, Celera partners with leading supply chain players to provide turnkey silicon development from specification to silicon with unprecedented speed and flexibility.

Trusted by major clients like NBC's Saturday Night Live and The Tony Awards, VOW enhances personalization, efficiency, and revenue potential for media, entertainment, corporate, and sports sectors.

Their technology enables seamless earning and redemption of loyalty points while driving deeper customer engagement and new revenue streams. Headquartered in New Jersey with a New York presence, Dfinitiv is recognized for transforming loyalty programs into connected commerce ecosystems leveraging proprietary deep-linking and content aggregation.

Adanola is a Manchester-based fashion brand specializing in versatile activewear and loungewear that blends style and function for everyday wear. It targets fashion-conscious consumers seeking stylish, comfortable gym-to-street apparel and has grown rapidly with a strong social media presence and celebrity endorsements. Adanola operates internationally with retail partnerships including Harrods, Selfridges, and Flannels.

Dishoom is a British chain of Indian restaurants founded in 2010, inspired by the Irani cafés of Bombay in the 1960s. Operating multiple locations across the UK, Dishoom is known for its warm hospitality and award-winning dining atmosphere.

Flox Robotics develops AI-driven autonomous drones and technologies to manage human-wildlife conflicts by gently deterring animals from farms, airports, and infrastructure without harm. Founded as a spinoff from KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Flox targets agricultural, transportation, and public sectors aiming for sustainable coexistence between humans and wildlife.

Freenome is a biotechnology company headquartered in South San Francisco, United States, specializing in early cancer detection through a comprehensive multiomics platform using standard blood draws. Freenome targets healthcare organizations and population health decision-makers, aiming to make cancer screening more accessible and effective. Its multimodal approach addresses cancer heterogeneity, enhancing early detection accuracy.

It integrates internal files, external data, and trusted sources into a unified, searchable platform with custom models that understand complex financial documents. Backed by OpenAI, Endex enables users to automate and streamline financial workflows, providing unique capabilities such as AI-labeled cell tracing and repeatable templates. Its main clients are financial professionals seeking advanced automation and accuracy in Excel-based financial analysis.

The Sleep Company is an Indian comfort-tech brand founded in 2019, specializing in mattresses and bedding solutions incorporating patented SmartGRID technology. The company focuses on innovation, manufacturing scale-up, and retail footprint expansion across metro and tier-1 cities in India. Its unique value lies in combining sleep science with technology to enhance sleep quality and comfort.

Its unique value lies in combining game publishing with technology consultancy to enhance game performance and player experience.
