Pitch: Novig operates a peer-to-peer sports prediction market that eliminates traditional sportsbooks by enabling users to trade bets directly with each other, removing hidden fees and biased odds. Launched publicly in September 2024, it offers commission-free, high-frequency sports betting with a focus on transparency, fair pricing, and skill-based trading. Targeting sports fans and bettors in the U.S., Novig has rapidly grown to become the top sports prediction platform by volume and user retention. Its unique model and backing from top investors position it as a leading innovator in the evolving U.S. sports betting landscape.
Investors: Forerunner, Y Combinator, NFX, Perceptive Ventures, Gaingels

Pitch: Chowdeck is a Nigerian quick commerce and food delivery startup founded in 2021, operating in multiple cities across Nigeria and Ghana. It offers ultra-fast delivery of meals, groceries, and medicines using a network of riders and dark stores to achieve average delivery times under 30 minutes. The company targets urban consumers seeking convenience and speed, leveraging local market expertise and sustainable logistics to redefine last-mile delivery in African cities. Its recent $9 million Series A funding supports expansion and scaling of its quick commerce strategy.

Aizy develops AI-based marketing software that automates and optimizes online advertising campaigns across platforms like Google, Facebook, and Instagram, targeting small and medium-sized enterprises. The platform combines AI-driven automation with human expert oversight to deliver cost-effective and efficient ad management. Aizy aims to make advanced marketing technology accessible to SMEs, boosting sales and reducing advertising complexity and costs.

Aira is a Swedish clean energy-tech company founded in 2022 that provides intelligent heat pumps and complete home energy systems to decarbonize residential heating. Their products reduce CO2 emissions by up to 75% and cut heating bills by up to 40%, offered via an affordable monthly subscription with no upfront costs. Operating across Europe with production in Poland, Aira aims to install 5 million heat pumps in the next decade, making clean energy accessible and affordable for consumers. Their vertically integrated model and consumer-centric approach uniquely position them to accelerate the net zero transition in residential heating.
Investors: Altor Equity Partners, Kallskär, Kinnevik, Lingotto, Temasek

Pitch: GREÏ is a Lithuanian deeptech startup that provides an AI-powered operational intelligence platform connecting to existing cameras and systems at large industrial and retail sites. Their platform uses AI detection agents to identify safety risks, inefficiencies, and unexpected behaviors in real time, transforming surveillance data into actionable insights. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Lithuania, GREÏ targets businesses with complex physical sites seeking to enhance operational safety and efficiency.

DigitalErleben is a German EdTech startup providing AI-powered digital education tools and practical teacher training to enhance media literacy and digital competencies in schools. Founded by young entrepreneurs close to the school environment, it offers flexible, on-site training sessions and an AI platform called paddy to modernize classroom experiences. The company targets schools and educators, aiming to simplify digital tool adoption and improve teaching efficiency through tailored workshops and ongoing support.

Silver Lion Innovations is a Scottish healthtech startup focused on improving the lives of people with limited mobility due to various health conditions and those who care for them. Their flagship product, EasyOver, is a smart mattress topper that enables safe and comfortable turning in bed, either independently or with minimal caregiver assistance. The company aims to impact healthcare systems globally by providing innovative assistive technology that enhances quality of life and care. Founded in 2018, it has recently secured early-stage funding to accelerate growth and market reach.

Seluna is a Scottish med-tech startup developing machine-learning software and a wearable device to enable early, remote diagnosis of pediatric sleep and respiratory disorders. Their solution targets clinicians by facilitating rapid, at-home diagnosis of conditions like obstructive sleep apnea, reducing hospital stays and improving healthcare access for children. Founded in 2022 and based in Glasgow, Seluna aims to improve health equity and reduce healthcare costs through innovative, user-friendly diagnostics.

Smplicare provides a Healthy Ageing-as-a-Service (HaaS) platform that uses AI and wearable technology to help older adults predict, prevent, and manage common health issues, particularly falls and frailty. Their digital health coaching platform delivers personalized exercise and wellbeing plans co-designed with healthcare professionals and older adults. The solution targets older populations and health systems, aiming to extend independence and reduce healthcare burdens with scalable, evidence-based interventions.

Edumentors is a UK-based online tutoring platform that combines expert tutors from top UK universities with advanced human-like AI technology to deliver personalized, interactive tutoring sessions. Their flagship product, Edu AI, offers live one-to-one tutoring that adapts to students' individual needs using facial expression and body language analysis to mimic real human interaction. The platform aims to make high-quality education accessible and affordable globally, having already delivered over 100,000 lessons in 35 countries. Edumentors focuses on school students preparing for exams such as GCSEs and A-levels, providing tailored learning maps and progress tracking.

Periodic Labs is a United States-based startup founded in 2025 that applies artificial intelligence to materials science. Founded by former OpenAI and DeepMind researchers, it aims to accelerate discovery of new materials using AI technologies. The company recently raised $200 million in funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, valuing it at $1 billion. It targets scientific research and industrial innovation with a focus on AI-driven material discovery.

CWC Group is a family-owned healthcare company based in Northern Ireland, founded in 1983, providing specialist domiciliary, residential nursing, and disability care across multiple locations. The company focuses on high-quality care services and is led by a female-powered management team. Recent funding from BGF supports expansion through acquisition of new sites and enhancement of specialist care offerings. CWC Group is notable for its long heritage and commitment to serving community healthcare needs in the UK.

paddy is a German EdTech startup founded in 2023 that offers an AI-powered platform designed to reduce teacher workload by automating administrative tasks and enabling personalized student support. Founded by recent school graduates with backgrounds connected to teaching, it targets overwhelmed educators in the DACH region facing class size and workload challenges. The platform helps teachers regain time for individual student attention, addressing a critical gap in digital and structural educational support. Paddy recently raised €1 million in pre-seed funding led by High-Tech Gründerfonds to scale its solution.

NorcSi develops and industrially produces pure silicon anodes for lithium-ion batteries using a patented roll-to-roll manufacturing process. Their technology stabilizes silicon's volume expansion during charging, enabling high-performance, resource-efficient batteries with faster charging and longer range. Targeting the automotive and battery industries, NorcSi's scalable process integrates into existing manufacturing lines and aims to revolutionize electric vehicle battery performance.

NeuWave Technologies develops advanced AI-driven environmental analysis tools for the offshore renewable energy sector, focusing on floating offshore wind farm development and operational management. Their platform leverages 32 years of historical sea condition data combined with real-time inputs to provide localized insights for risk mitigation and operational optimization. Targeting renewable energy developers and maritime industry professionals, NeuWave enables smarter, faster decision-making to support a sustainable energy transition with precision and environmental responsibility.
Investors: EHE Ventures’ AI Growth Fund, Insurtech Gateway, QVentures

Pitch: Stone is a leading Brazilian fintech company providing an integrated ecosystem of payment processing, banking services, and credit facilities primarily for small and medium-sized businesses. It empowers merchants and partners to conduct seamless electronic commerce across in-store, online, and mobile channels. Founded in 2012, Stone stands out for its client-centric culture and innovative solutions that support Brazilian entrepreneurship and digital commerce growth.

Monato is a Mexican fintech founded in 2024 that builds modular, scalable financial infrastructure enabling companies to integrate financial services via API with regulatory compliance. It offers solutions including account management, payments through SPEI, B2B lending, direct debit, cross-border payments, and smart credit products. Targeting fintechs, retailers, and SMEs, Monato empowers clients to automate and expand their financial service offerings through a unified, developer-friendly platform integrated with Mexico's payment rails.

IORQ is a Brazilian fintech providing a modular credit infrastructure platform that uses AI to automate credit workflows such as underwriting, contract management, and real-time monitoring. Founded in 2025 by Patrick Sigrist and others, it enables companies to originate loans, manage guarantees, assess risk, and scale credit ecosystems through white-label APIs. IORQ targets firms seeking funding or proprietary credit programs, offering integrated infrastructure and funding with a focus on embedded finance and underserved markets.

Creditop is a Colombian fintech that provides an embedded lending network allowing merchants to offer instant financing options at the point of sale, both in physical and digital stores. Its platform connects retailers with multiple financial institutions and fintechs to offer customers real-time credit offers without needing a credit card. Serving major retailers in Colombia, Creditop targets markets with low credit card penetration to expand financial inclusion. The company recently raised $3.7 million to scale operations in Colombia and expand into Central America and Peru.
Investors: Collide Capital, Clocktower, Alaya Capital, Amador Holdings, Newtopia, Driven VC

Pitch: Radix Florestal is a Brazilian climate tech company specializing in Amazon reforestation and forest investment. It offers a platform that enables clients to invest in environmental preservation efforts, combining technology with forest management to restore degraded areas. The company focuses on sustainable production chains and social impact, supporting large-scale planting and regenerative business models. Radix has secured significant funding to scale its reforestation projects and contributes to biodiversity recovery and carbon capture initiatives.

Pigz is a Brazilian e-commerce platform specializing in the buying, selling, and donation of new, used, and semi-new clothing and accessories. It targets consumers interested in sustainable fashion and circular economy by facilitating secondhand and donation transactions online. The platform provides a virtual marketplace that connects sellers and buyers across Brazil, promoting reuse and affordability in fashion.

FanBase is a Brazilian sports-tech company providing digital tools that enable sports clubs and leagues to connect directly with their fans. Their products include Fan ID, a unified fan login system; Fanbox, a platform for analyzing fan behavior; and FanApp, a white-label app consolidating services and content for sports entities. FanBase serves major Brazilian teams and sports organizations, enhancing fan experience and helping clubs monetize fan relationships. The company recently raised $920K to expand internationally and improve its product suite.

Reite is a Chilean company transforming conventional retail stores into autonomous establishments using artificial intelligence cameras. Their technology changes how people purchase everyday products by enabling stores to operate without traditional checkout processes. Targeting retail businesses, Reite offers innovative AI-driven solutions to enhance shopping convenience and efficiency. The company is recognized for its innovation and international expansion efforts, including training and market entry support in France.

Leggal is a Brazilian legal technology company operating in the Legal Tech sector. The company provides solutions designed to improve legal operations, efficiency, and management for law firms and legal professionals in Brazil. It focuses on leveraging technology such as AI and automation to address challenges in case management, document handling, and legal workflows. Leggal serves the growing Brazilian legal market, aiming to streamline legal processes and reduce inefficiencies.

Gaio provides a unified data operating system that centralizes and simplifies data management for businesses, enabling faster and more practical processing of large data volumes. Its platform offers intuitive tools that turn complex data tasks into straightforward processes, promoting data democratization and agile decision-making. Focused on reducing costs and integrating technologies, Gaio enhances organizational efficiency and strategic insights.

BinSentry provides AI-powered optical sensor technology and software solutions to optimize animal feed supply chains. Their solar-powered sensors monitor feed inventory in real time with 99% accuracy, enabling feed mills and livestock producers to improve forecasting, reduce waste, and increase operational efficiency. Serving major agriculture enterprises across North America and Brazil, BinSentry's technology supports cost savings, animal health, and sustainability in feed management.

RBL LLC is a pioneering biotech venture creation studio based in Houston's Texas Medical Center Helix Park, launched in 2024 by Rice University. It accelerates the development of breakthrough medical technologies and therapies by forming startups that translate Rice's life science innovations into clinical applications. RBL provides entrepreneurs with infrastructure, financial support, strategic guidance, and access to shared lab resources to rapidly bring transformative therapies to patients. The company focuses on leveraging a large patent portfolio and collaborations with clinical centers to fast-track novel biotech ventures.

Green Steel Environmental provides patented products that enhance biogas production by economically and environmentally improving wastewater and renewable natural gas treatment. Their technology upcycles industrial by-products to sequester nutrients like phosphorus and sulfur, replacing hazardous chemicals and enabling nutrient recycling as fertilizer. Targeting anaerobic digester operators at wastewater plants, landfills, and dairy farms, they offer solutions that reduce environmental impact and promote a circular economy.

DOCSI provides a digital solution focused on surgical preference card optimization and surgeon engagement to reduce supply chain costs in healthcare. Their platform delivers actionable data insights to improve contract compliance, reduce waste, and decrease clinical variation without requiring IT integrations. Targeting hospitals and surgical teams, DOCSI enhances operational efficiency by minimizing excess inventory and staff time spent on material handling.

Swirltex is a Canadian clean technology company specializing in innovative wastewater treatment using its patented Buoyancy-Enhanced Membrane Filtration (BEMF) technology. This process improves membrane performance for challenging industrial wastewater streams, reducing energy use and footprint while enabling water reuse. Serving heavy industries like oil and gas, mining, and pulp and paper, Swirltex offers modular, decentralized systems that allow clients to avoid costly infrastructure upgrades through a pay-for-performance model. Their technology is recognized for advancing water sustainability and operational efficiency in diverse climates.

Lit is a Rome-based cleantech startup that has developed patented technology to virtualize electricity meters, transforming analog infrastructure into a real-time digital platform. By disaggregating electricity consumption data, Lit provides granular, actionable insights on energy behavior, enabling measurable savings for consumers and new services for businesses. The company recently raised €570,000 to expand its team and enhance its technology, focusing on better energy data insights to accelerate commercial operations in Italy and Europe.

Xpand is an Israeli retail technology startup founded in 2021 that builds autonomous, AI-powered 'store-in-a-box' units integrating robotics, computer vision, and real-time inventory management. These unmanned, modular stores operate 24/7 without staff, enabling retailers to rapidly scale with frictionless, personalized shopping experiences. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, Xpand targets global retailers aiming to reduce operational costs and labor shortages by offering scalable, plug-and-play autonomous retail solutions. The company recently raised $6 million to expand its smart store rollout across Europe and North America, starting with its first store in Vienna.

Vulcan Elements manufactures high-performance rare earth permanent magnets in the United States, targeting critical defense and commercial applications. Their innovative process accelerates production, reduces costs, and is validated by the Department of Energy and supported by the Department of Defense. The company aims to onshore and decouple the rare earth magnet supply chain from China, enhancing U.S. economic and national security while supporting decarbonization efforts through lower-carbon manufacturing.

EliseAI is a New York-based AI technology company specializing in conversational artificial intelligence that automates customer conversations across multiple channels. It primarily serves the housing and healthcare industries, helping organizations streamline operations, enhance customer engagement, and improve efficiency. The company’s AI Assistant provides 24/7 accurate responses to leads and customers, enabling property managers and healthcare providers to save time and scale service delivery effectively. With offices in New York, San Francisco, and Chicago, EliseAI is expanding its AI solutions to address critical challenges in these sectors.

Tahoe Therapeutics, based in South San Francisco, is advancing drug discovery by building AI-powered virtual cell models using large-scale single-cell datasets. Their platform maps drug-patient interactions at an unprecedented scale to enable precision medicine, particularly in cancer. They recently raised $30 million to develop the world's largest dataset for training these models and accelerate therapeutic discoveries.
Investors: Amplify Partners, Databricks Ventures, Wing Venture Capital, General Catalyst, Civilization Ventures, Conviction, Mubadala Capital Ventures, AIX Ventures

Pitch: Ultraviolette Automotive is an Indian company that designs and manufactures high-performance electric motorcycles, including its flagship model, the F77. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Bangalore, it focuses on innovative, design-led electric mobility solutions and energy infrastructure. The company offers a unique ecosystem including fast charging networks and tech-driven merchandise platforms, targeting urban riders seeking sustainable yet powerful transportation. Ultraviolette is expanding both domestically and into European markets, emphasizing cutting-edge technology and performance.

Squint is a Manufacturing Intelligence platform headquartered in San Jose, California, that uses AI and augmented reality to capture expert knowledge and standardize work instructions for manufacturing operators. Its platform combines spatial computing and large language models to reduce training time and provide real-time, contextual on-the-job assistance. Squint targets manufacturing and energy companies aiming to bridge the knowledge gap between retiring and incoming workers, enhancing operator performance and production insights.
Investors: The Westly Group, TCV, Sequoia Capital, Menlo Ventures

Pitch: Confido provides an AI-driven financial operating system designed specifically for consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies. Its platform automates cash application, deduction categorization, trade promotion management, and sales forecasting, significantly reducing manual workload and improving accuracy. Targeting finance, accounting, and sales teams, Confido enables enhanced financial workflow efficiency, real-time analysis, and strategic planning within CPG businesses.
Investors: Footwork, Watchfire Ventures, Barrel Ventures, Liquid 2, Boulder Food Groups, Y Combinator

Pitch: Life Safety Inspection Vault (LIV) offers a web-based SaaS platform designed to streamline fire and life safety compliance for fire departments, regulatory agencies, and building owners. Their software automates inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) reporting with digital, customizable reports and real-time tracking of compliance deadlines. LIV's platform enhances code enforcement efficiency by providing dashboards, notifications, and data-driven insights tailored to the fire prevention ecosystem. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in the United States, LIV recently raised $28.7 million to accelerate product innovation and growth.

Cover is a US-based fintech company specializing in embedded property insurance designed to make insurance fair and accessible for consumers. It integrates insurance products seamlessly into customer online journeys through API-driven solutions. Serving primarily the US market, Cover aims to optimize pricing and bundling to enhance customer experience and conversion rates. The company is backed by prominent investors including Y Combinator and Tencent and operates globally with a focus on digital insurance innovation.
Investors: Yolo Investments, a16z speedrun, Volt Capital, WndrCo, Arbitrum Gaming Catalyst, Tusk Ventures

Pitch: Studio Atelico is a gaming AI startup founded by veterans from Uber, Meta, and Creative Assembly. It develops an AI engine that enables game developers to integrate generative AI running directly on players' devices, eliminating the need for costly cloud solutions. Their modular AI engine supports major game engines like Unreal, Unity, and Godot, offering fine-grained control and significantly reducing development costs. Studio Atelico's technology creates autonomous in-game characters with emergent behaviors based on memories and experiences, enhancing interactive gaming experiences.

Cuttable is an AI-powered advertising platform based in Melbourne that automates the creation and publishing of digital ads, primarily for social media platforms like Facebook and Instagram. Founded in 2023 by seasoned entrepreneurs including Sam Kroonenburg, it targets growing brands and agencies by enabling rapid, high-quality ad production that combines creative expertise with AI efficiency. With a $10 million seed funding round led by Square Peg, Cuttable aims to reduce creative burnout and improve marketing ROI by delivering data-driven, scalable ad campaigns quickly.

Riva is a UK-based fintech startup founded in 2025 by former Revolut and Wise professionals. It uses blockchain technology and stablecoins to streamline and modernize cross-border business payments, offering a dual-rail system that routes transfers via blockchain or traditional networks for optimal speed and cost-efficiency. Targeting businesses globally, Riva aims to provide faster, more transparent, and cheaper international money movement by combining innovative technology with a strong regulatory framework.

Claros Technologies develops sustainable advanced materials and breakthrough technologies for the destruction of harmful PFAS chemicals in wastewater. Their solutions target businesses and organizations seeking environmental remediation and circular economy materials. Their proprietary technology also creates textiles with embedded antimicrobial, UV-resistant, and moisture-wicking properties. Claros focuses on solving environmental challenges without creating new problems, emphasizing sustainability and innovation.

Softwear Automation develops advanced robotic sewing systems called Sewbots that use high-speed machine vision and AI to automate textile manufacturing with precision rivaling human workers. Their technology enables on-demand, sustainable production of sewn goods such as T-shirts, home goods, and apparel, targeting manufacturers seeking to reduce labor costs and localize supply chains. Founded in 2007 and based in Georgia, USA, Softwear Automation combines patented vision and robotics to transform the $100 billion sewn products industry.

1Kosmos provides a cybersecurity platform that enables passwordless access through advanced biometric and digital identity proofing. Its BlockID platform uses blockchain to create distributed digital identities that prevent identity impersonation, fraud, and account takeover. Serving large banks, telecom, and healthcare clients, it is uniquely certified by NIST, FIDO2, and iBeta, supporting millions of authentications daily with a focus on secure, frictionless user experiences.

SetPoint Medical develops a proprietary bioelectronic medicine platform designed to treat chronic autoimmune and inflammatory diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn's disease by stimulating the vagus nerve to activate the inflammatory reflex. Their miniaturized implant offers a novel, potentially safer and cost-effective alternative to drug therapies. The company is clinical-stage, advancing therapies through ongoing studies in the United States. Headquartered in Valencia, California, SetPoint combines scientific discovery with precision engineering to innovate in bioelectronic therapies.

Nokken designs and manufactures modular hotel cabins using architectural input from England, styling from Denmark, and engineering from Germany, with manufacturing in Latvia and Portugal. Their cabins are highly insulated, sustainable, and designed for quick installation, enabling hospitality operators to launch or scale retreat accommodations efficiently. The product offers full turnkey solutions including modular units that can be delivered and installed rapidly, targeting hospitality businesses seeking flexible, scalable, and eco-conscious lodging options. Nokken's unique value lies in combining modular construction with integrated design and operational support for faster, cost-effective, and sustainable hospitality developments.

Amylu Foods is a Chicago-based natural consumer packaged goods company specializing in chicken sausages, burgers, and meatballs made from simple, all-natural ingredients. Founded in 1924, it pioneered the chicken sausage category and emphasizes healthier, nitrate-free products. The company targets retail and foodservice customers nationwide, focusing on small-batch production and innovative flavors that redefine the protein category.
Investors: TowerBrook Capital Partners, Prelude Growth Partners

Pitch: Laurel provides an AI-powered time tracking platform designed for professional services firms such as legal and accounting practices. It automates timesheets, reduces revenue leakage, and delivers operational insights to improve profitability and client delivery. The platform uses firm-specific AI models ensuring data privacy and allows professionals to spend less time on administrative tasks. Laurel's solution is unique in connecting time tracking directly to business outcomes with enterprise-grade security compliance.

Mabylon AG is a Swiss biotechnology company specializing in discovering and engineering novel human-derived antibody therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases and allergies. Leveraging access to large patient populations and advanced single-cell screening technologies, Mabylon rapidly develops high-quality antibody libraries to identify functional therapeutic candidates. Their lead programs include clinical-stage antibodies targeting peanut and birch-related allergens, aiming to address major unmet medical needs in immunology and inflammation. Mabylon combines deep scientific expertise with a proprietary platform to accelerate drug discovery and development in allergy and neurology.

National Renewable Network (NRN) is an Australian clean energy company that provides no-upfront-cost solar and battery systems to households, integrated into a virtual power plant (VPP) operated in partnership with energy retailers. Their platform enables retailers to quickly build and scale distributed renewable energy portfolios without capital-intensive balance sheet burdens, while maintaining customer ownership. NRN's model removes financial barriers for consumers and supports the energy transition by combining technology, data, capital, and compliance to deliver affordable, scalable clean energy solutions across Australia.

Vast Renewables develops and manufactures concentrated solar thermal power (CSP) technology that generates, stores, and dispatches zero-carbon electricity and industrial heat. Its modular CSP systems enable long-duration energy storage to provide on-demand clean power, addressing intermittency issues of solar PV. The company targets utility-scale renewable energy projects, including its flagship VS1 plant in Port Augusta, supported by substantial government funding. Vast uniquely combines CSP technology with green fuels production, positioning itself as a key player in Australia's energy transition and global decarbonization efforts.

Inclined Technologies offers a proprietary digital platform that enables whole life insurance policyowners to access their cash value quickly and seamlessly through a secured revolving line of credit called the Inclined Line of Credit (iLOC). The platform partners with whole life advisors and insurance carriers to simplify and automate the application process, typically under 15 minutes, providing competitive rates and flexible liquidity access. Headquartered in Sausalito, California, Inclined aims to unlock the financial potential of whole life policies and improve long-term policyowner outcomes by modernizing an industry traditionally slow to adopt technology.

Vidaa develops VIDAA Smart TV OS, a Linux-based operating system and content platform preinstalled on Hisense and Toshiba TVs. Founded in 2019, it offers a user-friendly interface with AI-powered personalized content recommendations, voice control, and an app store. Vidaa targets TV OEM manufacturers and consumers seeking an intuitive, fast, and secure smart TV experience globally.

PleoPharma is a pharmaceutical company developing novel FDA-approved therapies to address unmet needs in central nervous system disorders and substance abuse, focusing on cannabis use disorder and withdrawal. Founded by two physicians in 2019, it aims to provide safe and effective treatments where none currently exist. Its lead program has successfully completed Phase 2 trials and targets millions suffering from addiction and withdrawal symptoms. The company emphasizes ethical standards and collaboration with healthcare providers and researchers.

Loopr AI provides advanced visual inspection AI solutions designed to automate manufacturing quality control. Their products, such as LooprIQ Inspect and LooprIQ Verify, enable precise defect detection and assembly verification to reduce costs and improve consistency. Targeting industries like aerospace, automotive, and general manufacturing, Loopr AI helps companies save manual inspection hours and minimize part rework with AI-powered automation.

FinLocker provides a white-labeled financial fitness platform for mortgage lenders, financial institutions, and credit counselors to offer their customers tools for credit monitoring, budgeting, goal setting, and mortgage readiness. The platform aggregates and analyzes consumer financial data to deliver personalized financial journeys, helping users prepare for homeownership and streamline mortgage applications. Its unique value lies in combining financial education, credit simulation, and direct data sharing with lenders to reduce costs and accelerate loan approvals.

Shanghai Moyom Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese R&D and production enterprise specializing in biotechnology. The company focuses on developing biopharmaceutical products and advancing life sciences research. Moyom serves clients in the healthcare and biotech industries, leveraging its research capabilities and manufacturing expertise. It is recognized for its integration of innovative biotechnology solutions within China.

Atlantic Fish Co., based in Raleigh, North Carolina, develops cultivated seafood using cellular agriculture to produce premium black sea bass that replicates wild-caught fillets in taste, texture, and nutrition. The company targets sustainable seafood markets aiming to reduce environmental impact and ocean ecosystem reliance. Their innovation is supported by over $700,000 in non-dilutive funding including NSF and USDA grants, enabling scalable production of clean, traceable fish products.

Beam Benefits is a digitally-native employee benefits company offering dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental health coverage through an intuitive online platform. It serves employers of all sizes across the United States, leveraging AI-powered underwriting and self-service tools to simplify and modernize ancillary benefits. Beam focuses on a customer-first digital experience with competitive rates and rapid implementation. Its technology-driven approach and personalized rewards program distinguish it in the employee benefits market.

GeoWealth provides a cloud-based, fully integrated financial technology and turnkey asset management platform (TAMP) designed specifically for registered investment advisors (RIAs) and institutional investors. Their platform offers comprehensive solutions including portfolio accounting, client portals, billing, reporting, and outsourced back office services, all accessible via a single user interface. GeoWealth's customizable, open-architecture system supports advisors in growing their business and serving clients efficiently with flexible investment strategies and robust technology. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, GeoWealth has secured significant funding to expand its offerings and scale its award-winning platform.

Joinable Labs is a SaaS platform that accelerates the AI development lifecycle for AI Builders by enabling them to turn raw proprietary data into Private AI systems up to 50x faster. Its flagship product, RAG in a BOX, allows users to prototype and deploy AI systems rapidly while maintaining privacy, security, and control. Targeting AI developers and enterprises, Joinable focuses on reducing Time-to-Intelligence for Private AI applications with a unique acceleration platform backed by leading AI and Web3 investors.

Eat Just, Inc. is a food technology company headquartered in Alameda, California, specializing in plant-based egg alternatives and cultivated meat products. Its flagship brand, JUST Egg, is made entirely from plants and is America's fastest-growing egg brand. The company also developed the world's first commercially sold cultured meat, produced from animal cells rather than slaughtered livestock. Eat Just aims to create healthier, safer, and more sustainable food systems through innovative science and culinary expertise.

Metaimpact provides an AI-powered collaborative SaaS platform that enables leaders and multi-stakeholder networks to align goals, drive collective action, and measure social and environmental impact. Its platform supports real-time data sharing, strategic alignment, and advanced analytics to tackle complex challenges like climate change and racial equity. Targeting enterprises, philanthropic organizations, and regional collaborations, Metaimpact uniquely facilitates cross-sector collaboration and impact measurement through a unified digital infrastructure.

Tive provides real-time supply chain visibility solutions through innovative IoT trackers and a cloud platform that enables shippers, carriers, and logistics providers to monitor shipment location and condition globally. Their technology reduces delays, damage, and shipment failures, improving customer experience and operational efficiency. Serving over 900 global businesses, Tive combines hardware, software, and professional services for actionable supply chain insights and 24/7 live monitoring.
Investors: Fifth Wall, Qualcomm Ventures, One Way Ventures, Plug and Play Tech Center

Pitch: Zinc is a UK-based SaaS company specializing in automated background checks and recruitment solutions for HR professionals. It leverages technology to streamline hiring processes and ensure compliance, targeting businesses seeking efficient and reliable employee screening. The company stands out by integrating automation within HR tech to improve recruitment accuracy and speed.

Applicant Tracking System (ATS) companies in India provide software solutions that automate and streamline the hiring process for businesses of all sizes. Their platforms typically include resume screening, interview scheduling, candidate communication, and compliance management. They leverage AI to enhance recruitment efficiency and candidate experience, targeting enterprises and startups looking to reduce hiring time and costs. The growing digital job market in India and demand for data-driven hiring solutions fuel the adoption of these ATS providers.

CodeKarma is a Bengaluru-based SaaS startup founded in 2025 that offers an AI-native software productivity platform integrating real-time production insights directly into developer workflows. Its platform helps engineering teams and AI systems detect risks, eliminate redundant code, and create continuous feedback loops for higher software quality, targeting fast-growing sectors like e-commerce, fintech, and logistics. By embedding deployment-grounded intelligence into IDEs, CodeKarma uniquely bridges development and production, enabling self-improving autonomous software systems and improving developer efficiency globally.

DesignX is an Indian smart manufacturing platform founded in 2015 that offers a Digital Factory Operating System (Df-OS) to digitize and optimize over 600 factory floor processes. Its SaaS platform integrates with ERP systems, IoT devices, and enterprise tools to provide real-time insights and AI-driven decision-making for industries such as automotive, FMCG, and pharmaceuticals. Serving major clients like Unilever, Suzuki, Dabur, and Hero, DesignX enables factories to improve productivity, sustainability, and operational efficiency across India and international markets.

Eon Space Labs, founded in 2022 and based in Hyderabad, India, develops miniaturized, high-resolution optical payloads and imaging systems for satellites, drones, and ground platforms. Their flagship products include MIRA, India's lightest high-resolution space telescope, and LUMIRA EO/IR imaging systems for long-range surveillance and disaster response. Leveraging AI and ultra-precision engineering, they target defense, Earth observation, and commercial applications, offering compact, lightweight solutions that enhance global EO/IR surveillance capabilities.

FincFriends Private Limited is an Indian non-banking financial company (NBFC) founded in 2017 that provides unsecured personal loans through a fully digital platform. It targets underserved individuals in India, especially in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, offering quick, collateral-free credit access via its flagship lending platform RupeeRedee. The company leverages data-driven underwriting and automated decision-making to tailor credit products for borrowers with limited or no prior credit history. Its recent funding rounds aim to expand digital lending reach and enhance fintech infrastructure to promote financial inclusion.

Hylenr Technologies is an Indian clean energy startup pioneering Low Energy Nuclear Reaction (LENR) technology to develop scalable, carbon-free heat and power systems. Their proprietary LENR reactors generate abundant heat at near-room temperatures without harmful radiation or radioactive waste, targeting industrial and extraterrestrial applications. With recent $3 million Pre-Series A funding, they aim to commercialize and deploy compact, safe, and efficient LENR reactors for decarbonizing industrial operations and enabling sustainable energy solutions worldwide.

ILine.ai Solutions is an Indian climate-tech startup founded in 2024 that provides an AI-powered dual-app platform optimizing last-mile logistics using electric vehicles. Their technology enhances route efficiency, reduces carbon emissions, and offers features like real-time tracking, carbon savings analytics, and OTP-secured deliveries. Their platform integrates with existing restaurant systems without requiring hardware upgrades, aiming to become the industry standard for voice interaction in QSRs globally. Vox AI recently raised €7.5 million in seed funding to accelerate global expansion, including opening a San Francisco office.

Property Sense is a UK-based PropTech company specializing in build-to-rent (BTR) lettings and lease-up management. Founded in 2019, it offers a self-serve platform connecting residents, letting agents, and BTR operators to accelerate lease-ups and streamline communications. Their technology integrates with CRM and PMS systems, providing pre-construction marketing tools and pre-approved tenant databases to reduce lease-up times. The company aims to revolutionize BTR leasing with scalable, middleware solutions that support developers and operators across the UK.

Detechgene is a Cologne-based biotech company developing a portable, pocket-sized PCR diagnostic device that delivers rapid and precise detection of viral, bacterial, and fungal pathogens within 30 minutes. Their technology combines the accuracy of laboratory PCR tests with the ease of use of rapid antigen tests, enabling decentralized and mobile diagnostics outside specialized labs. Founded in 2022, Detechgene aims to improve healthcare outcomes by making molecular diagnostics accessible anywhere, especially in rural or resource-limited settings.
Investors: neoteq ventures, NRW.BANK, Aquarius Invest, Meerkat Holding, Campus Capital, strategic business angels

Pitch: Toppi is a Dutch SaaS startup founded in 2023 that provides AI-driven local marketing solutions to help hospitality businesses and other local enterprises improve their online visibility and drive offline revenue. Their platform boosts rankings on Google and other search engines, enhances reputation through review management, and increases customer actions such as website clicks and direction requests. Toppi uniquely targets local businesses of all sizes with cost-effective, tailored solutions that combine advanced AI technology and expert services to deliver long-term growth.

Mantic is a UK-based AI company founded in 2024 that focuses on improving the forecasting ability of large language models (LLMs) and applying this technology to AI governance. Supported by significant research grants, it aims to advance forecasting science through experimental development and consultancy in AI. Its unique value lies in combining AI forecasting research with practical governance applications to enhance predictive accuracy and decision-making.

Farang is a Swedish AI research lab founded in 2025 that develops next-generation foundational large language models with a novel architecture designed to outperform existing Transformer-based models. The company focuses on creating specialized AI assistants that use significantly fewer computational resources, targeting individual developers and AI enthusiasts initially. Farang aims to enable smarter, more customizable AI solutions that enhance user autonomy and privacy, positioning itself as a future leader in consumer and enterprise AI.

InstaLILY is a New York-based SaaS company offering an advanced Vertical AI Agent Platform that automates complex workflows and operational processes for B2B enterprises. Its core product, the Instalily Multi-Agent Platform, enables deployment of autonomous AI agents to enhance sales, service decision-making, and operational efficiency while ensuring data security. Targeting enterprises aiming to reduce manual labor and boost productivity, InstaLILY differentiates itself with precision AI agents and a composable agents layer that evolves with client needs.

Weekera is a French HR technology company based in Nîmes, Occitanie, that provides an AI-powered platform for verified skills intelligence. It helps organizations hire, upskill, and manage talent using data-driven, personalized skills assessments and development plans. The platform integrates with existing HR and learning management systems to enhance workforce planning, performance management, and internal mobility. Its unique AI-driven approach enables organizations to build future-fit, competitive workforces by accurately verifying and developing business-critical skills.

Therna Biosciences is a biotechnology company pioneering programmable RNA therapeutics by integrating AI and RNA biology to design custom RNA-based medicines. Their platform enables rapid creation of RNA therapies engineered for enhanced translation, durability, immune evasion, and precise tissue targeting. Founded by leading experts in RNA biology and AI, Therna aims to accelerate drug development to deliver safer, more effective RNA medicines. The company recently raised a $10 million seed funding round to advance their AI-powered RNA drug design platform.
Investors: AIX Ventures, Pear VC, Fusion Fund

Pitch: Moment Energy specializes in commercial-scale clean and reliable battery energy storage systems by repurposing retired electric vehicle batteries. Their Luna BESS product offers high performance and cost efficiency, targeting on and off-grid facilities across North America. The company aims to reduce carbon footprints and support the transition to sustainable energy through innovative energy storage solutions.

Lumaegis, Inc. develops the RadBox, a patented sterilization device using dual-modality germicidal and thermal LED radiation for fast, energy-efficient sterilization of medical and dental instruments. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, it targets dental and medical practices seeking faster, safer, and more sustainable sterilization solutions. The company is preparing for FDA De Novo approval and commercial launch in 2026, with initial sales already lined up and a major global industry partner secured.

Hemi Labs develops a modular layer-2 blockchain network that integrates Bitcoin and Ethereum into a single system, enabling developers to build secure and scalable decentralized finance applications. Its Hemi Virtual Machine embeds a Bitcoin node within an Ethereum environment, allowing seamless use of both chains' capabilities. Targeting blockchain developers and DeFi users, Hemi uniquely combines Bitcoin's security with Ethereum's programmability through its novel Proof-of-Proof consensus mechanism.

Leal Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing novel precision medicines targeting high-need central nervous system disorders. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Worcester, Massachusetts, it focuses on creating innovative therapeutics for patients with major CNS conditions. The company combines advanced research and development to deliver targeted treatments, aiming to address unmet medical needs in neuroscience.

mPower Technology develops DragonSCALES™, an ultralight, flexible, and modular solar cell technology designed for space applications. Their products deliver scalable, customizable, affordable, and resilient solar energy solutions optimized for satellite constellations, lunar and deep space missions, and space-based solar power. Manufactured in ISO and AS-9100 certified facilities, mPower targets aerospace and space logistics clients, offering advanced solar modules that perform reliably in harsh environments at low cost.

Polymarket is a decentralized cryptocurrency-based prediction market platform headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2020, it enables users to trade on the outcomes of real-world events using USDC stablecoins on the Polygon blockchain. Polymarket uniquely combines blockchain transparency with prediction markets, targeting investors and traders interested in event-based derivatives. Its acquisition of QCEX and regulatory compliance efforts position it to reenter the US market as a fully regulated platform.

BlastOne International is a global leader in abrasive blasting and surface preparation equipment, supplies, and protective coatings. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, it serves industrial clients worldwide with sandblasting machines, abrasives, and custom blast and paint booths. The company is known for its customer-focused approach, providing tailored solutions, expert training, and innovative products to extend the life of critical infrastructure and improve project efficiency.

Bench IQ is an AI-powered legal research platform that uses Large Language Model technology to analyze court data and uncover the reasoning behind 100% of judges' rulings, not just the 3% with written opinions. It provides attorneys with deep insights into judicial decision-making patterns to inform legal strategies and improve case outcomes. The company targets law firms, including top AmLaw 100 firms, offering unique transparency into judicial behavior. Founded by pioneers of legal AI and backed by leading venture capital and law firms, Bench IQ aims to make the law more transparent and predictable.

Sinewave is a UK-based specialist electrical engineering company providing high and low voltage electrical services up to 132kV nationwide. They offer turnkey solutions including grid connections, EV charging infrastructure, renewables, and electrical network maintenance, serving clients across various infrastructure sectors. Accredited as an Independent Connection Provider and certified B Corporation, Sinewave emphasizes sustainable practices and technical expertise. Their unique value lies in combining engineering excellence with strong environmental and social commitments.

Tazapay is a Singapore-based fintech company that provides a cross-border payments infrastructure platform enabling businesses to conduct seamless international transactions. Its platform offers checkout, payment link, escrow solutions, and supports local collection and payouts in over 70 markets with coverage in 173+ countries. Tazapay leverages modern payment rails including real-time payments and stablecoins, offering institutional-grade security and compliance across multiple jurisdictions. Targeting global enterprises, marketplaces, and fintechs, it simplifies cross-border trade with a robust, API-driven solution that reduces risk for buyers and sellers.

Avasa is a New Zealand-based medical device company developing the Avasa Coupler, a novel micro-artery coupling device that simplifies and standardizes the reconnection of micro-arteries in reconstructive microsurgery. Founded by clinician-bioengineer Dr. Nandoun Abeysekera in 2018, the company addresses a critical unmet need by replacing the complex and time-consuming manual hand-sewing process. With strong clinical demand from microsurgeons and successful pre-production testing, Avasa aims to achieve FDA clearance and market entry within 18 months.

Assort Health develops AI-powered voice solutions that automate and enhance patient and staff phone interactions for healthcare providers. Their technology manages patient intake, appointment scheduling, and call triage, reducing staffing burdens and wait times while improving patient experience. Targeting healthcare organizations, Assort Health leverages advanced conversational AI tailored to medical specialties to streamline operations and increase appointment revenue.

Sleep.ai is a United States-based healthtech company pioneering AI-powered sleep intelligence solutions. Founded in 2017 as a spin-out from ResMed, it offers the world's first sonar-based smartphone sleep sensor and personalized digital sleep coaching validated by extensive clinical research. Its platform integrates sleep data, insights, and coaching via APIs and SDKs to help health, wellness, insurance, and technology brands improve sleep outcomes and user engagement. Sleep.ai uniquely combines rigorous science, large-scale data, and reimbursable sleep improvement programs to transform sleep health globally.
Investors: Treasure Coast Ventures, Nurture Ventures, HBS Alumni Angels of Greater New York

Pitch: DarwinAI is a Canadian company specializing in Explainable AI (XAI) solutions for visual quality inspection in manufacturing. Their patented AI platform helps manufacturers improve product quality and production efficiency, with adoption by numerous Fortune 500 companies. Led by AI expert Dr. Alexander Wong, DarwinAI provides an end-to-end, trustworthy AI integration that delivers transparent and actionable insights to industrial clients.

TransBnk is an Indian fintech startup founded in 2022 that provides a modular, API-driven transaction banking platform for fintechs, banks, NBFCs, and corporates. Its platform integrates over 40 banks and offers services including treasury, liquidity, escrow management, reconciliation, and lending support via a single consolidated interface. TransBnk aims to modernize corporate banking infrastructure by replacing legacy systems with scalable, cost-effective SaaS solutions, currently serving more than 220 clients and expanding internationally into Southeast Asia and the Middle East.
Investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, Arkam Ventures, Fundamentum Partnership, 8i Ventures, Accion Venture Lab, GMO Venture Partners

The company sells over 400 designs through its own website and major marketplaces like Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and Amazon. Nuyug focuses on stylish, durable, and culturally diverse celebration wear jewellery to meet the needs of modern Indian women.

Matiks is an Indian mobile gaming platform founded in September 2024 that focuses on enhancing mathematical skills through interactive games spanning speed, puzzles, logic, and memory categories. The platform offers multiplayer duels, daily challenges, global leaderboards, and a paid Creators Programme for community engagement. With around 100,000 users and over 50,000 downloads, Matiks positions itself as a skill-driven, engagement-led alternative to traditional real money gaming. It targets users seeking to sharpen math skills via an engaging, competitive gaming experience and aims to expand internationally using recent funding.

With over 3,000 clients served and a 95% repeat rate, BhaoBhao aims to expand across India using recent angel funding of $200,000 and plans for a larger $4–5 million round to scale its services.

Fullerton Health is a leading integrated healthcare platform founded in 2010 and headquartered in Singapore. The company offers a comprehensive range of solutions including managed care, primary care, diagnostics, specialty, and ancillary services, supported by clinical excellence and digital innovation. Fullerton Health tailors corporate healthcare programs and leverages data analytics to improve healthcare delivery across the region.

Maisa is an AI startup co-headquartered in Valencia, Spain, and San Francisco, specializing in enterprise AI agent platforms. The company works globally, particularly in Southeast Asia and Europe, partnering with businesses through a certified plastic credit system to create measurable environmental impact and build local recycling infrastructure.

This innovation reduces supply-chain costs, drug waste, and environmental impact, improving global accessibility to life-saving medicines, especially in regions lacking reliable refrigeration. Founded in 2022, EnsiliTech recently raised £4.5 million in seed funding to scale technology adoption and advance manufacturing integration.

The company focuses on sustainability with plastic-free packaging and responsibly sourced materials, aiming to redefine healthy cooking by eliminating harmful chemicals and providing high-quality cookware at accessible prices.

Synkka is a UK-based AI startup automating carrier integrations to accelerate parcel delivery networks. Their AI-driven integration Platform-as-a-Service (iPaaS) reduces setup times from months to days and minimizes engineering effort for scaling delivery operations. Targeting logistics companies, Synkka aims to build the operating system for parcel delivery, enabling faster go-live, cost reduction, and scalable delivery infrastructure. InstaLILY AI is a New York-based software company that helps B2B teams rapidly adopt artificial intelligence by automating complex workflows and operational processes. The platform operates nationwide with a network of over 300 active mechanics and services more than 600 machines monthly. Heave's app-based model offers flexible work for technicians and significant cost savings for contractors, rapidly expanding in key U.S. construction regions.

Pitch: Fusion Fuel Cycles Inc. is a joint venture between Kyoto Fusioneering Ltd. and Canadian Nuclear Laboratories, established in 2024 and headquartered in Chalk River, Ontario, Canada. The company develops and engineers fully integrated deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle systems essential for commercial fusion power plants, focusing on safe, high-performance, and cost-effective fusion energy solutions. Its flagship project, UNITY-2, is a pioneering fuel cycle test facility designed to demonstrate efficient tritium processing and support global fusion development programs. Fusion Fuel Cycles leverages combined expertise in fusion fuel cycle technology and tritium management to accelerate fusion commercialization on a decadal timeframe.

Axenya is a Brazilian health tech company that offers an AI-driven corporate health platform connecting companies, employees, insurers, and healthcare providers. Its platform features LifeVault, an interoperable data lake organizing clinical and operational information, and Axenya IQ, a predictive AI engine that anticipates risks and optimizes care journeys. Targeting corporate healthcare, Axenya aims to transform healthcare management through advanced technology and a unique business model.

Welcome Tech provides a digital platform focused on empowering immigrant households in the United States by offering tailored services and technology that support recruitment, employee retention, and community integration. Their proprietary jobs platform connects employers with millions of qualified candidates, while curated content and benefits help immigrants navigate healthcare, education, and financial decisions. The company uniquely combines technology with a community-powered approach to help immigrants succeed and strengthen society.

MedaSync provides AI-powered reimbursement optimization software specifically designed for skilled nursing facilities. Their platform uses machine learning and big data to streamline MDS management, automate audits, and improve revenue integrity across various payment models like PDPM and managed care. By delivering continuous, daily intelligence and alerts, MedaSync helps skilled nursing operators proactively capture reimbursement opportunities and reduce administrative burden. The software aims to empower reimbursement teams and improve financial outcomes in a complex multi-payer healthcare environment.

PainTEQ is a medical device innovator headquartered in Tampa, Florida, specializing in minimally invasive solutions for sacroiliac (SI) joint dysfunction. Their flagship product, the LinQ SI Joint Stabilization System, provides a patented, drill-less outpatient procedure designed to reduce or eliminate chronic lower back pain with faster recovery compared to traditional fusion surgery. Targeting pain management specialists and patients suffering from SI joint pain, PainTEQ emphasizes clinical evidence, patient outcomes, and innovative surgical instruments to enhance treatment safety and efficacy.

Auditoria.AI is an AI-driven SaaS company that automates finance back-office processes for corporate finance and accounting teams. Their platform leverages natural language processing, machine learning, and predictive analytics to reduce manual tasks, improve business resilience, and accelerate financial insights. Targeting enterprise finance teams, Auditoria.AI offers autonomous solutions that enhance productivity and decision-making while minimizing heavy IT involvement.

Copper is a startup that produces battery-equipped induction stoves designed primarily for business-to-business customers such as owners of multi-unit buildings and real estate portfolios. Their stoves work with standard 120-volt outlets, avoiding costly electrical upgrades, making them suitable for older buildings. Copper's products qualify for battery investment tax credits and various local and state incentives, supporting clean energy adoption. The company recently raised $28 million in funding to scale production and develop more appliances.

Aurelian provides an AI-powered voice assistant that automates non-emergency calls for 911 emergency communication centers across the United States. Its platform autonomously triages and resolves calls such as noise complaints and parking violations, supporting over 35 languages via voice, SMS, and web chat. By handling routine tasks, Aurelian reduces dispatcher burnout and allows human operators to focus on life-threatening emergencies. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Seattle, it is notable for being the only AI solution currently deployed live in emergency call centers.

Terraton is a biochar-focused carbon removal platform that provides agribusiness operators in emerging markets with financing, technology, and access to carbon markets. Their vertically integrated software and hardware systems convert agricultural waste into stable carbon while improving soil health, enabling scalable and cost-effective carbon removal. Terraton's model removes barriers like upfront costs and complexity, helping farmers generate income through carbon credits. The company is unique in bridging the gap between high-demand biochar carbon credits and agribusiness producers, with projects in Ghana and Kenya delivering significant CO2 removal.
Investors: Lowercarbon Capital, Gigascale Capital, angel investors

Pitch: FriendliAI provides an all-in-one platform for deploying and managing custom generative AI models with a focus on efficient, reliable inference and GPU cost optimization. Their products support large language models with advanced monitoring, seamless data integration, and scalable endpoints for production workloads. Targeting businesses deploying AI models, FriendliAI enables enhanced throughput, low latency, and predictable performance through dedicated GPU resource management.

BEWI ASA is a leading European producer and distributor of customer-tailored packaging and insulation solutions, specializing in expanded polystyrene (EPS) products. The company serves diverse markets including food, building and construction, automotive, and pharmaceuticals, offering sustainable and innovative products such as EPS fish boxes and automotive components. BEWI is also committed to circular economy practices through extensive recycling operations. Headquartered in Norway, it has grown through strategic acquisitions to establish a strong European presence.

R for Rabbit is an Indian baby products company founded in 2014, offering a wide range of innovative and safety-certified baby gear, nursery items, feeding products, diapers, and baby care essentials. Founded by parents who experienced difficulty finding quality baby products, the brand focuses on safety, quality, and affordability. It serves over 5 million parents through 2000+ offline partners and digital platforms, emphasizing research-driven innovation and parental testing to meet international standards.

Surface Design Solutions is a woman-owned company based in Henrietta, New York, specializing in commercial and residential flooring products and refinishing services. They work closely with contractors, architects, and property managers to provide competitive pricing, project planning, and sustainable flooring solutions. Their services include thorough bid assessments, direct proposals, and project management with a strong focus on safety and customer satisfaction. The company emphasizes honesty, integrity, and personal service, aiming to be a top choice in the flooring industry.

Ordinal provides AI research assistant software designed specifically for local governments and municipalities. Their platform enables city staff to quickly retrieve accurate information from internal documents like codes and ordinances using a retrieval-augmented generation model, grounding answers in official records. Targeting governmental agencies, Ordinal aims to improve operational efficiency and help cities work smarter with easy implementation and no per-seat fees.

Guild provides a platform for artists and creators that combines tools like smart contracts for IP protection and royalty splits, AI agents for content creation and distribution, and immersive community spaces. It enables creators to own their work and participate in AI training revenue sharing with transparent, on-chain attribution. With a dual-token model, Guild supports fair payouts and governance by contributors, differentiating itself by empowering creators with ownership and control over their digital assets and AI data.

UserEvidence is a Customer Evidence Platform designed for B2B software, product, and hardware companies to collect feedback, curate success stories, and create verified content proving product value. It enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to generate authentic customer proof points, boosting buyer trust and increasing conversion rates. The platform integrates seamlessly with existing tech stacks and provides unbiased, third-party validated research to support product claims and competitive differentiation. Headquartered in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, UserEvidence pioneers evidence-based marketing by automating the creation of customer testimonials, ROI statistics, and market-specific insights.

Matey AI develops AI-powered legal tools focused on criminal defense, enabling defense teams to quickly analyze and organize massive case data including video, audio, and documents. Their flagship product, CrimD, helps uncover critical facts buried in data, accelerating investigations and trial preparation. Based in Austin, Texas, Matey aims to transform legal operations by providing smarter, faster, and more reliable AI solutions tailored for law firms, corporate legal departments, and litigation funders.

Sola Insurance is a managing general agent (MGA) based in Atlanta, United States, that offers data-driven supplemental insurance focused on parametric tornado and wind/hail coverage for homeowners. Their Tornado Crisis Coverage provides fast payouts using National Weather Service data as an add-on to existing homeowners' policies. Founded in 2022, Sola leverages actuarial modeling and partnerships with reinsurers like Lloyd's to offer reliable, affordable catastrophe insurance solutions tailored to US individuals.

Sarborg develops advanced AI and cybernetics technology to optimize drug development processes such as drug repurposing, clinical trial monitoring, and asset management. Their platform offers predictive models and real-time data dashboards that enhance decision-making efficiency and reduce costs. Sarborg's solutions target pharmaceutical companies seeking to accelerate drug development and gain competitive advantages through AI-driven innovation.

Rain offers an employer-integrated Earned Wage Access (EWA) solution that allows employees to access earned wages before payday. Serving over 2 million users and 1,200+ employer partners, Rain helps reduce payday loans and overdraft fees while improving employee financial wellness and engagement. Their platform integrates seamlessly with payroll and HR systems, including Workday, providing a scalable and transparent financial benefit to hourly and salaried workers.

Artificial Societies develops AI-based digital simulations of human societies composed of AI personas to enable marketers, creators, and businesses to test and optimize product ideas, marketing messages, and social media content before launch. Their platform uses a proprietary behavioral analysis engine with data from social channels to create a database of over 500,000 AI personas, delivering simulations that predict audience reactions with high accuracy. Backed by Y Combinator and Kindred Capital, the company offers enterprise-grade tools that reduce guesswork, save time and cost, and improve market research outcomes.

Framer is a SaaS company headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, providing a no-code web design and website building platform. It enables designers and teams to create and publish fully custom, professional websites quickly with powerful CMS, built-in SEO, and real-time collaboration features. Framer is targeted at designers and teams seeking maximum design freedom without coding. Its unique value lies in combining design flexibility with ease of use to accelerate web development.

BIGC operates an all-in-one digital venue platform connecting artists and fans globally, focusing on K-pop and cultural concerts. It offers integrated services including ticketing, AI-powered live streaming, fan interaction, video OTT content, commerce, and fan data analytics. With proprietary AI live technology and extensive fandom data, BIGC supports monetization of performances and artist IPs. The platform serves over 1.1 million members and partners with major Korean media and artists, expanding into global music markets.

It focuses on enabling compliant on-chain circulation of real world assets and stablecoins, targeting the crypto finance ecosystem in the Asia-Pacific region. The company has secured multi-million dollar funding and collaborates with leading Web3 institutions to build a new crypto finance ecosystem. Its unique value lies in expanding strategic footprints in the Real World Asset sector with strong institutional partnerships.

Utilizing proprietary gene-editing technology, including CRISPR/Cas9, Wugen aims to overcome limitations of first-generation cell therapies by enabling scalable, safe, and effective treatments. Headquartered in St. Louis, USA, with additional operations in San Diego, Wugen leverages partnerships with Washington University and focuses on rapid manufacturing and deployment of transformative cancer therapies.
