GEOH's software uniquely addresses challenges such as electronic visit verification to reduce Medicaid claim denials and enhance caregiver management. Headquartered in Indianapolis, GEOH serves nearly 6,000 caregivers and 300 agencies nationwide and recently secured $3 million in Series Seed Plus funding to expand its market reach and platform capabilities.

Stan is a platform that enables content creators to monetize digital goods by hosting courses, products, and bookings within a single link-in-bio storefront. It provides tools for coaching, recurring memberships, and audience analytics to help creators convert followers into paying customers. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York, Stan has scaled rapidly, reaching $30M in ARR within two years. Its ease of use and comprehensive monetization features make it a preferred choice for creators seeking to build sustainable online businesses.

Enginius.ai is a United States-based company specializing in AI-driven software and engineering business solutions. The company provides technology services aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and innovation for its clients. Its unique value lies in combining AI with engineering expertise to deliver tailored solutions across various industries.

Gyala Therapeutics is a Barcelona-based biotech company developing next-generation CAR-T immunotherapies targeting CD84 for hematological cancers with high unmet need. Founded in 2020 as a spin-off from Hospital Clinic Barcelona and IDIBAPS, it leverages over a decade of academic research and clinical expertise. Its lead program, GYA01, is a first-in-class therapy showing strong preclinical efficacy in difficult-to-treat leukemias. The company has raised significant funding from specialized investors and national innovation programs to advance clinical development.

Hala is a Saudi-based fintech company founded in 2017 that provides embedded financial services tailored for SMEs. Its offerings include business accounts, card issuance, payment and transfer services, POS solutions, and financing products designed to help small businesses manage and grow their operations efficiently. Licensed by the Saudi Arabian Central Bank, Hala serves over 140,000 businesses and processes more than $8 billion in annual transactions, supporting Saudi Vision 2030 goals for SME growth.

Pascal AI develops AI-powered autonomous investment research tools that analyze financial data, filings, transcripts, and alternative data to generate actionable insights for funds, private equity firms, and corporates. Their platform automates complex investment workflows, delivering personalized, institutional-grade financial intelligence that enhances decision-making speed and accuracy. Headquartered in Bangalore with offices in New York and London, Pascal AI uniquely combines AI automation with human investment judgment to uncover insights at scale.

PopChill is a Taiwan-based luxury resale marketplace specializing in authenticated second-hand fashion items. It operates a unique model where products are first sent to PopChill for AI-powered authentication and quality control before delivery to buyers, ensuring trust and reducing counterfeit risks. The platform targets luxury fashion consumers in Taiwan and Hong Kong, aiming to expand further in Asia. PopChill differentiates itself by focusing exclusively on luxury goods with a high authentication accuracy rate, leveraging partnerships with Entrupy and in-house authenticators.

Lila Sciences develops AI-driven tools and autonomous labs to accelerate research in life sciences, chemical sciences, and materials sciences. Their platform enhances research efficiency and scientific discovery by integrating AI and automation. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, they serve scientific researchers and institutions aiming to innovate in health and science applications.
Investors: Braidwell, Collective Global, Altitude Life Science Ventures, Alumni Ventures, ARK Venture Fund, Common Metal, Flagship Pioneering, General Catalyst, March Capital, Mathers Foundation, Modi Ventures, NGS Super, State of Michigan Retirement System, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority

Pitch: Arch is a fintech company headquartered in New York that offers secure, crypto-backed loans for individuals and institutions. Their platform supports loans backed by Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, providing instant qualification and same-day funding without credit checks. Arch prioritizes security by storing collateral in qualified custody and does not rehypothecate assets. They target crypto holders seeking to unlock liquidity without selling their assets, combining industry-leading security with concierge customer service.
Investors: Oak HC/FT, Menlo Ventures, Craft Ventures, Quiet Capital

Pitch: GreenLite accelerates construction permitting by combining AI-powered software with a team of licensed experts to streamline plan review and code compliance for developers, builders, and municipalities. Its platform, LiteTable, rapidly identifies violations and provides jurisdiction-specific guidance, reducing approval times from months to days. The company serves major retailers, REITs, and home builders nationwide, standing out for privatizing and digitizing a traditionally manual, government-dominated process.
Investors: Insight Partners, Energize Capital, Craft Ventures, LiveOak Ventures, Chicago Ventures

Pitch: Doctronic is an AI-powered health assistant offering free AI-driven medical consultations and affordable telehealth video visits with licensed doctors across all 50 U.S. states. The platform provides personalized symptom checks, actionable health insights, and connects users to clinicians for prescriptions and referrals. Headquartered in New York, Doctronic aims to improve healthcare accessibility and efficiency by complementing traditional care and addressing physician shortages.
Investors: Lightspeed, USV, Tusk Ventures, Mantis VC, Seven Stars, Fei-Fei Li

Pitch: Inbox Health automates and modernizes patient billing, support, and payment processes for healthcare providers. Its platform integrates with multiple practice management systems to streamline revenue cycle management, helping billing teams reduce manual work and increase collections. Patients benefit from a convenient, multi-channel billing experience including email, text, paper mail, and voice calls. The company leverages AI-driven workflows to customize billing cycles and improve payment velocity.

Pascal AI Labs is an AI-driven platform that automates complex investment research workflows for financial institutions such as private equity firms and asset managers. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Bangalore, it provides autonomous investment research by integrating institutional expertise with advanced machine intelligence. The platform offers secure data connections and insights on over 16,000 public companies across 27 markets, enabling faster, auditable, and continuously updated investment decisions. Its unique value lies in combining AI with proprietary knowledge to deliver instant, reliable insights tailored to clients' investment philosophies.
Investors: Kalaari Capital, Norwest, Infoedge Ventures, Antler

Pitch: Figure is an AI robotics company developing the world's first commercially viable autonomous humanoid robot. Based in Sunnyvale, California, it focuses on embedding advanced reasoning abilities into its robots for commercial and home use. The company has strategic partnerships with OpenAI and Microsoft and aims to bring embodied AI to transform humanity. Figure has raised significant funding, including a $675 million Series B round in 2024, with a valuation targeting $39.5 billion.

Tabs is an AI-powered revenue automation platform that streamlines the entire contract-to-cash process for B2B finance teams. It automates billing, collections, revenue recognition, and reporting by integrating with ERP, CRM, and finance stacks. Tabs uses AI agents to handle invoices, payments, and customer records, enabling finance teams to save time and focus on higher-value work. Its platform supports compliance with ASC 606 and provides real-time revenue insights to accelerate cash flow and business growth.

Fourth Power develops utility-scale thermal battery technology that stores renewable energy as heat for durations ranging from 5 to 500 hours and dispatches it as electricity on demand. Their modular, low-cost system uses thermophotovoltaic cells and molten liquid metal to achieve high efficiency and scalability, enabling grid decarbonization and reliable renewable energy supply. Founded in 2021 and based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Fourth Power targets utilities seeking flexible, cost-effective long-duration energy storage solutions to support the energy transition.

PayNearMe provides a flexible payments platform enabling businesses to accept various payment types including cash, debit, credit, ACH, and mobile wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay. It serves thousands of businesses and government agencies across industries such as consumer lending, iGaming, property management, and tolling. The platform offers a seamless customer payment experience with extensive cash payment locations in the U.S., driving operational efficiency and increased customer engagement. PayNearMe is a subsidiary of Handle Financial and operates primarily as a remote-first fintech company headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

RevOpsis Therapeutics is a next-generation biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative ophthalmic therapies using its proprietary RevMod Platform. Founded in 2018, it targets chronic multifactorial diseases such as neovascular age-related macular degeneration by creating multispecific biologics that engage multiple disease pathways simultaneously. Its lead candidate RO-104 uniquely targets three dominant angiogenic pathways to improve disease outcomes and extend remission. The company collaborates globally to advance novel treatments that address unmet patient needs in vision loss and beyond.

Nalu Medical develops and commercializes innovative, minimally invasive neurostimulation systems to treat chronic neuropathic pain. Their battery-free implantable pulse generator system modulates pain signals for patients suffering from spinal cord and peripheral nerve pain. The technology offers a less invasive alternative with external battery power, enhancing patient comfort and reducing surgery needs. Nalu targets patients and physicians seeking effective, drug-free chronic pain management solutions.

Little Otter is a San Francisco-based pediatric mental health company providing personalized, integrated virtual care for children aged 0-14 and their families. Founded in 2020 by child psychiatrist Dr. Helen Egger and entrepreneur Rebecca Egger, it offers evidence-based, family-focused mental health services through a proprietary telehealth platform. The company delivers comprehensive, outcome-driven care including therapy, medication management, and parent coaching, all accessible via their app with no waitlists. Little Otter’s unique approach combines expert clinicians, transparent progress tracking, and immediate access to high-quality mental health support for families nationwide.

Dyna Robotics develops high-performance intelligent robots using foundation models for real-world automation. Their flagship DYNA-1 model delivers reliable, dexterous manipulation tasks such as napkin folding and cup-filling with near-human speed and accuracy. Targeting industries requiring scalable robotic autonomy, Dyna Robotics focuses on robust, round-the-clock robot performance and generalizable skills for commercial applications.

Divergent develops the Divergent Adaptive Production System (DAPS), a fully digital manufacturing platform that integrates AI-enabled design optimization, additive manufacturing of metal nodes, and automated robotic assembly. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Torrance, California, it serves automotive, aerospace, and defense industries by enabling faster development cycles, improved performance, and cost reduction. Its unique software-hardware approach replaces traditional manufacturing with a scalable, adaptable, and sustainable digital factory solution.

Temelion is a French AI startup that streamlines pre-construction workflows by assisting building engineers with automated, high-quality, flexible, and low-carbon building designs. Their AI copilot simplifies complex technical documentation, specification management, and 3D model generation, targeting construction professionals to improve project delivery speed and compliance. Founded in 2025, Temelion aims to digitize and reduce complexity in the construction sector, enhancing efficiency and sustainability.

Rulebase builds AI 'coworkers' that automate back-office operations for financial services, focusing on compliance, quality assurance, and dispute management. Its AI reviews 100% of customer interactions in real time across channels like email, chat, and voice, flagging regulatory risks and reducing manual workload. Targeting banks and fintechs, Rulebase integrates with tools such as Zendesk and Slack to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and maintain compliance. Founded in 2024 by Nigerian engineers based in London, it has already deployed with clients including U.S. business banking platform Rho.

Ethosphere is a Seattle-based startup that uses advanced voice AI and large language models to transform in-store retail operations. Their platform analyzes real customer interactions to provide frontline sales associates with actionable, personalized guidance, enhancing customer experience and boosting sales. Founded in 2024 by leaders with retail and tech expertise, Ethosphere focuses on augmenting human interaction rather than replacing it, making retail support more effective and human-centric.

Genoskin develops advanced human skin models to provide reliable, human-relevant data that accelerates drug development and reduces reliance on animal testing. They serve pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and cosmetics companies by offering ex vivo skin platforms combined with immunology expertise and AI tools. Headquartered in Toulouse, France, with operations in the US, Genoskin enables safer therapeutic and product development through predictive human-based data and extensive scientific collaborations.

Rofim is a French telemedicine platform founded in 2018 that connects healthcare professionals to streamline exchanges and facilitate diagnosis, particularly for rare and complex diseases. Its platform integrates video, voice, email, and SMS tools enabling specialists to collaborate securely, share diagnostic data, and consult in real time. Used by nearly 1,000 establishments and over 30,000 doctors, Rofim also supports surgical teleassistance and continuous medical education. The company aims to improve patient care globally by reducing diagnostic delays and expanding expert access through innovative digital health solutions.

ORIS Materials Intelligence is a cloud-based AI-powered platform that helps engineers, contractors, and public authorities design sustainable linear infrastructure such as roads and railways. It optimizes material usage, reduces carbon emissions by up to 50%, and cuts natural resource use by up to 80% through data-driven life cycle assessment and geospatial analysis. The platform centralizes materials data and supports multi-criteria decision-making to deliver low-carbon, resilient, and cost-effective infrastructure projects. ORIS serves global infrastructure leaders and embeds sustainability into infrastructure design from early stages.

Amaani is a UAE-based beauty and wellness platform that launched the Arab beauty brand AÏZA in 2025. It blends regional ingredients with clinical actives formulated internationally to create products that celebrate Modern Arabia. The company targets consumers seeking locally relevant beauty brands with global appeal. Amaani raised $3 million in seed funding to scale AÏZA regionally and globally, both online and through retail.

DMD Systems Recovery, Inc. provides full-service IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) and Data Destruction solutions focused on secure data sanitization and environmentally responsible asset recovery. Serving hundreds of companies and public entities, it offers customized services including decommissioning, redeployment, and resale of IT equipment across data center, end user compute, and mobility categories. Recognized as a Certified B Corporation and included twice in Gartner's Market Guide for ITAD, DMD emphasizes sustainability through its Reuse First™ approach and maintains high security and environmental standards.

DRUID AI is a leading provider of conversational AI solutions, offering an enterprise platform that enables companies to automate interactions with customers and employees. The platform includes a proprietary NLP engine and supports various deployment models. DRUID's solutions are used by over 300 global customers across multiple industries to enhance customer service and operational efficiency.

Enhanced Genomics is a biotechnology company based in the United Kingdom that uses a proprietary 3D multi-omics platform to identify and genetically validate novel disease-relevant drug targets. Their technology translates massive disease-associated genomic data into actionable biological insights, enabling rapid discovery of high-confidence therapeutic targets for common diseases, particularly autoimmune indications. This approach increases the probability of drug development success and supports patient stratification to improve clinical trials. The company combines advanced genomics with drug discovery to accelerate the development of first-in-class therapeutics with blockbuster potential.

Highlight Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Valencia, Spain, specializing in immuno-oncology with a focus on RNA-based therapies for cancer treatment. Its lead drug candidate, BO-112, aims to reactivate immune responses in tumors resistant to current immunotherapies, particularly in dermato-oncology. The company collaborates with institutions like Merck & Co and UCLA and is advancing multiple clinical trials to develop innovative treatments for solid tumors.

Feelit Technologies is an Israeli company developing AI-powered nanotechnology sensor solutions for industrial operations. Their unique adhesive 'Sticker' sensors provide real-time structural and operational data to enable predictive maintenance, improving uptime, safety, and environmental performance. Targeting large manufacturers in energy, chemical, and industrial sectors, Feelit's platform helps reduce costs and emissions through early detection of equipment failures. The company has raised $8.3 million to expand in the US, Europe, and the Middle East and counts global clients like Henkel and Nestlé.

MetalBear develops mirrord, an open source Kubernetes tool that lets developers run and test local code directly in cloud environments without deployment. It eliminates the bottleneck of waiting for staging environments, enabling instant, production-like testing for microservices. The tool is used by developers at major tech companies to accelerate iteration, reduce bugs, and share cloud environments efficiently.

Fabrix.ai, formerly CloudFabrix, is a U.S.-based enterprise software company providing an AI-driven platform that unifies data, automation, and AI to enhance IT operations and digital transformation. Its solutions include AI-native identity and access management, robotic data automation fabric, and observability tools that help enterprises optimize network, infrastructure, and system performance. Fabrix.ai targets large organizations needing scalable, explainable AI for access governance and operational intelligence, distinguishing itself by leveraging AI agents for dynamic access decisions and autonomous IT workflows.

BIOWEG develops high-performance, bio-based, biodegradable ingredients using precision fermentation of food-industry byproducts to replace fossil-based microplastics and polymers. Their products serve industries such as personal care, home care, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture, enabling reformulation with sustainable alternatives. Operating a pilot plant and a lab in Germany, BIOWEG is scaling up industrial production to meet growing European demand for microplastics-free ingredients, uniquely combining biotechnology, green chemistry, and circular economy principles.

SEON provides a real-time fraud prevention and anti-money laundering platform leveraging over 900 first-party data signals, AI-driven analytics, and customizable risk rules. It serves fintech, payments, iGaming, and eCommerce businesses globally, enabling detection of multi-accounting, onboarding fraud, and transaction monitoring with rapid integration and expert support. SEON’s solution reduces fraud and compliance risks while maintaining seamless customer experiences, protecting over 5,000 businesses and preventing billions in fraud losses.

Nothing is a London-based consumer electronics company focused on distinctive, design-led smartphones, earbuds, wearables, and accessories. Its products, such as the Nothing Phone and Ear series, target tech-savvy consumers seeking innovative design and user experience. The company differentiates itself through transparent aesthetics, unique features like the Glyph Interface, and collaborations with leading designers.
Investors: Tiger Global, GV, Highland Europe, EQT

Pitch: Eve Security is an agentic AI observability and policy enforcement platform that protects organizations from risks posed by autonomous AI agents across workflows, data, and applications. It uses the industry's first Agent-in-the-Loop (AITL) technology to secure AI agents interacting with critical business systems. Founded by cybersecurity and AI veterans and based in Austin, Texas, Eve Security targets enterprises adopting AI to ensure governance, compliance, and prevention of data breaches and malicious actions.

Shop Circle is a London-based SaaS company founded in 2021 that provides a unified suite of AI-powered e-commerce software tools, primarily focused on the Shopify and Amazon ecosystems. It offers solutions including product discovery, up-selling, review management, and inventory management, all integrated under one platform to help online brands scale efficiently. The company targets e-commerce entrepreneurs and merchants seeking to streamline operations and enhance customer experiences with data-driven insights. Shop Circle distinguishes itself by combining multiple best-in-class e-commerce apps into a single, scalable platform, supported by strong Shopify integration.

Sympower provides advanced software solutions that unlock the flexibility of electric assets across industries to balance national electricity grids and support the transition to a fully renewable energy system. Their platform enables industrial and commercial businesses to optimize energy use and generate new revenue streams by participating in demand response programs. Operating primarily in Europe, Sympower uniquely pays its customers for their flexible electricity usage while helping grid operators maintain stability. With a presence in multiple European countries, they combine local expertise with cutting-edge technology to accelerate the energy transition.

Pack is an Italian HR tech startup founded in 2022 that provides an AI-driven platform for workforce development. Its platform helps organizations map skills, foster agile teams, and create personalized growth paths including coaching and mentoring. Pack partners with over 80 multinational companies and uses AI to continuously monitor progress and business impact. The recent €3.5 million funding round will support adding new AI features and international expansion.

Cofrai is a Madrid-based vertical SaaS platform that automates and streamlines the management of fire protection companies. Its AI-driven software automates administrative tasks, job order creation, compliance documentation, and maintenance tracking to boost productivity and reduce errors. Targeting fire protection maintenance providers, Cofrai aims to be the leading operational system in the sector by integrating AI with comprehensive management tools.

Plumerai develops AI solutions for cameras, offering efficient and accurate on-device AI for applications such as security cameras and smart home devices. Its Tiny AI technology enables features like people detection, vehicle detection, and familiar face identification, running on low-power hardware. Plumerai's AI is designed to be fast, private, and cost-effective, making it suitable for battery-powered cameras and expanding into sectors like enterprise security and retail.

OnTracx is a Belgian spin-off from Ghent University that provides a wearable sensor and app delivering real-time feedback on musculoskeletal load during running to prevent overuse injuries and optimize rehabilitation. Their technology quantifies mechanical load on muscles and bones using biomechanical algorithms, targeting runners and healthcare professionals such as physiotherapists and coaches. Founded in 2023, OnTracx aims to reduce running injuries by enabling personalized load management and rehabilitation through scientific insights translated into practical solutions.

Conceivable Life Sciences develops the world's first AI-powered automated IVF lab, using AI, robotics, advanced optics, and machine vision to automate and improve in vitro fertilization processes. Their system, AURA, performs all IVF lab functions with precision and scale, aiming to make IVF more accessible and affordable globally. The company targets fertility clinics and patients facing infertility by increasing IVF availability and improving success rates through automation and digital traceability.
Investors: Advance Venture Partners, ARTIS Ventures, Stride, ACME

Pitch: Divergent Technologies develops the Divergent Adaptive Production System (DAPS), an end-to-end digital manufacturing platform that designs, 3D prints, and robotically assembles complex structures for automotive and aerospace industries. Its software-defined approach replaces traditional manufacturing, enabling rapid, cost-effective, and sustainable production of vehicle components. The company serves as a Tier 1 supplier to automotive OEMs and aerospace primes, and also operates Czinger Vehicles, a hypercar manufacturer.

Remedio provides a platform for continuous, real-time device security posture management, leveraging AI to detect and autonomously fix configuration risks. It offers enterprises complete visibility into security vulnerabilities and ensures devices are secure, compliant, and resilient to breaches. The company serves leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies, aiming to expand globally and enhance its product offerings.
Investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, TLV Partners, Picture Capital

Pitch: GreenLite Technologies is a New York-based construction technology company founded in 2022 that uses AI-powered software combined with expert plan reviewers to accelerate building permit approvals and reduce delays. Their platform scans plan sets for code violations and provides jurisdiction-specific compliance guidance, serving developers, architects, and contractors. GreenLite’s proprietary AI-driven platform, LiteTable, streamlines permitting by reducing revision cycles and unlocking faster paths to approval nationwide. The company targets large enterprises including Fortune 500 clients across retail, industrial, and real estate sectors.
Investors: Insight Partners, Energize Capital, Craft Ventures, LiveOak Ventures, Chicago Ventures

Pitch: Space Cargo Unlimited is a European startup pioneering in-space manufacturing and microgravity research. It offers turn-key pressurized round-trip missions for various applications, including life sciences and new materials. The company's REV1 space factory aims to automate high-value product manufacturing in Low Earth Orbit. By collaborating with partners like Thales Alenia Space, it enables scalable and impactful space-based solutions.
Investors: Expansion Ventures, Eurazeo, European Innovation Council, European Investment Bank, Luxembourg Future Fund II, Tudigo

Pitch: Modern Animal is a veterinary care platform based in Los Angeles that offers primary, urgent, and 24/7 virtual veterinary services through an app. It provides pet owners with easy access to licensed veterinarians anytime while equipping vets with technology to enhance care. The company operates state-of-the-art clinics and emphasizes a seamless, transparent, and personalized pet care experience with features like online appointment booking and medical records management. Modern Animal's membership model and technology-driven approach aim to redefine veterinary care for pets and their owners.
Investors: Addition, Upfront Ventures, True Ventures, Founders Fund

Pitch: Rodatherm Energy Corporation develops advanced geothermal power generation technology using a patented closed-loop, refrigerant-based system that is 50% more efficient than traditional water-based systems. Focused on the Great Basin region in the Western United States, it aims to deliver clean, reliable, and cost-effective baseload power with low operating costs and long system life. The company recently raised $38 million in Series A funding to build a pilot plant in Utah, targeting scalable and firm renewable energy generation with minimal water use.
Investors: Evok Innovations, TDK Ventures, Toyota Ventures, TechEnergy Ventures, MCJ

Pitch: WorkFusion provides an AI-powered software-as-a-service platform that automates enterprise data operations by combining human workforce and machine learning automation. Its solutions focus on business process automation including robotic process automation, workforce orchestration, and cognitive automation. The company serves industries like banking, agriculture, education, and healthcare, enabling clients to automate tasks such as compliance, client onboarding, and invoice processing. WorkFusion's AI-driven digital workforce helps organizations increase efficiency, reduce manual workloads, and enhance compliance processes.

Merciv develops EVA (Enterprise Virtual Analyst), an AI platform that transforms unstructured retail data into autonomous business decisions, helping large retailers optimize operations and strategy. The company targets enterprises seeking to leverage AI for actionable insights and workflow automation. Merciv stands out for its focus on agentic AI that not only analyzes but also autonomously acts on business signals.

Kojo is a commercial construction procurement platform that helps trade contractors order and track materials, automate manual data entry, and unify supply chain stakeholders on a single platform. It reduces construction costs, shortens purchase order processing time by up to 75%, and improves materials management efficiency by 38%. Kojo targets commercial trade contractors aiming to modernize the construction supply chain and improve project delivery speed and affordability.

Ripplr is a full-stack tech distribution and logistics company based in Bengaluru, providing data-driven analytics and plug-and-play systems to streamline supply chain operations for new-age consumer brands. The company delivers integrated, customizable solutions aimed at enhancing distribution efficiency and certainty for clients. Ripplr stands out for its focus on innovation, technology integration, and a commitment to transforming the traditional distribution sector in India.

Emerald AI develops the Conductor platform to help AI data centers flexibly adjust their power consumption in response to electricity grid demand. The company targets AI data centers aiming to optimize energy use and reduce costs by aligning AI workloads with grid conditions. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Washington, District of Columbia, Emerald AI leverages advanced AI and grid optimization expertise to provide unique demand flexibility solutions for large-scale computing environments.
Advisor is a fintech company utilizing AI to create a marketplace. It aims to provide innovative financial solutions, but specific details about its products or target clients are not available.

Augment AI provides a platform that streamlines B2B sales processes by creating a centralized hub for buyers and sellers. It offers tools like Decision Site and Meetingflow to align stakeholders, eliminate bottlenecks, and enhance visibility into deal progress. The platform is designed to improve sales efficiency and trust between buyers and sellers.

Avalanche is an ultra-fast, low-latency Layer-1 blockchain platform developed by Ava Labs that enables builders to create customizable, interoperable public and private blockchains with near-instant transaction finality. It supports high throughput and scalability for decentralized applications, targeting developers, enterprises, and institutions seeking efficient Web3 solutions. Avalanche's unique consensus mechanism and subnet architecture allow for tailored blockchain deployments with low fees and high security, making it a leading platform in blockchain innovation.

Cascade Bio develops proprietary enzyme immobilization technology to create durable, cost-effective biocatalysts that enable industrial partners to produce sustainable, biobased chemicals more efficiently. Their cell-free enzyme solutions improve stability and lifespan under harsh manufacturing conditions, helping companies in chemicals, flavors, fragrances, food ingredients, and pharmaceuticals transition from petrochemical processes to cleaner biomanufacturing. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Denver, Cascade Bio leverages significant NSF funding and venture capital to scale its breakthrough biomanufacturing platform.

Catalyze is a ClimateTech company founded in 2017 that accelerates the transition to clean, renewable energy by integrating smart energy resources into commercial and industrial real estate infrastructure. Their proprietary software platform, REenergyze®, automates and streamlines solar, storage, and EV charging project development and operations, enabling rapid, profitable scaling of renewable energy portfolios. Catalyze targets commercial real estate owners, business operators, and renewable energy developers, offering turnkey solutions with no capital expenditure for property owners. Their unique combination of technology, financial resources, and expertise enables faster, more efficient renewable energy deployment nationwide.

Eloquent Labs developed artificial intelligence technology to automate customer interactions, specializing in automated responses to customer questions and feedback. Acquired by Square, its solutions aim to help businesses of all sizes efficiently manage customer communication. The company’s AI-driven messaging tools are designed to integrate across platforms, offering scalable support for diverse sellers.

Foodini is a US-based company providing an AI-powered dietary intelligence platform that offers ingredient transparency and personalized dietary tagging solutions for the food tech and hospitality sectors. Their platform supports over 150 diets and allergens, enabling real-time personalized menu matching for guests. Foodini combines AI with dietitian quality assurance to deliver precise dietary profiles, targeting restaurants, stadiums, and other dining venues to improve accessibility for individuals with dietary needs.

GCT Semiconductor, Inc. is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in advanced 4G LTE, IoT, and 5G integrated circuit solutions. Their products include single-chip CMOS RF transceivers, mobile digital TV receivers, and cellular IoT chipsets, targeting manufacturers of smartphones, tablets, routers, and M2M applications. The company is distinguished by its expertise in RF CMOS and system-on-chip technology, offering cost-effective, low-power, and compact semiconductor solutions. Headquartered in San Jose, California, GCT serves global markets including Taiwan, China, Korea, Japan, Europe, and the Americas.

Kredete.io is a fintech company founded in 2023 that helps African immigrants build credit and access financial services through stablecoin-based cross-border money transfers. The platform enables users to send money to over 30 African countries while improving their credit history in the US and beyond. Kredete offers API infrastructure for businesses to make secure, affordable payments into Africa, and is expanding features like rent reporting, credit-linked savings, and Africa’s first stablecoin-backed credit card. It targets thin-file or no-file immigrants, providing innovative financial inclusion solutions leveraging blockchain and modern payment rails.

Local Express provides a comprehensive AI-driven SaaS platform tailored for multi-location grocery stores to optimize digital customer engagement and streamline operations. It integrates inventory management, personalized merchandising, prepared foods, and fulfillment with hundreds of POS and retail systems. Serving over 300 regional and specialty grocery banners across the U.S., Puerto Rico, and Canada, Local Express enables grocers to efficiently manage online and in-store channels while maintaining control over branding and customer relationships.

Luminary Cloud is an early-stage technology startup providing a modern SaaS platform for computer-aided engineering that enables engineers to perform rapid simulation, analysis, and iteration with high accuracy. Their Physics AI models achieve less than 1% prediction error, revolutionizing industrial R&D processes in sectors like aerospace and manufacturing. The company serves clients including leading aerospace and sporting equipment companies, offering significantly faster and more accessible simulation compared to traditional methods. Backed by top-tier investors like NVIDIA and Sutter Hill Ventures, Luminary Cloud combines computational physics expertise with cloud technology to deliver impactful engineering insights.

rPlus Energies is a diversified renewable energy developer, owner, and operator based in the United States. The company focuses on utility-scale power plants utilizing solar, wind, pumped storage hydro, and battery storage to provide reliable, resilient, and affordable power. Partnering with private sector, municipalities, and utilities, rPlus Energies aims to rebuild America's energy infrastructure by leveraging regional renewable resources. Their projects emphasize community engagement and long-term economic opportunity.

Silent Push specializes in preemptive cyber defense by providing threat intelligence through indicators of future attacks. It uses a proprietary scanning engine to track changes in global internet-facing infrastructure, helping organizations anticipate and defend against emerging threats before they are launched. Silent Push's unique approach focuses on identifying attacker infrastructure before it becomes weaponized, offering proactive defense solutions to security teams.

Zyppah, Inc. develops and sells FDA-cleared anti-snoring mouthpieces that uniquely combine jaw advancement with a patented stabilizing tongue band to address the root cause of snoring. Their products are safe, BPA-free, manufactured in the USA, and clinically tested for effectiveness. Targeting individuals suffering from snoring, Zyppah offers a hybrid oral appliance that stands out due to its tongue stabilization feature, which differentiates it from other devices. The company operates primarily online and through Sleep Certified dentists and physicians.

BoobyBiome is a London-based biotechnology company founded in 2019 that develops infant feeding solutions harnessing the breast milk microbiome to improve infant health. It offers a patented storage device that preserves breast milk's natural microbiome, antioxidants, and vitamins, and a live microbiome supplement to support formula-fed, C-section, or preterm infants. The company targets families facing challenges with exclusive breastfeeding and aims to reduce infant health issues such as allergies, asthma, and type 1 diabetes. BoobyBiome's innovations build on the world's largest high-resolution breast milk microbiome database and proprietary bacterial strains.

Cera is a UK-based digital-first healthcare-at-home provider that combines AI and machine learning with a community of professional carers and nurses to deliver care, nursing, telehealth, and repeat prescription services at patients' homes. Founded in 2016, it focuses on reducing hospitalizations and improving health outcomes by predicting health deteriorations and falls up to a week in advance. Serving primarily elderly and vulnerable populations, Cera partners with the NHS and local governments to transform healthcare delivery through technology, making care more efficient and personalized.

Cusp.ai is a Cambridge-based DeepTech startup founded in 2024 that builds an AI-powered 'search engine for materials' to accelerate discovery of breakthrough materials needed for clean energy, semiconductors, and sustainability.
