Founded in 2022, Erad aims to close the regional SME financing gap and has raised significant funding to expand its presence across the Gulf.

ZILO is a UK-based fintech company providing cloud-native asset and wealth management software designed to replace legacy transfer agency systems. Its flagship product, ZILO Global Core, delivers real-time digital operations for traditional and digital assets, serving top global custodians and asset managers. The platform emphasizes cost reduction, scalability, and integration of AI-powered tools, targeting institutional clients such as advisers, platforms, and integrators. Founded in 2020, ZILO aims to modernize global asset management infrastructure with a user-centric, innovative approach.

ATXP Protocol, developed by Circuit & Chisel, is a web-wide protocol that enables AI agents to autonomously conduct commerce and payments across the internet without human oversight. Founded by former Stripe crypto leaders, it supports real-time decision-making, nested transactions, and secure micropayments, aiming to become the foundational infrastructure for AI-driven agentic commerce. The protocol facilitates instant, low-cost, delegated payments between AI agents, addressing a critical infrastructure gap for the next generation of digital economy interactions.

Zilch is a UK-based fintech offering a direct-to-consumer ad-subsidised payments network that enables flexible payment solutions for online and in-store transactions. Founded in 2018 and regulated by the UK's FCA, Zilch combines payments and advertising to eliminate the cost of consumer credit. It targets consumers seeking buy now, pay later options with a transparent, flexible credit model. Zilch has rapidly grown to millions of users and operates globally with offices in London, Miami, and Krakow.

SuperMoney (operated by Scapic Innovations Private Limited) is a fintech company offering a suite of digital financial products including UPI payments, credit cards with cashback, buy-now-pay-later options, fixed deposits, and instant loans. Targeting Indian consumers, it aims to democratize access to money and credit through a seamless, paperless process with rewards and competitive interest rates. The platform is recognized and approved by the National Payments Corporation of India and partners with banks like Yes Bank to ensure security and compliance.

Space Cargo Unlimited is a Luxembourg-based deep tech company specializing in in-orbit testing and manufacturing solutions. It develops the BentoBox return capsule, a modular payload platform designed for microgravity research and manufacturing in low Earth orbit. Serving industrial and scientific clients, it enables repeated access to space environments with return-capable payloads, supporting sectors like pharmaceuticals, materials science, and agriculture. The company recently secured €27.5 million in Series A funding to advance its missions planned between 2025 and 2027.
Investors: Expansion Ventures, Eurazeo, BEI, Luxembourg Future Fund II, Tudigo

Pitch: StemInov is a French clinical stage biotech company developing WhartSep®, an off-the-shelf allogeneic stem cell therapy derived from umbilical cord Wharton’s jelly. The therapy targets severe inflammatory conditions such as septic shock and acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), with immunomodulatory, antibacterial, and organ-targeting properties. StemInov aims to advance WhartSep® through clinical trials while scaling industrial bioproduction to meet large-scale therapeutic needs.
Investors: Angels Santé, Business Angels des Grandes Écoles, Alsace Business Angels, Codexial, Finovam Gestion, ILP

Pitch: Kikleo is a French FoodTech startup founded in 2019 that uses artificial intelligence and 3D camera technology to reduce food waste in collective catering environments such as schools, healthcare facilities, and companies. Its solution identifies and quantifies food waste on trays and plates, providing actionable data via a customer platform to help clients reduce waste sustainably. Kikleo has demonstrated significant impact with over 5 million meals analyzed, achieving up to 65% waste reduction and substantial cost savings for its customers. The company supports environmental sustainability by lowering greenhouse gas emissions associated with food waste.

SocialPost.ai is a US-based AI-driven SaaS platform that helps small businesses enhance their social media presence by automating content creation and post scheduling. Its AI customizes posts based on the client's brand voice, colors, and products, enabling consistent engagement and professional marketing without the need for extensive time investment. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Miami, it targets small to medium businesses seeking affordable, automated social media management solutions.

Ardent AI provides a platform that enables artificial intelligence models to securely call APIs and access data, allowing businesses to build, deploy, and share AI agents with custom skills. Their solution automates data engineering tasks, helping companies build and maintain data pipelines efficiently with minimal engineering time. Targeting enterprises, Ardent AI focuses on enhancing AI model capabilities and operational efficiency through secure and scalable automation.

Vylit is an 18+ social media meets creator platform launching publicly in December 2025 that empowers creators to monetize content and build communities with advanced AI discovery and content generation tools. Founded by former OnlyFans CEO Amrapali Gan and Kailey Magder, it targets creators without pre-existing audiences by combining social media discoverability with built-in monetization and strong safety measures including age verification and content moderation. The platform allows topless content but restricts explicit material, focusing on self-expression, autonomy, and audience growth.

Scorecard provides a SaaS platform that enables teams to systematically test, evaluate, and improve AI systems with continuous feedback. It targets enterprises building AI products by replacing subjective reviews with data-driven, repeatable testing to build trustworthy AI that performs reliably in real-world scenarios. Scorecard's tools help customers ship production-grade AI with confidence and speed through structured evaluation and smart recommendations.

PostSig provides an AI-powered platform that automates post-signature contract management for capital markets, banks, finance, data vendors, and consulting firms. It transforms static contracts into actionable insights by extracting critical dates, terms, and clauses, enabling teams to track obligations, avoid missed renewals, and optimize contract performance. The platform offers a centralized dashboard for collaboration across finance, legal, and procurement, simplifying contract lifecycle management and reducing manual work. Founded by AI and fintech experts, PostSig focuses on making contract management seamless, efficient, and strategically valuable.

MaxHome.ai is an AI-powered platform designed to streamline real estate transactions by automating document management, compliance, and transaction coordination. It targets real estate agents and brokers to simplify lead management and improve customer experience. The platform enhances internal productivity by eliminating tedious tasks and empowering real estate teams.

Curated For You is an AI-powered e-commerce platform that enhances online shopping by delivering personalized, lifestyle-driven product recommendations. It uses real-time consumer insights from social media, local events, and weather to curate dynamic assortments tailored to individual customer needs. Targeting retailers, it helps them increase conversion rates by aligning product discovery with shoppers' passions and occasions. Its unique approach blends advanced AI merchandising with localization and marketing tools to create a boutique-like, scalable shopping experience.

BotCity is a SaaS company specializing in intelligent automation and robotic process automation (RPA) using Python. Founded in Brazil in 2018, it offers a platform that enables developers and technology teams to build, orchestrate, and govern code-based automations with high performance and flexibility. BotCity targets enterprises seeking scalable, secure automation solutions with full governance and observability, differentiating itself by emphasizing code freedom, open-source programming, and avoiding vendor lock-in.

Nanofiber Quantum Technologies, Inc. (NanoQT) develops ultra-low-loss nanofiber cavity-QED interconnects that integrate with quantum processors to enable modular, networked quantum computing and quantum communication. Their proprietary technology allows scalable quantum interconnects compatible with neutral atom quantum processing units and existing optical fiber networks. Headquartered in Palo Alto, USA, NanoQT targets quantum computing hardware markets by solving key bottlenecks in scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing and quantum networking.

Prelude Security develops an advanced endpoint security platform that provides continuous monitoring and validation of existing security tools to identify and remediate gaps. Their technology uniquely detects in-memory cyberattacks and adversary activity from user mode, enabling organizations to preemptively strengthen defenses. Targeting enterprises seeking to secure endpoints against modern threats, Prelude integrates with current tools to offer unparalleled visibility and proactive threat mitigation.

Daymark Health partners with health plans to provide comprehensive, tech-enabled cancer care that addresses clinical, social, and mental health needs. Their platform delivers personalized care navigation, 24/7 support, symptom management, and social support both virtually and in patients' homes. Collaborating with oncologists and primary care providers, Daymark improves patient outcomes and manages total cost of care. The company recently raised $20 million in Series A funding to scale its innovative cancer care services across the U.S.

Axon Therapies develops innovative medical devices targeting heart failure by selectively ablating neural pathways to address root causes rather than symptoms. Their flagship therapy, Splanchnic Ablation for Volume Management (SAVM), offers a minimally invasive, implant-free treatment to calm sympathetic nerve activity and normalize fluid balance. Designed primarily for heart failure patients with preserved ejection fraction, Axon Therapies aims to improve cardiac capacity and quality of life. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, the company leverages advanced technology for frontline heart failure therapy.

GHGSat provides high-resolution satellite monitoring and intelligence for greenhouse gas emissions, specializing in methane detection. Their patented sensor technology enables precise emissions data from space, aiding industries like mining in emissions assessment and mitigation. As a pioneer in satellite-based environmental monitoring, GHGSat delivers unique, actionable emissions insights to support climate action and regulatory compliance.

Valence provides an AI-powered leadership coaching platform tailored for enterprises, enabling managers to improve team health, connectivity, and performance through data-driven insights and on-demand expertise. Their AI coach, Nadia, democratizes executive-level coaching at scale, supporting Fortune 500 companies with personalized, confidential, and compliant coaching solutions. Valence's platform uniquely combines generative AI with enterprise-grade security and responsible AI use to transform leadership development and workplace collaboration.

Hub.xyz operates a globally distributed, programmable-bandwidth supernetwork that leverages idle residential internet connections to provide advanced, on-demand AI training data streams. Its platform collects and processes multimodal web data at scale, offering high-quality, low-cost datasets tailored for AI, finance, cybersecurity, and public sector applications. By enabling a decentralized data infrastructure powered by a community of users, Hub.xyz improves data freshness and coverage while reducing costs for enterprises building AI systems.

FREDsense Technologies is a Calgary-based company specializing in rapid, portable water quality testing solutions using advanced biosensor technology. Their flagship product is the first commercially available field-based detector for PFAS, enabling utilities, industrial operators, and environmental service providers to detect contaminants in hours instead of weeks. By combining genetically engineered bacteria sensors with automated systems, FREDsense makes water contaminant analysis faster, more accessible, and cost-effective. Their technology supports real-time monitoring for various contaminants, helping clients safeguard water resources and optimize treatment processes.

Delta g is a University of Birmingham spin-out developing quantum gravity gradiometry sensors that visualize underground locations and measure ground conditions. Its technology delivers real-time spatial intelligence by detecting subtle gravitational differences, enabling non-disruptive mapping for infrastructure and repair projects. The company is pioneering the first field-deployable quantum gravity gradiometer, proven under commercial contracts, and targets industries requiring precise underground mapping and navigation solutions.

DOO is a Saudi Arabia-based AI-powered customer support platform founded in 2024 that specializes in delivering hyper-localized, culturally aware AI-driven customer service tailored to Arabic dialects. It integrates with existing enterprise systems to autonomously handle complex service requests, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Serving enterprises across telecom, banking, airlines, and ecommerce in the GCC, DOO's platform enables personalized, real-time interactions across digital channels like WhatsApp and Instagram. Its unique regional linguistic expertise and focus on localization position it as a leading AI customer experience solution in the Gulf region.

Stickerbox is a Brooklyn-based developer of a voice-activated device and mobile app that creates and prints custom stickers using advanced computer vision algorithms. Founded in 2017, it targets consumers seeking easy and high-quality personalized sticker creation from photos or selfies. The product stands out by automating sticker template selection and precise face processing for seamless integration into various designs, making sticker creation simple and enjoyable.
Investors: Maveron, AI2, Matthew Brezina, Serena Ventures

Pitch: ProofPilot is a U.S.-based healthcare software company founded in 2014 that offers a digital protocol automation platform to improve clinical trial recruitment, conduct, and data quality. Its platform automates complex clinical workflows, reduces protocol deviations, and enhances patient and site engagement for virtual, hybrid, and in-person trials. Targeting life sciences and consumer health companies, ProofPilot uniquely integrates regulatory review, personalized patient experiences, and compliance monitoring to maximize trial efficiency and reduce costs.

MAIA Biotechnology is a Chicago-based immuno-oncology company developing first-in-class telomere-targeting drugs to treat telomerase-positive cancers. Their lead candidate, Ateganosine (THIO), is in Phase II clinical trials targeting advanced non-small cell lung cancer and other difficult cancers. The company aims to improve and extend patients' lives with novel mechanisms of action and is publicly traded on the NYSE American exchange.

Emergence AI develops an advanced agentic platform that automates, optimizes, and scales complex enterprise workflows using self-improving and dynamically created agents. Their Orchestrator Platform enables flexible workflow execution and integration across industries such as supply chain management and semiconductor manufacturing. The company targets enterprises seeking to simplify workflow complexity, enhance system integration, and improve operational adaptability through AI-driven solutions.

Axon Therapies develops a minimally invasive, implant-free catheter-based therapy using Splanchnic Ablation for Volume Management (SAVM) to treat heart failure by targeting the overactive sympathetic nervous system. Their novel procedure aims to restore volume balance, halt disease progression, and improve symptoms in heart failure patients, including those with preserved and reduced ejection fraction. The company focuses on clinical-stage development and serves healthcare providers and cardiologists specializing in heart failure treatment.
Investors: Earlybird Venture Capital, Santé Ventures, Deerfield Management, CD Capital, KOFA Healthcare

Pitch: Resbiotic Nutrition, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, develops physician-formulated, science-backed dietary supplements focusing on microbiome-based products to support respiratory and gut health. Their flagship product, resB Lung Support Probiotic, targets lung structure and function through the Gut-Lung axis, combining probiotics and botanical extracts. Led by Dr. Vivek Lal, a double board-certified physician-scientist, the company emphasizes rigorous clinical research and global partnerships to expand their reach in health and wellness markets.

GaadiMech provides professional car repair and maintenance services with a focus on convenience through doorstep service in Indian cities like Jaipur and Delhi. Their offerings include periodic maintenance, AC repair, denting, painting, battery replacement, and windshield services. They differentiate themselves with a 90-minute express car service using parallel processing to ensure fast and reliable vehicle care. Targeting car owners seeking expert mechanics and transparent service, GaadiMech emphasizes quality and efficiency.

Anode develops AI-powered mobile battery energy storage systems and microgrid solutions that provide flexible, grid-independent power for large electricity users such as utilities, data centers, and EV/AV fleet operators. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in San Francisco, it integrates hardware, proprietary software, and AI services to deliver clean, quiet, and cost-competitive energy alternatives to traditional fossil fuel generators. Its vertically integrated model enables scalable energy solutions that support the transition to a cleaner energy economy.

Plazza is a Bengaluru-based healthtech startup founded in November 2024 by Aman Priyadarshi that specializes in quick medicine delivery with an extensive catalog of over 20,000 SKUs. The company operates an omnichannel model combining physical stores and rapid delivery within 15 to 60 minutes, targeting urban consumers seeking fast and reliable access to pharmaceuticals. Plazza aims to expand its product range to include healthy snacks, mother and baby care, elder care, and dermatology products while scaling its store footprint in Bengaluru. It differentiates itself by addressing limited availability in traditional pharmacies and leveraging integrated supply chain technology for dependable service.
Investors: All In Capital, Better Capital, Abhishek Goyal, Vivekananda Hallekere, the Singhania family office, the promoters of JK

Pitch: SeaPattern is a Swedish startup founded in 2020 that develops modular floating hydrokinetic turbines combined with AI-driven software to increase electricity output from existing hydropower plants by 7 to 10 percent. Their technology enhances renewable energy generation without new infrastructure or environmental impact, targeting hydropower operators and utilities. SeaPattern's solution is validated through field trials and aims to scale industrial operations across Europe, contributing to the clean energy transition.

Carla is a Swedish e-commerce platform specializing in buying, selling, and leasing used electric vehicles with delivery within 72 hours in Sweden. Founded in 2020, it offers customers rigorously tested cars with a 12-month guarantee, favorable financing, and free returns. The company aims to simplify and modernize the electric car ownership experience, targeting environmentally conscious consumers seeking convenience and transparency. Carla is expanding internationally and focuses on aftermarket services and rapid delivery.

Ascilion is a Swedish medtech company founded in 2012 that develops and manufactures patented hollow microneedle technology to painlessly sample dermal interstitial fluid (dISF), a rich source of biomarkers. Its flagship product, PELSA, enables real-time health monitoring applications such as metabolic health, stress, hormone tracking, and drug therapy management. Ascilion collaborates with pharmaceutical companies, researchers, and hospitals to advance diagnostic and wellness testing, positioning itself at the forefront of next-generation diagnostics.

Levoit is a Swedish company specializing in smart home wellness products including air purifiers, humidifiers, and vacuum cleaners designed to create clean and comfortable indoor environments. Their products feature advanced technologies such as AI-powered smart routines and efficient filtration systems, targeting health-conscious consumers and allergy sufferers. Levoit emphasizes quiet operation, energy efficiency, and app-based control to enhance user experience and indoor air quality.
Investors: ReGen Ventures, Starship Ventures, Project Europe, Wave Ventures

Pitch: Cheque helps professional service firms accelerate invoice payments by allowing clients to pay early at a small discount. This solution improves cash flow without relying on loans or factoring, enabling businesses to maintain strong client relationships and reinvest revenue faster. Founded in Sweden and now based in New York, Cheque focuses on simplifying payment management and cash flow optimization.

Openroll is an AI-powered platform that helps companies benchmark compensation data, simulate pay positions, and make confident compensation decisions. It targets HR and finance teams seeking smarter, data-driven salary planning. The platform's unique value lies in its AI capabilities to optimize pay strategies and support fair, competitive compensation management.

HAALE is a Swedish wearable tech startup founded in 2023 that develops smart rings designed to provide accurate health data through a minimalist, accessible device. Their product tracks sleep, physical activity, menstrual cycles, and offers gesture control, all managed via a free app compatible with iOS and Android. With an ultra-slim design, extended battery life, and waterproof features, HAALE targets health-conscious consumers seeking affordable, stylish health monitoring. The company has rapidly expanded across Europe, gaining thousands of users and positive media recognition.

Svensk Hampaindustri (SHI) is a Swedish foodtech startup specializing in the cultivation and processing of pesticide-free, EU-certified industrial hemp seeds for the food and cosmetics industries. They produce various hemp fractions in their Swedish hemp-foodtech factory and sell residual streams as carbon-binding biobased materials to industries transitioning from fossil to biobased inputs. SHI aims to build a sustainable, integrated infrastructure for hemp seed and fiber processing in Sweden, promoting biodiversity, soil health, and sustainable production and consumption.

MyLoppis operates an online marketplace platform focused on the second-hand and flea market segment in Sweden. It provides a digital solution for users to buy and sell preloved items, integrating marketplace functionality with SaaS features to facilitate transactions and community engagement. Targeting consumers interested in sustainable shopping and vintage goods, MyLoppis leverages Sweden's strong loppis culture to create a unique, localized marketplace experience.

ZettaScale develops innovative open-source connectivity solutions that optimize device-to-device and cloud-to-device communication, enabling low-latency, efficient data exchange across industries such as robotics, mobility, and healthcare. Its flagship Zenoh protocol facilitates seamless connectivity across devices, networks, and platforms, serving over 100 global customers including Fujitsu and Boeing. The company is recognized for breaking connectivity bottlenecks and driving digital transformation with scalable, versatile technology.

Manifest AI provides GPT-powered chatbots that integrate with Shopify stores to help direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands increase revenue through AI-driven product recommendations, personalized customer interactions, and enhanced customer service. Their solution automates routine inquiries to improve operational efficiency and offers detailed analytics for customer insights. Manifest AI positions itself as a growth partner focused on delivering a superior, personalized shopping experience that drives e-commerce sales.

Crossmint is a fintech platform providing an all-in-one suite to integrate wallets, stablecoins, and blockchain primitives into products, apps, and AI agents. It offers chain-agnostic wallet infrastructure supporting Solana, EVM chains, Stellar, Aptos, and Sui, with features like custodial and non-custodial custody, gas sponsorship, and compliance (SOC-2, PCI, VASP licensed). Trusted by major financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, Crossmint simplifies blockchain integration with easy APIs, no-code dashboards, and bank-grade security, targeting fintechs and enterprises seeking seamless crypto payments and tokenization solutions.

Lãberit is a leading Spanish IT company specializing in software development and technological solutions across multiple sectors including public administration, banking, insurance, telecommunications, energy, industry, and healthcare. It provides consulting, development, and maintenance of digital solutions with a strong focus on innovation, quality, and the human aspect of its workforce. The company has a significant presence in Spain and Latin America and partners with global firms to deliver AI-powered supply chain and Industry 4.0 solutions. Lãberit serves over 2,500 active clients, optimizing their operations with tailored IT tools and services.

Alpic is a Paris-based all-in-one cloud platform that enables businesses to deploy, manage, monitor, and scale Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI agents in production. Founded in 2025, it offers developer-centric toolkits for rapid deployment, fine-grained authentication, versioning, and observability without framework lock-in. Alpic's platform focuses on providing secure, reliable, and easy exposure of services to AI agents, targeting companies building AI-native experiences. Its unique value lies in combining deep MCP expertise with core internet infrastructure knowledge to simplify AI infrastructure operations.

GoodFit is an AI-driven data platform founded in 2020 in London that redefines how companies execute go-to-market strategies. It combines proprietary market data, first-party performance data, and configurable tooling to help commercial leaders precisely identify, prioritize, and engage customers across human-led and programmatic sales strategies. The platform enables unified targeting, campaign management, channel mix forecasting, and customer acquisition cost optimization, empowering revenue leaders with direct control over GTM outcomes. GoodFit’s unique intelligence layer aims to make world-class go-to-market accessible to a broad range of companies as AI reshapes sales practices.
Investors: Notion Capital, Salica Investments, Inovia Capital, Robin Capital, Common Magic

Pitch: Paid is a fintech SaaS company headquartered in the United States that provides automated accounts payable and payment solutions for businesses. Its platform streamlines invoice processing and payment workflows, targeting enterprises seeking to improve financial operations efficiency. Paid's technology enables seamless B2B payments, reducing manual work and enhancing cash flow management.

Kapiva is an Indian wellness brand founded in 2016 that offers modern Ayurvedic nutrition products combining traditional Ayurvedic principles with modern technology. Its product portfolio includes herbal juices, ayurvedic gummies, nutrition powders, and everyday nutrition items targeting lifestyle health issues such as immunity, skin and hair health, weight management, and chronic conditions. Kapiva operates primarily through a direct-to-consumer omnichannel model, focusing on natural, organic, and convenient health solutions for modern consumers.
Investors: 360 ONE Asset, Vertex Growth, Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India, 3one4 Capital

Pitch: Petpooja is an Indian SaaS company providing an all-in-one restaurant management platform that includes billing POS, online order management, CRM, and loyalty programs. Founded in 2011, it serves over 100,000 clients across India and other countries, processing millions of bills daily and handling a significant volume of orders on platforms like Zomato and Swiggy. Its technology enables restaurants to streamline operations, integrate multiple sales channels, and enhance customer engagement through a configurable and user-friendly system.
Investors: Dharana Capital, Ashish Gupta, Abhiraj Singh Bhal, Varun Khaitan

Pitch: Hocco is a premium Indian food and ice cream brand operating over 100 outlets across India and the United States. Founded by the Chona family, it offers authentic Indian cuisine with a modern twist alongside a diverse portfolio including Hocco Eatery, Ready-to-Eat products, and specialty ice cream cafes. The company focuses on innovation, quality, and expanding its market presence through franchise and direct operations. Recent funding of $20 million aims to scale production, enhance distribution, and explore sustainable practices to meet growing demand for premium food products.

iGowise Mobility is an India-based electric vehicle startup specializing in safe, sustainable, and affordable electric mobility solutions. Their flagship product, the BeiGo X4, is a patented Narrow-Tilting-Trike offering motorcycle agility with three-wheeler stability, ideal for urban commuters and last-mile delivery. The company focuses on frugal innovation, indigenous supply chains, and IP-driven development to create world-class EVs for both domestic and global markets. iGowise is expanding globally through strategic partnerships and aims to revolutionize electric trike transport with a modular LeanEV platform.

Datavault AI Inc. is a technology company specializing in AI-driven data management, valuation, and monetization through a Web 3.0 ecosystem. Their cloud-based platform offers tools for secure data asset visualization, valuation, and monetization, targeting enterprises across multiple industries including biotech, fintech, healthcare, and energy. The company leverages advanced AI, machine learning, and blockchain technologies to enable real-time data insights, privacy protection, and regulatory compliance, distinguishing itself with patented data management platforms and high-performance computing capabilities.

Gain is a deeptech startup based in Israel that provides intelligent AI Employees for end-to-end procurement automation. Its AI workforce layer autonomously manages procurement workflows including sourcing, contract execution, transaction processing, and exception handling, integrated with ERP and collaboration tools. The platform targets global enterprises in retail, CPG, energy, and chemicals, helping them scale operations, improve compliance, and reduce hidden costs in procurement. Gain recently raised $12M in seed funding to advance R&D and expand in the US and Europe.

Pura Beverage Company offers natural, low-sugar, preservative-free sodas made with real ingredients as a modern alternative to traditional soft drinks. Headquartered in the UK and South Africa, it targets health-conscious consumers seeking authentic taste without synthetic sweeteners. The company focuses on sustainability through environmentally responsible packaging and ingredient sourcing. With global distribution in Southern Africa, the US, and select Middle East markets, Pura aims to expand its presence and brand visibility internationally.

Lexroom.ai is an AI-powered legal tech platform founded in 2023 in Milan, Italy, that streamlines legal research, document analysis, and drafting specifically for the Italian legal system. It enables lawyers and corporate legal teams to rapidly generate high-quality drafts and receive accurate legal insights using natural language queries, saving them up to 73% of time on repetitive tasks. The platform integrates seamlessly into daily workflows and currently supports multiple legal domains including Civil, Commercial, Privacy, Banking, and Labour Law. Lexroom.ai's focus on Italy's complex legal landscape and its subscription-based SaaS model position it uniquely to transform legal workflows and scale internationally.

OXCCU is a University of Oxford spin-out developing novel catalysts and reactor designs that convert carbon dioxide and hydrogen into sustainable aviation fuel, chemicals, and plastics. Their innovative one-step catalytic process directly synthesizes liquid hydrocarbons from waste carbon sources and green hydrogen, reducing costs and carbon intensity compared to traditional methods. Headquartered in the UK, OXCCU operates pilot and demonstration plants producing synthetic fuels with high flexibility in feedstock inputs. The company aims to scale cost-effective, low-carbon aviation fuels to help decarbonize the aviation industry globally.

MyEdSpace is a London-based online education platform founded in 2022 that offers live, interactive lessons for UK students aged 8-18, focusing on core subjects like Maths, English, and Sciences. It selects top 1% UK teachers to deliver scalable, engaging lessons supported by workbooks, homework, and video solutions, making high-quality education affordable and accessible. The platform features AI-powered learning tools and 1-1 mentoring to enhance student support and outcomes. Its mission is to eliminate educational inequality by combining expert teaching, technology, and social media reach.
Investors: White Star Capital, Educapital, Emerge, Active Partners, Coalition Capital

Pitch: RDS is a French medtech company developing MultiSense®, a CE-marked reusable wearable patch that continuously monitors six vital signs for patients in hospital or at home. Their solution combines a lightweight adhesive patch with a secure cloud platform to enable real-time remote patient monitoring, improving patient comfort and clinical workflow. Deployed in multiple European hospitals, RDS targets the hospital-at-home market and aims to scale manufacturing and expand internationally, including a planned US launch.

Talentica is a Czech Republic-based HR technology company specializing in recruitment and talent acquisition for technically skilled professionals. Founded in 2009, it provides tailored job matching and employer partnership services, leveraging AI to connect top technical talent with leading companies. The company supports candidates throughout the hiring process and offers scalable software development solutions to meet evolving business needs.
Investors: Purple Ventures, Venture to Future Fund

Pitch: Anything is a US-based AI startup specializing in no-code AI app development platforms that enable users to build applications without coding expertise. The company recently raised $11 million in Series A funding, bringing total capital to $19.5 million, with earlier seed investment from Bessemer Venture Partners. Its platform targets developers and businesses seeking to leverage AI for rapid app creation, emphasizing ease of use and accessibility.

Aiode is an AI-driven music technology company that creates virtual versions of real musicians to empower artists' creative exploration. Their proprietary AI models capture the unique styles of musicians, allowing creators worldwide to produce music with virtualized artists while ensuring original musicians receive royalties through an ethical profit-sharing model. With teams in Tel Aviv, London, and New York, Aiode combines music production expertise and AI development to offer a unique platform that innovates music creation and collaboration.

Unive is an AI-powered college and career counselling platform that supports students throughout the admissions journey by combining data-driven AI guidance with expert admissions professionals. It helps students identify best-fit schools, refine essays, prepare for interviews, and find scholarships, targeting applicants to US universities with plans to expand to Western Europe. The platform aims to make admissions support more accessible and affordable by pairing AI with expert review, offering ethical, high-quality guidance that levels the playing field for students regardless of financial background.

Willo is a UK-based SaaS platform founded in 2018 that provides an AI-powered video interviewing and candidate screening solution designed to streamline and improve the hiring process. It helps recruiters filter candidates, automate scheduling and personalized communication, and reduce time-to-hire while enhancing candidate experience. Willo targets startups, scale-ups, and enterprises globally, offering multilingual support and integrations with ATS systems. Its unique value lies in leveraging AI to improve hiring efficiency, reduce bias, and provide actionable insights at scale.

Cylib is a German cleantech company revolutionizing battery recycling with proprietary water-based technology that recovers over 90% of critical materials from lithium-ion batteries, including lithium, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and manganese. Founded in 2022 as a spin-off from RWTH Aachen University, it offers an end-to-end recycling process that significantly reduces carbon footprint by 30-80% compared to conventional methods. Cylib targets battery producers, automotive OEMs, and the battery value chain to enable a circular economy and strengthen resilient European supply chains. The company is scaling industrial production with a new plant in Chempark Dormagen, set to begin operations in 2027.

OMMM provides AI-powered standardized planning software designed to optimize industrial production and supply chain planning. Their platform automates complex production and demand planning in real time, targeting process industries such as food, pharma, and cosmetics. OMMM integrates seamlessly with existing ERP systems, including SAP, delivering measurable productivity gains and reducing resource waste to give companies a competitive advantage.

Igonogo is a Grenoble-based deeptech startup offering an AI-enhanced online survey platform that measures customer emotions in real time using neuroscience and behavioral science. Its technology detects subtle emotional responses through simple finger movements on smartphones, providing authentic insights beyond traditional surveys. Targeting marketing and market research industries, Igonogo enables businesses to understand customer expectations and improve decision-making with precise emotional analytics. The company recently raised €4M in Series A funding to accelerate growth, expand internationally, and enhance its AI-driven emotion analysis algorithms.

Abby is a French SaaS platform founded in 2021 that provides freelancers with an all-in-one tool to manage their business activities, including invoicing, accounting, and tax declarations. It automates bank synchronization, VAT reporting, and social contribution declarations via an official partnership with Urssaf. Abby offers a freemium model with paid subscription plans, targeting independent entrepreneurs seeking simplified financial management and administrative compliance.

Chat3D is a French generative AI startup specializing in rapid 3D model creation from text or images, targeting gaming and VR industries. Their software reduces 3D asset creation time by 95%, offering an all-in-one SaaS solution including editing, UV mapping, and texturing. The company supports small and independent studios to compete with major players by simplifying and accelerating 3D content production. Founded in 2023, Chat3D recently completed a funding round to accelerate development and international expansion.

All In Box offers a comprehensive marketing service platform designed to help physical retail businesses attract and retain customers using simplified AI-assisted tools and personalized human support.
