Investors: MKB Equity Partners, Blue Earth Capital, Canada Growth Fund

Pitch: Summation offers a Decision-Grade AI Platform that provides enterprise leaders with real-time, verified insights to make faster and more confident decisions. Its proprietary AI Calculation Engine runs thousands of analyses simultaneously, uncovering hidden drivers of performance and transforming business complexity into clarity and profitable growth. Targeting executives and leadership teams, Summation enables data consolidation, workflow streamlining, and optimized business planning with audit-ready clarity.

Plasana Medical develops a medical device using cold atmospheric plasma technology to treat chronic wounds such as diabetic foot ulcers and pressure ulcers. Their portable device disinfects wounds and stimulates tissue regeneration, reducing healing time and infection rates. Targeting healthcare professionals in hospitals and homecare, Plasana aims to improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare costs with this innovative, non-invasive treatment.
Investors: TF Participation, Cantrak, Maison Worms, Cléry, L’Occitane Group Ventures

Pitch: Up&Charge is a French startup developing induction charging stations for electric vehicles that enable cable-free recharging activated via a mobile app. Founded in 2021, it targets businesses and local authorities with affordable, user-friendly, and accessible charging solutions optimized for energy transfer and compatible with users having reduced mobility. The company recently secured €1.5M in seed funding to finalize product development and begin installations, focusing on enhancing hardware, software, and user experience to facilitate EV adoption and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

Synboli is a French deeptech startup that combines AI and patented synthetic chemistry to accelerate the discovery and development of novel polymers. Their proprietary technology drastically reduces polymer development time from years to months by integrating in-silico design and rapid synthesis/testing. The company targets industries requiring high-performance materials with unique properties, such as aerospace, healthcare, and electronics. Synboli’s innovations enable the creation of unprecedented sustainable materials and provide a competitive edge in polymer innovation.

Metreecs is a French AI-powered platform that optimizes inventory management and demand forecasting for mid-market fashion and lifestyle retailers. It leverages machine learning and real-time data such as weather and social trends to reduce stock shortages and unsold inventory significantly. The platform automates inventory decisions, helping retailers increase profitability and sustainability by minimizing waste and overproduction. Metreecs targets retail companies seeking precise demand planning and inventory optimization to improve operational efficiency and environmental impact.
Investors: Y Combinator, Monte Carlo Capital, Founders Future, Kima Ventures, Business Angels

Pitch: Flai provides an AI-powered 24/7 virtual assistant tailored for car dealerships that handles phone calls, emails, and texts to book test drives and service appointments instantly. Their omni-channel AI solution improves customer engagement and lead conversion by ensuring no call or inquiry is missed, operating seamlessly with dealer CRM/DMS systems. Founded by former engineers and data scientists, Flai aims to increase dealership revenue by automating critical communications and capturing leads outside business hours.

Art of Time is an Indian luxury watch retailer established in 2015, offering a curated selection of prestigious watch brands like Cartier, Montblanc, and Jaeger-LeCoultre. It operates 14 boutiques across multiple cities, providing a premium omnichannel shopping experience focused on personalized service and a diverse range of timepieces. The company targets affluent customers and aims to expand its footprint and product categories leveraging recent funding. Its unique value lies in combining luxury retail with expert horology knowledge and a large-format boutique concept.
Investors: Mithun Sacheti, Siddhartha Sacheti, Girish Mathrubootham, Plutus Wealth Management

Pitch: Apiphani is a technology-enabled services company based in Boston, United States, specializing in minimizing risks and efforts in managing mission-critical applications. It offers a comprehensive suite of services including application support, SAP managed services, ServiceNow management, data pipelines, and security management, leveraging deep automation and machine learning. Apiphani serves large enterprises and MSPs by providing stable application environments, proactive incident prevention, and infrastructure scaling. Its unique value lies in integrating extensive industry experience with innovative automation to directly benefit clients' business goals.

The Plug Drink is a health-focused startup offering a plant-based recovery beverage formulated with traditional Korean herbal medicine. Its product supports liver health, digestion, immunity, and energy, targeting consumers seeking natural hangover relief and overall wellness. Manufactured in South Korea and headquartered in Los Angeles, it is distributed online and in liquor stores in Michigan and Southern California, distinguishing itself with a clinically-backed, multi-ingredient formula designed as a liver health booster.

Midi Health is a telehealth platform specializing in insurance-covered midlife care for women experiencing hormone changes such as perimenopause and menopause. It offers personalized, holistic care plans including prescription hormonal and non-hormonal medications, lifestyle coaching, supplements, and specialized care paths for cancer survivors. The platform integrates with employers and insurance providers to offer fully reimbursed medical programs, making expert midlife care accessible and affordable across all 50 states.
Investors: Advance Venture Partners, Emerson Collective, GV, Anne Wojcicki, Amy Schumer, Tory Burch

Pitch: Lore is a social media company focused on empowering individuals and businesses through advanced artificial intelligence education and resources. It offers a community platform with over 23,000 innovators to stay updated on AI developments, including generative AI insights and practical applications. Services include a weekly newsletter, podcasts, and educational materials designed to help clients navigate the evolving technology landscape confidently. Lore is trusted by industry leaders and aims to inspire and inform about the future impact of AI across sectors.

Westra develops patented, PFAS-free conductive polymers derived from forestry byproducts for batteries, solar cells, and capacitors. Their materials enable safer, eco-friendly alternatives to harmful PFAS-containing polymers, improving battery performance and regulatory compliance. Founded as a spin-off from Linköping University, Westra targets industrial companies aiming for sustainable electrification solutions with scalable, high-performance polymers.

Meetric is a Swedish SaaS company providing an AI-powered conversation intelligence platform designed for virtual and hybrid sales teams. The platform automates data entry, categorizes and summarizes conversations, and delivers actionable insights and coaching to improve sales effectiveness and customer retention. It integrates with CRM and communication systems, targeting telecom operators, UCaaS providers, and sales organizations primarily in the Nordics. Meetric’s unique value lies in its modular, white-label solution that enables service providers to offer advanced conversational AI as their own branded product while maintaining GDPR compliance.

Metamorfish, branded by Nano Textile Solutions in Sweden, develops multi-size adaptive textile components that can reversibly adjust in size hundreds of times for a personalized fit. Their technology integrates into products like shoes, clothing, and accessories, enabling infinite customization and supporting circular economy principles. This innovation addresses fit issues with precision and sustainability, targeting industries requiring adaptive wearable materials.

HikmaAI offers a SaaS platform that continuously evaluates, secures, and controls AI agents to ensure security, compliance, and operational efficiency. The platform provides organizations with real-time status updates and risk oversight for their AI systems, helping to prevent vulnerabilities and maintain trustworthy AI operations. Targeting businesses relying on AI, HikmaAI focuses on proactive AI system management to reduce risks before they incur costs.

Specific is a United States-based company operating in the developer tools sector, providing software solutions and platforms that enhance software engineering and developer productivity. It targets developers and enterprises needing advanced tools for coding, API integration, and software development workflows. The company distinguishes itself by offering efficient, scalable tools that streamline development processes and improve collaboration within engineering teams.

Brickanta is a Swedish AI-native platform designed to automate administrative work in construction estimation and project management. Its AI analyzes project documents, flags missing items and compliance risks, supports cost analysis, tendering, and planning, and integrates with common construction tools like MS SharePoint and Outlook. Targeting construction and real estate companies primarily in Europe, Brickanta helps reduce errors, accelerate delivery, and protect project margins by aligning documentation with standardized building protocols such as Swedish Eurocodes.

011h is a Spanish construction technology company founded in 2020 that accelerates the transition to sustainable, net zero buildings by integrating digital technology with prefabricated, low-carbon building systems such as mass timber. It targets residential developers and municipal housing authorities, offering a scalable and reliable construction process that reduces carbon emissions by up to 81%. Their unique model combines prefabricated components, an integrated supplier network, and full digitization of the construction process to deliver faster, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly buildings in Spain, with plans for European expansion.
Investors: SICC Innvierte (CDTI Innovación), Seaya Andromeda, Redalpine, Breega, BSOCIAL funds

Pitch: Bookline is a Spanish SaaS company founded in 2019 that provides AI-powered conversational voice assistants to automate customer service and booking management for the hospitality industry, including restaurants, hotels, and vacation rentals. Its platform operates 24/7 to handle reservation calls and customer interactions, helping clients recover missed bookings and increase direct revenue. Serving over 1,700 clients across Europe and Latin America, Bookline integrates seamlessly with existing systems to optimize operational efficiency and enhance guest experience. The company recently closed a €3.5 million Series A round to expand internationally and develop new products for the hospitality sector.

Hysun is a Spanish startup developing a proprietary photo-thermo-catalytic technology that produces 100% renewable hydrogen using concentrated solar energy without relying on electricity. Their innovative process splits water into pure hydrogen and oxygen off-grid with zero CO2 emissions, significantly reducing costs compared to traditional green hydrogen production. Targeting industrial and heavy transport sectors, Hysun aims to scale up with modular plants and demonstrate commercial viability with a full-scale prototype in Spain. Supported by strategic investors including InnoEnergy and Equinor Ventures, Hysun positions itself as a leader in cost-competitive green hydrogen production.

Ki Labs is a Spanish healthcare AI startup specializing in personalized skincare solutions. It uses digital tools to analyze individual skin needs based on environmental and lifestyle data, creating customized dermo-cosmetic products. Targeting consumers seeking tailored skincare, Ki Labs combines expert pharmacist knowledge with AI-driven personalization to innovate in skincare innovation.
Investors: business angels, Instituto Español S.A., ENISA

Pitch: IENAI SPACE develops highly efficient, modular, and fully customizable ionic-liquid electric propulsion systems based on electrospray technology for nano-satellites ranging from 2U to 12U. Their propulsion modules are tailored to each mission's unique requirements, enabling optimized maneuvering, orbit changes, and space debris mitigation. The company also offers mission analysis software that leverages genetic algorithms and machine learning for propulsion planning. Headquartered in Madrid, Spain, IENAI SPACE targets small satellite operators seeking advanced propulsion solutions with a reduced form factor to maximize payload capacity.

Nevam provides the first automated journey mapping platform that connects strategy to execution by syncing real-time data across channels and tools. Designed for enterprise marketing, product, UX, and operations teams, it eliminates manual updates and silos to deliver a 360-degree customer experience view. Its platform integrates with existing systems like Jira and analytics to enable continuous micro-optimization and actionable insights. Founded in 2024, Nevam aims to improve decision-making and business impact through live, trackable customer journey maps.
Investors: The Huljich Family office, Brand Fund by Previously

Pitch: Filigran develops open-source cybersecurity platforms for threat intelligence management, breach and attack simulation, and cyber risk management. Its solutions empower security teams to proactively detect, analyze, and respond to threats using AI-driven automation and collaborative tools. The company targets enterprises, government agencies, and managed service providers, offering both cloud and on-premise deployments with a strong focus on actionable intelligence and crisis preparedness.

Navata Supply Chain Solutions is a tech-enabled B2B logistics platform that integrates advanced technology, data intelligence, and operational excellence to provide end-to-end, cost-effective supply chain services across urban and rural India. It offers comprehensive third-party logistics solutions—including warehousing, distribution, reverse logistics, and real-time analytics—primarily for manufacturing, retail, and e-commerce clients. The company differentiates itself with a unified, AI-powered platform that delivers full supply chain visibility and optimizes logistics for both large enterprises and MSMEs, even in remote regions.

GreyLabs AI is a Mumbai-based startup founded in 2023 that provides agentic voice AI and speech analytics solutions specifically for the BFSI sector. Their platform automates customer service functions for banks and financial institutions, enabling smart digital voice assistants that can listen, talk, and take actions such as handling calls and verifications. With over 50 clients including RBL Bank and SBI Life, GreyLabs AI aims to transform call centers into AI-driven conversation hubs, improving operational efficiency and customer experience.

Raise Financial Services is a technology-led fintech company building innovative investment products and infrastructure for India's financially aware users, focusing on metros and urban centers. Its flagship product, Dhan, is a stockbroking and investing platform for retail traders and long-term investors, competing with Zerodha and Groww. The company also develops AI-powered tools and financial learning platforms, aiming to modernize the user experience beyond traditional offerings.
Investors: Hornbill Capital, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), BEENEXT, Ramesh Damani, DSP Family Office, JM F

Pitch: Finarkein is an Indian fintech startup specializing in open finance, data intelligence, and AI infrastructure to empower over 100 banking, financial services, and insurance companies. It provides scalable solutions leveraging frameworks like the Account Aggregator, OCEN, and ONDCFS to enable real-time financial data access, credit decisioning, and workflow automation. Its platform includes the Flux no-code tool and plug-and-play APIs supporting lending, insurance underwriting, and wealth management, focusing on data privacy and compliance. Finarkein aims to build foundational rails for open banking adoption and enhance financial services with AI-powered analytics.
Investors: DSP Group Family Office, existing investors

Pitch: Morphing Machines is an Indian fabless semiconductor IP company founded in 2005 and incubated at the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore. It develops REDEFINE™, a patented many-core, runtime-reconfigurable processor IP designed to deliver ASIC-level performance with FPGA-like flexibility for applications in AI, telecom, and high-performance computing. The company targets global customers seeking energy-efficient, scalable silicon solutions for data centers and compute-intensive applications. Recent funding supports chip development, engineering expansion, and go-to-market efforts.
Investors: IAN Alpha Fund, Speciale Invest, IvyCap Ventures, Navam Capital

Pitch: JSW One Platforms is a tech-driven B2B e-commerce marketplace serving MSMEs in India’s manufacturing and construction sectors. It offers integrated solutions including material supply (steel, cement, welding consumables), financing, and turnkey construction services. Founded by the JSW Group, it aims to increase transparency, trust, and ease of business for MSMEs through a unified ecosystem that streamlines procurement, credit access, and supply chain management. The platform has raised significant funding to expand technology, operations, and financial products tailored to small businesses.
Investors: State Bank of India (SBI), Principal Asset Management, JSW Steel, OneUp, International Conveyors, Scarlett Ventures

Pitch: Hoora is a Nagpur-based vehicle care platform offering on-demand, doorstep car and bike services—including washing, detailing, and insurance—via a mobile app and proprietary hardware kit. It targets vehicle owners seeking convenient, eco-friendly maintenance, using water-saving technology and a gig-worker network for scalable, sustainable operations. Hoora differentiates with its asset-light model, tech-enabled service delivery, and expansion into direct product sales and insurance.

MediView XR is a Cleveland, Ohio-based medtech company specializing in augmented reality-powered visualization and navigation solutions for medical imaging and minimally invasive procedures. Their FDA-cleared XR90 platform enhances ultrasound and CT-guided needle-based interventions, improving precision in ablation and biopsy of cancerous tumors. Partnered with leading organizations like GE HealthCare and Microsoft, MediView aims to transform interventional radiology and advance healthcare delivery through intuitive 3D visualization and remote collaboration.
Investors: GE HealthCare, Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, Edge Ventures, Emplify Health’s investment arm, JobsOhio Growth Capital Fund

Pitch: Tagaddod is an Egyptian cleantech startup founded in 2013 that collects and recycles used cooking oil and other renewable feedstocks to produce biodiesel and support global biofuels production. Using a tech-enabled platform and mobile app, it connects households, businesses, and traders with collectors to facilitate sustainable waste oil management. Operating in over 19 countries across Africa, Asia, and Europe, Tagaddod emphasizes sustainability, international certifications, and supply chain optimization to advance renewable energy and circular economy goals.

Trogenix Ltd is a University of Edinburgh spinout developing precision cancer therapies using its proprietary Odysseus platform, which combines Synthetic Super-Enhancers with gene therapy and immunotherapy to selectively target aggressive cancers such as glioblastoma. Their technology enables curative, one-time treatments that kill cancer cells while activating the immune system to prevent recurrence. Founded in 2023, Trogenix is advancing multiple cancer programs and aims to transform treatment paradigms for hard-to-treat solid tumors.

Vycarb is a Brooklyn-based ClimateTech company founded in 2022 that develops and deploys scalable, fully measurable carbon capture, removal, and storage technology using a novel water-based process. Their system converts CO₂ from various sources into stable bicarbonate in natural waters, enabling permanent carbon storage for 10,000 to 100,000+ years while providing real-time, auditable measurement through proprietary sensing technology. Targeting industrial decarbonization and environmental stakeholders, Vycarb offers a low-infrastructure, safe, and transparent solution that accelerates natural carbon storage and reduces water acidification.

NanoPhoria Bioscience is a preclinical stage biotech company developing inhalable cardiovascular treatments using a proprietary non-viral nano-in-micro delivery platform based on inorganic calcium phosphate nanoparticles. Their lead product, NP-MP1, is an inhalable formulation delivering a novel peptide to treat Heart Failure with reduced Ejection Fraction (HFrEF). The company targets patients with chronic heart failure and aims to address molecular causes unmet by current therapies. Founded in 2022 as a spin-off from Italy's National Research Council, NanoPhoria combines nanotechnology and biotech innovation to pioneer new therapeutic approaches.
Investors: XGEN Venture, Sofinnova Partners, CDP Venture Capital, Panakes Partners

Pitch: Heidi Health is an Australian health technology company that develops AI-powered medical scribe software to automate clinical documentation. Its software transcribes patient consultations into clinical notes, reducing manual note-taking and administrative burden for healthcare professionals. Founded in 2019, Heidi serves over 200 medical specialties and supports more than two million patient consults weekly across 100+ countries. The company’s platform enhances clinician wellbeing and healthcare capacity by integrating AI with clinical workflows.

Harvey is a generative AI platform specifically designed for the legal industry to enhance efficiency for law firms and legal professionals. It leverages advanced large language models trained on legal data and firm-specific documents to assist with contract analysis, legal research, drafting, and workflow automation. Harvey integrates with tools like Microsoft Azure and offers tailored AI solutions that provide contextual insights and improve accuracy, enabling faster and more cost-effective legal services. Headquartered in San Francisco, it is backed by investors including Sequoia and the OpenAI Startup Fund.

Hipp Health offers an AI-native platform designed to streamline operations for Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA) practices and other behavioral health providers. Its tools include AI-powered scheduling, data collection, clinical note generation, billing, and advanced patient analytics. The platform helps clinics improve provider retention, increase utilization, and deliver personalized care through real-time insights and automation. Hipp Health uniquely integrates these features into a secure, HIPAA-compliant system accessible via mobile and web to maximize care efficiency and patient outcomes.

Unconventional Concepts, Inc. is a professional engineering and technical consulting firm specializing in counter-terrorism, preparedness response, and national security. It provides technology policy development, complex problem analysis, and scientific technology transitioning for military, government, and commercial sectors. The company operates advanced training tools and military vehicle modeling, serving clients requiring high-value, time-critical solutions. Headquartered in Florida, it is known for adapting specialized technologies for broader applications.

Claimy is an AI-powered rights administration platform based in Paris that helps music publishers, labels, rights-holders, and artists identify missing revenues and recover lost royalties. The platform manages over €6 million in rights covering 160,000 music assets, providing transparency and ensuring proper tracking and compensation of music usage. Founded in 2023, Claimy leverages technology to solve issues of unallocated or misallocated music rights, enabling creators to regain control over their ownership and maximize catalog value.

Focused Energy is a German-American company founded in 2021, developing laser-based nuclear fusion technology to enable safe, clean, and virtually inexhaustible energy production. It specializes in low-cost, millimeter-scale deuterium/tritium fuel targets called Pearls and modular laser arrays to achieve commercial fusion power. Supported by significant funding from U.S. and German governments and leveraging expertise from fusion research institutions, it aims to build scalable fusion power plants to meet global energy and decarbonization needs.

FLIZpay is a Berlin-based fintech startup founded in 2023 that offers a mobile payment platform designed to eliminate transaction fees for 90% of companies by removing intermediaries. It targets small businesses and consumers in Germany and the EU, providing a transparent, fee-free payment method that keeps user data within the EU. With over 500 merchants and 50,000 users, FLIZpay aims to modernize the payment infrastructure and reduce hidden costs while rewarding consumers with cashback.

StratifAI is a precision oncology company based in Germany that develops AI-based biomarkers through its Polaris™ platform to deliver prognostic and predictive insights from multimodal clinical data. Its first product, Polaris™ Breast, assesses metastatic risk in early breast cancer from digitized histology slides and is undergoing regulatory approval in the EU and US. The company collaborates with hospitals, insurance providers, and pharmaceutical companies to enable personalized and equitable cancer treatment decisions. Founded in 2023, StratifAI leverages AI to accelerate biomarker discovery and improve clinical decision-making in oncology.

Clockin provides a digital platform for mobile workforce management, automating processes like time tracking, scheduling, and project documentation. It targets small and medium-sized businesses across Europe, helping them transition from manual processes to AI-driven solutions. The platform is designed to be user-friendly, making it accessible for non-tech-savvy users in industries such as healthcare and manufacturing.

Vocca is a French healthcare-focused voice AI startup founded in 2024 that provides an AI-powered voice assistant platform for medical practices and healthcare groups. Its technology automates phone communication tasks such as answering calls, booking appointments, sending reminders, and handling patient queries, integrating directly with medical scheduling software. Vocca aims to reduce administrative burden, improve patient access, and increase appointment rates while ensuring compliance with healthcare data regulations like GDPR and HIPAA.

Gojob is a French HR tech company specializing in AI-driven recruitment technology for temporary employment. Its proprietary AI platform, including the Gojob Aglaé virtual assistant, streamlines recruitment by pre-qualifying candidates rapidly and managing large-scale hiring processes. Serving major logistics and manufacturing clients, Gojob leverages generative AI to improve candidate experience and operational efficiency, positioning itself as a technology-driven alternative to traditional staffing agencies.

Deepomatic provides an AI-powered platform for visual automation, enabling businesses in the field service industry to automate tasks like quality control and defect detection. The platform allows clients to create and deploy custom image recognition applications, enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. It operates on a subscription model, offering tools for data annotation, model training, and application deployment. Deepomatic primarily serves sectors such as telecom and infrastructure.

Aisprid develops and deploys AI-driven autonomous robots for fruit and vegetable growers, specializing in high-precision greenhouse tasks like tomato plant de-leafing. Its flagship product, the AISPRID D01, addresses labor shortages and reduces physical strain by automating repetitive, demanding operations. The company targets large greenhouse cooperatives, offering real-time fleet supervision and comprehensive support to maximize productivity and sustainability in agriculture.

Iceberg Data Lab provides environmental data solutions and assessment tools to financial institutions, helping them measure and manage their impact on biodiversity, climate change, and deforestation. The company develops metrics and tools to support reporting, regulatory compliance, and sustainable development goals. Its solutions address environmental risks and opportunities in financial portfolios, enabling clients to meet growing stakeholder demands for accountability and support global climate targets.

Kemiwatt is a French startup specializing in stationary energy storage through innovative redox flow batteries using biodegradable and recyclable organic electrolytes. Founded in 2014, the company develops safe, long-lasting, and environmentally friendly batteries that address renewable energy intermittency and provide scalable power and capacity. Their technology offers high durability over 20 years, avoids rare or toxic metals, and targets large-scale grid and industrial energy storage markets.

Elmut is a French pet food company specializing in fresh, home-cooked-style meals for dogs and cats made with human-grade ingredients. Customers complete an online nutritional questionnaire to receive perfectly portioned meals tailored to their pets' specific needs, delivered directly to their homes. The company emphasizes high meat content, no preservatives, and minimal processing to promote healthier, happier pets. Elmut targets pet owners seeking convenient, nutritious, and customized fresh food solutions with veterinary and nutritional expertise backing.

MyFit Solutions offers a professional 3D scanning solution using smartphones, enabling the creation of custom products like orthotics and compression garments. It provides accurate body measurements for healthcare diagnostics and personalized consumer goods. Collaborations, such as with La Semelle Française, enhance its offerings in the orthopedic market.

Skyld is a French deep-tech cybersecurity startup founded in 2023 that develops hardware-agnostic software to protect machine learning models from reverse engineering, misuse, and cyberattacks without compromising performance or disrupting AI workflows. Their solution secures AI deployments on local devices such as smartphones, connected objects, and desktops, addressing the urgent market need for AI model protection especially on edge devices. Backed by prominent investors and accelerated by Berkeley SkyDeck, Skyld targets companies deploying AI in critical sectors by ensuring scalable, fast, and robust AI security.

Yomi Pharma is a biotech company developing targeted therapies for resistant forms of lung cancer, focusing on a first-in-class anti-EGFR peptide derived from sortilin. It aims to address unmet needs in oncology, particularly in treating lung adenocarcinoma with secondary mutations and resistance to Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. The company's innovative approach targets both common and rare EGFR mutations, offering potential solutions for thousands of patients annually.

Karbikes designs and manufactures enclosed, electric-assist cargo bikes that blend the utility of small vehicles with the low carbon footprint of cycling. Their models—Kozi, Kubi, and Koli—target families, commuters, and businesses, offering weather protection, cargo capacity, and car-like comfort without emissions. Based in Strasbourg, Karbikes aims to replace fossil-fuel vehicles for urban and last-mile transport needs.

INITIATIV operates a next-generation emissions trading platform designed to provide direct, low-cost, and accessible carbon credit trading with instant execution and same-day settlement. Targeting companies navigating the EU Emissions Trading System, it offers institutional-grade service without intermediaries, supporting small to large emitters. The platform integrates multiple carbon assets and automates trading processes, aiming to modernize and simplify carbon market participation in France and Europe.

elpyoo is a digital platform designed to support caregivers by offering a combination of technology and human-centric services. It helps caregivers organize daily life, navigate public systems, and connect with others in similar situations. The platform provides a digital assistant for practical advice and connects caregivers through a community network. elpyoo also offers services tailored for enterprises to support their employee caregivers.

Beez Biotech is a French healthcare company founded in 2021 that develops cutting-edge microfluidic and biomimetic solutions to improve the success rates of assisted reproductive technologies (ART) such as IVF. Their flagship technology, EVA, mimics natural sperm selection processes to enhance sperm quality without DNA damage, aiming to double IVF success rates by 2030. Targeting fertility clinics and labs, Beez Biotech combines advanced biotechnology and microfluidics to address infertility challenges and transform fertility care outcomes.

Aisthesis Medical is a UK-based medtech startup developing VIOSync, an AI-powered clinical decision-support system that predicts sepsis and multi-organ failure to improve acute care outcomes. It integrates with wearable devices, bedside monitors, and EHR systems to create personalized digital patient twins using multimodal data and explainable AI. The company partners with hospitals across the UK and EU to clinically validate and deploy its technology, aiming to enhance early detection and intervention in critical care settings.

Zero London is a London-based sustainable fashion company specializing in zero-waste menswear. Founded in 2020, it designs and manufactures high-quality garments locally to minimize fabric waste and environmental impact. The company integrates innovative design techniques and software solutions to optimize fabric use and reduce emissions by up to 15%. Targeting eco-conscious consumers, Zero London aims to set a new standard for responsible fashion production.
Investors: Bethnal Green Ventures, SFC Capital, SCE Freiraum Ventures, Cranfield University Seed Fund, Benjamin Manwaring

Pitch: Baldr Group is a UK-based company specializing in the wholesale and online retail of hardware, plumbing, and heating equipment. Their business model combines B2B distribution with direct-to-consumer e-commerce, focusing on efficiency and accessibility in the supply chain for energy-related home and building products.
Investors: Ada Ventures, Unconventional Ventures, Inclimo Climate Tech Fund, Prosegur, Techstars, S20 Fund, Viva Holdings

Pitch: Bright Harbor is a disaster recovery software company that helps survivors navigate recovery processes after natural disasters, including insurance claims, government programs, and private grants. Their expert team, including former FEMA and insurance executives, provides specialized guidance and digital tools to streamline and accelerate rebuilding efforts. Targeting disaster survivors, they offer a concierge service that makes recovery faster, easier, and more affordable, empowering clients to rebuild with confidence.

Sixfold offers a generative AI platform specifically designed for insurance underwriting, automating manual workflows to help underwriters focus on risk decisions. Their solution synthesizes diverse data sources and provides transparent traceability of underwriting decisions, ensuring enterprise-grade security and no data co-mingling. Trusted by major insurers, Sixfold aims to improve efficiency and accuracy in underwriting processes.

Nozomio is a San Francisco-based SaaS startup founded in 2025 that builds AI-powered collaborative developer tools designed to enhance software engineering workflows. Their flagship product, Nia AI, indexes codebases and documentation to provide context augmentation for coding agents, improving developer productivity and codebase analysis. Targeting software developers and engineering teams, Nozomio integrates advanced AI models and supports custom app building to streamline coding and innovation.

Gullie is an AI-powered, full-stack platform for global employee relocation, helping companies plan, manage, and execute end-to-end moves. It offers personalized relocation plans, automates workflows, and integrates visa, housing, banking, and compliance services—all managed through a unified dashboard. Gullie targets fast-growing companies seeking to streamline and reduce the cost of international talent mobility.

Psilera is a biotechnology company based in Tampa, Florida, specializing in early-stage drug discovery and development of novel neurological therapies. Co-founded by scientists with leadership experience in pharmaceutical and cannabis industries, Psilera focuses on repurposing psychoactive natural products to create next-generation medicines for mood, cognitive, and addiction disorders. The company leverages a proprietary compound library and computational database to develop breakthrough treatments for hard-to-treat neurological conditions, including Frontotemporal Dementia. Psilera is distinguished by its patient-focused approach, patented compound families, and leadership with extensive biotech industry expertise.

Mistral AI is a French AI startup founded in 2023, specializing in developing cutting-edge, open-source, and efficient large language models (LLMs). Headquartered in Paris, it focuses on creating accessible and customizable generative AI technologies for developers and enterprises worldwide. The company was founded by former researchers from Google DeepMind and Meta, emphasizing strong model performance, computational efficiency, and adaptability across diverse applications.

SafeHill is a cybersecurity company that helps organizations stay ahead of threats by continuously identifying, validating, and prioritizing vulnerabilities. It uses AI-driven automation combined with expert human validation to provide actionable insights. SafeHill's solutions focus on threat exposure management and attack path discovery, offering real-time threat intelligence and compliance assurance.

The Plug is a wellness brand focused on liver health, offering a plant-based drink and pill supplements. It utilizes traditional Korean herbal medicine to support liver function and overall well-being. The company targets individuals seeking natural health solutions, particularly for liver support and detoxification. Its products are designed to aid in digestion, immunity, and energy levels.

Currier Plastics, founded in 1982 and headquartered in Auburn, New York, specializes in custom injection molding and blow molding solutions primarily serving medical, personal care, food & beverage, and hospitality markets. The company offers integrated design for manufacturability and operates a certified Class 8 clean room facility, emphasizing quality, speed, and value. Known for its sustainability efforts, including renewable energy use, Currier leverages advanced manufacturing technology and a total quality approach to deliver precise, innovative plastic components that meet demanding industry standards.

Fidus Systems designs and develops highly complex electronic systems, specializing in FPGA and ASIC development, hardware and PCB layout, embedded software, and thermal design for aerospace, defense, medical, and semiconductor clients. As an AMD Premier Design Services Partner and Intel Gold Tier Partner, Fidus combines deep technical expertise with a proven track record, delivering reliable, high-performance solutions that help clients bring advanced electronics to market faster.

aXenic is a leader in designing and producing optical modulators for satellite and aerospace communications. Their technology specializes in high-speed optical communication solutions, particularly using gallium arsenide devices. The company's products are used in demanding sectors like defense and satellite communications, offering custom device design and production capabilities.

NanoPhoria Bioscience is a biotech company developing innovative inhalable cardiovascular treatments using a proprietary nano-in-micro delivery platform. Its lead product, NP-MP1, targets heart failure with reduced ejection fraction by modulating cardiac L-type calcium channels. The company's technology allows for targeted delivery of biologics directly to the heart via a lung-to-heart route, minimizing systemic exposure. This approach aims to improve heart function in patients with serious cardiac conditions.

EF Polymer develops and sells 100% biodegradable, high-absorbency polymers derived from plant-based raw materials like orange and banana peels. These polymers help farmers conserve water by improving soil retention, addressing global water scarcity issues. The company targets agricultural industries and is expanding into cosmetics and personal care. Its mission is to provide sustainable solutions for water challenges worldwide.

Heidi Health is an Australian health technology company that develops AI-powered medical scribe software to automate clinical documentation for healthcare professionals. Their software transcribes patient consultations into clinical notes and other documents, reducing manual note-taking and administrative burden across multiple specialties. Founded in 2019, Heidi Health's AI platform supports over two million patient interactions weekly in more than 100 countries, enhancing clinician efficiency and patient care quality. The company has raised nearly $100 million to expand its AI capabilities and global operations.

The company targets healthcare providers seeking to expand access to critical interventions, emphasizing speed, safety, and surgical precision powered by AI and robotics.

Targeting AI developers and enterprises, it enhances AI assistants with long-term memory, improving user experience and reducing hallucinations.

Bee Maps, powered by Hivemapper, provides a decentralized global mapping platform that transforms street-level imagery into dynamic map data using AI and blockchain technology. The company also develops a triple combination product for patients requiring additional anti-inflammatory therapy. AeroRx focuses on improving treatment outcomes for moderate-to-severe COPD patients who are underserved by traditional inhalers.

Eradivir is a biotechnology company focused on harnessing the immune system to treat viral infections, using its proprietary Bispecific Antigenic immuno-Therapy (BAiT) platform. Its lead product, EV25, is an antiviral therapeutic for influenza, demonstrating quicker recovery and reduced drug resistance compared to current treatments. Eradivir's technology combines the simplicity of small molecules with the efficacy of antibody therapies. The company aims to develop a toolkit of small molecule immunotherapies for various diseases.

The platform ensures clean data ready for clinical use, research, and AI applications. Datamonk targets hospitals, radiology networks, and PACS providers, focusing on efficient data migration and quality.

Ewake.ai provides an AI-powered production teammate that monitors production systems to detect and flag suspicious patterns before alerts trigger. Targeting engineering teams, Ewake helps reduce downtime and improve operational efficiency with GDPR and SOC II compliant solutions.

FurtherAI is an AI workspace designed for the insurance industry, automating complex workflows such as submission intake, policy comparison, and claims processing. It enables insurance teams to streamline operations, improve accuracy, and focus on strategic work. By leveraging AI, FurtherAI helps carriers, brokers, and MGAs enhance productivity and efficiency. The platform is built to integrate seamlessly with existing insurance workflows, providing real-time insights and automation.

Lucio is an AI-powered legal assistant designed to streamline and automate workflows for law firms, in-house legal teams, and researchers. It offers advanced features such as document summarization, contract drafting and review, fact discovery, and due diligence automation. Trusted by major Indian law firms, Lucio enhances legal efficiency while ensuring data security and confidentiality. Founded in 2024, it recently raised $5 million to scale its AI-driven legal platform.

DecorTwist is a direct-to-consumer home décor brand founded in 2022 and headquartered in Noida, India. It offers a range of stylish and eco-friendly products including storage, dining, kitchenware, and pooja essentials, sold via platforms like Amazon, Myntra, and Flipkart. The company focuses on making affordable, functional, and sustainable décor accessible to Indian households, with plans to expand inventory and enter quick commerce platforms. EcoEx’s Waste Commodity App integrates real-time tracking, secure payments, and e-auctions, supporting over 3,000 recyclers and collectors. The company focuses on Extended Producer Responsibility credit services and ESG-aligned compliance, positioning itself as a leader in transforming waste into climate and economic opportunities.

Energy Robotics develops AI-powered software for autonomous robots and drones that perform industrial inspections in harsh environments such as oil, gas, chemical, and power industries. Their hardware-agnostic platform enables seamless fleet management and AI-driven analytics, enhancing operational efficiency and safety by automating dull, dirty, and dangerous tasks. Since 2019, their solutions have been deployed globally with customers including Shell and BASF, supporting Industry 4.0 digitalization efforts.

Luna Robotics is a Lithuanian defense tech startup developing advanced tactical drone cameras, including their flagship LunaCam, designed for unmanned aerial vehicles used in military operations. Manufactured with a China-free supply chain, Luna Robotics focuses on security, compatibility with NATO standards, and battlefield-proven performance, supporting allied forces including deployments in Ukraine.

Targeting freight forwarders, Nexcade enables faster operations, better data visibility, and higher win rates by unifying scattered inputs and keeping critical processes running smoothly.

The company stands out for its tightly integrated, edge-optimized systems designed for high-speed, low-altitude, and obstacle-rich missions.

Trogenix develops precision cancer therapies using its proprietary Odysseus® platform, which combines Synthetic Super-Enhancers (SSEs) delivered via AAV vectors to selectively activate therapeutic genes in cancer cells—killing tumors and stimulating immunity with minimal damage to healthy tissue. Tycho AI develops mission-critical autonomy software and hardware for unmanned systems, enabling intelligent navigation and operation without GPS or persistent connectivity. Peer AI provides an advanced agentic AI platform designed to accelerate regulatory and clinical documentation in the life sciences industry. Their solution uses purpose-built AI agents to automate complex authoring tasks while maintaining human control for quality and compliance. Targeting biotechs and pharmaceutical companies, Peer AI offers inspection-ready documents faster than traditional methods, combining speed, quality, and regulatory adherence.

GAIM.FUN is an AI-powered platform that enables creators to generate fully explorable, interactive 3D virtual worlds from a single sentence within minutes. Its technology produces modular, editable assets with integrated physics, dynamic narratives, and intelligent NPC behaviors compatible with Unity and Unreal engines. The platform targets indie developers, small studios, educators, and user-generated content creators, accelerating virtual world and game development. GAIM.FUN’s unique combination of generative AI and user-friendly editing tools lowers traditional barriers in 3D content production and storytelling.

Sterling Brokers is Canada's largest independent insurance broker, specializing in employee benefits and group insurance. Talion differentiates itself through transparency, flexible service integration, and a heritage of defending critical national infrastructure, providing clients with full visibility and actionable intelligence tailored to their maturity and stack.

It offers whole life insurance products where premiums and claims are paid in BTC, providing protection against fiat currency volatility. The company leverages AI-powered systems to simplify application processes and targets Bitcoin-native families and high-net-worth individuals. It is notable for pioneering Bitcoin-denominated insurance with unique tax and estate planning benefits.

Based in Waltham, Massachusetts, Affinia aims to provide transformative, one-time dose genetic medicines with enhanced efficacy and manufacturability.

Their technology adapts continuously to the current state of the user, not just past data, targeting sectors like corporate wellness and cyber workforce readiness. The company combines expertise in AI, human performance, and cognitive science to improve individual and team performance and retention.

It empowers breakthroughs in synthetic biology, biotech, and pharma by delivering complex DNA sequences directly without assembly. The company's innovative technology supports faster and more efficient DNA synthesis, benefiting pharmaceutical and biotech companies in drug discovery and development.

The platform serves hedgers, speculators, and researchers, distinguishing itself with crypto-native infrastructure, low fees, and integration with decentralized oracles for dispute resolution.
