Stoke Space is developing fully and rapidly reusable orbital rockets designed to provide affordable, sustainable, and high-frequency access to space. Their flagship vehicle, Nova, features a full-flow staged combustion engine and innovative reusable second stage, targeting commercial, civil, and defense customers. Headquartered in Washington state, Stoke aims to revolutionize space transport with rapid turnaround and reduced environmental impact, supported by significant venture funding and U.S. government contracts.

Cyberwave is an AI-driven automation platform that connects AI agents to physical machines, enabling developers to integrate, simulate, and deploy behaviors across industries like manufacturing and logistics. It offers a digital twins platform that simplifies automation by turning hardware into programmable software components. Cyberwave aims to bridge the gap between AI and the physical world, making robots more accessible and useful. The platform supports rapid reconfiguration of physical systems, meeting needs in sectors such as defense and construction.
Investors: United Ventures, The TechShop, Vento (Exor), Pi Campus, Angel Investors

Pitch: Sees.ai develops an operating system for the safe operation of unmanned aerial vehicle fleets at a national scale. It provides detailed inspection data for grid operators, enabling safer, more efficient maintenance and asset management. Its technology is trusted by major clients like National Grid, and it offers solutions for methane emissions monitoring and offshore wind inspections.

Lumen Bioscience is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing orally delivered biologic drugs using a patented spirulina platform. Their vertically integrated approach accelerates drug development and manufacturing, targeting prevalent diseases with unmet medical needs such as metabolic disorders and infectious diseases. Headquartered in Seattle, they focus on creating cost-effective, scalable therapeutics with a unique technology that enables oral delivery of therapeutic proteins, aiming to transform biologic drug accessibility and affordability.

Membrion develops electro-ceramic desalination membranes for harsh industrial wastewater, enabling manufacturers to reclaim and reuse up to 98% of water onsite. Its modular, low-fouling systems integrate into existing facilities, reducing water consumption, energy use, and chemical waste while ensuring regulatory compliance. The company targets industrial clients seeking cost-effective, sustainable alternatives to traditional wastewater treatment, offering both technology sales and a flexible 'wastewater as a service' model.

Zingage is an AI-powered care delivery platform founded in 2023 and based in New York that automates scheduling, staffing, and compliance for home healthcare agencies. It enables reliable patient care at home by streamlining logistics and improving caregiver engagement, reducing turnover and missed visits. Targeting home care providers, Zingage's technology integrates with existing EMRs to support operational efficiency and better patient outcomes in the growing home healthcare market.
Investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, TQ Ventures, South Park Commons, others

Pitch: Arcjet provides a developer-first security platform that integrates AI-powered bot protection and attack detection directly into codebases. It offers solutions like rate limiting and email validation, making security implementation painless for developers. The platform is designed to protect against sophisticated attacks with minimal code changes.
Investors: Plural, Ott Kauver, Andreessen Horowitz, Seedcamp, angel investors

Pitch: Octave Bioscience develops an innovative precision care solution for multiple sclerosis (MS) that provides objective, quantitative measurements to improve clinical decision-making. Their MSDA Test is a simple blood test offering data-driven insights on MS disease activity, targeting patients, physicians, payers, and pharmaceutical companies. The company leverages AI and machine learning to continuously enhance care insights and support better patient outcomes through scientific clarity and precision medicine.

NanoPhoria is a preclinical-stage biotech company developing an innovative, non-viral drug delivery platform based on inorganic nanoparticles for the tissue-directed delivery of therapeutic peptides and RNAs. Its lead product, an inhalable nano-in-micro formulation, targets heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), offering a novel approach for cardiovascular treatment. The company's technology enables versatile, biomimetic nano-carriers that can be formulated for inhalation or other routes, addressing a major unmet need in chronic cardiovascular disease.

Finarkein Analytics provides AI-driven data products and plug-and-play APIs for India's Digital Public Infrastructure, enabling businesses in banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI) to build data-driven solutions for customer onboarding, underwriting, and risk management. Their platform aggregates consented financial data securely, helping clients maximize loan collections, minimize underwriting risk, and streamline insurance processes with real-time insights. The company stands out by offering compliant, scalable infrastructure for financial innovation within India's regulated digital ecosystems.

Glue is developing a smarter work communication platform that reduces noise and integrates AI directly into team chat to enhance productivity. Targeting knowledge workers and teams, it aims to rethink traditional work chat by making communication more structured and outcome-focused. The company operates from San Francisco and emphasizes a sustainable, flexible work culture.
Investors: Abstract Ventures, Chapter One, Hack VC, Goldcrest Capital, Craft Ventures

Pitch: Soufflé Therapeutics develops targeted nucleic acid medicines, leveraging proprietary technologies to identify cell-specific receptors and optimize ligands for precise delivery of siRNA therapies. The company aims to treat a broad range of diseases by modulating gene and protein levels within specific cell types, offering potentially safer and more durable treatments. Soufflé collaborates with major pharmaceutical partners to advance its pipeline, focusing on conditions such as autoimmune and cardiac diseases.
Investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, Arch Venture Partners, Vida Ventures, Polaris Partners

Pitch: Jupiter Endovascular is a medical technology startup based in Menlo Park, California, developing a new class of endovascular procedures using its proprietary Endoportal Control and Transforming Fixation (TFX) technologies. The company focuses on improving catheter-based interventions for complex cardiovascular diseases, particularly pulmonary embolism, by providing surgical-like precision and stability in minimally invasive procedures. Jupiter Endovascular is advancing pivotal clinical trials and preparing for commercialization of its Vertex Pulmonary Embolectomy System. Its technology addresses significant unmet clinical needs by enabling precise and controlled treatment delivery in challenging vascular anatomies.
Investors: Sonder Capital, Senvest Management, LB Investment

Pitch: Quilter develops the first fully autonomous, physics-driven AI engine for printed circuit board (PCB) layout, drastically reducing design time from weeks to minutes. Their technology applies reinforcement learning grounded in physics principles to generate fabrication-ready PCB designs from schematics without human intervention. Quilter targets R&D teams in aerospace, defense, and consumer electronics, enabling faster innovation cycles by eliminating manual PCB layout bottlenecks. Their solution integrates with existing CAD tools and supports complex design constraints, accelerating hardware development and testing.
Investors: Index Ventures, Benchmark, Coatue, Root Ventures

Pitch: Northbeam is a marketing intelligence platform that provides transparent, accurate attribution and performance data for digital ad campaigns, helping e-commerce brands and marketers optimize spend across multiple channels. Its unique deterministic view-through model connects ad views and in-app clicks with first-party transaction data, enabling clients to measure the true revenue impact of brand campaigns. Northbeam targets growth-focused marketers seeking to scale profitably in a fragmented, privacy-centric advertising landscape.

Realm.Security offers an AI-native security data pipeline platform that empowers security teams to filter, normalize, and route logs across diverse sources and destinations, reducing SIEM costs and vendor lock-in. The platform automates sensitive data detection, masking, and compliance reporting, targeting enterprises and organizations seeking centralized visibility and control over their security telemetry. Realm stands out for its simplicity, turn-key deployment, and focus on reducing operational overhead for resource-constrained security teams.

TransCrypts is a blockchain-powered platform that automates and secures the issuance, verification, and sharing of employment, income, health, and educational records. It enables individuals to control and share their credentials directly with employers, lenders, and other third parties without relying on intermediaries. The company stands out by offering HIPAA-certified solutions for medical data and has issued over 200,000 documents to date, targeting both organizations and individual users seeking efficient, tamper-proof verification.
Investors: Pantera Capital, Lightspeed, Alpha Edison, Motley Fool Ventures, California Innovation Fund, Tomer London

Pitch: The Invigilator is a South African edtech startup founded in 2020 that provides AI-powered remote exam monitoring and anti-cheating software. Using students' smartphones, it monitors exam activity with AI to flag suspicious behavior and detect AI-generated assignments. The platform operates effectively in low-bandwidth environments and serves over 100 educational institutions globally. With $11 million in funding, it aims to expand internationally and enhance continuous AI assessment monitoring.

Appy Pie is an AI-powered no-code platform that enables users to easily create mobile apps and websites without coding. It offers tools like an AI app generator and website builder with automation to streamline design and deployment. Targeting businesses and individuals, it provides a comprehensive suite of solutions for app and website creation, emphasizing ease of use and advanced AI technology.

OraLiva develops noninvasive, AI-powered diagnostic tests for early detection of oral cancer and dysplasia using a proprietary brush biopsy platform. Their technology delivers rapid, clinically validated results at the point of care, enabling dental providers to detect cancer earlier and improve patient outcomes. Starting with oral cancer, OraLiva aims to expand its AI cytology platform to detect cancers in multiple organ systems, combining biosensing with machine learning for precision medicine.
Investors: Preetpal Sidhu, DCVC, RTP Angel Fund, NYU Innovation Venture Fund

Pitch: Increase Alpha is a fintech company that has developed a proprietary AI predictive signal engine for institutional investors, particularly hedge funds. The engine provides ready-to-use trading signals that have demonstrated a 70% accuracy rate on hundreds of equities, significantly surpassing typical hedge fund benchmarks. It is designed to integrate seamlessly into existing investment strategies without requiring internal data cleansing or signal processing. The company aims to redefine how AI is applied in finance.

Appy.AI turns expertise and insights into real business solutions by leveraging AI to create sophisticated agents. It allows users to create, refine, launch, and sell AI-based solutions, focusing on delivering a complete user experience. The company is backed by top-tier investors and aims to empower businesses through AI-driven tools.

Nava Benefits is a modern benefits brokerage that aims to bring high-quality, affordable healthcare to Americans. It combines AI-powered tools, year-round employee advocacy, and ongoing measurement to deliver high-performing benefits plans. Nava's platform simplifies benefits administration for HR teams, providing real-time insights and support. It acts as an extension of clients' benefits teams, offering innovative solutions and excellent customer service.

Arthrosi Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing AR882, a next-generation URAT1 inhibitor designed to lower uric acid and reduce gout flares and tophi with a superior safety profile. Founded in 2018 and based in San Diego, it targets patients with gout, including those with renal impairment, aiming to offer a best-in-class therapeutic alternative. The company has completed multiple Phase 1 and 2 trials and is advancing two Phase 3 pivotal studies with strong investor backing.

Constant Contact is a digital marketing company that provides tools and services to help small businesses and nonprofits succeed online. It offers solutions such as web hosting, domains, eCommerce, marketing, and mobile business tools. The company focuses on empowering small businesses with effective online marketing strategies and tools. Its services are designed to help businesses grow through multi-channel marketing options.

Jiko is a fintech company that offers a digital treasury platform built 100% on U.S. Treasury bills, enabling individuals and businesses to hold cash securely while earning yield. Its flagship product, Jiko Pockets, combines bank and brokerage accounts for direct T-bill ownership with on-demand payment capabilities. Targeting corporate and individual clients, Jiko provides a secure, liquid alternative to traditional banking by leveraging government-backed securities and 24/7 transaction processing.

ClickHouse is a technology company specializing in data management solutions, focusing on real-time analytics and columnar databases. It offers innovative tools for efficient data processing and analysis, catering to businesses seeking scalable data solutions. ClickHouse provides both open-source and cloud-based offerings, making it a leader in the data analytics sector.

Celaid Therapeutics develops novel cell therapies using hematopoietic stem cells to treat leukemia, blood cancers, genetic disorders, and severe pediatric non-malignant diseases. Their unique technology enables selective expansion of functional hematopoietic stem cells using chemically defined agents, supporting transplantation and ex-vivo gene therapies. The company collaborates with academic institutions and is advancing clinical-grade manufacturing processes to enable global biotech and pharmaceutical companies to address challenges in cell and gene therapy production.

Takenos is a fintech startup from Argentina offering a dollar-denominated digital wallet designed for freelancers and remote workers in Latin America to receive, manage, and withdraw international earnings seamlessly. It supports payments from platforms like Payoneer, PayPal, and UpWork, and enables withdrawals in local currency, stablecoins, and crypto. The platform addresses financial challenges unique to the digital workforce by providing low-cost, borderless access to funds and plans to expand across Latin America with features like a global payment card and interest-earning accounts.

Grupalia is a fintech company that provides digital group loans for micro-entrepreneurs in Latin America. It offers a fast, secure, and inclusive lending experience by rebuilding the traditional group loan process. Grupalia aims to become Mexico's first neobank for micro-businesses, focusing on underserved SMEs. Its platform helps small business owners manage payments and finances more efficiently.

David AI is the world's first audio data research lab, focused on building high-quality, diverse audio datasets that power audio AI models. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in San Francisco, it serves leading AI labs by addressing complex challenges in speech and audio data for real-world AI applications. The company uniquely combines research-driven rigor with data collection to improve model training and evaluation, enabling advancements in humanoid robots, wearables, and personal assistants.

Relace develops specialized AI infrastructure for autonomous coding agents to efficiently store, search, and modify production codebases. Their platform offers a Git-compatible repository service optimized for AI agents, featuring fast code retrieval, instant code merging, and task-specific agents accessible via API. Targeting startups and tech teams, Relace enhances the speed, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness of AI-powered software development workflows.

Contrails AI develops a multimodal AI engine that detects and mitigates risks from AI-generated content—including deepfakes, misinformation, and fraud—across video, image, audio, and text. The platform enables real-time threat identification for enterprises in media, finance, and digital marketplaces, aiming to rebuild trust and safety online. Its technology combines forensic analysis with scalable automation, targeting global platforms and regulators seeking robust, explainable content governance.

Walko Food Company is an Indian food & beverage company specializing in manufacturing and selling premium dessert brands such as Café Chokolade, Grameen Kulfi, and Cream Pot. Headquartered in Mumbai, it operates in the frozen foods and quick-service restaurant sectors, targeting consumers seeking high-quality desserts. The company is distinguished by its focus on uncompromising quality and customer experience, supported by significant recent funding to expand its market presence.

Eternz Fashion Private Limited is an Indian e-commerce platform headquartered in Karnataka, specializing in selling a wide range of fashion jewelry and accessories including gold, silver, and fashion pieces. Launched in 2023, Eternz offers curated collections from various brands, catering to diverse styles and occasions with a focus on quality and affordability. The platform targets fashion-conscious consumers seeking trendy and sophisticated jewelry and accessories online. Its marketplace model provides unique, handcrafted, and branded products, making it a comprehensive destination for jewelry and fashion accessories.
Investors: Multiply Venture Partners, Kae Capital, Gemba Capital, IIMA Ventures, TDV Partners, Twin & Bull, Raghunandh

Pitch: Hala Mobility is India's first multi-modal vehicle sharing platform, offering electric scooters for urban commuters. Users can book scooters through a mobile app on a pay-per-minute basis, providing a cost-effective and eco-friendly alternative to traditional vehicles. The service includes features like GPS tracking and 24/7 availability, making it a reliable option for daily commutes.

Fastest.Health is an on-demand diagnostics platform in India offering 15-minute doorstep sample collection and 90-minute report delivery for most routine tests, primarily in Mumbai. Its proprietary app connects users to NABL-accredited labs, targeting consumers seeking speed, convenience, and reliability in diagnostic services. The company aims to build India’s first quick-commerce diagnostics network, emphasizing rapid turnaround without compromising quality.

EP Wealth Advisors is a fee-only, planning-first registered investment advisory firm offering comprehensive wealth management, financial planning, tax, and estate planning services. The firm serves over 15,000 clients nationwide, focusing on personalized advice and fiduciary standards. Its value lies in a client-first culture, a broad national presence, and recognition for growth and workplace excellence.

Sensi.AI is the world's first in-home 24/7 virtual care agent using audio AI technology, designed to empower long-term care providers by delivering continuous, data-driven insights into seniors' physical, emotional, and cognitive needs. Their solution uses a plug-and-play device to capture and analyze audio data for proactive care, reducing hospitalizations and caregiver turnover while enhancing client satisfaction. Targeting home care businesses and senior care providers, Sensi.AI offers a unique combination of privacy, accuracy, and operational efficiency to improve aging-in-place outcomes.

Sabika is a Cairo-based fintech startup founded in 2022 that provides a secure, transparent, and Sharia-compliant digital platform for investing in gold and silver. It enables individuals and businesses to buy, sell, and store 24K gold bars and fractions, offering an accessible and ethical asset-backed savings solution. The platform leverages smart tools, real-time pricing, and a scalable infrastructure to ensure a seamless investment experience. Sabika targets users seeking a trustworthy, convenient way to protect and grow wealth with precious metals in Egypt and the Gulf region.

Azuro is a Swiss proptech startup offering a new model for property ownership and travel through co-ownership of compact, design-led homes intended for year-round use. It replaces the traditional holiday rental model by providing access to prime properties in Europe's most coveted locations. Azuro targets travelers and property owners looking for flexible, shared ownership experiences. The company recently raised €5 million to expand this innovative property ownership model.

CBRX is a Lithuanian cybersecurity company that enables traditional IT service providers (MSPs) to quickly become managed security service providers (MSSPs) using its AI-powered cloud platform. The platform automates incident management, threat monitoring, analysis, and customer support, allowing MSPs to offer 24/7 cybersecurity services without upfront costs or complex infrastructure. CBRX targets MSPs across Europe, helping them add high-margin cybersecurity services under their own brand, accelerating their market transition and reducing response times.
Investors: Coinvest Capital, Scalewolf, Plug and Play Tech Centre, Firstpick

Pitch: Diffusely, formerly Meero, is a French AI media enhancement company founded in 2016 that develops tailored AI-powered solutions for specific verticals such as fashion, automotive, and real estate. Their products, including CarCutter and AutoRetouch, enable businesses to create authentic, high-quality visuals at scale, accelerating time-to-market and reducing costs. Diffusely targets enterprises seeking to boost engagement and conversion through scalable, professional imagery enhanced by AI models. It stands out by combining cutting-edge AI with human expertise to deliver high standards in visual content creation.

DevAlly is an Irish SaaS company that helps businesses integrate accessibility into their digital products. It offers an AI-powered platform that simplifies accessibility compliance by auditing and fixing issues within minutes. DevAlly supports large enterprises and scale-ups in meeting global accessibility standards, enabling them to create more inclusive digital experiences and avoid legal risks associated with non-compliance.
Investors: Miles Ahead Capital, NDRC, Enterprise Ireland, European angel investors

Pitch: Mentium develops advanced AI co-processors for mission-critical applications, delivering cloud-quality inference at ultra-low power for edge devices. Their AIM technology enables high-speed, efficient AI without external memory, targeting smart security, robotics, and space sectors. The company stands out for its hybrid in-memory and digital computation, offering a bolt-on solution that enhances existing systems with dependable, high-performance AI.

Base Power is a Texas-based energy company deploying distributed, software-connected home batteries to provide reliable backup power and stabilize the electric grid. Their service offers affordable, renewable energy with below-market electricity rates and automatic battery backup during outages, without requiring solar panel installation. By creating a distributed energy storage network, Base improves grid reliability and reduces costs for residential customers. They focus on modernizing the power grid through technology-driven, scalable energy storage solutions.
Investors: Addition, Trust Ventures, Valor Equity Partners

Pitch: Block, Inc. (formerly Square, Inc.) is a leading American fintech company founded in 2009 that provides comprehensive financial services and technology solutions. Its flagship product, Square, is a point-of-sale system enabling merchants to accept card payments and manage business operations. The company also offers Cash App, a digital wallet for peer-to-peer payments and investments, and owns other businesses including Afterpay (buy now pay later), Bitkey (bitcoin wallet), and Proto (bitcoin mining). Block focuses on increasing access to the global economy through innovative payment and financial tools for consumers and merchants.

BiMA is a Munich-based startup developing a mindful entertainment platform for children, featuring a screen-free projector that transforms bedrooms into immersive, story-driven environments. Founded in 2024, it aims to inspire imagination, creativity, and foster family connection by offering an alternative to conventional screen-based media. The company targets families with young children and positions itself at the intersection of edutainment, well-being, and consumer technology. Its recent €500,000 pre-seed funding will support market launch, production, and content development.

Sitehop is a UK-based cybersecurity company specializing in FPGA-powered, quantum-ready hardware encryption solutions designed to secure data in motion with ultra-low latency and high throughput. Its flagship product, the SAFEblade 1100, offers sub-900 nanoseconds latency and supports over 4,000 secure tunnels, targeting sectors including telecom, cloud, finance, government, and critical infrastructure. Sitehop's hardware-first approach provides quantum-resilient, energy-efficient encryption that outperforms software-only alternatives, enabling enterprises to protect sensitive communications without compromising speed or scalability.

Neuronoff develops the Injectrode platform, an innovative minimally invasive neuromodulation medical device designed to treat chronic pain without surgery or drugs. Their injectable electrode is delivered via an 18-gauge needle, eliminating surgical incisions and scars common in traditional neurostimulation therapies. The company targets interventional pain physicians, spinal surgeons, and other specialists, aiming for FDA clearance and a commercial launch in the U.S. in 2026. Neuronoff's technology offers a drug-free, aesthetically minimal, and cost-effective alternative to current chronic pain treatments.

BlastPoint is a Pittsburgh-based AI platform company that provides customer intelligence and analytics solutions to businesses across the energy, financial, automotive sectors, and nonprofit organizations. Its AI-driven platform helps companies understand customer behavior and optimize revenue growth without requiring extensive data management expertise. BlastPoint empowers businesses to achieve significant improvements in digital engagement and customer targeting. It supports strategic objectives by delivering actionable insights directly to business users.

Splash Sports is a leading sports gaming platform that allows users to compete in peer-to-peer contests for real money. It offers a mobile app for users to participate in various competitions, focusing on fantasy sports and skill-based games. The company includes platforms like RunYourPool and OfficeFootballPool, catering to a large user base across the U.S. and Canada. Its commitment to responsible gaming practices sets it apart in the industry.

Mindset Medical develops a virtual health platform that enables secure, device-free remote patient monitoring and telemedicine visits using only a smartphone or tablet camera. Its software transforms standard devices into contactless vital sign measurement tools, targeting clinics, hospitals, and integrated delivery networks. The platform integrates patient-reported data with clinically validated physiological measurements, enhancing the quality and convenience of remote care.

Coinflow is a fintech company providing web3 payment infrastructure that bridges traditional banking and blockchain technology. It enables businesses, especially in gaming, NFT projects, and digital wallets, to accept traditional payments like credit cards and instantly settle them into stablecoins, improving cash flow. Coinflow also offers instant fund disbursement to bank accounts via real-time payment rails. The platform supports payment acceptance in over 170 countries and focuses on seamless fiat-to-crypto and crypto off-ramp solutions.
Investors: Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures

Pitch: Everyset provides a fully integrated payroll and background performer management platform specifically for the film and TV industry. Their SAG-AFTRA-approved solution centralizes and automates payroll processes for background actors, including timecards, approvals, and payments, reducing errors and compliance risks. Trusted by major studios, Everyset's platform streamlines complex union payroll workflows, cutting costs and saving time for production companies and accountants. Their recent $9M funding supports the expansion of their Background Payroll product, enhancing on-demand payroll precision and operational efficiency on set.

Asterix Foods develops high-value, animal-free proteins—including dairy and egg proteins—using scalable plant cell suspension cultures in bioreactors, offering a cost-effective alternative to traditional precision fermentation. The company targets food and biotech industries seeking functional, bioactive, and affordable protein ingredients. Its unique technology enables rapid deployment and flexibility, with a focus on sustainability and drop-in replacement for animal-derived products.
Investors: CPT Capital, Grok Ventures, ReGen Ventures, SOSV

Pitch: Routefusion provides a global banking-as-a-service API that enables fintechs, marketplaces, and platforms to offer cross-border payments, local currency accounts, and access to global payment networks in 180+ countries. Its platform simplifies international payment infrastructure with built-in compliance, multi-rail payment routing, and fast integration, targeting businesses that need scalable and customizable global payment solutions. Routefusion distinguishes itself with volume-based pricing, broad local pay-in and payout capabilities, and a developer-friendly approach designed for fast expansion across markets.

Kneu Health is a University of Oxford spinout that develops AI-powered digital health solutions for neurology, focusing on Parkinson's and dementia. It uses a smartphone app and clinician dashboard to provide proactive, community-based care, reducing hospital admissions and improving patient outcomes. The platform is backed by over a decade of research and has been validated across major health systems.

Onos Health is a healthcare AI company based in San Francisco that provides a HIPAA-compliant platform designed specifically for behavioral health programs. Their AI and machine learning models analyze clinical and claims data to reduce waste, detect fraud, and improve care quality for health plans and payers. The platform synthesizes scattered data to guide clinical pathways and optimize behavioral health outcomes. Founded in 2024, Onos Health aims to streamline operations and enhance efficiency in behavioral health management.

QuoteWell is a tech-driven wholesale insurance brokerage headquartered in Austin, Texas, specializing in access to excess and surplus (E&S) markets and non-admitted carriers. It combines human expertise with proprietary AI-powered technology, branded as Human+, to help insurance brokers and agents place complex, hard-to-place risks faster and more efficiently. The company targets insurance producers and brokers seeking advanced coverage options, faster quotes, and personalized support to grow their books and strengthen client relationships. QuoteWell's platform leverages AI-driven automation and tech-enabled workflows to modernize and streamline wholesale insurance brokerage processes.

HiOctave provides an AI-powered go-to-market platform that automates lead research, account qualification, and personalized messaging in real time. It targets B2B sales, marketing, and product marketing teams to enhance precision and scalability in customer engagement. The platform integrates with CRMs and orchestration tools, enabling teams to rapidly adapt messaging to market changes and optimize outbound sales efforts.

Nexl offers an all-in-one collaboration platform tailored for law firms, combining CRM, relationship intelligence, email marketing, and project management to enhance client experience and business growth. The platform automates relationship management and provides unique insights into firm activities to identify growth opportunities. Nexl is SOC2-compliant with strong security standards, supporting law firms globally while meeting strict IT and privacy requirements.

Veritas Prime specializes in Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions, particularly leveraging SAP SuccessFactors for cloud-based HR, talent management, and payroll services. The company supports businesses globally by streamlining HR processes and enhancing employee experiences. Its expertise in SAP SuccessFactors implementation and ongoing support makes it a valuable partner for organizations seeking to transform their HR operations.

ImmunoVec develops in vivo gene and cell therapies that precisely engineer targeted immune cells to treat serious autoimmune and genetic diseases. Its proprietary platform uses DNA-loaded polymeric nanoparticles to reprogram cells directly inside the patient, offering faster, more scalable, and potentially curative alternatives to traditional ex vivo therapies. The company collaborates with leading U.S. research institutions and targets life-threatening conditions with limited treatment options.
Investors: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H)

Pitch: Yendo is a fintech company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, specializing in vehicle-secured credit cards and auto refi credit products. It leverages proprietary machine learning and AI for customer onboarding to offer prime credit products by unlocking asset equity, targeting consumers seeking affordable credit alternatives to high-interest personal loans. With over $189 million raised, including $150 million in recent debt financing, Yendo aims to expand its offerings nationwide and has saved customers over $150 million in interest and fees compared to previous credit options.

RealSense is an independent AI-powered computer vision company spun out from Intel in 2025. It specializes in depth cameras and vision technology for robotics, biometrics, industrial automation, and access control. The company targets humanoid and autonomous mobile robots, providing intelligent perception systems to enable safe integration of AI and robotics into everyday life. RealSense recently raised $50 million in Series A funding to accelerate growth and innovation in physical AI and robotics markets.

Stoke Space Technologies develops fully and rapidly reusable rockets, notably the Nova launch vehicle, designed to provide affordable, high-frequency access to orbit and support missions including satellite deployment and in-space mobility. Their innovative technology includes a unique reusable second stage with a hydrolox engine and regeneratively cooled heat shield, enabling aircraft-like launch cadence and cost reduction. Headquartered in Kent, Washington, they operate vertically integrated design, manufacturing, and test facilities and have secured significant funding and U.S. Space Force contracts reflecting their strategic importance.

Enurgen develops advanced energy yield performance software for utility-scale solar assets, covering planning, design, and lifetime management. Its flagship DUET platform uses physics-based, 3D modeling to optimize bifacial solar systems and provides real-time benchmarking and monitoring. The company targets solar developers, engineers, independent power producers, and asset managers, differentiating with highly accurate, end-to-end digital twin continuity for solar projects.

Anthea is a Bermuda-based fintech company specializing in life insurance products denominated in cryptocurrencies, notably launching the world's first Ethereum-denominated life insurance policy. Operating under the Bermuda Monetary Authority's Innovative Insurer regime, it integrates blockchain payment infrastructure and targets both digital asset holders and traditional investors seeking regulated exposure to crypto assets. The company recently raised $22 million in Series A funding to accelerate product development, expand market presence in Asia, and innovate in the intersection of digital assets and life insurance.

High Temperature Material Systems (HTMS) develops advanced Ceramic Matrix Composites (CMCs) that combine the heat resistance of ceramics with the strength and flexibility of embedded fibers, capable of withstanding temperatures up to 1400°C. Their proprietary matrix chemistries and fiber integration techniques reduce production time, energy, and costs compared to conventional methods. HTMS targets aerospace, automotive, and energy sectors with products like ThermaLite and IgniShield for heat shields and fire-resistant components. Founded in 2021 in the UK, HTMS operates labs and production facilities collaborating with manufacturers and research institutions to scale its innovative materials.

Asterix Foods develops animal-free, bioactive proteins using plant cell culture technology, targeting the food ingredients market. Their platform aims to produce functional, affordable, and scalable protein alternatives that can serve as direct replacements in existing food products. The company focuses on overcoming the cost and scalability challenges of precision fermentation, offering a resource-efficient, sustainable solution for global food production.

Expedition Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing novel therapies targeting neutrophilic inflammation for serious respiratory and inflammatory diseases, primarily chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Their lead candidate, EXPD-101, is a first-in-class oral DPP1 inhibitor designed to block enzymes causing airway damage and disease progression. The company in-licenses assets from China and focuses on global development and commercialization outside mainland China, aiming to address unmet medical needs in neutrophil-driven diseases with innovative, disease-controlling treatments.
Investors: Sofinnova Investments, Novo Holdings, BVF Partners

Pitch: Arthrosi Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing AR882, a next-generation URAT1 inhibitor designed to reduce uric acid levels, prevent gout flares, and dissolve tophi. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Diego, the company focuses on creating a best-in-class gout therapy with superior safety and efficacy profiles, targeting patients with chronic gout and renal impairment. Arthrosi is advancing two pivotal Phase 3 clinical trials to bring this novel treatment to market, addressing a significant unmet need in gout management.
Investors: Prime Eight Capital, CR Biotech, HighLight Capital, HM Venture Partners, ReliantTech

Pitch: DUOS is a healthcare technology company founded in 2020 that uses an AI-powered platform to connect Medicare beneficiaries and their caregivers with personalized resources and community services. It focuses on improving health outcomes and plan performance by addressing social determinants of health and enhancing care navigation. DUOS uniquely combines technology with human relationships to support older adults' independence and well-being. Its platform helps health plans and providers engage members, close care gaps, and improve satisfaction at scale.

Nilo Therapeutics is a biotech company focused on harnessing neural circuits to restore immune homeostasis in diseases. It builds on pioneering research from the Charles Zuker lab at Columbia University to develop drugs targeting messenger molecules and neural circuits involved in inflammation. The company aims to treat autoimmune and inflammatory diseases such as toxic shock and rheumatoid arthritis.
Investors: The Column Group, DCVC Bio, Lux Capital, Gates Foundation, Alexandria Venture Investments

Pitch: Spellbook is a Canadian legal technology company offering a generative AI contract drafting and review tool powered by GPT-4 and other large language models. It integrates directly with Microsoft Word to help lawyers draft, review, and revise contracts faster and more accurately by suggesting terms and identifying risks.
