The platform helps teams standardize content, distribute presentations instantly, and enhance team communication skills. Prezent serves large enterprises across various sectors, including technology and biotech.

Glide Identity provides an advanced authentication platform designed for the AI era, using SIM-based cryptographic verification to prevent account takeover and AI-powered fraud. Its solutions eliminate traditional OTP vulnerabilities by enabling seamless, phishing-proof user authentication through mobile carrier networks. Targeting enterprises across multiple industries, Glide Identity enhances security while delivering a frictionless user experience, addressing the rising threats of AI-driven attacks and digital fraud.
Investors: Crosspoint Capital Partners, Amigos Venture Capital, Singtel Innov8 Ventures, Sir Ronald Cohen

Pitch: Planera is a U.S.-based construction technology company founded in 2021 that provides a visual, collaborative scheduling software platform designed specifically for commercial construction projects. Its software enables construction teams to create, manage, and update resource and cost-loaded Critical Path Method (CPM) schedules with ease, improving planning efficiency and project outcomes. Planera’s intuitive interface replaces legacy tools like P6 and Excel, offering real-time collaboration between office and field teams, enhanced risk management, and seamless integration of master and field schedules. The company targets general contractors and specialty subcontractors, aiming to democratize construction planning and improve worker safety.

Unfabled is a UK-based FemTech company offering sustainable, non-toxic health and wellness products tailored to women's hormonal, menstrual, and sexual health needs. Their curated platform provides personalized self-care solutions targeting eco-conscious consumers. The company emphasizes accessibility, clinical trust, and supports female-founded brands, delivering products with free UK shipping over £30. Founded in 2021, Unfabled combines expert curation with an engaging quiz to help clients find suitable products.

ClaimSorted is a technology-driven third-party administrator (TPA) that automates and streamlines insurance claims processing for commercial and personal lines, using AI and human adjusters. Its platform handles document verification, fraud detection, and customer communication, delivering faster payouts and improved policyholder satisfaction. The company partners with insurers, MGAs, and other insurance entities across the US, UK, and EU, offering a modern alternative to traditional claims outsourcing with measurable cost savings and higher NPS.
Investors: Atomico, Eurazeo, Y Combinator, firstminute capital, Start Ventures Capital

Pitch: Quivo is a logistics company specializing in scalable e-commerce fulfillment solutions. It integrates with over 40 shop systems and ERP platforms, offering real-time inventory tracking, automated warehouse management, and personalized packaging services. Targeting fast-growing e-commerce brands, Quivo enables seamless order processing, returns management, and international expansion through its network of warehouses in Europe and the US. Its unique value lies in flexible integration, comprehensive logistics support, and a user-friendly fulfillment platform.

Navan provides an integrated SaaS platform combining corporate travel booking, expense management, and virtual corporate payment cards. It serves large enterprises globally, offering AI-powered automation, advanced analytics, and a global travel inventory with multi-GDS integration. Navan differentiates itself with a dual-system travel model, white-glove travel management, and innovative card-link technology, supporting clients like Unilever, Zoom, and Heineken.

Ecorobotix develops AI-powered ultra-high precision field sprayers that reduce chemical use by up to 95% by targeting only weeds, not crops. Its flagship ARA sprayer is used by large-scale farmers in Europe and beyond, helping them cut costs, improve yields, and meet sustainability goals. The company stands out for its plant-by-plant recognition technology and commitment to eco-friendly, resource-efficient farming.

Gladys is a UK-based AI-powered home care technology platform that matches care seekers with vetted local carers and companions. It uses AI back-office agents and scheduling tools to simplify finding, booking, and managing care, aiming to improve outcomes for families and carers. The platform supports carers with better pay and career development while addressing the broken social care system. Following a £1.5 million seed funding round led by Cornerstone VC, Gladys plans to expand nationwide and deliver hundreds of thousands of hours of care by 2026.
Investors: Cornerstone VC, Exceptional Ventures, Embryo Ventures, Ufi Ventures, Houghton Street Ven...

Pitch: Jack Fertility offers discreet, mail-in sperm testing kits for men, making fertility testing convenient and private. The company focuses on empowering individuals with actionable, science-based insights to improve sperm health, aiming to reduce the stigma and inconvenience of clinic-based testing. Jack Fertility targets proactive individuals and couples, providing easy-to-understand results and personalized recommendations.

Meta-Flux develops an AI-powered platform that models disease biology using genetic, proteomic, and metabolic data to accelerate and de-risk preclinical drug development. Its 'AI biologist' integrates trillions of data points to help pharmaceutical teams identify viable drug targets, validate mechanisms, and make faster go/no-go decisions before costly clinical trials. The company targets biotech and pharma partners seeking to reduce discovery timelines and improve the accuracy of early-stage drug development.

PartSpace is an industrial AI company that uses AI to optimize the procurement of drawing-based components. Its software, PartSpace AI, analyzes technical drawings to identify potential savings and streamline procurement processes. Targeting manufacturing companies and procurement departments, it aims to reduce costs and enhance efficiency in technical purchasing.

Honoré Gaming is a technology company that offers a comprehensive betting platform for regulated operators. It provides a multi-channel solution supporting sports betting, lottery, horse racing, and casino games from a single point of sale. The company focuses on delivering innovative solutions for both online and land-based operators, emphasizing flexibility and integration.

Diffusely is an AI media enhancement company that develops tailored products for specific industries like automotive, fashion, and real estate. It uses AI models to elevate visual assets at scale, enhancing engagement and conversion for businesses. Solutions include CarCutter for automotive and AutoRetouch for fashion. The company aims to democratize high-quality digital imagery creation.

Kenko provides tailored corporate health insurance solutions, offering a customizable and digital platform for employee health coverage. The company focuses on adapting insurance to individual needs, reducing administrative burdens, and enhancing employee well-being through additional health services.

Purenat develops biomimetic, self-cleaning filter media that destroy air pollutants—including VOCs, odors, bacteria, and viruses—at the molecular level, offering a sustainable alternative to traditional activated carbon. Their customizable solutions are designed for integration into industrial, building, automotive, and aerospace systems, targeting clients seeking high-efficiency, low-maintenance, and eco-friendly air treatment. The company stands out for its long filter lifespan (up to 5 years), low energy consumption, and significant reduction in operational and waste costs.

REasy is a fintech platform headquartered in France that simplifies cross-border payments and trade for African SMEs, focusing initially on the CEMAC-China trade corridor. It offers fast, secure payment processing in multiple currencies and integrates shipping and logistics solutions to streamline international trade. Regulated by the Central Bank BEAC, REasy provides transparent, compliant financial services that address high transaction costs and delays faced by African importers. The platform targets small and medium-sized importers by enabling seamless payments to global suppliers through trusted channels.

Extensee is a French drone service provider specializing in implementing drone solutions for civil, industrial, and governmental missions. Founded in 2018 by experienced partners in operations and aircraft maintenance, it offers a full range of UAV support services including airworthiness management, maintenance, logistics, expert provision, spare parts supply, and pilot training. The company serves civilian, government, and military clients in France and internationally, focusing on complex flight scenarios with heavy UAVs while maintaining high standards of quality and safety.

Cellura is a French biotech company pioneering low-shear bioreactor technology for the scalable production of sensitive cells, including stem cells and organoids. This technology supports advancements in cell therapy, cultivated meat, and sustainable biotechnology. By minimizing shear stress, Cellura enables optimal cell growth and viability, making it a valuable solution for healthcare and agri-food industries.

Chalkie AI Ltd. provides an AI-powered lesson planning platform that enables teachers to create high-quality, customizable lessons, activities, and worksheets quickly across any topic or education level. Designed to save educators time, it generates engaging classroom-ready materials including quizzes and slides, supporting over 40 languages and adhering to strict data privacy standards. Chalkie targets schools and teachers worldwide, offering a secure, scalable solution that enhances lesson preparation efficiency.

Nexcade AI provides an AI automation platform for freight forwarders, helping them automate pricing, quoting, and rate procurement. Its AI agents extract unstructured data from emails and conversations, converting it into structured workflows to improve rate management and win rates. By automating complex workflows, Nexcade enables freight forwarders to operate faster and more profitably. The company focuses on addressing exceptions in logistics workflows.
Investors: Connect Ventures, MMC Ventures, Entropy Industrial Capital, Inovia, Charlie Songhurst, Keith Wallington

Pitch: Dragonfly Technology offers an AI-powered enterprise platform that helps organizations build, manage, and evolve their technology stacks by providing instant access to a comprehensive catalogue of over 250,000 software tools. Their solution enables faster, data-driven decisions about software selection, targeting professionals and enterprise leaders seeking to optimize their tech infrastructure. Founded by experienced engineering and data leaders, Dragonfly bridges the gap of reliable, up-to-date guidance in tech decision-making, making expert knowledge accessible to all users.
Investors: Episode 1, Dreamcraft, Portfolio Ventures, Sam Bourton, Markus Villig

Pitch: SY4 Security (Talion) delivers managed detection and response, 24/7 SOC services, and threat intelligence for organizations seeking to strengthen cyber defenses. The company offers both co-managed and fully managed solutions, integrating with clients’ existing security teams. Talion is known for transparency, platform-agnostic services, and supporting clients from critical infrastructure to global finance.
Investors: NPIF - Mercia Equity Finance, Crown Fund S.C.A. SICAV-RAIF

Pitch: Bold provides digital payment solutions, including POS terminals, payment links, and digital business accounts, enabling Colombian entrepreneurs and small businesses to accept a wide variety of payment methods securely and affordably. The company stands out as a leading independent merchant acquirer, serving over 100,000 merchants with innovative, easy-to-use tools that help businesses grow and reach global customers.
Investors: General Atlantic, Cóndor Inverlink, InQlab, IFC

Pitch: Pagaleve is a Brazilian fintech offering Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solutions that enable consumers to split purchases into interest-free installments, even without a credit card, using Brazil's instant payment system, Pix. The company targets underserved consumers and integrates directly with retailer checkouts, partnering with over 10,000 merchants. Its AI-driven credit engine delivers high approval rates and low delinquency, making credit access simpler, faster, and more inclusive in Brazil.
Investors: OIF Ventures, Sun Hung Kai & Co, Credit Saison, Endeavor Catalyst, others

Pitch: Lemon is an Argentina-based crypto fintech founded in 2019 by Marcelo Cavazzoli. It offers a platform for users in Latin America to buy, sell, and store digital assets, make payments, and use a Visa debit card linked to their crypto holdings. The company aims to simplify access to cryptocurrencies and expand financial inclusion across the region, with over 5 million users and plans to grow to 10 million. Lemon emphasizes transparency through real-time Proof of Reserves and Solvency verification.

Creditú is a Chilean fintech company founded in 2017 that provides innovative mortgage financing solutions to middle- and lower-income families in Chile, Peru, and Brazil. It uses AI and Open Banking technology to deliver fast, automated loan approvals, democratizing access to homeownership for underserved populations, including women household leaders and immigrants. Supported by major investors like the Inter-American Development Bank, Creditú focuses on financial inclusion and social impact through accessible, technology-driven mortgage products.

Pitz is an AI-powered platform designed to modernize automotive repair shops by streamlining operations such as estimating, scheduling, inventory management, and customer service. It aims to reduce wait times and costs for both mechanics and customers. Targeting independent workshops and corporate fleets, Pitz provides a comprehensive management system that can be accessed via mobile devices.

Loto LatAm is a Colombian fintech founded in 2024 that provides an integrated platform for expense and incentive management tailored to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Its solution combines debit and credit cards with accounting software to automate expense reporting, ensure real-time visibility, and reduce fraud risks. The company also offers Visa-powered corporate incentive cards to simplify employee benefits. Loto LatAm aims to improve financial control for SMEs in Latin America, addressing a critical market need with a technology-driven approach.

Agent Shop is a Brazilian SaaS platform that enables brands and retailers to sell directly via WhatsApp with a fully automated conversational commerce experience. It integrates with major e-commerce and ERP platforms, managing product catalogs, carts, payments, and orders through AI-driven automation. The platform targets retailers seeking to leverage AI to enhance customer engagement and streamline sales processes on popular messaging channels. Its unique value lies in combining AI with conversational commerce to enable seamless, personalized shopping experiences without requiring a traditional website.
Investors: Maya Capital, Caravela Capital, Mira Capital

Pitch: Limbix develops prescription digital therapeutics focused on mental health treatments for adolescents. Their flagship product, SparkRx, is available nationwide for licensed healthcare professionals to offer to patients. Limbix combines clinical expertise with technological innovation to create accessible and scalable mental health solutions, integrating their software into telehealth platforms for broader reach.

Mozart is an AI-powered conversational platform from Argentina that automates customer service, collections, sales, and fraud prevention. It uses virtual AI agents with natural language processing and hyperrealistic voices to interact empathetically with customers in their local language. The platform offers real-time analytics, multichannel inbox management, and scalable automation to improve operational efficiency and customer engagement for businesses.

David Protein is a Foodtech company that develops high-protein, low-calorie nutrition products, focusing on enhancing muscle and reducing body fat. Their flagship product is a protein bar with 28 grams of protein and zero sugar, offering the highest protein-to-calorie ratio in the market. David targets individuals seeking nutritious snack options that support fitness and dietary goals. The company aims to revolutionize the taste and macronutrient content of high-protein foods.

Tonbo is an extensible, in-process database designed for analytics-ready object storage with Apache Arrow and Parquet. It enables real-time inserts and queries across browsers, local disks, and object storage, and supports building serverless, data-intensive applications with structured data and high performance.

Falcon Finance builds a universal collateral infrastructure that allows any liquid, custody-ready asset to be used as collateral for issuing onchain liquidity. Its main products include minting USDf, an overcollateralized synthetic dollar, and staking sUSDf, a yield-bearing token offering institutional-grade trading strategies. Targeting traders, investors, crypto projects, and exchanges, Falcon Finance uniquely bridges onchain and offchain financial systems to unlock stable and yield-generating liquidity from existing assets.

Kapnative offers an AI-powered platform that streamlines due diligence and access to pre-vetted private market funds for wealth managers, family offices, banks, and institutional investors. Its automated workflows reduce manual review time by up to 80%, provide regulatory-compliant investment processes, and enable efficient, white-label solutions for high-net-worth allocations. Kapnative distinguishes itself with a strong in-house investment committee, institutional-grade product selection, and a focus on the German-speaking European market.

Cryptomesh is a DeFi staking platform that supports multi-chain compatibility across over 10 major blockchain networks. It enhances the staking experience by allowing users to diversify their portfolios and maximize earning potential. With a focus on security, Cryptomesh offers a robust environment for users to stake their assets. The platform recently raised $2.5 million in funding to expand its operations and innovate its staking features.

Isentroniq is a Paris-based quantum hardware startup developing breakthrough wiring technology to overcome the wiring bottleneck in superconducting quantum computers. Their solution enables integration of 1,000x more qubits in existing dilution refrigerators by addressing heat, cost, and space constraints inside cryostats. The company offers an end-to-end, plug-and-play wiring infrastructure aimed at scaling quantum systems from thousands to millions of qubits, targeting quantum computer builders. Their fabless model leverages specialized manufacturing partners to industrialize their technology and accelerate large-scale quantum computing deployment.
Investors: Heartcore, OVNI Capital, Kima Ventures, iXcore, Better Angle, Epsilon VC, Bpifrance

Pitch: Arbio is a Berlin-based AI-native platform that provides full-stack property management for vacation rentals across Europe. It automates distribution, accounting, operations, guest communications, and dynamic pricing to maximize revenue and reduce operational burdens for property owners. With over 1,000 units under management and rapid growth fueled by substantial Series A funding, Arbio aims to modernize the fragmented vacation rental market by delivering consistent, high-quality guest experiences and seamless owner management through its AI-first operating system.

Afori is an AI platform specifically designed for insurance brokers to automate and streamline back-office administrative tasks starting from the email inbox. By integrating with Outlook, it transforms unstructured communications into structured workflows and delegates partial automations to insurance-specific AI agents, saving brokers significant time. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Barcelona, Spain, Afori aims to increase efficiency and allow brokers to focus more on client advisory. It recently closed a €4 million pre-seed funding round led by General Catalyst to accelerate product development and expand market adoption.
Investors: General Catalyst, Yellow, Booom, Christopher Lohmann

Pitch: Clove is a London-based wealth management fintech startup focused on closing the financial advice gap by combining human advisers with AI-driven personalized guidance. It offers accessible, affordable, and scalable financial planning and money management services targeting young professionals, entrepreneurs, and mass-affluent individuals. Clove recently raised $14 million in pre-seed funding led by Accel to build its platform ahead of a planned full launch in 2026, subject to FCA authorisation.

SpeakX is an Indian edtech startup founded in 2020 that uses advanced AI to provide personalized English learning for children aged 5-15. Its app offers AI-driven interactive conversations, gamified lessons, and a dedicated AI tutor to help users practice and improve their English speaking skills in real-time. Having pivoted from extracurricular classes to AI-powered language learning, SpeakX has achieved significant scale with over 10 million downloads and aims to revolutionize English education with its proprietary AI technology.
Investors: WestBridge Capital, Goodwater Capital, Elevation Capital, Shyamal Anadkat, Ronnie Screwvala

Pitch: Réia Diamonds is an Indian jeweller specializing in certified lab-grown diamond jewellery, offering engagement rings, everyday wear, and customizable pieces. Targeting modern consumers seeking ethical, transparent, and affordable luxury, the company combines Indian craftsmanship with sustainable innovation. Its unique value lies in a collaborative design process, omnichannel retail, and a franchise-driven expansion model.
Investors: Dinesh Talera and family, Venture Catalysts

Pitch: Fery Rides is India's first women-led and women-centric mobility platform offering safe, reliable, and eco-friendly two-wheeler transportation exclusively for women passengers, operated by trained women drivers. The platform uses electric vehicles to minimize emissions and provides transparent pricing with no surge or cancellations, targeting urban women in Gurgaon with plans to expand. It uniquely combines safety, sustainability, and women empowerment through technology-enabled real-time tracking, SOS alerts, and community-building features.
Investors: IAN Angel Fund, Hari Balasubramanian, Uday Chatterjee, Sri Prakash

Pitch: Anthea Holding Limited is a Bermuda-based crypto-fintech company that offers life insurance products denominated in cryptocurrencies through its subsidiary Anthea Insurance Limited. It recently secured $22 million in Series A funding to launch the world's first life insurance product denominated in Ethereum (ETH). The company integrates traditional life insurance with blockchain technology to provide regulated, innovative insurance solutions for crypto-savvy clients and traditional investors. Anthea aims to modernize life insurance by combining digital asset exposure with protection and wealth management.

Pimly is a B2B SaaS company offering an AI-powered Product Information Management (PIM) platform built natively on Salesforce. It helps businesses streamline product data, enabling faster launches and smarter selling by integrating product, commerce, and CRM data. Pimly targets B2B and D2C companies seeking to enhance customer experiences through centralized product information management.

HOOTL builds secure, scalable automation infrastructure tailored for high-risk, highly regulated sectors such as healthcare and insurance. Their platform addresses the gap in trust and compliance that traditional automation and AI solutions struggle with, targeting clinicians, CIOs, and administrators overwhelmed by complexity. HOOTL emphasizes automation that meets privacy and regulatory demands, enabling reliable and compliant AI-driven workflows in critical environments.

CrunchLabs is a STEM toy subscription company based in Sunnyvale, California, founded by former NASA engineer Mark Rober. It provides monthly educational Build Box kits that teach kids aged 8-13 to think, build, play, test, and solve like engineers. The company emphasizes sustainability with compostable packaging and durable, repairable wooden toys. Its unique approach combines fun and hands-on engineering learning for children and kids at heart.
Investors: Galaxy Ventures, Road Capital, VanEck, Multicoin

Pitch: Rana Energy is a Nigerian clean energy startup providing innovative solar and renewable energy solutions through an Energy-as-a-Service model. They design, install, finance, insure, monitor, and maintain solar power systems, offering customers affordable, reliable, and clean energy with no upfront costs via leasing. Leveraging AI, GIS, and AR technologies, Rana targets homes, businesses, and institutions to accelerate energy transition and reduce reliance on polluting energy sources in Africa.

Helios Innovations develops a proprietary evaporation technology that purifies industrial process water using waste heat, enabling industries to reduce waste volumes and improve energy efficiency. Their modular, plug-and-play systems target industrial clients with polluted water streams, including PFAS-contaminated water. The company offers a leasing model that includes installation, maintenance, and waste concentrate disposal, providing a cost-effective and sustainable water treatment solution. Helios is recognized for its innovative approach to making evaporation—one of the most energy-intensive processes—more sustainable and profitable.

ŌURA Health is a Finnish health technology company known for the Oura Ring, a scientifically validated smart ring that tracks sleep, activity, readiness, stress, and various biometrics. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Oulu, Finland, ŌURA offers personalized health insights and daily guidance to millions of users worldwide. The company focuses on preventive health by enabling users and healthcare providers to monitor wellness and recovery through continuous biometric data.
Investors: Fidelity Management & Research Company, ICONIQ, Whale Rock, Atreides Management

Pitch: Dreamdata is a Denmark-based SaaS company providing a B2B Activation and Attribution platform that unifies customer journey data to empower marketers with precise audience targeting, AI-driven intent signals, and scalable ROI reporting. Its platform enables marketers to analyze campaign performance, sync conversions to ad platforms, and activate data-driven marketing workflows without heavy data engineering. Trusted by thousands of B2B companies, Dreamdata addresses data silos and offers the most complete B2B customer journey mapping with AI-enhanced features to optimize marketing impact and revenue growth.
Investors: PeakSpan Capital, InReach Ventures, Angel Invest, Curiosity VC, Crowberry Capital

Pitch: Epiminds develops a multi-agent AI platform, Lucy, that automates end-to-end marketing campaigns for agencies—handling reporting, optimization, bidding, creative analysis, and strategy. Agencies can onboard clients in seconds, and Lucy learns their playbooks, proactively monitors performance, and integrates with their tech stack. The system enables agencies to focus on strategy and creativity while delivering faster, more transparent results for clients.

Titan4 is an Italian SpaceTech startup founded in 2019 that provides an AI-driven Earth Intelligence platform integrating satellite imagery, ground sensor data, and climate models. Its platform delivers real-time monitoring and risk management for critical infrastructure such as bridges, dams, energy, and transport networks. The company targets public authorities and private enterprises seeking to enhance infrastructure resilience and safety through actionable insights from complex environmental data.

SirenOpt develops AI-driven sensors and software that provide real-time, non-destructive materials characterization and quality control for advanced manufacturing industries. Their PlasmaSens platform leverages cold atmospheric plasma and machine learning to generate rich material fingerprints, enabling predictive analytics and process optimization. Targeting sectors such as battery, aerospace, semiconductor, and electronics manufacturing, SirenOpt accelerates R&D and enhances production quality with inline and offline inspection solutions. Founded as a UC Berkeley spin-out in 2022, SirenOpt combines advanced materials science with manufacturing intelligence to improve industrial efficiency and product performance.

Marble is a youth mental health platform that connects schools, therapists, health plans, and families to provide accessible and effective care for students. It offers virtual therapy appointments with licensed therapists, including group and individual sessions, often within four days and accepts most insurances including Medicaid. Marble integrates AI tools to support clinicians and enhance care quality, aiming to address the youth mental health crisis by making therapy affordable and easy to access through schools and families.

SiC Systems specializes in manufacturing inductive furnaces designed for physical vapor transport growth of silicon carbide ingots, enabling industrial-scale production of SiC boules. Their furnaces feature robust, simplistic designs for high reliability and reproducibility, with customization options like automatic loading and vertical fab integration. The company leverages extensive R&D history and partnerships with academic research groups to deliver advanced process equipment for semiconductor manufacturing.

Black Forest Labs, founded in 2024 in Germany by former Stability AI employees, develops advanced generative AI models for image and video synthesis. Their flagship product suite, FLUX.1, enables precise and coherent text-to-image generation and editing, serving creators, developers, and enterprises. The company focuses on pushing the boundaries of creativity, efficiency, and diversity in generative media through cutting-edge research and scalable APIs.

Strawberry is a Swedish AI startup building an agentic browser platform that integrates AI companions to automate repetitive digital workflows directly within the browser. Founded in 2023 and recently raising $6 million in seed funding, it targets freelancers, startups, and small businesses seeking accessible AI automation without technical complexity. Its self-driving browser adapts to individual workflows, streamlining tasks like market research and lead generation, differentiating itself by embedding AI seamlessly into everyday browsing.

GEVI specializes in developing intelligent vertical-axis micro-wind turbines with AI-enhanced blade control. These turbines adapt to changing wind conditions, offering a modular and distributed energy solution suitable for urban environments. They aim to revolutionize local wind power by making it accessible and efficient for homes and small businesses.

Patchworks is a no-code/low-code iPaaS platform that simplifies integrations across various business applications, enabling retailers and brands to automate data flow and streamline operations. It supports seamless integrations with ecommerce platforms, ERPs, CRMs, and more. Patchworks is designed to facilitate rapid growth by providing a single integration backbone.
Investors: Gresham House Ventures, Palatine Growth Credit

Pitch: SymTerra is a UK-based construction site communication platform launched in 2021 that provides real-time visibility and streamlined communication across project supply chains. Its app replaces fragmented tools like WhatsApp and spreadsheets by enabling instant, intuitive interaction among contractors, subcontractors, and clients. The platform automates construction reporting, quality assurance, and compliance tracking, serving major infrastructure clients such as Thames Water and Transport for London. SymTerra's unique value lies in its bottom-up data management approach, built by experienced construction project managers to reduce rework and improve project delivery efficiency.

Wayve is a British autonomous driving technology company developing self-driving vehicle systems using end-to-end deep learning and embodied AI. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London, it focuses on vision-based AI drivers that learn from camera data and real-world driving experience, avoiding reliance on detailed 3D maps. Wayve targets automotive OEMs and fleet operators, enabling rapid deployment of L2+ to L4 autonomous driving through customizable AI software. Its innovative approach supports complex urban environments and has secured over $1.3 billion in funding from major investors.

Flow Engineering provides a collaborative hardware development platform designed for next-generation engineering teams in aerospace, defense, robotics, nuclear, and fusion industries. Their software enables teams to design, build, test, and iterate complex hardware products with agility and software-speed workflows. Flow integrates requirements, design targets, and simulation data in one place, helping companies reduce costly mistakes and accelerate product development. Their customers include leading companies building re-usable rockets, humanoid robotics, self-driving cars, and advanced nuclear technologies.
Investors: Sequoia, Odyssey Ventures, David Helgason, Patrick Collison, John Collison

Pitch: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company focused on developing reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. It has created a family of large language models named Claude and conducts extensive research in AI safety and interpretability. The company aims to deploy safe models for public use, leveraging its research to ensure the responsible development of advanced AI technologies.

AirStrip Technologies provides innovative healthcare solutions by unlocking siloed clinical data and transforming it into actionable information for clinicians. Their technology supports real-time patient monitoring and decision-making across various healthcare settings. By integrating clinical data, they enhance patient care and improve healthcare delivery. AirStrip's solutions are designed to make healthcare more accessible and efficient.

Alec's Ice Cream produces premium, regenerative organic ice cream made with A2 dairy for better digestion and sustainability. Its products are sold direct-to-consumer and in major US retailers, targeting health-conscious consumers seeking ethically sourced, environmentally friendly desserts. The company is unique as the first certified regenerative organic ice cream brand, emphasizing both taste and positive planetary impact.

Amplifi Vascular develops the Amplifi Vein Dilation System, a wearable blood pump device designed to enlarge veins before arteriovenous fistula (AVF) surgery. This technology aims to increase AVF eligibility, reduce failure rates, and provide reliable vascular access for hemodialysis patients. Its proprietary blood pump rapidly dilates veins to support early AVF maturation and prolonged patency, improving outcomes and reducing complications associated with hemodialysis access.

AnyTeam Inc. offers the world's first AI-native sales operating system designed specifically for sales representatives in B2B and enterprise environments. Its platform automates administrative sales tasks like meeting preparation and follow-ups by running AI locally on users' devices, enabling reps to focus on selling. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, it targets sales teams seeking to increase efficiency and reduce overhead through AI-driven automation and real-time sales support.

Attuned Intelligence offers a supervised AI voice platform designed specifically for hospital call centers to improve healthcare access. Their Voice AI Agent answers every call instantly, communicates in multiple languages, and safely connects patients to appropriate care while supporting frontline healthcare teams. The company combines healthcare operations expertise with advanced AI research to reduce staff burnout and improve patient experience, aiming to make healthcare access as simple and dignified as possible.

Chef Ann Foundation is a nonprofit organization founded in 2009 that promotes whole-ingredient, scratch cooking in K-12 schools across the United States. It provides professional development, grants, and online resources to help schools serve fresh, healthy, and delicious meals that support children's health and learning. The foundation also advocates for policies that increase access to healthy school meals and sustainable food systems. Its unique value lies in empowering school food professionals to transform school meal programs nationwide.

Cyvl.ai automates infrastructure inspection and management for cities and municipalities using vehicle-mounted LiDAR sensors and proprietary AI. Its platform captures and analyzes data on roads, sidewalks, signs, and related assets, generating condition scores and actionable reports to help governments prioritize repairs and allocate resources efficiently. Cyvl.ai targets public sector clients seeking to modernize infrastructure management with faster, data-driven decision-making.

Echelon AI is a startup focused on artificial intelligence solutions, operating primarily in the B2B sector. It aims to provide innovative AI-driven products and services, although specific details about its offerings are not widely available. The company is based in the United States and is part of the broader AI industry.

Enact Mortgage Insurance provides private mortgage insurance solutions to lenders and homeowners, enabling them to achieve homeownership. With a focus on borrower-centric products, Enact offers expert guidance and support throughout the mortgage process. As a leading provider in the US, Enact aims to deliver high-quality service and innovative solutions to its clients.

IonQ is a leading quantum computing company specializing in trapped-ion quantum computers. It develops and manufactures general-purpose quantum systems, providing cloud services and software solutions for executing quantum circuits. IonQ's technology is designed to solve complex problems across various industries, offering unique capabilities in quantum computing. The company collaborates closely with research institutions like the University of Maryland to advance quantum technology.

Jupiter Endovascular, Inc. is a medical technology startup developing a novel class of endovascular procedures using its proprietary Endoportal Control™ platform to provide unprecedented stability and precision in catheter-based cardiovascular interventions. Initially targeting pulmonary embolism treatment, the company aims to expand into other high-need cardiovascular applications. Its technology enables flexible navigation through vasculature with surgical-like control at the treatment site, addressing major limitations of current catheter therapies. Based in Menlo Park, California, Jupiter recently closed significant funding to support pivotal clinical trials and product development.

Archive Intel provides an AI-powered compliance and communication archiving platform designed for regulated industries. Its software automatically archives multiple digital communication channels and uses AI to reduce manual compliance workload and false positives. The platform supports firms of all sizes with scalable, customizable solutions that enable audit-ready transparency and streamline regulatory oversight. It uniquely integrates AI marketing review to ensure compliance with SEC and FINRA marketing rules while maintaining firm-level control.

Kadence is a hybrid working platform that coordinates people, places, and projects to help employees be in the right place at the right time with the right people. It focuses on enhancing productivity and collaboration in remote and hybrid work environments. The platform is designed to support businesses in managing their workforce effectively across different locations.

Munro Vehicles designs and manufactures rugged, fully electric 4x4 utility vehicles for demanding industries like agriculture, mining, and forestry. Hercle is an institutional-grade fintech company based in Milan, Italy, providing infrastructure that bridges fiat currencies, stablecoins, and digital assets. It offers a trading platform and market-making services tailored for institutional clients such as banks, asset managers, and payment providers, enabling fast, secure cross-asset and cross-border transactions. Hercle emphasizes compliance, risk management, and 24/7 liquidity access, powering seamless global money movement at scale.

Polygraf AI provides AI-native data integrity, monitoring, and governance solutions through a zero-trust framework. Its proprietary Small Language Model (SLM) technology runs on-premise to detect deepfakes, prevent data leaks, and ensure regulatory compliance in real-time. Targeting enterprises and government organizations, Polygraf AI addresses AI-driven security threats with explainable and auditable AI solutions that protect sensitive data without compromising privacy.
Investors: Allegis Capital, Alumni Ventures, DataPower VC, Domino Ventures

Pitch: Standard Economics is a fintech startup developing the Uno app, a stablecoin-based payments platform designed to facilitate fast, low-cost cross-border remittances. The company targets unbanked and underbanked populations worldwide, aiming to provide accessible, regulated stablecoin payment solutions that overcome traditional financial system barriers. Backed by major investors like Paradigm and Lightspeed, Standard Economics focuses on scalability, security, and user-friendly experiences to enable global digital financial inclusion.

Ornn AI Inc. is building the global financial infrastructure for the compute economy. It enables the creation of standardized, cash-settled futures and derivatives on GPU compute hours, allowing AI companies, data-center operators, and lenders to hedge against price volatility. Ornn's mission is to bring liquidity and stability to the compute market through its compute price indices and market analytics.
Investors: Crucible Ventures, Vine Ventures, Link Ventures, Box Group

Pitch: VeroSkills is an AI-powered staffing platform that connects blue-collar businesses with fully vetted, pre-screened skilled workers primarily from immigrant, refugee, and underserved communities. It uses AI-driven matching combined with human verification to deliver reliable hires quickly, reducing time-to-hire and improving retention. The platform handles the entire recruitment process including background checks, compliance, and payroll, targeting small and mid-sized businesses facing labor shortages in the U.S. manufacturing and trades sectors.
Investors: Yonder Ventures, Circadian Ventures, Motivate Ventures, Colchuck

Pitch: Loon is developing Canada's first regulated, Canadian-dollar-backed stablecoin (CADC), acquired from Paytrie, to provide a sovereign digital payment infrastructure for the Canadian economy. The company targets virtual-currency exchanges, fintech applications, and liquidity partners, aiming to reduce reliance on US dollar stablecoins and enable faster, more inclusive domestic transactions. Loon is actively engaging with Canadian regulators to establish standards for stablecoin issuance and operation.

Druo is a fintech company providing a global direct-debit payment network that enables businesses to accept payments directly from bank accounts, including international transactions. Its proprietary network bypasses legacy payment systems, reducing transaction costs to 0.5% and enhancing fraud protection by up to 25 times. Serving financial institutions and merchants, Druo covers over 1 billion bank accounts across 38 countries, offering a secure, fee-efficient, and inclusive payment method without relying on cards or traditional intermediaries.

Pinetree Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing bispecific antibody-based targeted protein degraders using its proprietary AbReptor™ platform. The company focuses on addressing drug resistance and preventing tumor recurrence in oncology, targeting solid tumors such as pancreatic, breast, and non-small cell lung cancers. Pinetree's innovative platform enables degradation of membrane-bound and extracellular proteins, offering a transformative approach to cancer treatment. It has an exclusive license agreement with AstraZeneca to advance its pan-EGFR degrader into clinical development.

zLinq provides comprehensive telecom lifecycle management solutions for multi-location enterprises, acting as a vendor-neutral extension of IT teams. Their services include audit, optimization, procurement, and management of voice, data, collaboration, and contact center assets from over 350 providers. They deliver measurable cost savings, enhanced visibility, and streamlined telecom operations without requiring clients to switch providers. Based in Denver, Colorado, zLinq is distinguished by its strategic approach to reducing telecom waste and improving communication efficiency.

FLiiP is a Canadian SaaS platform offering end-to-end fitness business management software designed specifically for multi-location commercial gyms. Founded in 2015 by gym owner David Bourbonnière, FLiiP provides tools to simplify operations, improve member experiences, and support scalable growth with features like CRM, payment processing, payroll, and analytics. It targets mid-size gyms including functional training, yoga, pilates, martial arts, and boxing studios, distinguished by its ease of use and focus on multi-location scalability.

Synthesia is a leading AI video generation platform that empowers businesses to create professional-looking videos with AI avatars and voiceovers in numerous languages. Its technology is used for corporate communications, training, and marketing, making video creation scalable and accessible for companies worldwide. Synthesia's platform supports over 140 languages and is used by more than sixty percent of Fortune 100 companies.

Ornn AI Inc. is building the world's first compute futures exchange, creating financial infrastructure for the compute economy. The company develops compute price indices tracking GPU compute costs across cloud and on-premise providers, enabling futures and derivatives trading to manage price volatility and liquidity. Its platform targets developers, infrastructure operators, and investors in AI and blockchain sectors. Ornn's innovation brings liquidity and stability to GPU compute as a critical resource market.
Investors: Crucible Ventures, Vine Ventures, Link Ventures, Box Group

Pitch: Polygraf AI provides an on-premise AI security platform utilizing proprietary Small Language Models to detect AI-driven threats such as deepfakes, data leaks, and synthetic content in real-time. Its technology operates in zero-trust, air-gapped environments, ensuring compliance with stringent standards like IL6 and GDPR. Targeting enterprise, defense, and intelligence sectors, Polygraf delivers autonomous countermeasures and advanced data governance to protect sensitive information and maintain operational integrity.
Investors: Allegis Capital, Alumni Ventures, DataPower VC, Domino Ventures

Pitch: Lyzr AI develops a full-stack platform that enables enterprises to build fully autonomous AI agents to automate complex workflows while ensuring complete data privacy. Their products include specialized AI agents for sales, marketing, productivity, and knowledge search, designed to enhance business efficiency and customer engagement. Headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey, Lyzr targets enterprises seeking secure, scalable AI automation solutions. The company is noted for its partnerships with AWS and accolades like the Accenture Venture Award.
Investors: Rocketship.vc, GFT Ventures, Accenture Ventures, Firstsource, Plug and Play Tech Center, BGV, Partnership Fund for New York City, Arka

Pitch: xMEMS Labs develops the world's first monolithic True MEMS speakers for true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds, hearing aids, smart glasses, and other personal audio devices. Their innovative silicon-based MEMS technology delivers precise, high-fidelity sound with unmatched clarity and spatial imaging, leveraging over 100 patents. The company targets consumer electronics and smart wearable markets, offering unique solid-state audio solutions that improve sound quality and device performance.

Helex is an early preclinical biotechnology company developing genomic medicines for high-burden kidney diseases, starting with Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease. The company leverages proprietary drug design and lipid nanoparticle delivery platforms to enable safer, targeted in vivo gene editing. Its focus is on unlocking novel therapeutics for patients with genetic kidney diseases, aiming to address significant unmet medical needs.

Kaizen builds modern, resident-focused platforms for government services, enabling cash-free, intuitive access and payment for permits, licenses, and other public sector needs. The company targets local, state, and federal government agencies, aiming to replace outdated tools with scalable, user-friendly solutions that reduce administrative friction and improve citizen satisfaction. Kaizen’s technology is designed for easy expansion across multiple government service areas, emphasizing speed, efficiency, and a seamless user experience.

Catalyx Space provides turnkey, autonomous space labs and reusable capsules for rapid, affordable orbital access, enabling customers to conduct experiments, manufacture, and process data in microgravity. Targeting innovators, researchers, and enterprises in defense, biopharma, and advanced manufacturing, the company offers a fully integrated stack—from satellite deployment to re-entry—making space missions faster and more routine.

Recess is a consumer wellness brand creating sparkling beverages and powders infused with adaptogens and nootropics designed to help people feel calm, balanced, and focused. Its products serve as a mindful alternative to traditional caffeinated or alcoholic drinks, targeting health-conscious consumers seeking mental wellness. The company is distributed in over 15,000 stores across the U.S. and is expanding its retail and marketing presence following recent funding.

DotBlocks is a no-code platform that enables users to build accessible and highly performant numerical simulation tools tailored to their needs. Its platform accelerates innovation workflows for engineers, physicists, and developers by combining state-of-the-art algorithms with a user-friendly interface. DotBlocks targets industrial clients and researchers seeking efficient, validated simulation solutions without requiring deep coding expertise. The company stands out for its rigorous scientific validation and focus on making advanced simulation accessible to non-experts.

Exiles Interactives is a Bengaluru-based gaming startup developing Centarius, a browser-based social gaming platform that supports mid-core titles and runs across multiple devices without app store restrictions. It aims to empower indie developers and expand gaming reach via social media collaborations on TikTok, Twitch, and YouTube. The platform leverages high-fidelity web graphics for immersive competitive gaming experiences.
Investors: Chimera VC, Warmup Ventures, IndigoEdge, Dhruv Vohra, Sourav Gupta

Pitch: Beyond Renewables & Recycling specializes in sustainable, high-value solar panel recycling, offering comprehensive solutions for end-of-life PV panels. The company has validated its recycling process at lab scale, achieving high recovery rates. It targets the growing need for circularity in the solar industry, aiming to turn panel waste into valuable resources and support a cleaner energy transition.
Investors: Momentum Capital, Venture Catalysts, IIMA Ventures, Oorjan

Pitch: Redacto is an AI-powered data privacy and governance platform founded in 2025 and headquartered in Bangalore, India. It offers an AI-first suite of products including automated data mapping, consent management, third-party risk monitoring, and compliance reporting to help Indian enterprises comply with the new Digital Personal Data Protection Act. Its platform enables businesses to automate privacy compliance, secure sensitive data, and ensure transparency, targeting payment companies, NBFCs, banks, fintechs, and insurance firms. Redacto aims to transform data protection from a regulatory burden into a strategic business advantage.

Vijya Fintech offers a cloud-based, full-stack wealth management platform for financial intermediaries such as MFDs, RIAs, stock brokers, PMS, and banks. Its flagship product, MadosX, provides open architecture technology connecting the fragmented financial ecosystem. The company enables digital client onboarding, trade management, and operates India's first B2B2C investment marketplace, simplifying investment processes for investors, distributors, advisors, and brokers.

iOrganBio is a biotech company based in North Carolina that has developed CellForge, the first AI-powered platform for scalable and reproducible manufacturing of human cells and organoids. Their technology uses AI-driven prediction combined with automated 3D culture control to optimize cell production for applications in drug discovery, regenerative medicine, and cell therapies. By providing precise, programmable biology, iOrganBio aims to accelerate disease modeling and therapy development while reducing costs and variability for biopharma partners.

CustoMED is an Israeli MedTech startup that uses AI-driven automation and 3D printing to provide orthopedic surgeons with patient-specific surgical guides and implants. Their cloud-based platform enables real-time, personalized pre-surgical planning, transforming medical imaging into customized surgical tools within minutes. Targeting orthopedic surgery, CustoMED aims to make precision surgery faster, more accessible, and scalable globally by integrating AI, automation, and on-demand manufacturing.
Investors: Longevity Venture Partners, Varana Capital, Flag Capital, Israel Innovation Authority, Avishai Abrahami

Pitch: BTS Software Solutions is a service-disabled veteran-owned small business headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, specializing in intelligence operations, software development, advanced engineering, and strategic advisory services primarily for the Department of Defense and intelligence community. Founded in 2011, BTS leverages a highly skilled team including data scientists, AI experts, and engineers to deliver innovative technology solutions that support defense and intelligence missions. Their portfolio includes patented technologies in telemetry data compression and tactical communications, serving agencies like DARPA, MDA, and DOD. BTS is recognized for combining small company agility with large-scale capabilities to solve complex security challenges.

Q.ANT is a deep tech company headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany, pioneering photonic processing solutions for AI and high-performance computing. Founded in 2018 as a spin-off from TRUMPF, it develops photonic processors using light for unprecedented energy efficiency and computational density. Their technology, based on Thin-Film Lithium Niobate, integrates as co-processors to dramatically improve AI workloads while reducing energy use. Q.ANT targets data centers and industries needing scalable, sustainable AI infrastructure, pushing the limits of conventional electronics with native photonic computing and sensing.

The Mobile-First Company builds an AI-powered suite of mobile apps designed for small teams, starting with Allo—an AI phone system that automates call notes and receptionist tasks. It also offers Due for AI invoicing and Claim for expense management, all accessible directly from smartphones. The company targets small businesses globally, replacing legacy software with intuitive, mobile-first tools that automate everyday workflows and connect seamlessly with existing business applications.

FAKTUS is Europe’s first neobank dedicated to small and medium-sized construction businesses, providing tailored cash flow solutions such as invoice factoring, material advances, and retention bonds through an AI-powered online platform. Founded in 2023 and based in Paris, it compresses underwriting time from weeks to hours by evaluating invoices, contracts, and sector risks. FAKTUS targets construction SMEs, supporting project-specific financing and real-time cash flow tracking, aiming to scale rapidly across Europe with a €56 million funding round backing its expansion.

SAGES is a UK-based startup pioneering sustainable colouration through innovative phytochemical extraction and biochemical dyeing processes that eliminate synthetic dyes. Their bio-chemical dyes achieve industry standards for light and wash fastness while reducing CO2 emissions by 90% and energy use due to lower temperature requirements. SAGES offers versatile, soluble dyes suitable for various fibres and easy integration into existing industrial dyeing processes, targeting textile manufacturers seeking eco-friendly alternatives.

Tethys Robotics develops compact, highly automated underwater drones for inspection and mapping in challenging aquatic environments. Its flagship product, Tethys ONE, operates as both a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) and an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV), excelling in turbid waters and high currents. The company targets industries such as hydropower, offshore wind, oil & gas, and search & rescue, offering high-resolution data collection, live 3D mapping, and enhanced safety by reducing reliance on human divers. Its technology features modular design, advanced sensor fusion, and robust navigation for reliable operations in demanding conditions.

Scavenger AI develops software that enables companies to analyze internal data without technical expertise by connecting to existing data sources and allowing natural language queries. The platform cleans and standardizes data, applies statistical models, and delivers actionable insights through visualizations or text. It is designed for SMEs and specialist departments in large companies, empowering employees across departments to make fast, data-driven decisions. Scavenger AI is GDPR-compliant and operates exclusively on EU servers.

Human Health is a digital health platform that helps people with chronic conditions track symptoms, treatments, and progress to better manage their care. The platform provides actionable insights for patients and care teams, focusing on personalized healthcare and empowering individuals to advocate for better outcomes. Founded by ex-Canva product leaders, it supports a wide range of chronic conditions and is expanding internationally with a strong emphasis on data privacy and research partnerships.
Investors: LocalGlobe, Airtree, SkipCapital, Aliavia, Scale Ventures

Pitch: Lenskart Solutions Limited is a vertically integrated eyewear company that designs, manufactures, and retails prescription glasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses through both online and offline channels. It operates one of India's largest eyewear retail networks and uses technology for remote eye testing and fast delivery. The company targets consumers seeking affordable, stylish eyewear with a seamless digital and physical shopping experience.

Fruitist grows and distributes premium, jumbo blueberries and other berries, focusing on consistent quality and size through vertical integration and select global sourcing. Its refrigerated snack cups and fresh berries are sold in major US retailers and internationally, targeting health-conscious consumers seeking reliable, nutritious alternatives to processed snacks. The company stands out for its tight supply chain control, sustainability focus, and rapid retail expansion.

Norse Atlantic ASA operates a low-cost, long-haul airline using a fleet of Boeing 787 Dreamliners to offer direct transatlantic and intercontinental flights, primarily between Europe and the United States. The company targets cost-conscious travelers seeking affordable, nonstop routes to major global cities. Its lean operational model and modern fleet differentiate it in the value segment of long-haul aviation.

EnduroSat is a Bulgarian aerospace company that designs, builds, and operates CubeSats and Nanosatellites for commercial and scientific missions. It offers unique software-defined NanoSats capable of hosting multiple space sensors at reduced cost and time. The company is developing a universal space data service and marketplace to streamline satellite data downlink, safeguarding, distribution, and commercialization. EnduroSat targets space and non-space companies by making space data more accessible and simplifying satellite operations.
Investors: Riot Ventures, GV, Lux Capital, European Innovation Council Fund, Shrug Capital

Pitch: IntrCity SmartBus is a tech-enabled intercity bus platform in India offering a fleet of branded, standardized, and safe buses with amenities like Wi-Fi, CCTV, onboard toilets, and real-time GPS tracking. Launched in 2019 as part of IntrCity, it connects over 100 cities across India using an asset-light model by partnering with local bus owners and centralizing ticket booking and route planning on its digital platform. The company targets budget travelers seeking comfortable and reliable long-distance bus travel and stands out by providing a train-like experience with high on-time performance and safety monitoring. Its recent $30 million funding round aims to expand its network further into smaller cities and towns.

Snabbit is an Indian quick-service app founded in 2024 that offers on-demand home services such as cleaning, cooking, dishwashing, and laundry. It operates a hyperlocal, full-stack model by sourcing, training, and managing its workforce in-house to deliver trusted professionals to urban households within 10-15 minutes. The platform targets busy urban consumers seeking reliable, fast, and quality domestic help, differentiating itself through speed, quality assurance, and worker welfare initiatives.
Investors: Bertelsmann India Investments, Lightspeed, Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners

Pitch: Uluu develops seaweed-based biodegradable materials as sustainable alternatives to fossil fuel plastics. Their products mimic conventional plastics in performance but are home compostable and marine biodegradable, breaking down without releasing microplastics. Targeting industries like cosmetics, fashion, and automotive, Uluu scales production from pilot to demonstration plants to supply commercial volumes globally. Their technology sequesters more CO2 than it emits, offering a climate-positive solution to plastic pollution.
Investors: Burda Principal Investments, Main Sequence, Novel Investments, Startmate, Fairground, Trinity Ventures

Pitch: The Mobile-First Company builds AI-powered mobile apps designed to simplify daily business operations for small teams, starting with Allo, an AI phone system, and expanding into invoicing and expense management. Its tools are tailored for entrepreneurs and small businesses that operate on the go, offering intuitive, mobile-native solutions that replace legacy desktop software. The company differentiates by focusing exclusively on the needs of mobile-first, real-world businesses across retail, healthcare, and professional services.

SalarySe is a fintech platform in India focused on providing financial services to salaried individuals, particularly lower to middle-class employees. It offers revolving credit via UPI payments integrated with company payrolls, using salary liens to reduce credit risk for banks. The platform also provides co-branded RuPay credit cards, rewards, and budget management tools, aiming to enhance financial accessibility and convenience for India's salaried workforce.
Investors: Flourish Ventures, Susquehanna Asia VC, Peak XV, Pravega Ventures

Pitch: Cue Labs develops and maintains CUE, an open source declarative configuration language designed to simplify and secure complex software system configurations. Their Configuration Control Plane platform enables organizations to manage, audit, and validate configuration data across environments, reducing operational risk and ensuring compliance. Based in Zug, Switzerland, Cue Labs serves global enterprises in cloud, networking, IoT, and other sectors, turning configuration from a source of outages into a source of reliability.
Investors: Sequoia Capital, OSS Capital, Founders Fund, Dell Technologies Capital

Pitch: Sparrow BioAcoustics is a Canadian medtech company that developed Stethophone, an FDA- and Health Canada-cleared smartphone app transforming phones into medical-grade stethoscopes using patented bioacoustics and AI. Their platform enables healthcare professionals and patients to capture, analyze, and share heart sounds for early detection of structural and rhythmic heart anomalies, improving accessibility and precision in cardiac diagnostics. The company targets hospitals and consumers seeking scalable, practical cardiovascular screening solutions without additional hardware.
Investors: Killick Capital, Klister Credit, Pelorus VC, 98827 Newfoundland & Labrador, Brinex Capital

Pitch: Surgical Automations develops autonomous surgical robots for endoscopic diagnostic and interventional procedures, leveraging AI-driven navigation and automation to enhance precision and control. Their flagship Vāsuki Robotic System targets gastrointestinal procedures, aiming to make endoscopy safer, faster, and easier for physicians. Based in Dallas, the company integrates advanced sensing and intuitive interfaces to improve patient care in the healthcare sector.

Homecourt is a luxury home and personal fragrance brand founded by Courteney Cox and beauty industry veterans in 2022. It offers premium, non-toxic cleaning and body care products infused with fine fragrances and skincare-grade ingredients, all packaged in 100% post-consumer recycled materials. The brand targets consumers seeking elegant, sustainable, and effective homecare solutions and has expanded distribution to over 300 retail locations including Nordstrom. Homecourt is recognized for redefining homecare with a beauty-industry approach and has secured $8M in Series A funding to accelerate growth.

VentureMed Group, Inc. develops and markets innovative endovascular medical devices targeting unmet medical needs in the treatment of peripheral arterial disease (PAD) and stenoses of arteriovenous (AV) fistulas and grafts. Their flagship product, the FLEX Vessel Prep System, facilitates vessel preparation by creating precise micro-incisions to improve vessel compliance and clinical outcomes. The company serves interventionalists and vascular specialists, offering FDA-cleared and CE-marked solutions that enhance treatment efficacy and patient care.

Voxel leverages AI and computer vision to enable security cameras to automatically identify hazards and high-risk activities in real-time, helping organizations improve workplace safety and operational efficiency. Its platform delivers real-time notifications of safety violations and detailed incident reports to on-site personnel. Targeting industrial and commercial environments, Voxel's solution reduces preventable injuries and provides full site visibility through advanced video analytics.

Dream Exchange is the first minority-owned stock exchange in the United States, establishing a National Market System Exchange and a Venture Exchange to increase access to public capital markets for small and mid-cap companies, particularly underrepresented founders and minority-owned businesses. Founded in 2018, it leverages proven trading technology from MEMX to provide a secure, fast, and efficient trading platform. The exchange aims to democratize IPO opportunities, stimulate innovation, create jobs, and build wealth across diverse communities by bridging gaps in capital market participation.

Hoop.dev provides secure, auditable access to infrastructure and data for developers and agents, enabling fast and compliant workflows. Its platform offers zero-configuration data masking, granular access controls, automated reviews, and runbook automation. The solution is designed for engineering teams needing to maintain security and compliance without sacrificing speed. Hoop.dev stands out by integrating security directly into developer workflows, making safe actions the fastest path.

FrontlineIQ is an AI sales coaching platform headquartered in Montreal, Canada, that enhances in-person frontline sales performance through AI-driven skill development, structured coaching, and real-time behavioral insights. It targets frontline teams in retail, automotive, finance, and telecom sectors, enabling managers to set goals, track progress, and improve sales effectiveness. The platform has demonstrated rapid ROI and adoption by major brands such as Ashley HomeStore and Hyundai, distinguishing itself by focusing on face-to-face sales coaching and performance intelligence.

KapKap is an AI-powered video generation and editing platform that enables creators to produce high-quality talking videos, animated characters, and marketing content. Its features include lip-sync video generation, AI scriptwriting, teleprompter tools, and multi-language support. The platform targets marketers, vloggers, and businesses seeking to streamline video production with advanced AI capabilities. KapKap stands out by integrating AI-driven enhancements and supporting both web and mobile deployments.

Bevel is an AI-powered health companion app that synthesizes users' health data from various sources to provide personalized insights and recommendations across sleep, fitness, nutrition, and stress management. Targeting individuals seeking to actively manage their well-being, Bevel emphasizes user empowerment by positioning users as the CEO of their health with technology and doctors as advisors. The app supports interoperability with multiple wearables and prioritizes privacy by not storing or sharing data without permission. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in New York, Bevel aims to extend healthspan through actionable, data-driven health guidance.

Applied Compute builds Specific Intelligence by training custom AI models on a company's internal knowledge, enabling in-house agent workforces to support human teams. The company targets enterprises seeking to unlock AI's potential through tailored models and agent-based solutions. Founded by former OpenAI researchers, it focuses on deploying agent workforces that scale with business needs and are deeply integrated into corporate workflows.
Investors: Benchmark, Sequoia Capital, Lux Capital, Elad Gil

Pitch: PhonePe is an Indian fintech company offering a digital payments platform based on the Unified Payments Interface (UPI). It enables users to send and receive money, recharge mobile and DTH, pay utility bills, and make in-store and online payments. The app also provides financial services such as insurance, mutual fund investments, gold purchases, and stock trading. PhonePe stands out by supporting multiple Indian languages and expanding into hyperlocal e-commerce and international UPI payments.

All's Well Health Care Services is a privately held healthcare staffing company based in the United States. It provides cost-effective staffing solutions for nurses, allied health professionals, therapists, and healthcare administrative personnel. The company operates with a focus on delivering high-quality, around-the-clock recruitment services year-round. Its unique value lies in combining innovative, human-centered AI solutions with personalized staffing to enhance healthcare teams' capabilities.
Investors: Amboy Street Ventures, Seae Ventures’ Unseen Capital, Techstars

Pitch: The Prompting Company helps brands get mentioned in ChatGPT and other AI assistants by optimizing their content for generative engine optimization (GEO). It builds AI-friendly web pages that answer specific product-intent queries, enabling brands to appear in AI-generated recommendations. The company targets B2B clients seeking visibility in the era of AI-driven product discovery, offering a new approach distinct from traditional SEO.
Investors: Peak XV Partners, Base10, Y Combinator, Firedrop
